asset_description: A young man in a gym flexes and poses in front of the big wall mirror, moving in sync with his reflection like a game. Friends in yellow and purple shirts gather around and everyone flexes at the mirror, laughing.
title: mirror_481

asset_description: A macaque monkey climbs a huge banyan tree by a mossy temple, swings along a branch and hangs upside down by its tail. It drops onto a fruit seller's table, grabs a banana while the man waves his hat at it, then sits on a branch peeling and eating the banana.
title: monkey_483

asset_description: In an animated late-night diner, a waitress dunks a mop into a red bucket, wrings it out dripping, and mops the checkered floor between stacked chairs. She nearly slips on the wet tiles, catches herself, and finally leans on the mop admiring the shiny clean floor.
title: mop_484

asset_description: In a misty forest full of green-covered boulders, two people press their hands into the thick springy moss on a rock, leaving hand prints that slowly spring back. One squeezes a wet clump of moss so water drips out, then a woman rests her cheek on the soft mossy rock like a pillow.
title: moss_485

asset_description: A drone view shows a huge snow-capped mountain with a zigzag trail climbing through forest. Then a hiker's point of view walks over rocky ground above a sea of clouds, and finally two hikers stand on the snowy summit raising their trekking poles in celebration.
title: mountain_486
transcript: Oh wow, the valley floor dropped away dramatically.

asset_description: In a warm-lit wooden barn at night, a little grey mouse peeks out of a hole in the wall and creeps toward a piece of cheese on the floorboards. It sits up, nibbles the cheese held in its tiny pink paws, then scurries back into the hole with its tail sliding in last.
title: mouse_487

asset_description: In a gym, a skinny red-haired teen flexes his thin arms and groans at how small they look. A fit woman steps in and flexes visibly bigger biceps next to him, then a huge bearded bodybuilder flexes enormous muscles while the teen's jaw drops in shock.
title: muscle_488

asset_description: In an autumn forest, a couple with a wicker basket crouches over the leaf-covered ground where the woman points out a cluster of brown mushrooms with dewy caps. They then find a bright red mushroom with white spots glowing in the sunbeams and marvel at it without picking it, while a squirrel darts past.
title: mushroom_489

asset_description: On a cobblestone street at sunset, a red-haired young busker strums an acoustic guitar and sings to a circle of people. The crowd films him with their phones and applauds, and his open guitar case with coins lies at his feet.
title: musician_490

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a man tastes a spoonful of bright yellow mustard from a stone bowl and winces at its sharp taste. He whisks the mustard with honey into a glaze, brushes it over a tray of carrots, and a woman tastes the result and reacts with delighted surprise.
title: mustard_491
transcript: Ooh, sharp! Sweet and sharp, wow!

asset_description: At a sunny patio table with iced drinks, a woman shakes a bottle of coral nail polish, opens it and carefully paints her fingernails with the little brush. She blows on the wet nails and waves her hand stiffly, refusing to touch anything while her friend teases her.
title: nail_polish_492

asset_description: A couple climbs over a wooden fence and walks through a green alpine meadow toward a clear stony stream. They quietly watch two deer grazing on the far bank, then lie down side by side in the wildflower grass gazing up at the sky.
title: nature_495

asset_description: On a terrace full of pink flowers, a young woman holds up a colorful beaded necklace of red, blue and yellow strands. Her friends help her slip it over her head onto her white shirt, and she admires it in a small hand mirror, delighted.
title: necklace_496

asset_description: Backstage in the dark wings, a young musician with an acoustic guitar peeks through the curtain at the bright stage. He gulps water, breathes with wide anxious eyes and a hand on his chest, and when the stage manager points him on, he steels himself and walks out in front of the crowd.
title: nervous_498

asset_description: At an outdoor cafe table with coffee and a croissant, a woman opens a huge broadsheet newspaper that completely hides her face. Her boyfriend leans over as she plays peek-a-boo from behind the pages, then she folds the newspaper up neatly and they leave together laughing.
title: newspaper_499
transcript: The whole world's in here! Peek-a-boo!

asset_description: On a floodlit caged pitch at night, a player in a white hoodie dribbles a football toward a defender in teal. He beats him with quick skill touches, sprints away with the ball at his feet and finishes by shooting into the small goal.
title: dribble_500
transcript: Oh my head! No way, no way! He's gone!

asset_description: A young couple walks home through a quiet whitewashed village street at night under the moon and street lamps, a black cat trailing them. They say good night at a blue door and the man walks off alone down the dark lane.
title: night_501

asset_description: Two cartoon hikers in winter parkas stand in a rocky arctic landscape and check a golden compass whose needle settles on N. The woman points the way, and they hike off toward mountains under the northern lights.
title: north_502
transcript: There. It stopped. This way? Straight ahead. Come on. [whistling] [music playing]

asset_description: Two young women sit at a desk with pens and washi tape; one unwraps a brand-new mint-green notebook and flips through its blank pages. She then writes the first line in it with a pen while her friend claps excitedly.
title: notebook_503

asset_description: A couple sits at a wooden garden table in autumn with a bowl of walnuts. The man cracks one open with a metal nutcracker, shows the two shell halves with the kernel inside, and they both snack on the nuts happily.
title: nut_505

asset_description: Two runners in sportswear build a colorful healthy plate in a kitchen: spinach, oats, tomato slices, avocado, berries, eggs and nuts arranged in rings. They taste it, celebrate, and jog out the door with their packs.
title: nutrition_506

asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a girl crouches by a grassy stream and holds a magnifying glass up to a dragonfly perched on a cattail. She watches it closely and intently, then smiles at what she sees.
title: observe_507

asset_description: From the deck of a sailboat, endless deep-blue water stretches to the horizon under a clear sky. Dolphins leap out of the waves beside the boat while the crew in sailing jackets points and cheers.
title: ocean_508

asset_description: In a sunny Greek-style kitchen, golden olive oil is poured slowly from a bottle into a dish, pooling in circles. Tomato slices are laid in the oil, and a couple dips chunks of fresh bread into a small bowl of it and eats with delight.
title: oil_509

asset_description: A man peels a white onion, halves it on a cutting board and starts slicing, but his eyes water and he wipes tears while a woman behind him cries too. He then puts on blue swim goggles, gives a thumbs up, and happily finishes chopping the onion.
title: onion_511

asset_description: A young woman and a guy lay clothes out on a bed, swapping pieces: a rust jacket, a cream blouse, dark jeans traded for cream trousers, white sneakers and a straw hat. She then wears the finished combination and checks herself in the mirror while he cheers.
title: outfit_512

asset_description: On a sunny savanna, a family carries their table, chairs, a woven mat and a big pot of food out of their small house onto the grass. They set everything up in the open air and sit down to eat together in front of the house.
title: outside_513

asset_description: A young couple slides a tray of raw bread dough into a kitchen oven and crouches at the glass door, watching the light inside as the loaf rises and turns golden. Wearing oven mitts, they pull out the finished brown loaf, thrilled.
title: oven_514

asset_description: In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.
title: overcome_515

asset_description: In a cel-animated kitchen, a man fills the sink to wash dishes but looks away, and the foamy water rises over the rim and pours onto the floor. He rushes back to shut the tap and stands sheepishly in a big puddle.
title: overflow_516

asset_description: In a cel-animated desert highway scene, a red sports car pulls alongside a slow beige camper van, speeds past it and swings in front. The camper shrinks in the distance while the grinning driver whoops and races ahead.
title: overtake_517

asset_description: An extreme close-up of a huge orange eye pulls back to reveal a grey owl staring into the camera. It perches on a branch at dusk, swiveling its head, then spreads its wings and flies off toward the sunset over the forest.
title: owl_518

asset_description: Hands fill an empty beige tote bag laid on a bed: a pink water bottle goes into a side pocket, then notebooks and books, a pencil pouch and earphones each find their place. The full bag is zipped up and lifted by its straps, ready to go.
title: pack_519
transcript: I pack my bag for school. I put my books, my bottle, and my pens inside.

asset_description: A smiling girl in a life jacket dips a wooden paddle into a calm green river and strokes on both sides of a canoe, gliding past bamboo and orange cliffs. A man in a sun hat lies dozing in the bow and gets a few drips on his face as she paddles over him.

asset_description: A barefoot young man carrying a laundry basket stubs his toe on a metal bed frame, drops the laundry, cries out and sits on the floor clutching his hurt foot.

asset_description: On a sunny Santorini terrace, a young woman at an easel mixes blue paint and paints a seascape of the coast in front of her, then smiles and presents the finished painting, joking it is better than the real view.
title: painting_522
transcript: Big, bold, blue. Better than the real one.

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a man in an apron oils a steel frying pan, adds sliced peppers and onion, tosses the vegetables high in the pan while a woman watches amazed, then slides them onto a plate.
title: pan_523
transcript: Little one first! The big door!

asset_description: On a metro platform a young woman with blue hair frantically pats her pockets, dumps her tote bag on the ground to search through keys, wallet and phone, then rushes at the closing train doors and grabs her head in wide-eyed despair as the train leaves.
title: panic_524

asset_description: In an office a desk fan blows sheets off a paper stack while two coworkers scramble; the woman takes a paperclip from a glass dish, clips the stack together, and the papers now hold even in front of the fan as they celebrate.
title: paperclip_525
transcript: The pages catch! Holds even now!

asset_description: In a cartoon workshop a young scientist fires a ray gun at a man in a green tracksuit; he freezes mid-step with a glowing outline, stuck rigid in one pose while she waves at him and tests him, and he finally tips over stiff as a board into her arms.

asset_description: A courier in a yellow vest hands a surprised red-haired woman a brown paper parcel tied with string at her garden gate; she carries it to the front door, shakes it curiously while a man watches, then opens the box and pulls out the tissue-wrapped contents excitedly.
title: parcel_527

asset_description: In a colorful cartoon beach town a young woman carefully steers her teal car into a street parking space between two cars, turns the key off, and steps out beaming while a man on the curb applauds her neat parking.

asset_description: A bright red scarlet macaw perches on a wooden porch railing in front of tropical flowers and banana leaves, flaps a wing, preens its yellow-and-blue feathers, tilts its head and squawks Hello at the camera.

asset_description: At sunset a group of friends holds a garden party with bunting, balloons, a snack table and lemonade; they dance on the grass with a dog running around, throw confetti and raise their cups in a toast.

asset_description: On a paved plaza in a colorful mountain town, players in teal shirts play street football against a defender; the man passes the ball to his teammate, she takes it, shoots at the small goal and the two celebrate with a hug.
title: pass_532

asset_description: In a cartoon airport a woman in a pink jacket hands her blue passport to a border officer, who flips through the stamped pages, checks her photo against her big grin, stamps a page and gives it back; she kisses the passport and rolls her suitcase through the gate.
title: passport_533

asset_description: In an Italian kitchen a chef fans dry spaghetti into a big pot, boils and tastes it, lifts the strands with tongs into a pan of tomato sauce, then serves a tall twirled tower of pasta on a plate that a woman happily slurps.
title: pasta_535
transcript: Find it! In they go! Now twirl it!

asset_description: A young woman in linen pajamas steps onto a tropical veranda at sunrise, sets a mug of coffee on a stool, settles into a rope hammock among palm trees and relaxes with closed eyes while an orange cat climbs onto her lap.
title: peace_536

asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene a girl with a braid sits on a porch above green fields and peels a red apple with a small knife in one long unbroken spiral that drops into a basket, then holds up the fully peeled pale apple.
title: peel_537

asset_description: A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.

transcript: Look at my pen. This pen is so cool. I click the pen and I write in many colors.

asset_description: On a sun-baked pitch a referee points to the spot; a player in orange places the ball on the penalty mark, takes a run-up and shoots past the diving green goalkeeper, then her whole team mobs her in celebration.
title: penalty_540

asset_description: A young woman in a beret sketches a mountain landscape with a yellow pencil in an open notebook at a sunny wooden table, while a bearded man watches and applauds her finished drawing.

asset_description: A gentoo penguin waddles across Antarctic snow toward the camera, flops onto its belly to slide down the ice, then dives into the sea and swims underwater past the ice edge.
title: penguin_542

asset_description: A man in a bright kitchen grinds black pepper from a tall wooden pepper mill over a bowl of creamy pasta, then the pepper tickles his nose and he sneezes into his elbow before laughing and presenting the dish.

transcript: (upbeat music) Grind, grind, grind. Ah, ah. (laughs)

asset_description: Two street performers juggle colorful clubs inside a chalk circle on a cobblestone old-town square, tossing clubs high while a large crowd rings them, watches and applauds, and the pair finally bow beside their tip hat.
title: performance_545

asset_description: In an ornate Moroccan-style courtyard at night, a young woman sprays perfume from a small amber bottle onto her wrist and neck, then playfully sprays big clouds of it at her friend, who laughs, waves the mist away and finally gives a thumbs up.
title: perfume_546
transcript: Smells amazing. Too much, too much.

asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a phone rings on a wooden table while two young women drink tea; one grabs it excitedly, answers the call and paces around chatting happily with her hand pressed to her cheek.
title: phone_547

asset_description: At golden hour in a narrow cobblestone street, a young woman directs a man posing against a sunlit wall, shoots him with a large camera, then the two lean over the camera screen together, pointing at the shots and celebrating the best one.

transcript: Three, two, hold! That one! That one!

asset_description: At a mirror with vanity lights, a young woman points to the small piercing holes in her ear, picks a gold hoop from a jewelry tray, fits it into an ear piercing and admires the rings in her ear with a thumbs up.
title: piercing_549
transcript: Four tiny holes. New ring day.

asset_description: A big pink pig rolls happily in a muddy patch on a sunny farmyard, gets up, roots in the dirt with its snout, trots across the yard and drinks from a metal bucket while a farmer watches by the fence.
title: pig_550

asset_description: A grey pigeon struts between cafe chairs on a cobblestone city square, pecks around with other pigeons near a fountain, then flies up and lands on a terracotta rooftop.
title: pigeon_551

asset_description: A groundskeeper in a flat cap mows the striped grass of a stadium football pitch, checks the fresh white lines with his boot, plants the yellow corner flag and stands proudly with crossed arms while players train in the background.
title: pitch_553

asset_description: A young woman carries a rolled mat along a wide tropical beach, scans the shore for the right spot, announces she has found it, unrolls the mat under a white umbrella and sits down facing the sea.
title: place_554

asset_description: In a bright plant-filled apartment, a woman waters a potted plant with a gold watering can, wipes its big green leaves with a cloth, then she and a man excitedly point at a fresh new leaf shooting up from a pot while a cat watches.
title: plant_555
transcript: Look at that! A new one!

asset_description: A red-haired woman winces and shows a cut finger in a kitchen; a man opens a small first-aid tin, peels the backing off an adhesive plaster, wraps it around her fingertip and playfully blows on the bandaged finger.

transcript: Ow! Tiny cut! I've got this. All wrapped up.

asset_description: A chef polishes a large white plate with a cloth, twirls spaghetti in tomato sauce onto its center with tongs, adds basil and a ring of olive oil, wipes the rim clean and proudly serves the plate to a delighted woman at a candlelit table.
title: plate_557

asset_description: An animated group of friends plays volleyball in a sunny park: a man dives for the ball and loses his hat, a woman leaps to spike over the net, and the mixed teams end up laughing and hugging on the grass.
title: play_558

asset_description: Under floodlights at night, a football player in a yellow kit dribbles past a defender in blue, fires the ball into the goal, then slides on his knees screaming with joy as teammates pile on top of him.
title: player_559

asset_description: A young woman takes an excited nighttime selfie in a crowded square, then the camera swings around to reveal the illuminated Trevi Fountain, panning over its turquoise water and marble statues.
title: fountain_560

asset_description: A young woman in a grey beanie and red scarf bites into a fresh croissant outside a bakery, closes her eyes and savors it with a blissful face, saying "Oh wow". She then shares it with a friend on the bench, who tastes it and enjoys it just as much.
title: pleasure_561

asset_description: A couple's floor lamp goes dark, and they frown and investigate. Following the cable, they find the white two-pin plug lying loose on the floor, hold it up to the camera saying "Well, there's why", then push it into the wall socket and the lamp lights up again.
title: plug_562
transcript: Well, there's why. Let there be light!

asset_description: A red-haired young man by a stone wall pats himself down asking "Where are they?" and digs through the many pockets of his green jacket, pulling out random things like a pebble, a wrapper and a woolly glove. Finally he fishes his keys out of a pocket and holds them up in relief while his friend sips coffee.
title: pocket_563
transcript: Where are they? In your pocket.

asset_description: In a gymnastics hall, athletes push three foam blocks together to build a three-step winners' podium while teammates watch. Three gymnasts in tracksuits climb onto first, second and third place; the winner in the middle throws her arms up, then all three join hands, wave and bow.
title: podium_564

asset_description: In an animated town square, two rival candidates - a woman in an orange suit and a man in teal with a green rosette - stand on crates shouting "Vote for me!" while the crowd waves orange and green fans. title: politics_565
transcript: Vote for me, friends! No! Vote for me! Yeah! Well done. Good luck!

asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a man tips a rusty barrel of brown sludge off his truck into a clean river between rice terraces; the muck spreads across the water while fish scatter and a chimney smokes in the hills. A girl in a yellow raincoat wading with a bucket finds the water fouled, covers her nose and says "Oh no!" sadly.
title: pollute_566

asset_description: Two young people kneel at the mossy stone edge of a small garden pond ringed by ferns and purple irises. They point excitedly ("Oh wow. Whoa!") at orange goldfish gliding under the lily pads, and a fish splashes, sending ripples across the still water.
title: pond_567

asset_description: At a sunny outdoor swimming pool ringed by pink flowering bushes, a woman relaxes on an orange inflatable ring while two guys cannonball off the edge one after another, sending up huge splashes and laughter. Afterwards the men float on their backs beside her in the turquoise water.
title: pool_568

asset_description: In a 2D cartoon post office, a stern grey-haired woman in uniform with a ring of keys throws open the doors shouting "Open! Everybody in!" and bosses two clerks around. title: postmaster_569
transcript: Open! Everybody in! They're falling! Yes boss!

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a young couple fills a big metal pot with water, sets it over an open fire and tips small potatoes into it. They cover it with a lid, peek inside as it boils and joke that the water is "dancing", then lift a cooked potato out on a fork through the steam.
title: pot_571
transcript: Watching won't help. Look, it's dancing!

asset_description: In a vegetable garden, a man levers a leafy potato plant out of the dark soil with a spade ("Easy and lift!") and golden potatoes tumble from its roots. A woman kneels down, picks the potatoes out of the dirt admiring how many there are, and together they fill a metal bucket with the harvest.
title: potato_572
transcript: Easy and lift! Look how many!

asset_description: A young barman in an apron pours orange juice from a big plastic jug into a row of glasses on a wooden counter, filling them one by one. He shows off by pouring from higher and higher - "Steady, steady. Not a drop!" - while a woman watches open-mouthed, and every glass ends up neatly filled.
title: pouring_573
transcript: (upbeat music) - Steady, steady. - Not a drop!

asset_description: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".
title: powder_574

asset_description: On a park bench, a young man despairs over his dead phone - "No plugs anywhere!" - throwing his hands up. His friend digs a power bank out of her bag ("Pocket power!"), they plug the phone into it on the bench, watch it charge and celebrate with a fist pump.
title: power_bank_575

asset_description: A stressed student at a desk piled with textbooks and a laptop presses her palms together, looks up at the ceiling and begs "Please, I pray for a good grade... I want to pass my exam". She dramatically pleads into the camera with clasped hands and desperate eyes.
title: pray_576
transcript: Please, I pray for a good grade. I pray and I pray. I want to pass my exam, please, or pass my--

asset_description: In a hand-painted anime seaside scene, a woman points up at a single dark cloud and calmly gets her yellow umbrella ready while the man beside her scoffs "No chance!". Seconds later rain pours down exactly as she said; she stays dry under the umbrella and he laughs, admitting "You knew it!".
title: predict_577
transcript: No chance! Oh! Haha! You knew it!

asset_description: A woman mechanic in overalls wheels a vintage motorcycle she has restored out of her garage onto a sunlit cobbled street and polishes its silver tank. Neighbours gather around admiring it while she stands tall beside the bike, crosses her arms and beams, saying "There! I did that."
title: pride_578

asset_description: A young couple sits at a laptop trying to code a small wheeled robot that stands on a paper track on the table. The robot won't obey, they groan with heads in hands, then type new code, and suddenly the robot drives along the drawn track - "It works!" - so they cheer, high-five and kiss.
title: programming_579

asset_description: In a 3D-animated storm on a lake pier, a tall strong woman whips off her orange coat and stretches it over a smaller bespectacled woman carrying a picnic basket, shouting "Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!". She shields her from the pouring rain all the way to a stone boathouse, then wraps the coat around her shoulders and hugs her.
title: protect_580
transcript: Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!

asset_description: A crowd marches through a sunny city square carrying green flags, sunflowers and hand-painted signs of a tree, a water drop, a sun and green hearts. They link arms, chant together and raise the signs while cafe guests watch.
title: protesting_581
transcript: (upbeat music) - Hey, hey, hey, hey! - Sign's up, everyone! - All together, now! (cheering)

asset_description: In a carpentry workshop a young woman finishes a wooden chair, presses the seat to test it, puts her hands on her hips and admires it. She sits down, crosses her arms and beams with pride while an older colleague congratulates her.
title: proud_582

asset_description: A 3D-animated young woman faces a doubting friend who stands with crossed arms. She kicks up into a perfect handstand, holds it while his face turns from smug to amazed, then lands; he applauds and admits she won.
title: prove_584
transcript: No way! Okay, okay, you win.

asset_description: In a hand-painted animated city square a young woman sits on a case and plays a red accordion beside a fountain. Workers, elderly people and families stop one by one until a large crowd rings the square to listen.
title: public_585

asset_description: A cartoon referee holds up a black puck and drops it for a face-off between purple and yellow teams. A player in yellow wins it, skates up the ice, fires the puck past the purple goalie into the net and celebrates holding it up.
title: puck_587
transcript: Ready? Here it comes! Whoa! Yes! In!

asset_description: On a narrow street after rain, people in red and black rubber boots and bright raincoats jump together into a big puddle that mirrors the blue sky. The splash sends ripples across the water while they laugh.
title: puddle_588

asset_description: At a village tug-of-war a man and a woman strain backwards pulling a thick rope until the red marker crosses the chalk line. They win, collapse on the grass laughing, and the onlookers applaud while a dog runs over.

asset_description: In a boxing gym a young woman in red gloves throws fast combinations, punching the black focus pads her trainer holds up. She works through jabs and hooks in rhythm and finishes the round laughing with him.

asset_description: Two young men lean into the back doors of a white van on a residential street, counting and pushing with all their strength. The van slowly rolls away down the road and they stand up, laugh and high-five.

title: pyjamas_593

asset_description: A wild brown rabbit moves through grassy dunes at sunset. It hops between tufts, sits upright on its hind legs with ears tall, nibbles clover, washes its face with its paws and bounds away.
title: rabbit_595

title: rain_598

asset_description: Two footballers face off one-on-one on indoor and outdoor pitches, chaining rapid stepovers, feints and direction changes to beat each other. Defenders lunge and slide in as the quick-cut compilation strings the fast moves together.
title: rapid_599

asset_description: At night on a city sidewalk a rat scurries past a parked bike to a pizza box lying on a manhole cover. It stands up on its hind legs, sniffs the steam, grabs a slice and drags it across the pavement down into the open drain, cheese stretching behind.
title: rat_600

asset_description: A man with shaving foam on his face shaves with an electric razor at a bathroom mirror while his impatient friend behind him taps his watch and hands him a shirt.
title: razor_601
transcript: (upbeat music) - Whose morning magic? (upbeat music) - Smooth in seconds.

asset_description: An animated red-haired girl with glasses reads a thick book at a table on a night train through snowy mountains; a plot twist makes her gasp and cover her mouth before she sips cocoa and keeps reading.
title: reading_602

asset_description: In a hand-painted village grocery, a cashier rings up a man's basket of fruit and the old register prints an endless receipt that spirals around his body; he studies the huge list, then rolls it up and pockets it.
title: receipt_604
transcript: Oh, dear. Sorry. It's still going. Here, keep it, please.

title: recipe_606
transcript: Step one, eggs. Just like the card.

asset_description: Two hikers in rain jackets walk across green Icelandic terrain toward a tall waterfall pouring off a cliff. They stop on the black rocks at its base, where a rainbow hangs in the spray, and spread their arms in awe.

asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at sunset, a couple fills a metal watering can at a tap and pours water over their potted tomatoes and herbs. A droopy basil plant gets a good shower and they lean in happily as it revives.
title: watering_867
transcript: Heavy, but worth it. Look, it's coming back!

asset_description: Two swimmers turn to see a huge green wave rising behind them at the beach. It curls and crashes right over their heads, and they come up in the foam and sprint out of the surf onto the sand.
title: wave_868

asset_description: In a garage gym a woman carries a heavy round plate, swings a kettlebell, and a big man heaves a huge stone ball onto a wooden box with a shout. The two then flex their arms proudly beside the box.
title: weight_869

asset_description: A group of friends stands at a wooden railing over the sea at dusk. One of them points at the setting sun on the horizon, and they all watch quietly as it sinks and the sky turns dark orange, clapping at the end.
title: west_870

asset_description: A basketball player in a sports wheelchair speeds across an indoor court, dribbling beside his wheels. He rolls to the hoop, shoots and scores, then fist-pumps and celebrates with a teammate in another wheelchair.
title: wheelchair_871

asset_description: At a garden table under a lemon tree, a young man whistles and coaches his friend to do it too. Her first tries produce only air, but she keeps puckering her lips and finally gets a real whistle out, and they both cheer.
title: whistling_872
transcript: *whistling* Nothing, just air! *whistling* *whistling* That's it, you did it! *whistling*

asset_description: A married couple enjoys a morning at home: the woman flips a pancake while her husband claps, they clink coffee mugs, and she straightens his tie with her wedding ring in view before they flop onto the sofa laughing.
title: wife_873

asset_description: At a vanity mirror a young woman lifts a pink bob of fake hair off a white mannequin head and pulls it on over her own hair, striking poses. Her friend then claps a curly ginger one onto his shaved head and they both mug for the mirror.
title: wig_874
transcript: Oh! A whole new me! And off it comes!

asset_description: On a green field with bending poplars and a windmill, a couple's hair whips around and the woman's yellow scarf is torn off and flies across the grass. Sheets on a clothesline billow wildly, and she leans her whole body against the gusts, laughing.
title: wind_875

asset_description: In a vineyard a woman touches a bunch of dark grapes on the vine, then pours red wine from a bottle into a glass at a small table. She swirls it, smells it, sips, and clinks glasses with a man as the sun sets over the rows of vines.
title: wine_876
transcript: Swirl and smell. The grapes right there.

asset_description: In an animated mud obstacle race, a muddy woman in an orange top strains ahead of two rivals and breaks the white finish tape first. She screams with joy, receives a gold trophy, kisses it and is lifted on her competitors' shoulders under falling confetti.
title: winner_877
transcript: First! You were first! This was mine!

asset_description: Two friends sled down a snowy slope past snow-covered pines, tumble laughing into a drift, then build a small snowman with a carrot nose above a snow-covered alpine village. At dusk they sit on their sleds watching the village lights come on.
title: winter_878

asset_description: A grey wolf walks toward the camera across deep snow on a mountain ridge at dusk, pine forest behind it. It stops, lifts its head and howls, breath steaming in the cold, then turns and trots away.
title: wolf_879

asset_description: A cartoon farm girl shears a fluffy sheep, hugs the huge pile of soft wool, spins it on a spinning wheel into a ball of yarn and knits a cream sweater. She then dresses the now-bald lamb in the sweater and it runs off happily across the field.
title: wool_880

asset_description: In a Pixar-style animated gym, a woman in a purple tank top powers through a full workout — barbell squats, push-ups, kettlebell swings, punching-bag hits and pull-ups — cheered on by her small dog, then collapses happily on the mat shouting that she is done.
title: workout_882
transcript: One more! One more! Come on! Done! Ha ha!

asset_description: A sweeping dusk panorama over Istanbul — the curving waterway, ferries, domes and lit minarets — then a couple on a rooftop terrace gazes over the endless sea of city lights and the woman spreads her arm toward the horizon. Music only, no speech.
title: world_884

asset_description: Macro shot in a rain-wet garden bed: a pink earthworm rises out of the dark soil under big green leaves, wriggles across the dirt past a small snail and pebbles, then burrows back down until only its tail tip sticks up. Music only, no speech.
title: worm_885

asset_description: Selfie video under a grape pergola: a young woman scrunches her forehead to show her temporary frown lines and says hers just vanish, then her white-haired grandmother leans in, points proudly at the deep wrinkles on her own face and jokes that she earned these; both laugh.
title: wrinkle_886
transcript: Mine just vanish. I earned these.

asset_description: Close-up of a woman's hand opening a lined journal on a wooden table and writing a cursive line starting with 'Dear' with a black pen, then laying the pen in the closed-up notebook. Voiceover: she likes to write in her book every day and writing makes her happy.
title: write_887
transcript: I like to write. I write in my book every day. Writing makes me happy.

asset_description: A sleepy couple in pajamas stands in a morning kitchen with coffee mugs; the man does a huge stretching yawn, apologizes, and the woman immediately catches it and yawns too — they keep passing the yawn back and forth until even their dog joins in.
title: yawning_888

asset_description: At a kitchen table a woman turns a jar of thick white yogurt upside down to show it does not pour, spoons the creamy yogurt into a bowl, drizzles honey and adds berries and oats, then eats a big spoonful while her boyfriend watches amazed.
title: yogurt_889

asset_description: Outside a hotel at night a young man in a yellow shirt is caught fiddling with the silver hood ornament of a light-blue Rolls-Royce; warned off-camera that the car is so expensive — about 400 grand — his eyes go wide, he points at the ornament in disbelief, then leans down and strokes the hood, apologizing to the car.
title: expensive_891
transcript: Hey! Don't touch that! This thing is so expensive. How much? Like 400 grand. Oh! Oh no, sorry baby.

asset_description: A young woman in a yellow bikini steps under an outdoor shower on a wooden beach boardwalk, the sea and white sand behind her. She rinses the seawater off, running her hands through her wet hair while she talks to the camera about how good the shower feels.
title: rinse_892
transcript: Okay, this shower is actually the best part of the beach.

asset_description: In an animated snowy town street, a blond young person in a teal puffer jacket grips the zipper pull with gloved hands and pulls it all the way up to the chin, then flips the hood up and grins as snow falls.
title: zip_893

asset_description: Extreme close-up of the zipper on a rust-orange ski jacket. A blonde woman in a red beanie outside a snowy cabin fights with the stuck zipper, yanks it free and pulls it up over her chin, grinning at her friend before they walk off with ski poles.
title: zipper_894

asset_description: A hand lowers two slices of white bread into slots on the back of a grey model fighter jet standing on a granite kitchen counter. The heating elements inside the slots glow orange and a blue-and-orange flame roars out of the jet's exhaust nozzle like an afterburner. The flame dies down and the hand lifts out two browned slices.
title: fighter_4001

asset_description: Two women type at computers in a bright open-plan office. The camera whips round to a long meeting table where a woman in a dark leotard holds a handstand on the tabletop, legs straight up in the air. Colleagues crowd both sides of the table, throwing their arms up, cheering and filming her on their phones.
title: balance_4002

asset_description: Top-down view of two people standing toe to toe on a wooden floor. One wears bright yellow slippers with big googly eyes and a pink tongue sticking out; the other wears a matching set in green. They shuffle their feet until the two sets line up facing each other like cartoon monsters.
title: a_pair_4003

asset_description: A hand drops two slices of bread into slots on the spine of a grey twin-engine model fighter jet parked on a granite kitchen counter. The elements glow orange, then long blue flames shoot from both exhaust nozzles. When the flames cut out, two golden-brown slices stand proud of the slots and the hand reaches in to take them.
title: to_heat_4004

asset_description: A first-person view looking down the body of a climber in a red jacket standing on a glacier. Both gloved hands hold ice axes and the boots below wear steel crampons biting into the surface. The climber swings an axe into a bulging wall of blue-white ice and works up it.
title: frozen_4005

asset_description: Bare feet walk along a bleached log lying just under the surface of a glass-clear alpine lake. The water is so transparent that the stones and sunken branches on the bottom stay sharp. The camera lifts to a snow-capped mountain mirrored in the still surface, then drops under the water, where a small orange frog swims towards the lens above the sunken log.
title: transparent_4006

asset_description: At night a group of young men stand on a concrete ledge above a river, lighting the scene only with their phone torches. One of them takes off, tucks into a front flip and lands on a round trampoline set on the dirt below. The others lean over the ledge, sweeping their torch beams into the blackness, and two pale animal shapes appear far off on the track.
title: dark_4007

asset_description: A young man in a red tracksuit jacket stands under an apple tree in a garden at night, with a black dog beside him and yellow apples already scattered over the grass. He grabs a low branch and shakes it hard, and more apples drop around him. The dog trots through the fallen fruit and he climbs up onto the concrete fence.
title: to_shake_4008

asset_description: A cartoon flock of white ducks waddles down a winding gravel path through a bright green alpine valley. They walk one behind another in a long unbroken row, orange feet slapping the gravel, with dandelions, a wooden fence and a farmhouse on the hillside behind them.
title: a_line_4009

asset_description: A woman with a blonde ponytail climbs an overhanging white limestone cliff, filmed from above so the forest sits far below her. Her chalked fingers pull on small pockets in the stone while her feet smear against the wall. A rope runs from her harness down through quickdraws clipped to the face.
title: climb_4010

asset_description: A golden retriever puppy sits on a log holding a small wooden guitar and strumming it, mouth open as if singing. A ring of giant pandas sits in the bamboo enclosure in front of it, watching. The scene then cuts to the same puppy playing on a rock while king penguins and their chicks gather round in an aquarium.
title: audience_4011

asset_description: A first-person view looks down from the bow of a wooden sailing ship at the planking and rigging beneath, with the viewer's boots on the boards and loose pack ice drifting in the dark water either side. The camera lifts to a huge pale blue iceberg passing the varnished rail, then to snow-covered mountains mirrored in the flat polar sea.
title: a_deck_4013

asset_description: A young man in a white shirt and red shorts rides a skateboard through an empty airport car park, towing a hard-shell suitcase along beside him by its handle. He carries on down a glazed walkway, steps onto a travelator at sunset and glides out across the open roof deck past concrete bollards.
title: to_roll_4014

asset_description: A flock of sheep grazes on the steep grassy sides of a narrow stream running through a misty green valley. One by one the sheep gather at the edge, then leap the water and land on the grass opposite. A shepherd and a black-and-white dog stand among the flock on the far side.
title: a_bank_4015

asset_description: A grey British Shorthair cat crouches on the rim of a white bath filled with pale green water, staring down at two small dark toys floating on the surface. It reaches a front paw down and taps at the water, sending rings spreading out across it. After a few tries it pulls the wet paw back, shakes it and walks off along the rim.
title: a_bath_4016

asset_description: A slow tour of a loft flat as the day ends. Low sun throws long bars across the herringbone floor and a big round red paper lantern glows beside the window. The kitchen is lit only by a strip under the units, then a warm orange paper lantern hangs over a bed facing the city skyline at dusk, and finally strings of bulbs and candles light a roof terrace at night.
title: lantern_4017

asset_description: Filmed over a car bonnet on a dirt track running between tall golden reeds at sunset. A mint-green scooter rides ahead with two small dogs aboard, one in a blue cap. The dogs hop down and mill about on the track, then climb back on and the scooter tips over into the reeds at the edge.
title: scooter_4018

asset_description: A man in swim shorts stands at the edge of a garden pool holding a folded towel and smiling at the camera. In the pool a golden retriever puppy floats with its head and front paws resting through a bright pink inflatable ring. A grey pitbull drifts past in a red one, and the camera returns to the puppy dozing in the pink ring.
title: a_ring_4019
transcript: Three, two, one. Lucas, Rocky, Gumbo.

asset_description: A black labrador stands in a shallow forest creek with the water around its legs, head lowered towards the surface. A small brown frog swims slowly across the water just in front of its nose. The dog holds completely still and keeps its eyes fixed on the frog as it paddles away between the reflections of the ferns and trees.
title: to_watch_4020

asset_description: Two hands press peeled bananas into a bed of grated carrot in a lined glass baking dish, then tip in flour and sugar. The baked sponge comes out deep orange and a spoon spreads thick cream cheese frosting over the top. Chopped pistachios are scattered on and a long knife slices the cake down and across into even squares.
title: to_cut_4021

asset_description: A small white propeller plane is airborne over a city, with a river and a distant skyline behind it and rows of houses far below. A woman in a pink shirt sits in the open doorway, then steps out onto the wing and stands upright with her arms spread wide while the plane keeps flying. She crouches back down, holds the wing with both hands and climbs back inside. The plane flies on alone with the pilot visible in the cockpit.
title: to_fly_4022

asset_description: Seen from above, a young man in swim shorts jumps off a bridge into a green river and drops towards a blue inflatable dinghy where two friends are lying. He hits the water beside them with a big splash and disappears under the surface. He comes up, grabs the side of the dinghy and hauls himself on board. All three end up standing and grappling on the wobbling dinghy, laughing and shoving each other while small motorboats sit moored along the wooded bank.
title: fun_4023

asset_description: A man in a white shirt and yellow rubber boots stands at the open door of a red barn on a muddy farmyard. Brown hens stream out of the doorway past him. A goat, a large black and pink pig and a goose come out next and walk after him, and the camera backs away as they come. Finally three white alpacas walk out of the barn and follow the camera closely, the leading one filling the frame with its face.
title: to_follow_4024
transcript: Guys, it's not all sunshine and rainbows. Oh, wait. Hang on. It might actually be.

asset_description: A fluffy grey kitten stands on a windowsill next to a wooden toy tower made of stacked spiral ramps, with bare winter trees outside the window. A small green ball rolls down the ramps and the kitten swats at it with one paw, then follows it round the tower to the bottom tray. It bats the ball again, rears up on its hind legs to reach the top ramp, and finally leans right over the top bowl and takes the ball in its mouth.
title: to_chase_4025

asset_description: A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.
title: smooth_4026

asset_description: A man in a chef's hat carries a big glass bowl of red and green apples through a kitchen, followed by a black and white cow that is also wearing a chef's hat. At the counter he rolls out dough with a rolling pin while the cow watches over his shoulder and licks its nose. He lays overlapping apple slices in a neat circle inside a pastry-lined dish and slides it into the oven. At a wooden table the finished golden pie sits whole beside a glass of milk, and in the last shot the plate holds only crumbs while the man laughs and the cow leans in over the table.
title: a_pie_4027

asset_description: A brown and white bulldog rides away from the camera on a small skateboard along the wet road of a campsite lined with parked caravans and pickup trucks. It pushes with one back leg past an American flag and a big mossy oak, gets smaller in the distance, then swings round and comes back the other way. In the last shot it rides straight towards the camera with its tongue out.
title: to_turn_4028
transcript: You go. All right, we're going right, Grayson, this way. All right, let's go get a treat.

asset_description: Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.
title: to_knock_4029

asset_description: In a large public park with mown lawns, bare trees, benches and a gravel path, a man in a dark jacket walks along the narrow stone rim of a round ornamental pond. Orange and white koi swim just under the surface below him. He wobbles, throws one arm up to keep his balance and topples in with a huge splash. He sits up soaked in the waist-deep water while people walk past on the path behind, then hauls himself back over the stone rim.
title: a_park_4030

asset_description: Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.
title: top_4031

asset_description: Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.
title: a_mess_4032

asset_description: A strip of green artificial putting turf is laid across the carpet of a living room. In the foreground a pink golf ball sits on a wooden tee stuck into a red toy brick. At the far end a man in a purple t-shirt lines up with a golf club, swings it and hits a ball down the strip. He immediately throws both arms straight up, jumps and runs off to the side while a friend sitting on the floor cheers with him.
title: a_club_4033

asset_description: The tiled floor of a shop stacked with boxed toys is covered with dozens of black mousetraps, all set and laid out in rows. A man in a white shirt and shorts, blindfolded and holding a red foam bat, swings it around trying to hit a second man who is creeping between the traps in bare feet. The second man dodges away and steps carefully over the traps, but ends up sprawled on the floor among them while the blindfolded man swings again.
title: a_trap_4034

asset_description: A first-person view looks down at the filmer's own feet in black sandals on an outdoor water obstacle course, above a pool of green water. He steps from one floating blue and white block to the next along a line of them, arms out to keep his balance. He crosses a narrow beam, then reaches a tall red tower covered in scale-shaped panels and takes hold of a thick white rope with both hands to pull himself up. At the top he stands behind a red railing looking down over the whole course.
title: to_step_4035

asset_description: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.
title: a_smile_4036

asset_description: A sausage that has been cut into strips at one end so that it splays out like an octopus stands in the oil of a hot black frying pan. Beaten egg is poured from a white bowl all around it and spreads across the pan, and a thin stream of oil is drizzled over the top. The egg sets into a round yellow omelette with the sausage in the middle. The finished omelette is slid out of the pan onto a white plate and chopped green spring onion is sprinkled over it.
title: to_cook_4037

asset_description: A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.
title: to_love_4038

asset_description: In a gym lit with purple and green neon, a man and a woman are down on their hands and toes at the start of a marked running track, joined by a long red resistance band. They crawl forwards along the track side by side with their hips low, the band stretching tighter behind them. The band pulls the woman back and she is dragged flat onto her stomach, then ends up sitting on the track laughing while the man stands over her holding the band.
title: to_crawl_4039

asset_description: A couple sit at a square table with a white cloth on a beach at dusk, palm trees and the sea behind them and a lantern with a lit candle in the middle of the table. A waiter in a white jacket sets down their food and steps back. In front of the woman is a plate of green salad; in front of the man a burger with a pile of chips. He picks the burger up in both hands and takes a big bite, then grins at the camera. The two of them talk and laugh over their plates with wine glasses beside them.
title: a_meal_4040

asset_description: A couple walk hand in hand down the bright marble concourse of a shopping mall, she in a short gold dress and he in a white t-shirt and shorts. She stops in front of a lit shop window full of long evening gowns on mannequins and pulls him back towards it. Her face fills the frame with a hopeful, pleading look; his face follows, tight-lipped and reluctant. In the last shot the two of them walk out of the shop again, both loaded down with big paper carrier bags in each hand.
title: to_buy_4041

asset_description: At dusk a young couple stands on the pavement outside a brightly lit convenience store, its glass front and stocked shelves glowing behind them. The woman, in a pale yellow wrap dress with a white frangipani in her hair, sips from a whole green coconut through a red-and-white striped straw; a close-up shows her drinking with the store's shelves of packets and bottles filling the background. She looks up at the tall man in a white t-shirt beside her; he looks down at her and says no. She keeps holding the coconut between them and smiles up at him as scooters and other shoppers pass behind.
title: store_4042

asset_description: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.
title: surprise_4043

asset_description: At a floodlit driving range at night, a woman in a red hoodie, grey leggings, white trainers and a white cap stands on a green mat with a club, a ball teed up in front of her. She settles into her stance, swings the club back over her shoulder and hits the ball out into the dark field, then follows through and watches it fly. A man in a beige hoodie stands on the next bay watching her.
title: practice_4044

asset_description: In the living room of a stone-and-wood villa a man in a dark blue shirt and white shorts is looking for something: he turns on the spot, pats himself down, leans over the sofa and checks around the cushions while a woman in a cream robe sits on the sofa watching him. The camera cuts to a sunlit stone ledge by the window where two magazines, a bunch of car keys and a black phone are lying. Back inside, the man walks past the sofa holding the phone up, smiling, and the woman looks up at him.
title: find_4045

asset_description: A couple sits close together on a dark sofa in a room lit by candles and warm lamps at night. The woman in a floral top turns to the man in an olive t-shirt and talks to him, smiling. He turns his head towards her, raises his index finger in front of his chest, shakes it and says no. She keeps hold of his arm and bursts out laughing while he holds the finger up and keeps saying no.
title: refuse_4046

asset_description: A couple lies together on a wide cushioned daybed under a wooden pavilion at a beach resort, with an infinity pool, palm trees and the sea behind them and the sky orange and pink at sunset. The man in a white sleeveless top and sunglasses holds a phone; the woman beside him in a green bikini and a white shirt talks and gestures, then pulls her sunglasses down onto her face. She settles against his chest and he puts his arm around her while they watch the sunset.
title: holiday_4047

asset_description: A time-lapse of two men converting an empty cargo van into a home. First the van stands open and bare in a car park and one man climbs in through the back doors. Inside, the two of them press timber studs and purple insulation panels into place along the walls under a new wooden roof frame, standing on a fresh plywood floor. On the roof under a blue sky they lower two large black solar panels into position and fix them down. The finished interior is lined with pale wood and has a white-tiled shower, a kitchen with a sink, and a skylight; four men stand inside cheering and dancing.
title: install_4048

asset_description: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.
title: load_4049

asset_description: Two young men stand barefoot on the open tailgate of a van in the desert at sunrise with their fists raised, cheering. The white van drives along a coast road above the ocean. Inside, the van is lined with pale wood and fairy lights, and a black dog in a red bandana lies on a wooden bunk while a hand reaches in to stroke it. At night four friends and the dog sit in camping chairs in a circle around a small fire pit in the sand beside the lit van. Finally the four of them and the dog sit in a row on the tailgate, backs to the camera, watching an orange sunset over the sea.
title: friend_4050
transcript: Hey kids, it's your dad here. Been on the road for four years now, living out my childhood dreams. Home isn't a place, it's the people you're with.

asset_description: In a car park a man in a black t-shirt and cap stands beside a huge grey six-wheeled expedition truck with a living box built onto the back. He bends down at a rack on the truck's flank and pulls a black electric motorcycle out on its carrier, then stands holding it by the handlebars in front of the truck's giant wheels while he talks to the camera. He then walks through the wood-lined interior of the truck, past a black oven and microwave, a bed and a sink under a skylight, with two long-haired grey cats sitting on the counter and the bed.
title: motorcycle_4051
transcript: Yo, what is this? It's an electric motorcycle I charge off my truck. No, the truck. Oh, that's my house. Induction cooktop, full bed, even a skylight.

asset_description: On a white-sand beach with palm trees and shallow turquoise water, a couple in white pose for a phone that stands on a small tripod in the sand in the foreground; the phone's screen shows the shot it is taking of them. They stand arm in arm making peace signs at the lens. The woman then walks straight up to the phone, frowns and reaches down to adjust it, then goes back and they pose again. At the end they both laugh and give a thumbs-up as a small dog runs into the frame behind them.
title: record_4052

asset_description: On a white marble worktop two ribbed mugs of black coffee stand side by side, one teal and one orange, with a large knife lying behind them. The knife slices straight down through the orange mug, and the two halves fall open to show layers of sponge and chocolate inside: it is a cake. The shot changes to three pale ears of corn lying in a row on the marble, their husks still attached. The knife comes down through the middle ear and cuts it lengthways, opening it to reveal that it too is a cake, with a yellow sponge inside and rounded yellow dots along the cut face.
title: corn_4053

asset_description: A dark apartment block at night against a deep blue sky, with one window lit orange among all the black ones. The camera zooms in on that window: inside, a golden retriever is sitting upright on a black office chair at a desk, facing a screen, with its front paws resting on a keyboard. Wearing small glasses, it looks at the screen and moves its paws over the keys, tapping away as if working late.
title: keyboard_4054

asset_description: A husky with blue eyes sits on a teal leaf-patterned bed in front of a brown buttoned headboard. Two large plastic toy dinosaurs, a red-brown one and a dark grey one, are held up in front of it by hands out of shot, their jaws open and teeth bared, and they snap towards the dog from both sides. The husky opens its mouth, tips its head back and howls at them, then paws at the grey one. At the end the dinosaurs are set down on the bed and the husky sits between them panting with its tongue out.
title: dinosaur_4055

asset_description: At night on a city pavement in front of a brick wall, a woman in a black dress and black high heels holds a bottle of champagne with both hands, laughing. She works the cork loose and the bottle erupts: a thick white jet of foam shoots several metres into the air and rains back down over the pavement. She screams, crouches down and holds the gushing bottle out in front of her at arm's length while the foam keeps fountaining up and spreads in a wide white pool across the paving stones.
title: celebration_4056

asset_description: In a white kitchen a man in a blue zip sweater and sunglasses holds a large bottle of cola in both hands and shakes it hard, looking at the camera. Filmed from inside the house through a patio door, he goes out into the garden, sets the bottle down carefully on a low brick wall beside a garden shed and walks away. A woman in a turquoise sweatshirt and lilac leggings comes and sits on the wall next to the bottle, picks it up and twists the cap. The cola erupts in a tall brown jet straight up into her face and over her clothes; she jumps up, soaked, and throws her hands in the air.
title: cola_4057

asset_description: A man in a red cap and white t-shirt lifts a single small brown suitcase onto a white bed in a bedroom and closes it. He carries it out to a blue SUV standing on a sunny driveway with its boot open. He then turns and sees a woman in a black dress wheeling out a tower of about ten stacked suitcases in pink, green, teal, blue and black, balanced far above her head. He stands in front of it with his mouth open and his hands raised, staring up at the tower while she waits beside it.
title: trip_4058
transcript: Okay, babe, you ready? We're only there for one night. My shoes. I'll be back. No, no.

asset_description: Filmed from the driver's seat through the windscreen of a safari vehicle on a dirt track in the bush, with the steering wheel and dashboard in the foreground. A single yellow banana has been stood upright on the bonnet. A large baboon walks along the bonnet towards it and sits down beside it; a second and then a third baboon climb up and sit in a row, all staring at the banana with more of the troop on the track behind. One of them finally reaches out, takes the banana and starts to eat it while the others crowd in around it.
title: feed_4059

asset_description: A first-person view from a yellow kayak racing down a narrow jungle river, the paddler's blue sleeve and black paddle swinging in and out of shot. White water rushes past the nose of the boat between mossy rock walls and dense green foliage, with a rainbow hanging in the mist ahead. The kayak is carried straight over the lip of a waterfall and drops into the spray, the screen filling with white water; it comes out below in the mist and carries on downstream, where another paddler in a red kayak is running the same rapid ahead.
title: flow_4060

asset_description: An underwater shot in clear blue-green water with sunlight streaming down from the surface. A large great white shark swims straight towards the camera, head-on and filling the frame, its pale underside and pointed pectoral fins spread wide. As it comes closer the camera looks up into its face and its mouth opens slightly, showing the wide jaw lined with rows of triangular white teeth. At the last moment the shark turns and passes overhead, and the screen fills with churning white bubbles below the bright surface.
title: jaw_4061

asset_description: A head-mounted point-of-view shot from a kitesurfer riding on a shallow lagoon at sunset. Two bare forearms reach forward into the frame and both hands close around the horizontal control bar of a kite, the lines running up out of shot. The orange sun sits low over a line of palm trees on the far shore and other kites are visible as small shapes in the purple sky. The rider leans back, the board carves and white spray sheets up across the lens, and the shot ends with the red kite canopy overhead as he skims across the water.
title: grip_4062

asset_description: A man in a dark jacket and jeans hangs from two red webbing straps clipped to a harness across his chest, suspended in the air high above an unbroken sea of golden clouds at sunrise. He looks down between his boots. The straps let him go and he drops straight away from the camera, shrinking to a small dark speck against the cloud layer. The camera keeps looking down as he disappears into the clouds, and at the end a pale ledge slides into the bottom of the frame.
title: release_4063

asset_description: Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.
title: pole_4064

asset_description: A shot from the back of an open-topped sports car parked on a forest road. A big white Samoyed dog in a turquoise harness sits upright in the driver's seat with its front paws resting by the steering wheel, staring straight ahead through the windscreen. A beagle sits in the passenger seat with its tongue out, a grey cat perches on the centre console between them, and a raccoon looks over from the narrow rear seat. Tall pine trees and mist fill the view ahead; nobody moves and the car does not start.
title: driver_4065

asset_description: A green parrot stands on bare red earth while a hand lowers a tiny motocross helmet onto its head. The parrot hops onto a miniature dirt bike and rides off down a track of deep red-brown dirt that runs through open eucalyptus woodland. A low close-up shows the rear tyre spinning on the loose dirt as the bike speeds along, then the camera looks up from ground level as the parrot launches the bike off a mound of red dirt and lands, riding away over the ridge.
title: dirt_4066

asset_description: A wide shot of a lake at dusk under a clear blue and yellow sky. The water is completely flat and mirrors the dark line of fir trees on the far shore and the pale glow of the sky, so the treeline appears twice, once above the waterline and once below it. On the right a large rock juts out over the water and a person crouches in silhouette on its edge. They spring off, hit the water, and the smooth mirrored surface breaks into wide rings that travel outward. The swimmer's head appears in the middle of the rings and moves slowly across the lake as the water settles again.
title: mirror_4067

asset_description: An underwater shot in clear blue water just above a white sandy seabed. A large tiger shark, its grey back marked with dark vertical bars, cruises slowly from left to right across the frame. A freediver in a bikini, mask and long fins swims down beside it, matching its speed, and reaches out with one hand. She lays her palm on the shark's back near the dorsal fin and runs it slowly along the animal's flank as the two glide side by side over the sand. She keeps her hand on it for several seconds before the shark turns away.
title: stroke_4068

asset_description: An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.
title: rod_4069

asset_description: Inside the cramped white cabin of a small aeroplane, several people in swimwear and parachute rigs shuffle barefoot towards the open door. The shot cuts outside: two of them are hanging from the wing strut under the plane's long wing, high above a coastline, with the landing wheel beside them. They hold the strut with both hands, dangling in the wind, then let go one after the other and drop away. The camera stays with the plane, and the frame is filled by the underside of the wing with the blue sea, the white surf line and the flat coastal city far below.
title: wing_4070

asset_description: A rusted shipwreck stands tilted out of bright turquoise shallows under a sky of white clouds. A woman in a bikini runs along the wreck's raised bow, bends her knees and leaps off the end, stretching out flat as she flies over the water. She hits the surface and the shot follows her down in a stream of white bubbles. Underwater she levels off above a sandy bottom dotted with coral heads, where several large tiger sharks are cruising. She swims in among them and glides right alongside one, her arms wrapped loosely around its back, as a second shark passes behind.
title: leap_4071

asset_description: A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.
title: lagoon_4072

asset_description: An animated autumn park with orange trees and benches. A plump teal and purple pigeon stands with its eyes closed and a soft smile. A large angry white hen with a red comb stands over three yellow chicks and swings a wooden stick at the pigeon; the next shot shows the pigeon wide-eyed with the stick pressed across its beak. A yellow chick has fallen asleep tucked into the pigeon's blue chest feathers with the stick lying across it. The hen lowers the stick and walks off with her chicks, and the teal pigeon turns to a white and pink pigeon beside it, their wings touching.
title: stick_4073

asset_description: A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.
title: sun_4074

asset_description: A drone looks straight down at turquoise open sea. In the middle of the frame one woman in a dark swimsuit floats face down on the surface with her arms stretched out to the sides and her legs together, completely still. All around her, filling the whole picture, dozens of large sharks swim in every direction, some passing directly under her body, others crossing within a metre of her hands and feet. The camera holds and slowly drifts; the sharks keep circling and criss-crossing around her and she never moves.
title: danger_4075

asset_description: A camera fixed under a helicopter looks back at its wide open side door. Three skydivers sit inside the cabin with their backs to the camera, framed by the doorway, with blue sky and a coastline visible through the opening. One by one they swing out through the open door onto the landing skid, stand on it barefoot holding the frame, and then push off. They drop away in a spread position over a coastal town with a winding river and a long white beach. The helicopter climbs and shrinks to a small shape in the empty blue sky.
title: door_4076

asset_description: An animated night scene on a rooftop ledge, with a full moon and the blurred lights of a city behind. Two plump pigeons are asleep side by side in a big twig nest, a teal one and a white and pink one, both with their eyes closed and their heads tipped together. The teal pigeon suddenly jerks awake, beats its wings and lifts out of the nest, hovering for a moment while the other stays fast asleep with its eyes still shut. He drops back down beside her and settles, but stays sitting bolt upright with his eyes wide open, staring into the dark while she sleeps on.
title: asleep_4077
transcript: It's here. Probably just a mosquito. Go back to sleep.

asset_description: A plain bedroom with a woven wall hanging above an enormous bed made up in white. A row of seven identical white pillows is lined up along the head of the bed against the wall. A woman in a black top and grey joggers climbs onto the end of the bed and crawls slowly up the middle of it on her hands and knees, dragging the white duvet into long folds behind her. When she reaches the top she turns, drops back against the row of pillows and flings her arms out wide, lying flat with the pillows behind her head.
title: pillow_4078

asset_description: A point-of-view shot from the front of a yellow kayak dropping into a white-water river in a steep pine gorge. The pale green water rushes past on both sides, piling into standing waves and white foam between dark rocks, and the boat is carried down fast. A hand works a black paddle across the bow, spray bursts over the lens and blurs it, and the walls of fir trees rush by. The river then widens and slows, and the kayak arrives at a calm stretch where four paddlers in red kayaks and helmets are waiting on a grey gravel bank.
title: rush_4079

asset_description: An animated scene in a home. A mother in a purple jumper stands behind her small daughter, who sits scowling in a pink hoodie with her arms folded. The mother gathers a handful of the girl's long brown hair in one fist and holds it up, looking around with a worried face for something to tie it with. She leans over and rummages through an open wooden drawer, then searches a dressing table lit by round bulbs around a mirror, pushing aside bottles and tubes. She presses a hand to her forehead in despair. Then she notices three grey hair ties looped around her own wrist, and a close-up shows her fingers hooking one off her wrist as she smiles.
title: wrist_4080

asset_description: A chest-mounted point-of-view shot from a skydiver sitting in the open door of a helicopter over the Alps. His own legs in a white padded suit and tan boots hang out over a wall of high mountains whose ridges and summits are thickly covered in white snow, with a bare green valley running between them and the sun blazing overhead. He drops away, and the helicopter tips over above him and shrinks into the deep blue sky as the snow-covered peaks and glaciers slide past below. Under canopy he comes down towards a bright green alpine meadow with a large orange landing cross laid out on the grass, his boots pointing at it.
title: peak_4081

asset_description: Filmed from inside the open door of a small plane flying high above a turquoise coral reef. A woman in a white and blue jumpsuit and harness hangs from the wing strut outside the plane, laughing, her legs swinging free in the open air. She swings under the wing, hangs upside down, and then lets go and drops away from the plane, shrinking to a tiny figure against the blue water far below.
title: upside_down_4082

asset_description: An animated shot filmed straight down onto a bed at night. A woman and a bearded man sleep on either side, with a small pug lying between them. The pug slowly stretches out and spreads its legs, pushing the two people further and further towards the edges of the bed. By the end the humans have been pushed off completely — only their hands still grip the sides of the mattress — and the pug lies alone, spread out flat in the exact middle of the bed.
title: middle_4083

asset_description: An animated bald man in a red robe stands in a gold and green marble bathroom in front of a large mirror, holding up a small gold jar. A hairless sphynx cat sits on the washbasin beside him. A golden drop falls onto the cat's bare head and onto the man's bald head. Both heads sprout enormous hair: the man grows long thick black curls, the cat grows a golden lion's mane. The two admire themselves in the mirror.
title: head_4084

asset_description: An animated short about a man being transformed. He sits slumped on the sofa in a dark living room playing a video game while an angry woman stands behind him with her arms folded. She drags him out of the door. He then appears outside a smart townhouse in a navy suit and tie, standing tall and confident while two women look him over admiringly. A huge eye peers through a gap in the door. Finally the couple walk back into the house together.
title: change_4085

asset_description: A simple cartoon set in a dark blue house at night.
