A mosquito with an angry face hovers by a door next to a glowing red plug-in insect repeller, then next to a wall socket, unbothered by it. It flies on to a bedroom where a person sleeps under a blue blanket with the crescent moon in the window, and lands on the sleeper's bald head. In close-up the mosquito braces its legs and drives its long proboscis down to bite. The last shot is the little white house from outside.
title: bite_4086

asset_description: A series of shots of tabby cats dressed in grey business suits living a full office life. Two of them sit side by side on the blue seats of a commuter train between human passengers. One types at a laptop in an open-plan office, walled in by towering stacks of paper. Two stand chatting with paper cups by the coffee machine and the water cooler. Two sit at a boardroom table watching a bar-chart presentation on a projector screen. In the last shot a cat in striped pyjamas works on a laptop in bed at night, surrounded by scattered documents.
title: work_4087
transcript: As you can see, the Q3 projections are quite stable.

asset_description: A steady shot taken from the very brink of an enormous waterfall on a bright day. A broad sheet of deep green water slides towards the camera and pours over a long curved edge that stretches far away across the frame. White foam breaks along the top, and a huge white cloud of spray rises from below and fills the right-hand half of the picture. Blue sky and small clouds sit above the far shore.
title: wide_4088

asset_description: A night dive on white sand: two black-gloved hands hold out a small action camera and an octopus reaches out and takes it. The picture then becomes the octopus's own point of view — its head and arms in the foreground as it crawls low over the sand, past dark rocks, and down a narrow gully. It arrives in what looks like an underwater nightclub: glowing red jellyfish hang overhead like lamps, blue laser beams sweep the water, and a crowd of octopuses, one wearing white sunglasses, waves its arms and dances under the lights.
title: dance_4089

asset_description: A tall silver rocket stands beside its steel launch tower on a concrete pad under a clear blue sky, venting white vapour. The engines light and orange flame and white smoke burst out around its base. The rocket lifts off the pad and rises past the tower, its exhaust turning to a bright pink and white column. It climbs out of frame and a huge cloud of pale smoke and dust rolls across the pad, leaving only the tower and the trail of fire above it.
title: rise_4090

asset_description: A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.
title: crack_4091

asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a road bike at sunset. The rider's tanned arms grip the drop handlebars, and ahead of them a long, steep flight of worn stone steps drops away down the face of a red cliff towards the sea. The sun sits low on the horizon, laying a golden path across the water. The bike bumps down step after step, the stone blurring beneath the front wheel, until the steps end and the rider rolls out onto a dark dirt path by a low stone wall.
title: down_4092

asset_description: A telescope view of the moon against a black sky scattered with faint stars. At first only a small pale disc shows in the corner of the frame. The camera zooms in steadily until the moon fills most of the picture: a large round grey body with its curved bright edge on one side, the darker flat plains in the middle, and thousands of small craters picked out along the shadow line.
title: round_4093

asset_description: A camera mounted on a horse follows its day on a desert ranch. First a close-up of the horse's muzzle dripping water as it drinks from a concrete trough, red rock cliffs behind it. Then a barn corner where a trolley is stacked high with brightly coloured sacks of animal feed in red, blue, green, yellow and pink, with a green shovel leaning beside it. Then a black horse and a chestnut horse stand nose to nose eating pale green hay from a big round metal feeder at sunrise. Finally the horse walks down a dirt road lined with tall golden poplars.
title: feed_4094

asset_description: A behind-the-scenes clip from a film shoot in a red-rock desert at dusk. First the finished-looking action: a yellow muscle car races down an empty desert highway chased by a police car with flashing lights, then a shot from inside the car looking out through the windscreen at the setting sun. Then the camera pulls back to the reality: a young crew in hoodies and jeans stand in the sand around a monitor on a wheeled cart, watching the same shot play back, some holding tablets and notes. The last shot shows two pickup trucks parked on a dirt track under an orange and pink sunset sky.
title: movie_4095
transcript: Not long ago, folks figured a big picture took a big camera. So this little thing shot all that? Big movies, little camera.

asset_description: Underwater on bright white sand in clear turquoise water. A green sea turtle is tangled in a heavy brown rope net, unable to move. Two snorkellers in fins hold the turtle steady and work at the ropes with their hands, then one cuts the strands away with a black-handled knife. They peel the net back off the shell and flippers. Freed, the turtle glides away over the pale sand, its shadow following beneath it.
title: free_4096

asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a dry dirt jump park under a blue sky. Ahead of the camera another rider hurtles up a huge sloping ramp of packed orange earth and launches high into the air, hanging above the ridge. The point-of-view rider races after him down the trail, the ground blurring past the front tyre as he drops through bermed corners and along the side of a green and brown hill, chasing the rider ahead across the jumps.
title: fast_4097

asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.
title: way_4098
transcript: Excuse me, coming through. You going or am I going? Okay, I'm going.

asset_description: Filmed through a car windscreen in slow traffic on a busy city street under a concrete overpass, with shops and signs along the roadside. Ahead, a motorbike carries a tall stack of mattresses with a brown street dog riding on top. The load slides off and lands flat on the tarmac, and the dog jumps down and stands beside it. A man in a red shirt helps the rider heave the mattresses back onto the bike. As soon as they are strapped on, the dog climbs back up on top and the motorbike pulls away through the traffic.
title: back_4099
transcript: I'm telling you. Look at this. He's mad at the dog for dropping the mattress. Now they load it back up. And look, the dog hops right back on. There they go.

asset_description: A quiet bedroom with pale green walls, a wooden bed, a rug and a bedside table with a red digital clock. A man lies stretched out on the bed. Suddenly the ceiling bursts open and an enormous steel coil spring shoots down through it, punching a ragged hole in the plasterboard and driving straight through the floorboards into another hole below. Broken laths and clouds of white mattress stuffing rain down over the room. The man is left face-down on the floor in the debris, then picks himself up, stands and brushes the fluff off his clothes.
title: hole_4100

asset_description: A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.
title: show_4101

asset_description: An illustrated clip. A thin man sits on a wooden chair at a small desk in a bare room, typing on a laptop. Through the big window in front of him the outside is bright: a yellow sun in a blue sky, a purple kite flying on a string, and a green ocean wave rolling in. His head tips back toward the sunny sky while his hands stay on the keyboard. His body then stretches further and further out of the chair toward the window until the chair tips over and he is pulled almost horizontal, hands still on the laptop, drawn toward the sunshine outside.
title: sunshine_4102

asset_description: A black Labrador puppy is in a kitchen doorway behind an orange cardboard screen. On a flat sheet of cardboard in front of it stands a single upright sausage, with small dark plastic figures beside it. The puppy peeps around the orange screen at the sausage and holds still for a long time, only watching and edging closer. After several seconds it finally gives in, lunges forward, takes the sausage in its mouth and chews it, then sits back on the cardboard with its mouth open and only a hole left where the sausage stood.
title: patience_4103

asset_description: An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.
title: kiss_4104
transcript: What's up? He was asking for directions. Cool, cool, cool, cool. Were you jealous?

asset_description: An animated city street at sunset. A young woman with long black hair, a black leather jacket, cream trousers and a small red shoulder bag walks along the pavement, smiling and touching her hair. Ahead of her a young man in a leather jacket leans against a black car holding a huge bouquet of pink and cream peonies. She sees him, stops, and covers her mouth with her hand, eyes wide. He steps forward and holds the flowers out to her; she buries her face in the bouquet, then they stand close together behind the flowers, smiling at each other in the golden light.
title: boyfriend_4105

asset_description: A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.
title: hungry_4106

asset_description: Filmed from the audience of a circus. An elephant stands alone in the sawdust ring under a spotlight. A huge grey sheet is dropped from above and floats down over the elephant until the whole animal is hidden under the cloth, which spreads out across the ring floor. A performer in a dark red suit stands beside the covered shape with his arm out. The sheet is then pulled away and a white tiger with black stripes walks out where the elephant had been, padding across the ring towards the audience and snarling at the camera.
title: cover_4107

asset_description: An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.
title: husband_4108
transcript: Do you love your new car? I hate it! It's so embarrassing! But it's so cute!

asset_description: A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.
title: lawn_4109

asset_description: A circus ring filmed from the dark audience seats. An elephant stands on a low round pedestal in a beam of light. Beside it stands a clown in a yellow and purple polka-dot costume with a bright orange wig, huge yellow shoes and a white painted face, next to a man in a dark red suit. A big dark cloth drops over the elephant and hides it completely; the clown throws both arms up in the air towards the audience. When the cloth is pulled away, a white tiger is sitting on the pedestal instead. The clown lies down on the sawdust beside the tiger with its legs in the air while the audience films on their phones.
title: clown_4110

asset_description: A man in a black T-shirt, jeans and mirrored sunglasses kneels in the dirt beside a weathered wooden barn, holding a hammer and laying out fresh pale timber boards. A big woolly ram with curled horns walks straight up behind him and shoves its head into his side, pushing him against the barn wall. He shouts, braces one hand on the wall and tries to keep working, but the ram butts him again and again. In the last shot he is sitting slumped on the ground with the hammer still in his hand, head back, while the ram stands over him.
title: annoying_4111
transcript: with spring right around the corner. Ow! Oh my God! I'm sick of these goats. We're definitely having lamb chops tonight. Oh my God.

asset_description: A close shot of an unfinished wall built from large pale building blocks with thin mortar joints between them, under a window that looks out over a foggy green field. A hand in a grey work glove holds a cut-off clear plastic bottle flat against the blocks, directly under the tip of a drill. The drill bores into the block and the grey dust falls straight down into the bottle instead of onto the floor. When the drilling stops, the hand lifts the bottle away to show a neat round hole in the block and a heap of grey dust collected inside the bottle.
title: block_4112

asset_description: An animated city street at sunset with cartoon pigeons on the pavement. A small grey pigeon wears a glowing pink diamond ring that sparkles and casts pink light over its feathers. A white pigeon with pink-tinted feathers leans in beside it, admiring the ring with wide eyes and an open beak, while a huge dark pigeon with heavy eyelids looms over both of them in the background. The white pigeon presses herself against the grey one, then rears up, opens her beak wide and shouts with one wing raised. At the end the two walk off together side by side down the street, the ring still glowing between them.
title: jewellery_4113
transcript: You fine. Hey, hey, back off. I'm his wife. I don't see any ring on that finger. You belong to the sky!

asset_description: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.
title: mall_4114

asset_description: A tiled seaside promenade at night, lit by the lights of souvenir stalls. Racks of sunglasses and rows of straw sun hats stand outside the shops on one side, dark pine trees rise on the other, and the lights of the bay glow further along. A young couple walks away from the camera down the promenade with his arm around her shoulders. He reaches over and ruffles the top of her head; she ducks away, spins round with her blonde hair flying, and laughs. He puts his arm back around her and they walk on together past the stalls.
title: tourist_4115

asset_description: A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.
title: small_4116

asset_description: An animated living room with a low round wooden table, a pale sofa and big windows onto a green garden. A man in a dark blue shirt stands looking worried, then starts hunting through the room: he throws the sofa cushions into the air, crouches down to look under the furniture and turns around again and again. A woman in a cream top sits calmly on the sofa watching him with a small knowing smile. The camera drops to the coffee table, where his phone and a bunch of car keys are lying in plain sight; a hand reaches in and points at them. He looks up, sheepish, picks up the phone, and she stands behind the sofa with her arms folded, pointing at the table.
title: search_4117

asset_description: A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.
title: court_4118

asset_description: A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.
title: collapse_4119

asset_description: A close overhead shot outdoors. A pale wooden board with a round hole cut through the middle is laid flat across the top of a big carved wooden bowl, with a crate of whole walnuts behind it. A hand picks a walnut out of the crate and sets it in the hole in the board so it sits held in place. A hammer swings down and cracks the walnut; the pieces of shell and the kernel drop straight through the hole into the bowl underneath. The hand fetches another walnut and does it again, and the bowl below slowly fills up with broken shells and pale nut kernels.
title: board_4120

asset_description: A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.
title: scene_4121

asset_description: A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.
title: rob_4122
transcript: Nobody move! Give me all your money! Where's the vault? We don't have one. Then what do you keep here? Samples. Sorry. Wrong bank.

asset_description: A hand-drawn cartoon on a grey background. A girl with long dark hair kneels holding a sheet of paper marked with a big red A+. Her face crumples, her mouth turns down and two thick turquoise streams of tears run from her eyes. She throws her head back and wails with her mouth wide open while the tears gush out in great arcs on both sides of her head and pool on the ground around her knees, until she is kneeling in a spreading puddle of her own crying, still holding the paper. The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.
title: tears_4123

asset_description: A series of shots from life in a camper van. A curly-haired young man leans out of the open side door of a white van with a shaggy grey dog beside him, the blue ocean and a beach behind them. A drone shot follows the van along a winding coastal road at sunset. Then, on a bare clifftop at dusk, three friends sit on folding chairs around a small open fire built inside a ring of pale stones; the flames burn orange in the middle of the circle and light their faces while a dog sleeps on a blanket beside them and the van stands with its door open behind. Later the friends and the dog sprint across the wet sand of a beach, and at the end they sit together on the open tailgate of the van watching the sun drop into the sea.
title: van_4124
transcript: Hey kids, it's your dad here. I've been on the road for four years now. The things that make life special aren't the things you own, they're the people beside you and the memories you make along the way.

asset_description: A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.
title: stage_4125

asset_description: Shot at night on a phone. Two young men climb over a tall black iron fence with spear-shaped tips, next to a red warning sign, and drop down into dark bushes and tree roots on the other side. They walk up through the dark, and then the camera lifts to show where they have come out: a vast city spread below them, thousands of lit windows in tall towers packed along both sides of a dark harbour, with more towers climbing the hillsides and low cloud glowing above them. The two sit down side by side on the concrete edge and look out over the lit-up city.
title: building_4126

asset_description: A red dirt track through a dry pine forest. A white and chestnut sifaka lemur comes bounding down the track towards the camera, hopping upright on its back legs with its arms held out. It stops right in front of the camera, sitting up on its hind legs, and a woman's hand offers it a small piece of orange carrot, which it takes in both black hands and nibbles. While it eats, the hand reaches out and strokes the thick white fur of its chest and belly, running over it slowly again and again while the lemur sits still and lets her, staring straight into the camera with big orange eyes.
title: soft_4127
transcript: Here, have some carrot. It's so silky, so soft.

asset_description: A sunny back yard behind a house, closed in on all sides by a tall wooden fence, with a brick paved path along the house and a patch of green and dry grass in front of it. A pale golden retriever puppy comes trotting along the brick paving towards the camera, ears flapping and tongue out, then steps down off the paving onto the grass of the yard and keeps coming, tail up. It bounds the last few steps through the grass and drops down right in front of the lens, filling the frame with its face, panting happily in the sunshine.
title: yard_4128

asset_description: A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.
title: home_4129

asset_description: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.
title: flat_4130

asset_description: A barber's shop with a deep green wall filling the whole background, a mirror and a framed picture hanging on the green paint, and green plants on the counter. A chimpanzee sits in the chair in a green cape with its eyes shut and a big round afro. A ginger cat in a white coat, standing on a wooden stool, works through the hair with a hot styling tool that sends up a puff of steam. The afro comes out sleek and straight, cut into a shiny black bob, and the chimpanzee turns to the camera and grins with the green wall and the green cape all around it.
title: green_4131

asset_description: A marble salon with warm lights and shelves of bottles. A lion sits in a salon chair in a black cape with its head tipped back over a white washbasin. A ginger cat in a white coat sits on its head and works white foam into the mane, then rinses it out with a shower head, so the wet mane hangs down dark and heavy into the basin. The cat then takes a large wooden hairbrush and pulls it down through the long wet mane, stroke after stroke, working out the tangles from the top of the head to the ends hanging over the basin. In the last shots the lion sits up facing the camera with the mane brushed out full and dry, and the cat perched on a stool beside it.
title: brush_4132

asset_description: A kitchen with white cupboards and a dark polished wooden floor. A tall stainless steel fridge with a double door, an ice and water dispenser in the left-hand door and a freezer drawer underneath stands against the wall, and a raised metal dog bowl in a wooden stand sits next to it. A man in pink pyjamas crouches down on the floor in front of the fridge next to a golden retriever that is lying there, strokes its back and talks to it. He goes down onto his knees, then lies right down on the floor with his arms round the dog and his head against it, while a second golden retriever lies stretched out on the floor in the foreground.
title: fridge_4133

asset_description: A barber's shop with a mirror and shelves of bottles. On the black leather seat of the barber's chair sits a very round, very plump hedgehog, so fat that its little legs and paws stick out sideways from a body shaped almost like a ball, with a big round belly hanging over its feet. A ginger cat in a white coat and red bow tie leans in with a pair of electric clippers and runs them over the hedgehog's back, shaving off all the spines. They fall away onto the seat and leave a completely bare, smooth, pale, round body sitting there. The hedgehog looks down at itself, its eyes go wide and its mouth drops open in horror, while the cat covers its own face with a paw.
title: fat_4134

asset_description: A football pitch of bright green grass with white markings, laid impossibly high in the air with nothing but sky and a distant lake and forest far below its edges. A young woman in a dark football shirt, black shorts and long socks stands over a white and blue ball on the centre spot. She runs up and strikes the round ball towards the goal at the far end, where the keeper dives across. Then she keeps running, straight on across the pitch to where the green grass simply stops, spreads her arms out wide and leaps off the edge, and the shot follows her turning over and over as she falls through empty blue sky.
title: ball_4135

asset_description: A home gym with black walls, a squat rack, a red bench and a rack of weights along the wall. A big tattooed man in a white cap and blue T-shirt tries to train with four golden retrievers loose in the room. Lying on the rubber floor working an ab roller, he is swamped by dogs licking his face. He then lies back on the red bench and presses two heavy metal dumbbells straight up over his chest, arms locked out, while one dog climbs up and stands on his stomach and another pushes its nose into his side. At the end he does press-ups on the floor with his hands either side of a dog lying flat underneath him and two more lying on each side.
title: exercise_4136
transcript: Today I'm going to attempt to work out with four golden retrievers. Let's see how it goes.

asset_description: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.
title: yellow_4137

asset_description: A man in a white cap kneels on the tarmac drive outside a house and holds out both hands as an old golden retriever steps out of the open door towards him. He takes its head in both hands, rubs its ears and cheeks and kisses the top of its nose. The next shot is inside the open boot of a car, where the dog sits on a blanket beside him with a pink lead and licks at a small tub of vanilla ice cream he holds out. Then in the fenced back garden the dog runs to him across the grass and he crouches down, laughing, and rubs both hands through the fur of its back and sides.
title: pet_4138

asset_description: A travel sequence in thick mist. A man in a teal jacket stands on a windswept grassy hilltop swinging a big white sheet through the fog. Then a point-of-view shot looks down at a pair of orange trainers standing at the top of a long, narrow stone stairway that runs straight down the ridge and disappears into the cloud, with a huge rock pillar looming ahead. Next, an empty road runs between two rows of golden ginkgo trees towards a red pagoda under a cliff. In the last shot the man, now with a blue rucksack, walks away up a narrow dirt path worn through the green grass, past a wooden handrail, climbing towards the fog-covered rock tower above.
title: path_4139

asset_description: A run of shots from a trip with friends in wild green hill country. A young man throws himself head first off a high concrete ledge and drops towards the dark water far below; a point-of-view shot from the ledge looks straight down at the white ring of foam where he hit the surface. Someone in an orange shorts and a blue jacket runs down a steep grassy slope in driving wind and mist towards a braided river below. At dusk three friends sit in a row on a narrow wooden plank bridge over a rushing white river, watching the moon over a mountain wall lit orange by the last sun. In the final shot four of them stand on a grassy ridge at sunset with their arms flung wide, one grinning into the camera as the sky burns orange behind them.
title: adventure_4140

asset_description: A travel sequence. Five young men in swimming shorts lie side by side on their backs on the low heather and grass beside a still forest lake, feet towards the camera, resting in the sun with dark pine trees on the far shore. The next shot shows friends lying stretched out in long grass on a hillside high above a patchwork of green fields, only their heads and knees showing above the grass. Then a point-of-view shot looks down a long red wooden staircase dropping down a green cliff towards a turquoise bay and a white beach far below. In the last shot the camera sits in the grass at the top of a cliff, legs stretched out in front, looking across at a wide waterfall pouring into a gorge under an orange sunset sky.
title: lie_4141

asset_description: A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.
title: rain_4142

asset_description: The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.
title: bin_4143

asset_description: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.
title: a_tube_4144

asset_description: Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.
title: dive_4145

asset_description: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.
title: exhausted_4146

asset_description: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.
title: hurry_4147
transcript: Start the car, go, go, go!

asset_description: In a concrete parking garage a man in a navy suit runs his hand slowly along the bonnet of a bright red sports car. He opens the door and lowers himself into the red leather seat, then reaches for the start button on the steering wheel and the dials light up. The car rolls out of the garage with its headlights on, and the last shot shows it standing alone in profile on an empty rooftop deck under a grey sky.
title: a_luxury_4148

asset_description: An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.
title: a_giant_4149

asset_description: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.
title: speed_4150

asset_description: A hand holds a bright pink marker over a pencil drawing of a sports car on white paper lying on a wooden table. The hand fills in the bonnet of the car with pink strokes, and the drawing slowly turns from grey lines into a solid pink car. A close-up shows the finished front of the car with its black air vents. At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.
title: art_4151

asset_description: A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.
title: a_vehicle_4152

asset_description: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.
title: a_highway_4153

asset_description: On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.
title: a_sport_4154

asset_description: In a tiled bathroom, a cartoon-like ginger kitten in a pink t-shirt stands at a toilet holding a white plate smeared with red sauce. It dips the dirty plate into the toilet bowl, then reaches up with one paw and presses the flush button. Blue water swirls round the bowl and the kitten swishes the plate through it. At the end the kitten proudly puts a shining white plate on top of a tall stack of clean plates, with the dirty sauce-covered ones beside it.
title: clean_4155

asset_description: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.
title: approach_4156
transcript: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!

asset_description: On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. In the middle of the road stands a small old woman in a beige coat and scarf, holding up a large piece of white cardboard with the handwritten words RUN IF YOU THINK I'M SEXY. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.
title: race_4157

asset_description: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.
title: giant_4158

asset_description: A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.
title: high_4159

asset_description: A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.
title: disappear_4160

asset_description: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.
title: the_front_4161

asset_description: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.
title: a_plaza_4162

asset_description: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.
title: talk_4163
transcript: I have always loved mechanical things. The Lamborghini Miura was the first real supercar. You do not just drive it, you have to tame it. It makes you feel in charge.

asset_description: A green Lamborghini takes a corner on a race circuit, running over the red-and-white kerb. A close-up then fills the frame with one spinning black wheel: a big red brake caliper is clamped on the dark disc behind the spokes and the yellow wheel-nut turns in the middle. The car is seen from behind on the damp track with its wide rear wing, and the camera finally pans off into a blur of grass and tarmac.
title: a_brake_4164

asset_description: A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.
title: speed_4165
transcript: The most important thing is the connection with the car. Every action gets an immediate response. This thing is pure fun, like entering a different dimension.

asset_description: Outside a stone villa with clipped hedges in the evening sun, a man in a black tank top walks up to a red Ferrari, opens the low door and lowers himself into the red leather seat. A close-up shows his hand on the switches beside the steering wheel and the lit instrument dials. He then sits behind the wheel, looking straight ahead through the windscreen.
title: enter_4166

asset_description: A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.
title: exit_4167

asset_description: A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.
title: slow_4168

asset_description: A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.
title: a_look_4169

asset_description: An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.
title: save_4170

asset_description: A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.
title: creep_4171

asset_description: A grass field burns at dusk in an animated film. A hen snatches up her nest of chicks and flies low over the fire, then lands in a river and pushes through the current with the nest held above the water. She wades out on the far bank, sets the chicks down and drops onto the stones, worn out, while the wildfire still glows on the hillside behind her.
title: an_escape_4172

asset_description: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.
title: a_chase_4173

asset_description: A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.
title: defend_4174

asset_description: In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.
title: sneak_4175

asset_description: Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.
title: glow_4176

asset_description: A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.
title: a_mouth_4177

asset_description: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.
title: generous_4178

asset_description: A white-haired woman in a blue blouse sits at a table behind a large white cake with blue piping and three silver candles shaped as a 1, a 0 and a 0. Hands hang a colourful HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner on the black wall behind her and balloons show at the edges of the frame. Wearing a small tiara and a pair of pixel sunglasses, she blows the candles out one after another and then laughs at the camera.
title: a_birthday_4179

asset_description: An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.
title: mistake_4180
transcript: What are you doing? I'm walking the dog. That's an alligator. Your dog is right here. Oh, I forgot my glasses.

asset_description: In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.
title: offer_4181

asset_description: A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.
title: paint_4182
transcript: It is Grandpa's 100th birthday. Time to surprise her with a huge gift.

asset_description: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.
title: gift_4183
transcript: Time to surprise grandma with the best birthday gift ever. Surprise! Happy birthday, young lady. I love you.

asset_description: A small curly apricot-coloured poodle puppy stands on a living-room carpet over a white dome-shaped ball machine with a yellow tennis ball sitting in its opening. The puppy takes the ball, the machine shoots it away down the room, and the puppy runs off after it. It comes back down the carpet with the ball in its mouth and drops it into the hole in the top of the machine, then waits for the next shot. The same round repeats.
title: bring_4184

asset_description: On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.
title: press_4185

asset_description: On a blue tennis court in bright sun, an apricot goldendoodle stands next to an orange and white egg-shaped ball machine placed on the service line. A tennis ball is hit over the net towards the dog. The dog runs off across the court after it while a person stands waiting at the far baseline. The dog comes back to the machine with the yellow ball in its mouth, drops it into the opening on top and stands beside the machine waiting for the next ball.
title: return_4186

asset_description: Four parrots sit in a row on the back of a beige sofa in front of white curtains: a grey African grey, a white cockatoo with a yellow crest, a blue and gold macaw and a small green parrot. A hand holds a blue and white toy pistol up at them from below and 'shoots' one bird after another. Each parrot in turn flops sideways onto the sofa and lies there motionless with its feet in the air, playing dead, until the whole row has fallen over.
title: dead_4187

asset_description: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.
title: slope_4188

asset_description: In a wooden-floored hallway a hand holds a black dog bowl full of brown dry food and pushes a small white pill down into the middle of it, then covers the spot with a dollop of white yoghurt. A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.
title: empty_4189

asset_description: A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.
title: meet_4190

asset_description: A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.
title: tower_4191

asset_description: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.
title: fish_4192

asset_description: On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.
title: underground_4193

asset_description: On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.
title: ride_4194

asset_description: A first-person shot from the seat of a red mobility scooter driving down an empty asphalt road between warehouses, straight into a low sun. The rider's hands are on the handlebars and a basket sits on the steering column. The steering column starts to come loose and sinks down; the basket and the handlebars drop away. In the last shots the scooter has come apart completely: a wheel, the basket, the red body panels and the handlebar lie scattered on the road in front of the rider, whose feet are still on the footplate.
title: break_4195

asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character leans over a lit candle that stands in a small grey metal bucket on a bed of straw in a stone cellar. It blows the candle out and the room goes dark, leaving only the bucket and the smoking candle in the gloom. The scene cuts to a bedroom where the same character lies asleep in bed under a blue duvet with a red cap on. A digital clock shows 6:10, four phones lie on the duvet and light up with alarms, and a framed poster on the wall reads WAKE UP. CHASE GOALS. REPEAT. The character sleeps on with its mouth open, drooling.
title: bucket_4196

asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.
title: late_4197

asset_description: A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.
title: deep_4198

asset_description: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.
title: drag_4199

asset_description: A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.
title: gold_4200

asset_description: Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.
title: upright_4201

asset_description: Two dachshunds lie flat on their backs on a sunny concrete patio with their bellies turned up to the sun and their legs flopped out. A hand comes into the shot holding a white kitchen turner and hovers it over the nearest dog's belly, as if about to flip it like something cooking. The dogs do not move; a third dachshund in a green collar walks up to the spatula at the end.
title: belly_4202

asset_description: A shirtless man in neon green swim shorts stands over a shark stranded in the wet sand at the edge of a turquoise sea. He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.
title: rescue_4203

asset_description: A golden hamster comes along a sunlit garden path with a white daisy held in its mouth. It stumbles and goes flat on its face on the paving, the daisy still with it, lies there a moment with its eyes shut, then pushes itself up, sits back on its haunches and holds the daisy against its chest, facing the camera in the low evening light.
title: carry_4205

asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.
title: badge_4206

asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.
title: deliver_4207

asset_description: A hamster sits on a grey sofa in a dim room and works through one small meal after another straight to camera: a cheeseburger with a red paper cup of soda, a red pot of instant noodles eaten with chopsticks, a pink tub of yoghurt with a spoon, a corn dog covered in ketchup, then a slice of strawberry cream cake with a fork, ending with cream on its nose. Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.
title: snack_4208

asset_description: Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.
title: sleep_4209

asset_description: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.
title: hold_4210

asset_description: A hamster in a fluffy pink bow headband goes through a skincare routine at a white bathroom basin. It drinks through a straw from a pink tumbler, presses the pump of a yellow soap bottle, then washes and pats its face with both paws. It takes a cotton pad from a blue TONER PAD box, squeezes drops from a pink Facial Serum pipette over its head, and finishes by pressing both paws into its round cheeks, with two drops of serum still sitting on them.
title: cheek_4211

asset_description: A woman and a man stand side by side in a bright white panelled room in front of a cream sofa, posing to camera. Their matching shirt-and-trouser outfits change from one look to the next: both in deep chocolate brown, then cream with a light brown shirt, then tan brown, then dark brown again, and finally pale grey with a beige shirt. The woman changes her small handbag with every outfit so that it matches, and the two lean together and smile between changes.
title: brown_4212
transcript: Remember, taupe with white looks elegant. Wine with camel looks romantic. Mocha with ivory looks soft. Plum with grey looks striking. And sage with cream looks fresh.

asset_description: Two women pose together in a white panelled room in matching floor-length satin evening gowns with a high slit. The gowns and accessories change from look to look: black gowns with gold heels and small gold bags, then black gowns with bright green heels and a green bag, then chocolate satin gowns with lilac heels and lilac bags, and finally deep red gowns, one with a long cape sleeve, worn with emerald necklace and earrings and a green clutch.
title: red_4213
transcript: Remember, black with gold is expected, but black with deep green looks richer. Chocolate with lavender looks interesting, and red with emerald looks striking.

asset_description: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.
title: blue_4214
transcript: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.

asset_description: A couple pose in a white panelled room, their outfits changing from shot to shot. First she wears an orange halter top with wide white trousers while he wears a white linen shirt with orange trousers. Then she is in an orange vest with navy wide trousers and he in a navy shirt with the same orange trousers. Next both are in pink, hers an off-shoulder puff-sleeved top with grey trousers, his a pink linen shirt with grey trousers. Finally she wears a rust top with a pleated olive skirt and he a sage shirt with rust trousers.
title: orange_4215
transcript: Remember, coral with white looks fresh, but coral with teal looks striking. Powder pink with grey looks chic and olive with rust looks rich.

asset_description: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.
title: white_4216
transcript: Remember, if she is wearing red, he goes all black. Main character energy. If she wears white, olive and cream, old money. And if she wears black, taupe and chocolate, quiet luxury.

asset_description: A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.
title: police_4217

asset_description: A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.
title: engine_4218

asset_description: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.
title: beast_4219

asset_description: A man in a black t-shirt stands beside a white sports car parked on a road through dry golden hills at sunset. He lifts the front lid and leans in, then works over the bodywork with a grey microfibre cloth, wiping the paint in long strokes in close-up until it is spotless. Close shots follow of the wing mirror and of the rear spoiler rising, and then the car pulls away and drives off down the empty road into the low sun.
title: clean_4220

asset_description: A small green cartoon lizard carries a white bowl of colourful star-shaped cereal across a dark living room to a big grey couch, licking its lips. It climbs up the side of the couch with the bowl, gets the bowl onto the cushion, then pulls itself up and settles into the corner of the couch. It tucks a plaid blanket around itself, picks up the remote control, and sits back against the cushions eating from the bowl with the light of the television flickering on its face.
title: couch_4221

asset_description: A small green cartoon gecko stands in a bright circle of light, seen as if through a peephole. It raises one hand and waves at the camera, then breaks into a dance, spinning and throwing its arms out. It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.
title: wave_4222

asset_description: A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.
title: spicy_4223

asset_description: In a warm, softly lit hallway with a rug and a potted plant, an enormously fat green cartoon lizard waddles up to a doorway and has to squeeze its round belly through the frame. The door swings shut, and a small dark sign on it reads WC. The hallway sits quiet for a few seconds. Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.
title: toilet_4224

asset_description: A golden hamster sits on a white kitchen counter beside the sink, eating a green scouring pad out of a small round white dish. A white box like a phone box is set down next to the dish and a second hamster peeks in from the right. The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.
title: dish_4225

asset_description: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.
title: hunt_4226

asset_description: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.
title: friendly_4227
transcript: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.

asset_description: A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.
title: shore_4228

asset_description: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.
title: free_4229

asset_description: At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.
title: seat_4230
transcript: Evening. Where y'all coming from? Oh, you know, we were just out there hunting squirrels. Why does your friend look like that? Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing. Code 3.

asset_description: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.
title: window_4231
transcript: You know why I pulled you over? I don't know. But something's wrong with the stop sign. It won't turn green. Step out of the vehicle. Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing.

asset_description: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.
title: show_4232
