transcript: Hey buddy, do you like Messi? Do you like Ronaldo? Can you show us Ronaldo's overhead kick?

asset_description: A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.
title: stone_4233

asset_description: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.
title: closet_4234

asset_description: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.
title: cast_4235

asset_description: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. asset_description: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.
title: march_4331

asset_description: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.
title: arrest_4332

asset_description: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.
title: platform_4333

asset_description: In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.
title: ask_4335

asset_description: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.
title: instructions_4336

asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer pushes a card into the slot of a cash machine on a busy street, then keys something in. The clip cuts to her walking up to a row of cash machines inside a bright hall, each set into the wall under its own lit sign, and then to a longer row of machines with different bank logos above them where travellers with suitcases stand waiting to use them. Finally she stands in front of one of the machines fanning a thick stack of banknotes in both hands, mouth open in delight.
title: bank_4339

asset_description: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.
title: chips_4340

asset_description: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.
title: flee_4341

asset_description: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.
title: joy_4345

asset_description: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.
title: ferry_4347

asset_description: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.
title: guard_4349

asset_description: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.
title: marble_4351

asset_description: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.
title: dessert_4353

asset_description: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.
title: sore_4356

asset_description: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.
title: heavy_4358

asset_description: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.
title: purse_4360

asset_description: A woman in a bright floral dress stands on a sunny city street holding up two big brown paper shopping bags, one in each hand, grinning. She then walks through a shopping centre past lit storefronts with bags hanging off both arms, adds more bags and totes, and finally rides up an escalator hugging a pile of paper bags to her chest.
title: shop_4361

asset_description: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.
title: appear_4363

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a young woman and an older woman shape pale balls of dough and set them in rows on a baking tray dusted with flour. The older woman opens the oven and they slide the trays of raw dough inside. Later the oven is opened again and trays of golden baked croissants come out steaming, filling the table.
title: dough_4364

asset_description: An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.
title: fresh_4365

asset_description: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.
title: light_4368

asset_description: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.
title: tape_4369

asset_description: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.
title: lobby_4371

asset_description: A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.
title: gather_4373

asset_description: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.
title: noise_4376

asset_description: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.
title: basement_4377

asset_description: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.
title: shower_4378

asset_description: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.
title: fill_4380

asset_description: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.
title: thick_4383

asset_description: A price comparison of three beds. First a caption reading €50 over a bare mattress lying on the carpet, where a young man flops down and curls up on it. Then €800 over an ordinary double bed with a colourful patterned duvet, where a woman sits up smiling. Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.
title: cost_4385

asset_description: Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.
title: poster_4386

asset_description: Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.
title: compare_4387

asset_description: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.
title: start_4389

asset_description: A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.
title: excitement_4390

asset_description: A woman on her own at home. She sings into a hairbrush and dances around her empty living room in a big jumper. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.
title: alone_4391

asset_description: An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.
title: chat_4393

asset_description: In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.
title: bend_4394

asset_description: Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.
title: opponent_4395

asset_description: A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.
title: shock_4396

asset_description: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.
title: bike_4397

asset_description: A woman in cat-eye glasses stands at a bus shelter looking up with her mouth open in amazement. From a moving train window a large roadside billboard advertising a house slides past above the motorway. Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.
title: advertisement_4398

asset_description: At dusk a woman in a denim jacket stands at a lit bus-stop panel showing a giant cheeseburger, her mouth open and her hand on the glass as if she could eat it. From a car window a billboard slides past against an orange sunset, showing a big white house with palm trees and a pool. Then at night she stands alone in Times Square with her arms out, looking up at a stack of glowing screens advertising burgers and perfume.
title: dream_4399

asset_description: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.
title: far_4401

asset_description: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.
title: appetite_4402

asset_description: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.
title: layer_4403

asset_description: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.
title: injury_4404

asset_description: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.
title: help_4405

asset_description: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.
title: smooth_4406

asset_description: A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.
title: healthy_4407

asset_description: A man in a neon vest fills a blender jug with banana slices, mango chunks, raspberries and spinach, blends it to a bright orange smoothie and pours it into a tall glass. He lifts the glass, takes a long drink and pulls it away with an orange smoothie moustache on his upper lip, grinning at how good it is.
title: taste_4408

asset_description: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.
title: blind_4409
transcript: I can't see anything. This way?

asset_description: An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.
title: contest_4410
transcript: Oh, I blinked. You blinked. Don't blink.

asset_description: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.
title: treatment_4411

asset_description: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.
title: block_4412

asset_description: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.
title: smell_4413

asset_description: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.
title: struggle_4414

asset_description: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.
title: compliment_4415

asset_description: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.
title: ticket_4416

asset_description: A blonde woman with a red backpack steps up through the doors of a tram, holding the handrail, and turns back to the camera from inside. Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.
title: travel_4417

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.
title: burst_4418

asset_description: In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.
title: bone_4421

asset_description: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.
title: border_4424

asset_description: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.
title: meeting_4426

asset_description: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.
title: ceremony_4427

asset_description: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.
title: restaurant_4429

asset_description: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.
title: score_4431

asset_description: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.
title: ignore_4432

asset_description: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.
title: fair_4434

asset_description: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.
title: exhibition_4435

asset_description: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.
title: parade_4438

asset_description: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.
title: strike_4440

asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.
title: breath_4441

asset_description: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.
title: wedding_4443

asset_description: A young couple walk hand in hand through a wooden garden arch, then lean on a mossy stone wall looking out over the water at a long stone bridge with tall arches carrying a road across a bay. The camera drops to show three pairs of trainers standing side by side on the concrete, then the couple stand together at the red railings of a huge red suspension bridge, holding hands and looking up at its towers and cables as the road runs away from them across the water. The man turns to the camera by one of the red towers, laughing and pointing up at it.
title: bridge_4445

asset_description: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.
title: wet_4447

asset_description: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.
title: handle_4448

asset_description: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.
title: teenager_4451

asset_description: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.
title: hurt_4452

asset_description: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.
title: tip_4454

asset_description: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.
title: modern_4456

asset_description: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.
title: crouch_4457

asset_description: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.
title: disaster_4458

asset_description: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.
title: burning_4459

asset_description: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.
title: palm_4460

asset_description: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.
title: dig_4461
transcript: My friends bury me in the sand! Only my head is out.

asset_description: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.
title: funeral_4462

asset_description: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.
title: read_4464

asset_description: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.
title: upstairs_4465

asset_description: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.
title: aboard_4466

asset_description: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.
title: porter_4468

asset_description: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.
title: store_4470

asset_description: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.
title: altitude_4472

asset_description: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.
title: menu_4474

asset_description: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.
title: hall_4476

asset_description: A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.
title: date_4478

asset_description: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.
title: hard_4479

asset_description: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.
title: focus_4481

asset_description: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.
title: shoot_4482

asset_description: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.
title: powerful_4485

asset_description: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.
title: kind_4487

asset_description: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.
title: document_4488

asset_description: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.
title: prepare_4490

asset_description: A three-part comparison shot on a suburban street. A young man in a hoodie and jeans leans proudly on the roof of a rusty old brown car while the caption 500 EUR sits over it. Cut to a woman in a business suit unlocking a clean silver saloon, captioned 20,000 EUR. Cut to a red Ferrari with both butterfly doors standing wide open, and a man in a tailored suit strolling up to it, captioned 500,000 EUR.
title: cost_4495

asset_description: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.
title: lay_4496

asset_description: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.
title: sign_4498

asset_description: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.
title: visit_4499

asset_description: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.
title: quick_4500

asset_description: Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.
title: ceiling_4502

asset_description: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.
title: wish_4503

asset_description: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.
title: success_4504

asset_description: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.
title: comfort_4506

asset_description: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.
title: load_4508

asset_description: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.
title: weigh_4509

asset_description: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.
title: check_4510

asset_description: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.
title: service_4511

asset_description: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.
title: list_4512

asset_description: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.
title: suitcase_4513

asset_description: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.
title: win_4515

asset_description: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.
title: ash_4519

asset_description: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.
title: tour_4522

asset_description: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.
title: fold_4524

asset_description: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.
title: help_4525

asset_description: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.
title: election_4526

asset_description: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.
title: vegetable_4527

asset_description: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.
title: color_4529

asset_description: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.
title: popcorn_4531

asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.
title: trash_4532

asset_description: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.
title: official_4534

asset_description: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.
title: lesson_4535

asset_description: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.
title: clear_4537

asset_description: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.
title: rest_4538

asset_description: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.
title: equipment_4540

asset_description: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.
title: filthy_4541

asset_description: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.
title: agreement_4542
transcript: Hmm, this one. We have a deal.

asset_description: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.
title: strength_4545

asset_description: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.
title: waiting_room_4547

asset_description: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.
title: late_4548

asset_description: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.
title: finally_4550

asset_description: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.
title: camp_4551

asset_description: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.
title: hair_4553

asset_description: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.
title: flame_4554

asset_description: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.
title: pine_4555

asset_description: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.
title: praise_4556

asset_description: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.
title: lap_4557

asset_description: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.
title: support_4558
transcript: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.

asset_description: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.
title: console_4559

asset_description: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.
title: crew_4560

asset_description: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.
title: command_4561

asset_description: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.
title: direction_4562

asset_description: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.
title: law_4563

asset_description: A school yard with a giant world map painted across the tarmac in bright colours, each land mass a different colour. A girl in an orange hoodie and rainbow trainers jumps from land mass to land mass, landing squarely on the yellow one, then hopping on across the map. Her classmates in tracksuits stand in a wide ring around the edge of the map watching her. She finishes by landing with both feet on the white land mass at the bottom right and throwing her arms out wide, laughing at the camera.
title: continent_4568

asset_description: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.
title: fry_4569

asset_description: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.
title: chef_4570

asset_description: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count.
