At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.
title: helpful_4777

asset_description: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.
title: workshop_4778

asset_description: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.
title: germany_4779

asset_description: A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.
title: separate_4780

asset_description: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.
title: marry_4781

asset_description: A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.
title: playground_4782

asset_description: A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.
title: couple_4783

asset_description: A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.
title: give_4784

asset_description: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.
title: terrace_4785

asset_description: A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.
title: sparkle_4786

asset_description: A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.
title: shocked_4788

asset_description: A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.
title: authority_4789

asset_description: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.
title: plant_4792

asset_description: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.
title: sand_4793

asset_description: A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.
title: grandmother_4794

asset_description: In a pine kitchen an elderly woman in a floral apron pulls an open oven door down and slides out a tray of chocolate-chip cookies while two small girls bounce beside her with clenched fists and open mouths. In close-up her hands hold out two of the warm cookies and each girl bites into one. asset_description: A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.
title: rating_4872

asset_description: A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.
title: study_4873

asset_description: A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.
title: traffic_light_4874

asset_description: Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.
title: truck_4875

asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.
title: sit_4877

asset_description: A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.
title: pier_4878

asset_description: At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.
title: competition_4879

asset_description: From the edge of a tall rooftop the camera looks straight down at a car park deck far below, where a small blue water balloon falls and bursts. A grinning young man leans over the parapet holding a watermelon with the city skyline behind him, drops it, and it splatters on the concrete. Then a sack bursts on the deck and finally he tips a big water bottle over the edge and it explodes into spray far below.
title: bottle_4880

asset_description: A woman braces her hands against the back of a small silver car and shoves it along the street. The shot widens and a line of people is pushing the back of a long city bus, number 230, with its destination sign lit, along the road; then a group pushes the back of a lorry trailer, and finally a whole row of people leans into an enormous round boulder in the road.
title: bus_4881

asset_description: A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.
title: aircraft_4882

asset_description: A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.
title: reveal_4883

asset_description: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.
title: point_4884

asset_description: A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.
title: street_4885

asset_description: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.
title: steep_4886

asset_description: A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.
title: narrow_4887

asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.
title: barefoot_4888

asset_description: In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.
title: circular_4889

asset_description: A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.
title: circle_4890

asset_description: On a sunny university lawn a blonde student in a white crop top leans far to one side towards the camera and laughs; her friends lean the same way beside her; the camera pulls back to show dozens of students on the grass all leaning sideways in the same pose, with big shade trees, walkways and university buildings behind them.
title: campus_4891

asset_description: A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.
title: shorts_4892

asset_description: A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.
title: crowded_4893

asset_description: In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.
title: still_4894

asset_description: A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.
title: opposite_4895

asset_description: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.
title: shadow_4896

asset_description: On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.
title: join_4897
transcript: Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes!

asset_description: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.
title: panel_4898
transcript: Close it in. See you later.

asset_description: A hand pulls a carrot out of dark garden soil and it comes up as long as an arm; next two gardeners heave out a white radish taller than they are, with a mass of roots hanging off it; finally a whole group of gardeners lifts a full-grown tree straight out of the ground in a back garden.
title: enormous_4899

asset_description: In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.
title: stack_4900

asset_description: Seen from the top of a pale sea cliff, a woman dives head first off the edge into deep blue water under a blue sky; the sea below shades from turquoise to dark blue, and one after another more people leap off the cliff and hit the blue surface, leaving rings of white foam.
title: blue_4901

asset_description: Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.
title: submarine_4902

asset_description: An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.
title: crowd_4903

asset_description: Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.
title: risky_4904

asset_description: Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.
title: span_4905

asset_description: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.
title: tent_4906

asset_description: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.
title: speaker_4907

asset_description: Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.
title: branch_4908

asset_description: A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.
title: famous_4909

asset_description: A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.
title: scarf_4910

asset_description: A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.
title: owner_4911

asset_description: In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.
title: instructor_4912

asset_description: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.
title: bracelet_4913

asset_description: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.
title: guitar_4914

asset_description: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.
title: shoulder_4915

asset_description: A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.
title: bicycle_4916

asset_description: Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.
title: shoot_4917

asset_description: A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.
title: stairs_4918

asset_description: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.
title: membership_4919
transcript: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?

asset_description: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.
title: community_4920

asset_description: Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.
title: trail_4921

asset_description: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.
title: host_4922

asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.
title: seat_4923
transcript: Right this way, best seat in the house.

asset_description: A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.
title: familiar_4924

asset_description: A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.
title: care_4925

asset_description: In a bright dental surgery a woman in teal scrubs reaches up and swings the big round examination lamp over a man lying back in the treatment chair. Wearing latex gloves she leans over him with a small round mouth mirror and looks at his teeth while he keeps his mouth open. A close-up shows a toothbrush with blue bristles brushing along his front teeth. She then holds a round hand mirror up so he can see, and finishes by giving a thumbs-up next to the mirror.
title: dentist_4926

asset_description: A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.
title: lawyer_4927

asset_description: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.
title: fix_4928

asset_description: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.
title: grade_4929

asset_description: A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.
title: reward_4930

asset_description: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.
title: diagram_4931

asset_description: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.
title: steer_4932

asset_description: A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.
title: wheel_4933

asset_description: A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.
title: headset_4934

asset_description: A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.
title: compass_4935

asset_description: A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.
title: kitchen_4936

asset_description: A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.
title: ring_4937

asset_description: On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.
title: waitress_4938

asset_description: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.
title: golden_4939

asset_description: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.
title: butcher_4940

asset_description: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.
title: firefighter_4941

asset_description: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.
title: luggage_4942

asset_description: A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.
title: praise_4943

asset_description: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.
title: gown_4944

asset_description: A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.
title: sing_4945

asset_description: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.
title: ponytail_4946

asset_description: Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.
title: portrait_4947

asset_description: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.
title: skyline_4948

asset_description: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.
title: scenery_4949

asset_description: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.
title: hip_4950

asset_description: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.
title: bed_4952

asset_description: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.
title: hope_4953

asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.
title: visit_4954

asset_description: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.
title: reception_4956

asset_description: A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.
title: hotel_4957

asset_description: A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.
title: villa_4958

asset_description: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.
title: cottage_4959

asset_description: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.
title: cuddle_4960

asset_description: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.
title: pet_4961

asset_description: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.
title: binoculars_4962

asset_description: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.
title: finger_4963

asset_description: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. She smiles and nods. He then brings a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back; she gasps in delight, and they step onto the balcony and hug in front of the city lights.
title: taste_4964

asset_description: A teenage boy in mint-green pyjamas stands in a tiled bathroom in front of a white washbasin with a mirror, a shower cubicle and a towel rail. He brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush, leans over the basin and spits, then lathers his hands with soap and rinses them under the tap, splashes water on his face, dries his face with a small towel and smiles at the camera.
title: bathroom_4965

asset_description: In a busy public office a young woman with long red hair stands at a service counter, gasps with excitement and picks up a small plastic card that has just been issued to her. She turns it over, reads it, then holds it up beside her face so the photo on the card and her own face are seen together, gives a thumbs up, and the people waiting behind her clap.
title: card_4968

asset_description: At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.
title: cafe_4969

asset_description: Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.
title: fireworks_4971

asset_description: At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.
title: patriotic_4972

asset_description: A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.
title: monument_4973

asset_description: A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.
title: seller_4974

asset_description: A tide of commuters in grey and navy suits with briefcases crosses a street between glass office towers; in the middle of them walks one young woman in a bright turquoise coat, red beret, yellow headphones and yellow boots, the only colour in the crowd. She perches on a concrete bollard while the suits stream past behind her, sips an orange juice and smiles into the camera.
title: different_4975

asset_description: A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.
title: hand_4977

asset_description: A young street-food cook works a wok at a night market stall: a huge column of flame leaps from the pan as he tosses fried rice, he cracks an egg into the wok and stirs it with a ladle, flips the pan into another burst of fire, then plates the rice with a fried egg on top and satay skewers beside it and spreads his arms proudly behind the finished plate.
title: cook_4978

asset_description: An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.
title: office_4979

asset_description: On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.
title: breathe_4980

asset_description: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.
title: vaccine_4981
transcript: Tiny pitch. Done. Ow, not bad. Brave. Yay!

asset_description: On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.
title: ankle_4982

asset_description: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.
title: officer_4983

asset_description: On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.
title: briefcase_4984

asset_description: In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.
title: fix_4985

asset_description: A woman in a white shirt aims a cordless drill at a wall while a man in a blue polo holds a spirit level against a black bracket and then reaches up towards the ceiling. The two of them carry a large black screen across the room, hang it on the wall and switch it on, and it lights up in strong blue. In the last shot the room is dark and a wall of nine mounted screens glows bright blue, lighting up both of their faces and the plastic sheet spread over the floor.
title: bright_4986

asset_description: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.
title: present_4987

asset_description: A crowd of medieval re-enactors in helmets and tunics pours down a long grassy field toward a camp of white canvas tents. A man in full plate armour runs at the front holding a tall blue banner, and hundreds of fighters with shields and spears follow him downhill while spectators watch from behind ropes at the top of the field.
title: attack_4988

asset_description: Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.
title: hill_4989

asset_description: A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.
title: iron_4990

asset_description: A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.
title: messy_4991

asset_description: An older woman in a yellow cardigan carries a big armful of clean laundry across a bright room, opens a tall white cupboard and pulls out a folding ironing board. She sets it up on the wooden floor, spreads its patchwork cover flat, then works through the pile with a steam iron and holds up a finished pale blue shirt.
title: busy_4992

asset_description: A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.
title: alone_4993

asset_description: An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.
title: wooden_4994

asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.
title: a_laugh_4997

asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.
title: a_tunnel_4998

asset_description: A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.
title: thin_5000

asset_description: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.
title: landscape_5001

asset_description: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.
title: dusk_5002

asset_description: A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.
title: bay_5005

asset_description: An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.
title: kettle_5006

asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat stands on the step of a blue front door with a brass knocker, digging anxiously through her beige tote bag. She finds a bunch of keys and holds them up in front of her face, grinning with relief. A close shot shows her sliding one key into the round metal lock set in the blue door and turning it. She pushes the door open and steps into the hallway.
title: lock_5007

asset_description: A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.
title: unlock_5008

asset_description: A red-haired boy grins as he slides down a blue playground slide on a sunny day. He then runs across the grass of a park lawn and kicks a black-and-white football, and walks back with the climbing frame behind him. The camera pans over an empty park path and ends on the playground with the ball lying on the lawn.
title: child_5009

asset_description: In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.
title: king_5010

asset_description: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.
title: old_5011

asset_description: At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.
title: romance_5012

asset_description: Three kitchens are compared with a price caption over each one. First a frail old man stirs a pot on a single gas burner in a shabby room with peeling walls, captioned 500 euro. Then a woman in a bright white family kitchen pulls a tray of cookies out of the oven, captioned 10,000 euro. Last a man stands at the marble island of a glass-walled penthouse kitchen with the city skyline behind him, captioned 100,000 euro.
title: cheap_5013

asset_description: Three cooks in three very different kitchens. An old man in a vest tastes soup from a wooden spoon over a battered pot on a gas ring in a tiled, run-down room, then cracks an egg into it. A woman in a bright white kitchen lifts a baked cheesy dish out of the oven with oven gloves. Finally a man in a black turtleneck tosses peppers in a frying pan in a penthouse kitchen with copper pans hanging overhead and the night skyline in the windows, then spreads his arms wide.
title: rich_5014

asset_description: In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.
title: homemade_5015

asset_description: A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.
title: knee_5016

asset_description: Close up, a man's hands slice a tomato into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife on a wooden board. He works along the board slicing cucumber, then yellow pepper, then a red onion, until the board is covered with neat rows of pieces. He straightens up behind the board, which now shows the vegetables laid out in a rainbow-coloured row, and speaks to the camera.
title: cut_5017

asset_description: In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.
title: beef_5019

asset_description: In a bright flat a young woman points up at a ceiling fitting whose bare bulb is dead. She and a young man carry in an aluminium stepladder and open it under the fitting; she climbs the steps while he steadies the frame, screws a new bulb into the socket and it lights up warm and bright. They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.
title: replace_5020

asset_description: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.
title: lady_5021

asset_description: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.
title: shine_5022

asset_description: A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.
title: airplane_5023

asset_description: In a fairy-lit cafe a curly-haired woman sits at a table with small national flags and thick decorated dictionaries, greets the camera brightly, then jumps up and runs across the room. She sits down opposite a woman in a kimono who bows with pressed palms over an open book, then stands holding a huge stack of dictionaries, each spine carrying a different language. At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.
title: dictionary_5024

asset_description: In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.
title: joke_5025

asset_description: A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.
title: hilarious_5026

asset_description: In a wood-panelled courtroom a man in a grey suit heaves armfuls of heavy leather-bound volumes onto the bench beside a set of brass scales and a gavel, and the pile keeps growing. A close shot shows one thick book lying open on the stack, its pages dense with tiny print, with rows of seated people behind it. In the last shot the stack has become a tower taller than the people, the judge sits beside it and the whole room stands staring.
title: difficult_5028

asset_description: A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.
title: costume_5030

asset_description: On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. She steps first across a stream on stones while the group waits on the bank and watches her line. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.
title: ahead_5032

asset_description: A carnival parade fills a wide street hung with rainbow bunting between balconies packed with spectators. A woman in a huge rainbow feather headdress and a silver bodysuit walks down the centre line of the road at the front with her arms flung wide. Behind her, rows of drummers in white outfits and rainbow-striped trousers carry big rainbow-painted drums strapped at the waist and beat them with sticks as they advance, with a dense crowd stretching back down the street.
title: drum_5033

asset_description: A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.
title: spill_5034

asset_description: In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.
title: talent_5035

asset_description: In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.
title: learn_5036

asset_description: A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.
title: sidewalk_5037

asset_description: A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.
title: pace_5038

asset_description: At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.
title: cage_5039

asset_description: At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.
title: armchair_5040

asset_description: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.
title: painful_5042
transcript: Ooh, my legs. Leg day. Ow, ow.

asset_description: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.
title: hear_5044
transcript: God, save that for the camera.

asset_description: At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.
title: sound_5045

asset_description: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.
title: living_room_5047

asset_description: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.
title: shut_5048

asset_description: A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.
title: close_5049

asset_description: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries.
