A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.
title: lose_5050

asset_description: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.
title: lose_5051

asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.
title: label_5053

asset_description: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.
title: lift_5054

asset_description: A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.
title: maid_5056

asset_description: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.
title: postman_5058

asset_description: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.
title: letter_5059

asset_description: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.
title: male_5060

asset_description: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.
title: aquarium_5061

asset_description: A woman in a burgundy trouser suit strides through a busy open-plan office carrying a tablet, pointing and giving instructions to people at their desks. She stops beside a seated colleague and shows him something on the tablet screen. Next she stands at a whiteboard in front of four colleagues and draws a rising line graph with a blue marker, explaining it and pointing at the peak. Finally she stands among the desks, hands on the tablet, talking to the room while everyone works at their screens.
title: boss_5062

asset_description: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.
title: column_5063

asset_description: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.
title: trumpet_5064

asset_description: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.
title: aisle_5065

asset_description: A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.
title: sample_5066

asset_description: A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.
title: bride_5068

asset_description: A man in a pale shirt sits in a leather armchair in a lobby with green plants and a small water feature behind him. An older woman in a uniform polo shirt stands behind the chair and kneads his shoulders and neck with both hands. His face goes from a tight grimace to a slack, blissful expression as he tips his head back with his eyes closed and smiles.
title: enjoy_5069

asset_description: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.
title: mattress_5070

asset_description: A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.
title: service_5071

asset_description: A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.
title: medicine_5073

asset_description: A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.
title: introduce_5074
transcript: Hi there, nice to meet you. Welcome aboard!

asset_description: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.
title: sticky_5075

asset_description: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.
title: member_5076

asset_description: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.
title: recall_5077

asset_description: At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.
title: pork_5078

asset_description: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.
title: pyramid_5079

asset_description: A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.
title: yellow_5080

asset_description: A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.
title: purple_5081

asset_description: A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.
title: hairstyle_5082

asset_description: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.
title: berry_5083

asset_description: At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.
title: green_5084

asset_description: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.
title: statue_5085

asset_description: In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.
title: shiny_5086

asset_description: A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.
title: dirty_5087

asset_description: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.
title: mother_5089

asset_description: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.
title: motorbike_5091

asset_description: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.
title: helper_5092

asset_description: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.
title: overgrown_5093

asset_description: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.
title: skinny_5094

asset_description: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.
title: awe_5095

asset_description: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.
title: music_5097

asset_description: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.
title: national_5098

asset_description: In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.
title: photo_5099

asset_description: A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.
title: stick_5100

asset_description: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.
title: nausea_5101

asset_description: A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.
title: alley_5102

asset_description: A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.
title: neck_5103

asset_description: A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.
title: windmill_5106

asset_description: A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.
title: cradle_5107

asset_description: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.
title: village_5108

asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.
title: sweet_5109

asset_description: In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.
title: advice_5113

asset_description: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.
title: flamingo_5114

asset_description: In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.
title: study_5115

asset_description: A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.
title: open_5116

asset_description: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.
title: bookstore_5117
transcript: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!

asset_description: Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.
title: sunlight_5118

asset_description: A large crowd in summer clothes is packed in front of two huge studded wooden gates set in a grey stone archway, with pink and white bunting strung above them. Two members of staff push the gates apart from the inside and a bright strip of the park appears between them. As the gates swing fully open a painted carousel comes into view beyond the archway. The crowd streams forward through the entrance and out into the fairground, a young woman in a red dress laughing and running ahead of them towards the carousel.
title: entrance_5119

asset_description: A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.
title: surgeon_5120

asset_description: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.
title: remove_5121

asset_description: A short montage of young people finishing hard things. A woman in leggings hangs high on an indoor climbing wall and reaches for the last hold at the top. A young man in a gym drives a loaded barbell up out of a deep front squat, straining. A runner in black crosses a finish line on a red track with both arms thrown up and her mouth open in a shout while spectators watch. A young man in a sports hall presses the last piece into a big floor puzzle and beams straight at the camera. A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.
title: achieve_5122

asset_description: A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.
title: flood_5123

asset_description: A phone-held point-of-view shot from inside a road race: the camera runs with the pack along a narrow cobbled street in an old town, passing other runners in numbered vests. Spectators stand behind metal barriers on both sides and clap as the runners go by. The camera drifts sideways past several runners, then holds on one runner in a blue vest striding away up the street between tall pastel buildings.
title: marathon_5124

asset_description: Filmed from the seats of an old theatre, a play is being performed on the lit stage. A costumed actor with a moustache sits on a golden throne wearing a metal helmet while actors dressed as ragged peasants storm him with makeshift weapons. They tip the throne over and he tumbles onto a white mattress laid on the boards; a woman in rags holds the helmet up over her head and the whole auditorium rises, cheering and applauding.
title: stage_5125

asset_description: In a bedroom papered with travel posters, a young woman kneels over a hard-shell suitcase lying open on the bed. She folds T-shirts and stacks them in until the case is heaped over the rim, then grabs the lid and swings it down. It will not close, so she climbs on top, sits on the lid with her whole weight and presses it down with both hands, pulling faces the whole time.
title: shut_5127

asset_description: In a bright living room a young man in a grey tracksuit bangs his leg on the corner of the sofa. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, hops on one foot into the hallway, doubles over and clutches his shin with both hands. He slides down the wall by the doorframe, sits on the floor with his face screwed up and keeps holding the sore leg.
title: hurt_5128

asset_description: An empty room being redecorated: the furniture is hidden under grey plastic sheeting and the floor is spread with white dust sheets. A young man in paint-spattered dungarees, headphones round his neck, rolls terracotta paint over a grey wall with a roller on a pole. He works across and up until the whole wall is orange, then reaches up and starts peeling the masking tape off the top edge.
title: cover_5129

asset_description: A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.
title: kite_5130

asset_description: In a bright home kitchen a young man in a beanie makes a pancake. A knob of butter melts and slides across a large non-stick pan on the hob. He holds a ladle high over the pan and pours a thick pale batter into it in a steady stream; the batter spreads into a wide circle and bubbles rise on its surface. At the end he lifts the pan off the hob and tilts it towards the camera to show the browned pancake.
title: mixture_5132

asset_description: In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.
title: scream_5133

asset_description: Four short scenes of a mother and a father looking after their children. The mother spoons food from a bowl into a baby's mouth in a high chair while the father steadies the chair. Both of them kneel on a rug and help two toddlers stack a tall tower of coloured wooden blocks. At night the mother leans over a bed and tucks a boy under a blue duvet, and the father sits beside the next bed reading a picture book to a girl. Finally children run and swing in a sunny playground while the adults stand and watch.
title: parent_5134

asset_description: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.
title: space_5135

asset_description: Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.
title: parliament_5137

asset_description: A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.
title: train_5138

asset_description: A young man in an airport holds an open passport towards the camera and fans the pages: every page is plain white, with nothing on it. He grins, then hands the passport across an immigration counter where an officer's stamp and a screen sit. Later, at a table, he opens the same passport to show pages now crowded with coloured entry stamps and visas, before flicking through it again.
title: blank_5139

asset_description: At an airport border control desk, an officer in a peaked cap and uniform takes a passport, opens it on the black counter and inks a rubber stamp. He presses the stamp down and a large green tick appears on the page. The traveller lifts the passport up: the whole spread is covered in blue ticks, coloured stamps, little aeroplanes and a green cross. A woman in a yellow beanie then holds the stamped passport up to the camera, free to walk on, with the queue of waiting travellers behind her.
title: allow_5140

asset_description: In a bright surgery, a man in a white coat examines a young man in a checked shirt sitting on the examination couch. He holds the patient's mouth open and looks down his throat, then listens to his back with a stethoscope, then wraps a blue blood-pressure cuff around his upper arm. He gives a thumbs up; the young man laughs and flexes his bicep, and the doctor hands him a small colourful card.
title: doctor_5141

asset_description: An older man in denim overalls stands on a stepladder outside a clapboard house and pins a string of red, white and blue triangular bunting under the porch roof, then hangs a large striped flag beside the front door. A wider shot shows the same thing happening along the whole street: other men on ladders at their own porches, flags on the houses opposite, and a small child with painted cheeks running across the front lawn behind a wooden picket fence. In the last shots the man stands on the pavement in the middle of the decorated street, bunting strung above him and neighbours waving from the gardens on both sides, and puts his hand flat on his chest.
title: neighborhood_5142

asset_description: Two elderly men in suits meet in front of a tall white stone monument under a clear blue sky, shake hands warmly and then pull each other into a long hug while a crowd of onlookers watches. Rows of schoolgirls in navy uniforms line both sides of the paved square, each holding a wicker basket with white birds sitting inside. The girls tip the baskets open and the white birds burst upwards, first a handful and then dozens, until the whole sky above the monument is filled with them. The two men stand together at the centre looking up at the birds.
title: dove_5144

asset_description: A young man in an orange hooded jacket with a bag strapped across his chest walks quickly along a brick pavement in a Dutch city, past shoppers and parked bicycles. He steps off the kerb and crosses a wide zebra crossing while the light shows red for cars, then hurries down a narrow lane lined with flower stalls full of tulips and bunches in buckets. He comes out on a big paved square where a long blue and white electric train runs along rails in the street right behind him, with cyclists passing in front of it. He looks down at his wrist as he keeps walking with the tram still rolling past behind him.
title: tram_5145

asset_description: A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.
title: strip_5146

asset_description: A low shot follows the legs of men and women in dark suits carrying shopping bags as they stride across a wide striped crossing. The camera then moves into a covered market arcade so full that shoulders and backpacks touch: shoppers in coats and school blazers press slowly past stalls hung with food and signs. Finally the view rises above a huge city junction, where hundreds of walkers pour off every kerb at once and fill the whole crossing from both directions under tall buildings and video screens, until the road cannot be seen for the moving mass of them.
title: people_5147

asset_description: Early light over an empty paved plaza: a person in a mustard coat stands at the edge with a flock of grey birds pecking in front of them, then the birds lift off low across the stones. Inside a deserted station hall the same person stands alone at the foot of a bank of escalators under the bright ceiling lights. They sit by themselves on a long empty row of seats with a canvas bag beside them, sipping from a can. In the last shot they stand in the middle of a wide boulevard, alone on the white stripes of the crossing with no traffic at all, while the sun comes up between the buildings and the trees behind them.
title: morning_5148

asset_description: A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.
title: pharmacy_5149

asset_description: A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.
title: prescription_5150

asset_description: An elderly man in a patterned cardigan stands by a bright window holding up a small painting of a mountain valley in a silver moulded border, turning it so the camera can see it. He carries it to a hallway wall already filled with dozens of bordered landscape pictures, lifts it onto a hook and nudges the edges until it hangs straight among the others. He steps back and stands beside the finished wall, which runs the whole length of the hallway.
title: frame_5151

asset_description: A young woman in a white t-shirt and jeans stands in a small yellow-walled room with a curtained window and an empty wooden bed frame, and pats a single white pillow down onto the bare slats. She then starts flinging brightly coloured pillows onto the frame one after another — pink, turquoise, yellow, green, cream — until they are heaped high above the bed. She walks up to the heap, laughing, and finally drops backwards into it so that only her face and one hand still show above the colours.
title: bedroom_5152

asset_description: Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.
title: bed_5153

asset_description: A man in a white linen shirt stands at an open window with jungle and rice terraces behind it. He presses a tiny seedling into the soil of a terracotta pot standing on the windowsill, then lifts a metal watering can and pours water over it. The shot opens onto a room crowded with indoor plants - monsteras, ferns and trailing vines in pots on the floor, on stands and hanging in baskets from the ceiling - and he stands among them looking up at them.
title: houseplant_5154

asset_description: A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.
title: lunch_5155

asset_description: Under floodlights on a small caged pitch, a footballer in a yellow number 10 shirt takes the ball past a defender in dark blue, drives into space and finishes. He runs towards the goal, drops down onto his knees on the grass and stays there, head back, mouth wide open, shouting, until a teammate in the same yellow shirt arrives and grabs him round the shoulders while spectators press against the fence behind them.
title: kneel_5156

asset_description: On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.
title: neighbourhood_5157

asset_description: A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.
title: connect_5158

asset_description: A young man in an orange rain jacket with a backpack films himself on a big city square in front of a brick church tower while pigeons take off around him, then at a wooden railing above a turquoise mountain lake ringed with rock walls, then at a wooden table in a restaurant where he lifts a spoonful from a plate piled with fried dumplings and eats with wide, delighted eyes.
title: cathedral_5161

asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket stands with both arms spread wide on a cobbled square in front of a twin-towered brick church while a flock of pigeons flies up around him, then looks back at the camera from a wooden fence above a bright turquoise lake ringed with pine trees and mountains, then sits at a wooden table in a log restaurant behind a big white plate stacked with browned dumplings and forks them into his mouth with wide eyes.
title: beautiful_5162

asset_description: A woman in a red campaign T-shirt pastes election posters onto a city wall with a wide brush, smoothing down a blue poster with a candidate's silhouette; then two candidates in suits argue from glass lecterns on a brightly lit debate stage in front of a seated audience and a moderator; then, at a night rally, a crowd holds up red and blue placards, confetti falls, and a young woman in a red shirt cheers with her fist in the air.
title: campaign_5164

asset_description: A woman in navy overalls and work gloves stands knee-deep in a brown river whose surface is covered with floating plastic bottles, plastic cups, plastic bags and white foam; a factory with a smoking chimney and pipes stands on the bank behind her. She bends down, pulls a plastic bottle out of the water, grimaces at it, and straightens up holding it while more rubbish drifts past along the shore.
title: plastic_5165

asset_description: A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.
title: tile_5167

asset_description: In a small tiled bakery a woman in a white shirt, apron and headscarf slides a tray of custard tarts out of a wood-fired oven whose flames are still burning. She sets the tray on the marble counter, straightens the tarts in their tins and sprinkles powder over them. She then carries the tray to the shop front and holds it out to a small girl, who takes a tart and bites into it, while a crowd of people behind the girl claps and shouts its approval.
title: batch_5168

asset_description: A young man in glasses and a cardigan sits at a metal cafe table by the sea, writing on the back of a picture postcard with a blue biro; a stamp lies on the table beside it. He then stands at a rotating rack of postcards on a village street, turning it and pulling out a fan of cards. Finally he stands at a yellow street postbox, holds the postcard to his lips, pushes it through the slot and pats the box.
title: mail_5169

asset_description: A postman in a bright red high-visibility uniform and red cap wheels a red bicycle along a street of English terraced houses; a red bag stuffed with letters hangs from the handlebars. He pushes a bundle of letters through the letter slot of a red front door, knocks on the door, waves to a woman watering her front garden, hands a wrapped birthday parcel over a brick garden wall to a resident, then rides off smiling at the camera.
title: package_5170

asset_description: A grey-haired man in a striped shirt and apron stands at a hob in a small kitchen with a tall stainless steel stockpot in front of him. He tips a board of chopped carrots, potatoes and red peppers into the empty pot, then pours a jug of golden stock in on top of them. Wearing a padded oven glove he lowers the lid onto the pot; steam rises when he takes it off again, and he stirs the finished vegetable stew with a wooden spoon, smiling at the camera.
title: add_5171

asset_description: A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.
title: bang_5172

asset_description: A hand holds a metal bottle under a thin fall of water trickling off a mossy cliff and fills it; then a woman in a bright red hooded raincoat with an orange backpack walks along a wet path, reaches into the spray of a small waterfall, and finally stands in front of a huge waterfall, mouth open, looking up at it.
title: raincoat_5173

asset_description: At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.
title: cheerful_5174

asset_description: In a busy restaurant a waiter with a thick black moustache, in a white shirt and dark apron, sets down a glass, then lifts a metal pot high above his head and pours a long thin stream of tea into a small tulip glass on the table without spilling, and finally lowers the pot and looks up.
title: moustache_5175

asset_description: A run of pours in a kitchen: dark coffee streams from a carafe into a big white mug standing on the counter, pale pancake batter is poured into a black frying pan on the stove, golden syrup is drizzled over a tall stack of pancakes, and finally sparkling wine is poured into the top glass of a champagne tower.
title: mug_5176

asset_description: A young woman with red braids in denim dungarees leans over a wooden garden table and pours tea from a white teapot into a small cup on a saucer, then pours orange juice from a glass jug into a row of tall glasses, and finally tips a clay pitcher of juice into a large glass bowl.
title: teapot_5177

asset_description: In a white kitchen a woman in a navy headscarf opens the door of a tall built-in oven, turns to a baking tray of chocolate chip cookies on the counter beside her, lifts it, and slides it onto the rack inside the lit oven.
title: headscarf_5178

asset_description: A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.
title: reach_5179

asset_description: A grey-haired woman in a burgundy suit steps out of a black limousine onto a red carpet in front of a white palace lined with flags and guards and waves to the cameras, then sits at a desk and signs a document with a black fountain pen, holds the open folder up to show the fresh blue signature, and finally raises both arms to a cheering crowd from a balcony.
title: signature_5181

asset_description: A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.
title: achievement_5182

asset_description: On a cobbled stone bridge at sunset a young man in a grey suit drops onto one knee and holds up an open ring box to a young woman in a yellow dress. She claps both hands over her mouth in tears. A close-up shows the diamond ring in the black velvet box against the golden sunset; an accordion player and passers-by watch from behind. She says yes, they laugh, and she throws her arms around him as strangers applaud.
title: romantic_5184

asset_description: Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.
title: kindness_5185

asset_description: A sunny mown grass field under a clear blue sky. A teenage boy in a white t-shirt and black shorts leans right back and hauls a thick rope towards himself hand over hand, face screwed up with the strain. The camera pulls back and the other end of the rope turns out to be tied to a green two-wheeled farm wagon, which rolls slowly across the grass behind him. He gets it moving, drops the rope and grins.
title: wagon_5187

asset_description: Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.
title: disappointment_5188

asset_description: A wet cobbled street outside a Paris cafe under a grey sky. An elderly man with a white moustache, a flat cap and a beige trench coat holds his bare palm out flat to feel whether it is still raining, a folded red umbrella under his arm. Drops keep falling, so he lifts the umbrella, opens it with a snap over his head and stands under it, smiling at the camera while rain streaks past and other people pass behind him with their own umbrellas up.
title: weather_5189

asset_description: A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.
title: windy_5190

asset_description: On a flat white plain that is covered in snow to the horizon, a woman in a thick orange polar parka with a fur-trimmed hood holds a rope on a metal flagpole. A Norwegian flag climbs the pole against a deep blue sky. Two more people in the same orange parkas pull on the rope together to hoist the flag while others stand around holding mugs, a small hut on the snow behind them. The flag reaches the top and flaps in the wind above the group.
title: snowy_5191

asset_description: Close up on black gloved hands gripping a white rope on a flagpole, a red flag bunched at the top of the frame; behind, a flat field of snow runs out to a straight line where the white ground meets the blue sky. Three people in orange polar suits pull the rope together and the red flag climbs the pole. In the wide shots the empty snow plain stretches to that same distant line in every direction, with one small dark hut on it. The four of them finish standing at the foot of the pole, looking up at the flag.
title: horizon_5192

asset_description: Two young women in gardening dungarees sit on a wooden bench in a green garden. One of them, red-haired, screws her face up in pain and holds out her bare forearm, which is covered in a patch of angry red blotchy spots, and scratches at it with her fingers. Her friend uncaps a white tube of cream and squeezes a blob onto the red patch, then it is rubbed into a white circle over the spots. The red-haired one winces and grimaces at the sting while her friend laughs beside her.
title: rash_5193

asset_description: A young blonde woman sits curled up on a grey sofa in a bright living room, a white curtained window behind her. She holds a thick paperback open in both hands and reads it, her lips moving slightly as her eyes track the lines. She smiles at something on the page and turns over a page. At the end she closes the book, holds it on her lap and looks up and away with a satisfied smile.
title: novel_5194

asset_description: A young man in a yellow beanie and denim jacket sits on a long wooden slatted seat in a green park, trees and paths behind him. Several books are spread out along the seat next to him and a huge open volume lies across his knees. He picks up a small dark red book, then bends over the big open one, flipping through its pages faster and faster with his mouth open. At the end he lifts the enormous brown book right up over his head with both hands and stares up at it.
title: bench_5195

asset_description: A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.
title: bun_5196

asset_description: In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.
title: rebel_5197

asset_description: In a sunny kitchen a young woman in an apron and a green headscarf works through a handwritten page step by step. She leans over it and points at a line, chops cherry tomatoes on a board, tips them into a big bowl of cut vegetables, holds the page up and reads the next step, pours olive oil over the salad, then lays the page flat on the worktop and smiles at the finished bowl.
title: follow_5199

asset_description: Inside a bright living room several young people burst into motion one after another. A woman throws off a grey blanket on the sofa with a huge grin, a man springs forward out of an orange armchair, another drops to the carpet and pumps out press-ups, and then the whole group jumps, high-fives, claps and cheers around the coffee table.
title: lively_5200

asset_description: A woman in a pink jacket and a woollen bobble hat stands on a flooded salt flat so still that it works like a mirror: her whole body, the snow-capped volcano and every cloud appear again upside down in the water below her. She crouches down, touches the surface with one fingertip so rings spread out, then stands up and walks away, small against the doubled sky.
title: reflect_5201

asset_description: A woman opens a big double-door fridge and finds it almost bare, with only one jar of pickles on a shelf. Then hands start placing food inside: an apple onto a glass shelf, a bag of lettuce and cucumbers onto the shelf below, jars and a juice carton into the door racks. At the end she steps back in front of a fridge packed with fruit, vegetables, milk and juice and her mouth falls open.
title: put_5202

asset_description: A family arrives at a front door hung with a Christmas wreath. A man in a patterned jumper carries an iced cake in while more people come up the path behind him. Inside the hallway there are hugs and kisses on the cheek between grandparents, parents, teenagers and children, the hall fills up, and the whole group raises glasses together for a toast.
title: relative_5203

asset_description: Two people in paint-spattered dungarees work on a wrecked room whose walls are bare plaster with old paint peeling off in sheets. One hammers at a battered built-in shelf unit, the woman rolls fresh paint onto a wall while the man smooths the plaster beside her with a trowel, the camera pans across the wet cream paint, and then the same room appears finished: smooth painted walls, new wooden shelves, a plant and a clean tiled floor, with the two of them standing in it looking pleased.
title: improve_5204

asset_description: At an outdoor ceremony in front of a domed parliament building a woman in a dark suit raises her right hand and lays her other hand on a book held open in front of her while she speaks into a microphone. The crowd behind the barrier waves small red-white-and-blue flags and confetti drifts down. She then appears wearing a tricolour sash, waving to the cheering crowd, and finally turns on the stage and spreads both arms while photographers shoot from below.
title: oath_5205

asset_description: In a library aisle a young woman in glasses builds an investigation board on a cork wall: she pins up notes and photographs, links them with red string, gasps as something clicks, flips through a sheaf of papers with a pen in her mouth, and steps back to look at the finished web of pinned pages, printed photos and sticky notes. Bookshelves, a laptop and stacks of books and papers surround her.
title: evidence_5206

asset_description: On a sunny alpine meadow below a wall of snow-covered peaks, two shirtless hikers with big backpacks toil up the grassy slope on trekking poles, skin glistening. One mops his face with his cap and sits down on a boulder, breathing hard; the other drops flat on his back in the grass with his arms out. They drink from water bottles and rest side by side, one sprawled on a wooden bench, the other on the rock.
title: sweat_5207

asset_description: A young man in a suit sits down to three very different meals in three countries. At a blue plastic table on a narrow southern street a pan of meatballs in tomato sauce lands in front of him; in a trattoria with red checked cloths a waiter lifts the lid of a steaming tagine of stew; at a rooftop restaurant above a night skyline a plated steak with vegetables is uncovered under a silver cloche. Each time his eyes go wide with amazement.
title: cuisine_5208

asset_description: A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.
title: lounge_5209

asset_description: Three friends are having a picnic on a checked blanket in a park by a pond when a big white goose marches straight at them. They shuffle backwards with their hands raised, one still clutching a sandwich; as the goose spreads its wings they scramble to their feet and run off across the grass, abandoning the blanket. The goose stands on the blanket over the sandwiches, honking, while the group watches from a safe distance further down the path.
title: retreat_5210

asset_description: Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.
title: return_5211

asset_description: Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.
title: station_5212

asset_description: On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.
title: railway_5213

asset_description: A red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat travels through three places. She cycles along an Amsterdam canal past gabled houses and rows of parked bicycles, then rides an electric scooter down a palm-lined seaside boardwalk under a blue sky, and finally sits on a camel plodding over bare orange sand dunes at sunset, a line of other camels behind her in the empty desert.
title: desert_5214

asset_description: A woman in a colourful cycling kit and a white helmet rides a road bike fast along a coastal mountain road; the camera tracks her from the front while grey cliffs, a fjord and green slopes pass behind her, other riders roll along the road ahead, and she finishes by riding across a bridge over the water, still pedalling hard.
title: cycling_5215

asset_description: A woman in a long yellow dress with a film camera round her neck walks slowly through a narrow lantern-lit alley at dusk, then wanders between the stalls of a night flower market, and finally steps out onto a rooftop and spreads her arms in front of a city skyline at sunset.
title: stroll_5216

asset_description: A smiling man in a yellow high-visibility vest pulled on over his t-shirt stands on a terracotta tiled roof above an Italian old town; the camera pans away from him across a sea of red-tiled roofs, bell towers and a green dome under a clear blue sky, then comes back to him as he throws an arm out toward the view.
title: vest_5217

asset_description: A girl in a mustard cardigan opens one door after another in an old house: a dark panelled study, a small yellow kitchen, a bedroom with a patchwork quilt on the bed, and finally a tall vaulted hall with arched windows, which she walks into and turns around in.
title: room_5218

asset_description: Two young men who share a flat argue over a full black bin bag and settle it with rock-paper-scissors; one of them lifts the bag to take it out, then the two cook a big pot of pasta together and hold up plates, and finally sit side by side on the sofa with a bowl of crisps, playing a video game and shouting at the screen.
title: roommate_5219

asset_description: A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.
title: steps_5222

asset_description: A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.
title: route_5223

asset_description: A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.
title: royal_5224

asset_description: A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.
title: finish_5225

asset_description: Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.
title: carriage_5226

asset_description: A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.
title: several_5227

asset_description: A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.
title: doll_5230

asset_description: A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.
title: hospitality_5231

asset_description: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.
title: yacht_5232

asset_description: Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.
title: military_5233

asset_description: Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.
title: rank_5234

asset_description: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.
title: cargo_5235

asset_description: A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.
title: star_5237

asset_description: A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.
title: dune_5238

asset_description: A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.
title: wing_5240

asset_description: A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.
title: elegant_5242

asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.
title: schedule_5243

asset_description: Two teenage boys in navy school hoodies meet in a school corridor lined with coloured lockers and do a clasped-hand shake, laughing. Outside they sit on a wooden bench with their backpacks open, unwrapping a sandwich and holding a red apple while they talk. The shot then widens to the school field, where a crowd of students in the same navy uniform play football on the grass in front of the school building.
title: classmate_5244

asset_description: A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.
title: flask_5246

asset_description: A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.
title: footprints_5247

asset_description: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.
title: rent_5248

asset_description: A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.
title: wash_5249

asset_description: An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her.
