She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.
title: type_5251

asset_description: A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.
title: tropical_5252

asset_description: In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.
title: senior_5253

asset_description: In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.
title: partner_5254

asset_description: A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.
title: guilty_5255

asset_description: A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.
title: address_5256

asset_description: A rooftop bar at sunset. A laughing young woman in a bright patterned shirt stands behind a long counter and shakes a metal cocktail shaker beside her ear. A whole row of people along the counter shakes shakers with her in the same rhythm. Strings of light bulbs hang overhead, the sea and a pink sky are behind them, and glasses, juice bottles and steel tins stand on the counter.
title: bar_5258

asset_description: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.
title: fur_5259

asset_description: A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.
title: shame_5260

asset_description: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.
title: share_5261

asset_description: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.
title: photograph_5263

asset_description: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.
title: shift_5264

asset_description: A young man with a camera round his neck stands on a wooden jetty in a container port. A small motorboat passes behind him while gantry cranes and stacks of steel shipping containers fill the far bank. He raises a pair of binoculars and watches a green ship loaded with containers glide past, then the white bow of an enormous cruise ship slides in right beside the jetty and he tips his head further and further back, open-mouthed, as its decks pass above him.
title: container_5265

asset_description: At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.
title: gun_5267

asset_description: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.
title: rifle_5268

asset_description: A young woman in a beige coat and orange beret shops her way through a city: first in a wood-panelled chocolate shop where she holds up a chocolate bar, then at a clothes rail where she takes down an olive coat, then at the till where she hands the coat over and pays at the card terminal, then walking through the glass atrium of a shopping centre, and finally out through the doors holding a large white gift bag tied with a gold ribbon.
title: purchase_5269

asset_description: A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.
title: supermarket_5270

asset_description: Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.
title: cry_5271

asset_description: The same three backpackers at the Grand Canyon railing, filmed closer. The woman calls out over the canyon, the bearded man lets out a roar while she points at him laughing, and then all three throw their arms and fists up in the air and whoop together over the view.
title: hiker_5272

asset_description: A male model walks a fashion-show runway in a yellow denim jacket over a purple shirt and green trousers with white and yellow trainers. The catwalk is painted in soft colour blocks and rows of guests sit along both sides filming him. He walks towards the camera, turns at the end, checks the watch on his wrist and poses smiling in sunglasses.
title: model_5273

asset_description: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.
title: soaked_5274

asset_description: Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.
title: sibling_5276

asset_description: A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.
title: agree_5277

asset_description: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.
title: corner_5278

asset_description: A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.
title: scroll_5279

asset_description: A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.
title: signpost_5280

asset_description: Four scenes of people performing music with words. A grey-haired busker plays an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on a cobbled Lisbon street while a crowd stands round listening. A woman in a colourful apron sings into a wooden spoon in her kitchen while pots simmer behind her. Four friends belt out a number together in a car at night with the city lights behind them. Finally a performer in a white suit sings into a microphone on a huge arena stage in front of a packed, floodlit crowd.
title: song_5282

asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.
title: tower_5283

asset_description: Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.
title: sweatshirt_5286

asset_description: Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.
title: silence_5287

asset_description: A skier in a red one-piece suit and helmet carves down a wide groomed piste in bright sun, throwing up a spray of snow on every turn. The camera follows from the side; behind him are snow-covered alpine peaks, a chairlift line and dozens of other skiers spread across the slope.
title: ski_5288

asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.
title: skyscraper_5290

asset_description: Inside a full airliner cabin. A blonde woman sleeps slumped against the window with her mouth open, then the shot pans back through the rows: a bearded man in a suit sleeps with a grey neck pillow, a man in a hoodie sleeps behind him, and further back rows of men in suits and jackets doze in their seats down the length of the dim cabin.
title: businessman_5291

asset_description: A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.
title: productive_5292

asset_description: Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.
title: glove_5293

asset_description: A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.
title: slippers_5294

asset_description: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.
title: traditional_5296

asset_description: A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.
title: ruin_5297

asset_description: A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.
title: blazer_5298

asset_description: An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.
title: illegal_5299

asset_description: A young woman in a yellow dress stands in a huge summer meadow full of yellow, white and blue wildflowers. She sneezes hard into her cupped hands, screws her eyes shut, wipes under her nose and presses a hand to her chest with a miserable, streaming-eyed face while the pollen-heavy field goes on around her and other people wander through the flowers in the background.
title: allergy_5301

asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.
title: blossom_5302

asset_description: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.
title: snowflake_5303

asset_description: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.
title: dirt_5304

asset_description: A man in a denim shirt is slouched deep into a brown armchair in a carpeted room, knees up and socked feet resting on the seat, talking to someone off camera. The shot cuts to a living room where he sits sunk into a patterned sofa beside a woman while a small boy leans against them. The room then fills: more and more people arrive and drop onto the sofas, sprawling across the cushions and each other, laughing, until the whole sectional is packed with a dozen or more friends lying back with their legs stretched out over the arms and over one another.
title: comfortable_5306

asset_description: A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.
title: spacious_5307

asset_description: A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.
title: sunflower_5308

asset_description: A woman in a grey blazer and glasses sits at her desk in a large open-plan office and looks down in surprise: a takeaway coffee cup and a wrapped pastry have appeared next to her keyboard. She picks up a small white card propped against them and holds it up — a smiley face is drawn on it in pen. She looks around over the top of her monitor at the rows of cubicles where her colleagues are working, then stands holding the coffee, scanning the room to work out who left it. She ends up back at her desk with the cup in both hands, smiling.
title: note_5309

asset_description: A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.
title: son_5310

asset_description: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.
title: calm_5311

asset_description: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.
title: backyard_5312

asset_description: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.
title: neon_5313

asset_description: A young woman with a camera round her neck browses a souvenir stall on a Paris riverside. She picks up a small metal Eiffel Tower, then lifts a snow globe with a tower inside and looks at it up close. In the last shots she holds a large woven straw basket with two round handles, loaded with metal towers, fridge magnets and postcards, while an older woman behind the stall puts a red beret on her head.
title: basket_5314

asset_description: A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.
title: postcard_5315

asset_description: A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.
title: curly_5316

asset_description: On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.
title: ruffle_5317

asset_description: A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.
title: speak_5318

asset_description: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.
title: demonstrate_5320

asset_description: A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.
title: skate_5321

asset_description: A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.
title: spit_5322

asset_description: Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.
title: stone_5323

asset_description: A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.
title: sponge_5324

asset_description: A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.
title: spouse_5325

asset_description: In a gymnastics hall with a vaulting horse, a balance beam and blue landing mats, a young gymnast in training kit lands badly and sits down on the mat with her face screwed up in pain, clutching her bare foot. An older woman in a grey training shirt kneels beside her, takes the foot in her hands and winds a beige elastic bandage around the ankle, fastening it with tape. When the ankle is strapped the woman puts an arm around the gymnast's shoulders and holds her while she cries.
title: coach_5326

asset_description: In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.
title: cape_5327

asset_description: A young woman in a walk-in wardrobe lifts a loose peach-coloured women's shirt with ruffles down the front off the rail and holds it up in front of her, sniffing it and smiling. She sprays it with a small glass atomiser, then takes a large white spray bottle and mists the whole rail of hanging clothes, walking along the rack from the pale shirts to the bright dresses. At the end she stands back in the middle of the wardrobe, phone in hand, looking pleased at the rows of clothes.
title: blouse_5328

asset_description: A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.
title: seed_5329

asset_description: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.
title: spy_5330

asset_description: A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.
title: fitness_5331

asset_description: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.
title: unity_5332

asset_description: A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.
title: staircase_5333

asset_description: In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.
title: respect_5334

asset_description: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.
title: enthusiastic_5335

asset_description: In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.
title: loyalty_5336

asset_description: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.
title: rail_5337

asset_description: A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.
title: stay_5338

asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.
title: control_5339

asset_description: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.
title: garage_5340

asset_description: In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.
title: tongue_5342

asset_description: Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.
title: twin_5343

asset_description: Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.
title: quilt_5344

asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.
title: lean_5345

asset_description: A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.
title: stomach_5346

asset_description: A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.
title: stop_5347

asset_description: On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.
title: thank_5348

asset_description: A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.
title: award_5349

asset_description: Dusk on a road beside a bare-treed park. A woman in a red beret, a knitted scarf and a fur-hooded parka holds the camera at arm's length and pulls it along behind her, glancing back and laughing. Above and behind her an ornate cast-iron lamp on a tall post burns orange against the deep blue evening sky, and a line of the same lamps recedes along the road, their light pooling on the tarmac and the pavement. She leads on into a wide open square where strings of white lights hang overhead and more lit lamps stand along the edges.
title: streetlight_5351

asset_description: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.
title: frustration_5352

asset_description: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.
title: paperwork_5353

asset_description: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.
title: class_5354
transcript: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.

asset_description: Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.
title: trainer_5355

asset_description: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.
title: yoga_5356

asset_description: A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.
title: fancy_5357

asset_description: A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.
title: peek_5358

asset_description: A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.
title: hippo_5359

asset_description: A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.
title: metro_5360

asset_description: A woman in a striped top stands in a hallway with a small teal hard-shell cabin case, pulling its handle up, then heaves a much bigger navy soft suitcase down next to it and gestures at the two. The shot cuts to an airport hall where she is pushing a trolley loaded with six stacked suitcases in different colours, leaning into it with a strained face while the top case tips off the pile.
title: easy_5361

asset_description: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.
title: silly_5362

asset_description: An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.
title: aid_5363

asset_description: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.
title: assist_5364

asset_description: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.
title: weapon_5365

asset_description: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.
title: surrender_5366

asset_description: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.
title: stuff_5367

asset_description: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.
title: tough_5369

asset_description: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.
title: canoe_5370

asset_description: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.
title: garland_5371

asset_description: A young man in a grey vest and shorts works his way across a white-tiled outdoor terrace, pulling a brush on a long wooden handle over the tiles and pushing scattered dry leaves into a growing heap. Palm trees, a parked car and a street are visible behind him; he works in flip-flops and the wet tiles reflect his shadow.
title: broom_5372

asset_description: In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.
title: expand_5373

asset_description: A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.
title: shallow_5374

asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.
title: swing_5375

asset_description: A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.
title: switch_5376

asset_description: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.
title: set_5378

asset_description: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.
title: alter_5379

asset_description: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.
title: take_5380

asset_description: Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.
title: conversation_5381

asset_description: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.
title: discuss_5382
transcript: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?

asset_description: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.
title: avenue_5383

asset_description: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.
title: win_5385

asset_description: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.
title: tear_5386

asset_description: An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.
title: sorrow_5387

asset_description: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.
title: packet_5388
transcript: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.

asset_description: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.
title: dodge_5389

asset_description: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.
title: youth_5390

asset_description: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.
title: stare_5391

asset_description: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.
title: terror_5392

asset_description: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.
title: calm_5393

asset_description: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.
title: mark_5396

asset_description: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.
title: opera_5400

asset_description: A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.
title: wonder_5401

asset_description: In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.
title: throat_5402

asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.
title: time_5403

asset_description: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.
title: greedy_5404

asset_description: A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.
title: toddler_5405

asset_description: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.
title: toe_5406

asset_description: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.
title: toilet_5407

asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.
title: kit_5408

asset_description: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.
title: tooth_5409

asset_description: A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.
title: toothbrush_5410

asset_description: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.
title: swirl_5411

asset_description: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.
title: pillar_5412

asset_description: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.
title: rail_5414

asset_description: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.
title: red_5415

asset_description: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.
title: locomotive_5416

asset_description: A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.
title: depot_5417

asset_description: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.
title: interior_5418

asset_description: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.
title: transfer_5419

asset_description: A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.
title: vessel_5420

asset_description: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.
title: recycling_5422

asset_description: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.
title: worldwide_5423

asset_description: Outdoors in a sunny garden full of palms, a young woman in a teal blazer and a young man in a grey suit sit side by side at a long wooden table, each with an open document folder in front of them. A crowd of colleagues in business clothes stands packed behind their chairs. Two small desk flags, one teal and one orange, sit at the front edge of the table. Both sign their documents, the colleagues clap, and then the two stand up and shake hands.
title: deal_5425

asset_description: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.
title: delegation_5426

asset_description: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.
title: seal_5427
transcript: I'm shaking. So nervous. I can't.

asset_description: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.
title: freight_5428

asset_description: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.
title: trust_5429

asset_description: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.
title: fast_5430

asset_description: A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.
title: balloon_5431

asset_description: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.
title: trick_5432

asset_description: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.
title: turn_on_5433

asset_description: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.
title: electricity_5434

asset_description: Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.
title: alike_5435

asset_description: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.
title: twist_5436

asset_description: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.
title: courtyard_5437

asset_description: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.
title: filling_5438

asset_description: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.
title: grey_5439

asset_description: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.
title: uncle_5441

asset_description: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.
title: sleeve_5442

asset_description: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.
title: cooperate_5444

asset_description: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.
title: misty_5446

asset_description: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.
title: billboard_5448

asset_description: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock.
