At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.
title: doorway_5449

asset_description: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.
title: device_5450

asset_description: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.
title: injection_5451

asset_description: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.
title: peaceful_5452

asset_description: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.
title: vase_5453

asset_description: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.
title: approval_5455

asset_description: A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.
title: permission_5456

asset_description: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.
title: visitor_5457

asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.
title: vitamin_5458

asset_description: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.
title: sickness_5460

asset_description: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.
title: ballot_5461

asset_description: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.
title: democracy_5462

asset_description: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.
title: journal_5463

asset_description: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.
title: waist_5465

asset_description: A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.
title: awake_5467

asset_description: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.
title: sign_5468

asset_description: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.
title: walker_5469

asset_description: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.
title: downtown_5470

asset_description: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.
title: level_5471

asset_description: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.
title: wealthy_5473

asset_description: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.
title: coin_5474

asset_description: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.
title: fort_5477

asset_description: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.
title: robe_5479

asset_description: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.
title: task_5480

asset_description: A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.
title: pink_5481

asset_description: A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.
title: bath_5482

asset_description: A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.
title: scan_5483

asset_description: A boy, a woman and a man stand side by side at the wooden railing of a rooftop terrace at night, with the roofs of a town behind them. Fireworks climb and burst in the dark sky above them. All three keep their heads tilted back and their eyes fixed on the sky for the whole clip, mouths open in wonder, the boy pointing upwards once as another rocket goes up.
title: gaze_5484

asset_description: On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.
title: watering_can_5485

asset_description: An elderly man in a flat cap and body warmer stands at a greenhouse windowsill holding a metal watering can over a terracotta flowerpot with a pale green succulent growing in it. He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.
title: flowerpot_5486

asset_description: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.
title: farewell_5488

asset_description: In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.
title: wear_5489

asset_description: A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.
title: weed_5490

asset_description: A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.
title: welcome_5491

asset_description: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.
title: hub_5493

asset_description: In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.
title: rumor_5495

asset_description: A young couple's morning at home. She stands at the stove in his oversized blue shirt, flipping a pancake in a frying pan while he dances up behind her in a white shirt and tie. She then turns to him, holding a big mug of coffee, and carefully straightens the knot of his tie against his collar until it sits right. Later they kneel at a low table in the living room holding hands over two slices of cake, and finally they flop onto the sofa laughing, she raising the TV remote in the air.
title: adjust_5496

asset_description: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.
title: candidate_5497

asset_description: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.
title: window_5498

asset_description: A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.
title: woman_5499

asset_description: A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.
title: storage_5502

asset_description: A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.
title: position_5503

asset_description: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.
title: send_5504

asset_description: Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.
title: dance_5506

asset_description: A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.
title: zoo_5507

asset_description: A bright concrete stairwell during a move. On the top landing a young woman in a blue vest top and black joggers, her hair in a long braid, steps down from a stair and stands holding a whole beige two-seat sofa above her head on her own, smiling easily. Below her a young man in a white T-shirt and maroon shorts slips on the steps hugging one big cushion, and at the bottom a young woman in a mustard jumper carries a floor lamp and looks up. A cardboard box and a potted plant stand by the tall window.
title: able_5508

asset_description: A selfie on a tropical beach covered in snow under a grey sky. A young woman with dark wavy hair, wearing a coral bikini top and a thin gold necklace, stares into the camera with her mouth open in shock as snowflakes fall. A clump of snow drops from a palm tree behind her; she shuts her eyes, looks up at the sky with her mouth open, then stares at the camera again. A thatched sun umbrella, turquoise sun loungers and a straw hat are dusted white, and the turquoise sea rolls in.
title: abnormal_5509

asset_description: A sunny market street in a foreign town with arched arcades and fruit stalls under faded awnings. A young red-haired woman with a big backpack, a loose linen shirt, trousers and brown boots stands in the middle holding a hand-drawn map, shading her eyes with one hand and looking lost. Two local men on either side point in opposite directions, one stepping closer as he points. At the end she breaks into a smile. A wheelbarrow and shoppers are behind her and dry hills rise beyond the rooftops.
title: abroad_5510

asset_description: An evening birthday dinner in a room with deep blue walls and a star-shaped pierced metal lamp. Two young women sit at a wooden table laid with an embroidered cloth, a cake with lit candles, marigolds, a wrapped present and glasses of pink drink; one rests her chin on her hands and both look bored and let down. At the third place, where a guest should be, a black cat sits with its head at the plate. The woman in lilac reaches over and pats her friend's arm. Open doors show a courtyard with a fountain.
title: absence_5511

asset_description: An orchestra rehearsal in a grand hall with tall windows, globe lamps and a golden laurel frieze. A young conductor in a black shirt stands on a wooden podium with his baton raised, then lowers his arm and steps down, frowning at an empty chair: a cello leans against it with no one there to play it. A young woman with a violin, a young woman and a young man with a violin sit in a row and look at the empty seat too. The cello's bow lies on the parquet floor in front of the chair.
title: absent_5512

asset_description: An apple orchard in warm evening sunlight. The trees are so full of red and green apples that the branches bend down. A young woman with twisted hair tied up, in an olive utility shirt and trousers, carries an overflowing basket on her hip, reaches up into the branches and picks another apple, laughing, while apples drop to the ground. Along the row stand wooden bushel baskets heaped with apples, more apples lie all over the grass, and two men work by a trailer stacked with crates.
title: abundant_5514

asset_description: An orange clay tennis court on a sunny evening. A young woman in a white tennis dress and white trainers, her blonde hair in a ponytail, stamps hard on her own racket with one foot, fists clenched and face angry, and a puff of orange dust rises. The racket bends and its strings fly loose, then it lies flat on the clay while she steps back and stands staring down at it, breathing hard. A yellow ball lies nearby, a towel hangs over a wooden bench and a green windscreen covers the fence behind.
title: abuse_5515

asset_description: A narrow, rain-wet street at night lit by neon lotus-flower signs in pink and yellow. Close up, a young man in a mustard shirt leans out of his three-wheeled taxi, shouting angrily and shaking his raised fist. The view pulls back and shows a young woman in a blue top and white trousers riding past on a mint-green bicycle with a basket, looking straight ahead and ignoring him. Street food stalls glow under strip lights behind her and the neon colours reflect in the wet road.
title: abusive_5516

asset_description: A beach at sunset under pink clouds. A young man in a white linen shirt and cream trousers kneels barefoot on a patterned picnic blanket and holds up a small open ring box. A young woman with long black hair in a flowing white dress grips his other hand and laughs with joy. He jumps to his feet, still holding the ring box, and they throw their arms around each other in a long hug. A wicker picnic basket sits on the blanket, footprints cover the sand and a man with a fishing rod walks along the waves.
title: accept_5517

asset_description: A retro barbershop with mint-green tiles, chrome lamps, a black-and-white checked floor and a striped barber pole in the window. A young man in a striped cape sits in a red leather and chrome barber chair and makes an OK sign with his fingers, smiling, while a young female barber with her hair in a bun brushes cut hair off his neck and holds up a hand mirror. He then turns his head towards the mirror to study his fresh short haircut from the side. A jacket rests on a red bench.
title: acceptable_5518

asset_description: The view from a wheelchair: the person's hands rest on the chrome push rims in the foreground, one wrist wearing a thin gold bracelet. In front of them a wide wooden ramp with metal railings leads gently up to the open green glass door of a brick café, next to a few stone steps. A smiling young man in a green apron holds the door open, and a wire-haired dachshund trots down the ramp towards the wheelchair. A pot of lavender stands at the top, and a harbour and cloudy sky are behind.
title: accessible_5519

asset_description: A stone castle courtyard at dusk under a purple sky. A young woman with long braids, in a steel breastplate over a maroon leather jacket, black leather trousers and tall boots, draws a longbow and shoots; her arrow hits a round target on a wooden log among several arrows clustered in its red centre, and splinters fly. She lowers the bow, turns and grins proudly. A young man in a padded navy tunic holding another bow watches behind her, and a fire burns in an iron basket under a stone arch.
title: accurate_5520

asset_description: A bright, nearly empty room with a wooden floor, a pendant lamp and a tall window onto a spiral fire escape. A young man with curly hair and a beard, in a long navy coat, stands stiffly and points his finger straight at a grey-and-white husky. The dog sits in a huge mess of white stuffing pulled out of a torn mustard-yellow cushion and howls back at him. The man lowers his arm and starts to smile, and the husky lies down on the cushion. A lake painting hangs on the wall.
title: accuse_5521

asset_description: A narrow old stone alley with steps, wet with rain at dusk, lit by an iron street lamp. A man in a soaked light-blue shirt and dark jeans raises one hand and puts the other on his chest with a sheepish grin, admitting his mistake, then laughs and covers his face with his hand. Facing him, a young woman in a maroon raincoat, cream top and brown skirt holds a blue umbrella and smiles with one hand on her hip. A wet scruffy terrier beside him shakes the water off its fur.
title: acknowledge_5522

asset_description: A rehearsal on a small black theatre stage. A young man in a black T-shirt and trousers kneels in the middle, flinging his arms wide and throwing his head back as he cries out dramatically, with a wooden prop sword on the floor beside him. He then collapses backwards and lies flat on the stage. A spotlight on a stand throws his shadow onto a plain plywood backdrop. In the front row of grey seats a woman with a clipboard covers her face with her hand and laughs.
title: acting_5523

asset_description: The dark ash slope of a volcano at sunset. A huge column of grey smoke and ash billows up from the crater into a pink sky and keeps growing. In the foreground a young woman with curly hair tied back, sunglasses, a beige and dark brown jacket and jeans looks through a measuring instrument on a tall tripod pointed at the eruption, then straightens up, shields her eyes with one hand to watch the cloud, and bends to the instrument again. Another person works further away and wind blows dust over the ground.
title: active_5524

asset_description: The point of view of a customer at a white marble café counter: two forearms in blue sleeves with thin gold bracelets push a small spread of coins together into a pile. Behind the counter a young man with a beard, in a white shirt and a dark apron, leans on his elbows and watches the coins with a thinking face, then counts on his fingers and grins. A tall brass coffee urn with an eagle on top, a glass dome of macarons, a small espresso cup and an espresso machine stand around him under globe lamps.
title: add_together_5525

asset_description: The point of view of a courier in a narrow alley where every wall, step and door is painted bright blue. One hand in a rust-coloured sleeve holds out a brown paper parcel tied with string while the other knocks on a tall blue studded door. A smiling young woman in a blue shirt and white trousers leans out of the doorway, takes the parcel and holds it to her chest. A rooster walks across the lane by her feet, pots of red geraniums hang on the walls, and a blue bench and an iron lantern line the lane.
title: address_5527

asset_description: The cabin of a private jet with walnut wood panels, a small lamp and a window where the sun sets over a sea of clouds. A young woman in a black blazer, burgundy top and black skirt sits in a cream leather seat and laughs, gesturing at the young man in the seat right next to hers. He wears a navy blazer, white shirt and beige chinos, holds a glass of sparkling drink, turns to her and bursts out laughing too, raising his hand. Only a shared armrest separates their seats.
title: adjacent_5528

asset_description: A pink Art Deco club at night with glowing neon stripes and a neon flamingo sign. A smiling doorman in a black suit unhooks a red velvet rope from its brass post and holds it aside to let a guest in. A young woman with curly hair, in a white satin top and skirt and strappy heels, walks past him up the speckled terrazzo steps towards the entrance, glancing back happily. Warm light spills from inside, palm trees stand by the pavement and a few people wait further down the street.
title: admission_5529

asset_description: A mountain hiking path in clear evening light, with rocky peaks, wildflower meadows and a stone cairn beside the trail. A young woman with a blonde ponytail, in a blue jacket and black leggings, points at a young man with a beard. He wears a rust T-shirt and beige trousers, raises one open hand and gives a guilty, sheepish grin, owning up to something. They both smile, then turn and walk away together along the path. Two backpacks and hiking poles lie by the trail and a marmot sits on a rock.
title: admit_5530

asset_description: A sunny city street lined with brownstone buildings and black fire escapes. A young man dressed in a huge hot-dog costume, with a bun, a sausage and a yellow mustard stripe, jogs on the spot grinning and points a big foam pointing hand towards a steel food cart. At the cart a young man in a blue shirt and beige trousers laughs as a young woman in a burgundy jacket hands him a hot dog, and he takes it. Long shadows fall across the pavement.
title: advertising_5532

asset_description: A bouldering wall built inside an old stone church with tall stained-glass windows, an iron candle chandelier and a carved wooden pulpit. A young man in a blue T-shirt stands on thick blue crash mats and points up at a yellow hold, telling the climber where to go. A young woman with a blonde ponytail, in a lilac sports top and black leggings, grabs it and climbs higher to a green hold, and he lowers his arm and claps. Two young women sit on the mats behind; one cheers with her arms up.
title: advise_5533

asset_description: An outdoor flower market under a grey-and-white striped awning on a sunny day. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, in a pink knitted jumper and a white skirt, takes a huge bunch of pink and white peonies from a smiling young stallholder in a white shirt and brown leather apron, hugs it and smells the flowers happily while he gestures and laughs. In front of them wooden tubs and crates overflow with peonies and tulips in brown paper cones, and a bicycle with a basket leans on the stall.
title: affordable_5534

Trays of round buns fill the display case and a pendant lamp glows above.
title: both_5673

asset_description: At a picnic in the desert at sunset, a young woman with long curly dark hair, in a rust shirt tied at the waist and white linen trousers, sits on a woven blanket on the sand, frowning and waving her hand at a small fly buzzing around her face while she holds a sandwich in her other hand. She shuts her eyes, blows at the fly, then turns and complains with an annoyed face as it flies off. A steel flask and a bowl of dates sit on the blanket, with sand dunes and a golden sky behind.
title: bother_5674

asset_description: On the sunny wooden deck of a sailing yacht, a young man in a navy linen shirt and white trousers sits on a folding wooden chair, tied to it with many loops of pink ribbon around his chest and arms, and laughs. A young woman in a yellow sundress ties a big pink bow on top of his head, while a young woman in a red swimsuit and white shirt pulls more ribbon tight around him. Rolls of pink ribbon lie on the deck, with the mast, steel rails and blue sea behind.
title: bound_5675

asset_description: In a retro bowling alley with teal walls, red panels and neon lights, a young woman with a long blonde braid, in a red cropped jacket and cream trousers, throws both arms up in celebration as her ball crashes into the white pins at the end of the shiny wooden lane and knocks them down. In the foreground another person's arm points down the lane. Then she lowers her arms, turns around and looks back with an open mouth and a surprised smile.
title: bowling_5677

asset_description: In a pink living room in a curved retro style, a young woman in a pink satin robe sits on a green velvet sofa painting her toenails, then sits back and stretches her arms up. A young man in a navy overcoat and suit stands by the wooden front door holding a scarf, checks his watch with a frown and lifts his hand as he gets ready to leave. A Siamese cat lies on the sofa, and a coffee table holds nail polish bottles and cotton balls.
title: break_a_promise_5678

asset_description: In a work yard at dusk, a young woman in a tan work jacket and trousers, her braided hair in a bun, places her hand gently on the arm of a young man in a dark zip jumper who holds an empty wooden crate. She speaks to him seriously, lifts a white paper and shows it to him, and he turns from her face to the paper with a shocked look. Workers in yellow high-visibility vests stand near metal sheds, a street lamp glows and the sky is deep blue.
title: break_the_news_5679

asset_description: In a traditional Chinese garden pavilion, a young woman in a lilac satin wrap top and cream trousers suddenly bursts out laughing, covers her mouth with her hand, laughs harder with her head thrown back and finally bends over wiping her eyes. Behind her a young man in a black traditional jacket kneels very seriously at a low rosewood table, pouring tea from a small clay teapot into white cups, while a mallard duck stands on the table beside him. A red lantern and a round moon gate with bamboo are behind them.
title: break_5680

asset_description: On a lit-up disco floor of bright pink, orange and blue squares, a young woman in a gold sequin crop top and white flared trousers dances close up with her arms raised. As the view moves back, four young women in the same gold tops, white trousers and gold heels appear, but their routine has fallen apart: each one moves in a different direction and at a different moment, one throws her arms up, one reaches sideways and one stands still. A mirror ball and a ring of silver spotlights hang above.
title: breakdown_5681

asset_description: In clear blue sea, a young woman with long dark hair, in a blue bikini top, black board shorts and fins, floats upright beside a rope with a weight hanging from it and slowly blows a long stream of silver bubbles from her mouth that rise toward the bright rippling surface. Her eyes close, her fins move gently and she brings one hand to her chest. A single fish swims past on the right, and a pale sandy seabed lies below her in the deep blue water.
title: breathing_5682

asset_description: In a dim, old-style bar during an evening of short dates, a young woman with curly hair in a green satin blouse and black skirt laughs with her chin on her hand, talking to a young man in a dark blazer and white shirt. He laughs, takes off his blazer and leans back, throwing his head back. On their small marble table an hourglass runs, its sand almost gone. Behind them other couples sit at small round tables lit by green banker's lamps. Two glasses of lemonade stand in the foreground.
title: brief_5683

asset_description: On an ice rink in a packed arena, a young male figure skater in a black top and trousers bows deeply in the middle of the ice while red roses fly through the air and land around him. He straightens up, turns his back and spreads his arms wide toward the crowd. Behind the white barrier a large crowd stands and claps, some holding scarves and flags, under bright ceiling lights. Red roses lie scattered on the ice around his skates.
title: brilliant_5685

asset_description: In a sunny stone courtyard under a grapevine pergola, a young woman with curly hair in a lilac cropped jumper and black trousers holds a small brown puppy and gives a half-reluctant smile. A young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt and beige trousers reaches out, scratches the puppy's chin and leans in close to it. She softens, laughs and lifts the puppy up happily as he smiles. A metal water bowl and a striped blanket lie on the flagstones by a blue wooden door.
title: bring_around_5686

asset_description: In a busy street market at night under strings of lights, the pavement wet from rain, a young woman in an olive cycling top and shorts leans from her cargo bike and hands a wooden crate full of steaming fresh loaves toward a bread stall. She gets off the bike, carries the crate to the counter, sets it down and talks to the people in front of the stall, smiling. Wicker baskets, a chalkboard price list and a warm-lit counter stand at the stall, and a small crowd watches.
title: bringing_5687

asset_description: A young man with black hair, in a rust-red jumper and big headphones, sits in a small wood-panelled radio studio at dusk. He smiles, talks into a silver microphone on a studio arm and moves the sliders of a large mixing desk with one hand. Then he leans back from the desk and lifts a hand to his headphones. A red light glows above the door, vinyl records and a glass of water stand beside him, and a red and white radio mast rises outside the window.
title: broadcast_5689

asset_description: A young woman with curly dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a lilac knitted top and a cream skirt, takes a mirror selfie with her phone. A grey parrot with a red tail stands on her shoulder and keeps flapping its wings next to her face. She frowns, squints and pushes her hand towards it, then lowers the phone, rubs her forehead and looks annoyed. The room has mint-green walls, blue wooden shutters, a cane chair with clothes, a bird perch and an amber chandelier.
title: bug_5691

asset_description: Seen from the back of an open safari jeep, a driver's hands rest on a padded roll bar. Ahead, a kudu antelope with long spiral horns and white stripes on its brown coat walks across the sandy track, kicking up a little dust, then stops at the edge and turns its head. Wild land of thorny shrubs, low green trees and a red termite mound stretches to the horizon with no buildings, a dry sandy riverbed winds through it, and heavy grey clouds fill the sky.
title: bush_5695

asset_description: In a small flower shop full of buckets of fresh flowers and hanging plants, a smiling young woman with her hair in a bun, in a maroon top and a long cream apron, hands a big bouquet in brown paper across a wooden work table to a young customer in a lilac T-shirt and wide jeans, who gives her a banknote. The customer then holds the bouquet to her chest and smiles. Behind them a young man in an apron works at the table, rolls of ribbon hang on it and a dog sleeps underneath.
title: business_5696

asset_description: Under the glass roof of an outdoor flower market at dusk, on wet pavement, a young woman with sunglasses on her head, in a camel jacket and dark jeans, holds out a banknote to a stallholder and takes a large bunch of pink and red dahlias. She hugs the flowers to her chest and walks away towards the camera, smiling. Metal buckets of flowers stand on the ground and hang above, hanging scales dangle from the stall roof, rolls of wrapping paper are fixed to the counter and a woman waits behind her.
title: buying_5697

asset_description: On an outdoor basketball court with a blue surface and a green metal fence at dusk, a young man in a blue sleeveless top and black shorts, seen from behind, holds the ball above his head. A young woman with long curly hair, in a red crop top and black shorts, stretches one arm high with her mouth open, shouting for the ball. She then runs up close to him and raises both arms high while he keeps the ball above his head. Two young men stand watching by the fence.
title: call_for_5698

asset_description: On a sandy beach at sunset under a pink and orange sky, a tall young man in a black T-shirt and white shorts stretches one arm out and waves someone over. A smiling young woman in a mustard top and navy track trousers comes towards him barefoot, pulling on her jacket. He turns and points towards the game, and she walks after him with the jacket in her hand. People play football by the sea behind them, a brightly painted wooden boat lies on the sand and a white wall with a lamp post runs along the right.
title: call_in_5699

asset_description: On the front porch of a red wooden house at night, under a dark sky with a crescent moon, a young woman with long dark wavy hair, in a rust-coloured zip jacket and black cycling shorts, stands in the open white doorway and talks, then raises a fist. A young man with a beard, in a green knitted jumper, stands on the wooden deck beside a bicycle with a wicker basket and looks at her. A small brown and white dog walks out between them. A lantern glows on the wall and a pot of pink flowers sits by the step.
title: call_on_5700

asset_description: High on a steep red-tiled roof above a sea bay, under dark storm clouds with sunlight breaking through, a young woman with curly hair tied back, in a dark work jacket and a safety harness, kneels on the tiles. She stretches out an arm with a grey slate, turns her head and shouts out loud with her mouth wide open. A rope from a hoist hangs on the right, and two men in dark work clothes stand on the bare wooden roof battens below, holding slates. Green headlands line the coast.
title: call_out_5701

asset_description: Under a covered arcade with pastel green and pink walls, arches and glowing red paper lanterns at dusk, a young man in a dark bomber jacket and beige trousers stands with his eyes squeezed shut and his arms at his sides. A young woman in a blue jacket and black trousers rests her hands on his shoulder. He breathes out slowly through his mouth, tips his head back, then opens his eyes and stands calmly as she steps back. A cream-coloured scooter lies on its side on the tiled floor beside them.
title: calm_down_5702

asset_description: In a living room in the evening with dark green walls, a green tiled stove, tall windows and a brass pendant lamp, a young woman with long braids, in pink pyjamas, sits on a rust-coloured velvet sofa under a cream knitted blanket and eats ice cream from a tub with a spoon. Her friend, dressed to go out in a sequined top, a black leather skirt and heels, with a small gold bag, stands beside the sofa, throws her hands out in disbelief and talks to her, then lets her arms drop. A candle burns on the table.
title: cancel_plans_5703

asset_description: On a rooftop building site at dusk with lit skyscrapers all around, a young woman in a blue and maroon superhero suit with a mask, a flowing cape and tall boots holds up a huge steel beam above her head. She rises from a crouch, pushes the beam up with one arm, then with both hands, and loose bolts fall from it onto the wooden deck. A crane hook hangs nearby, and construction workers in orange hard hats walk calmly across the roof behind her, carrying bags.
title: capable_5704

asset_description: In a long underground car park with a low concrete ceiling, bright strip lights and rows of white pillars, a young woman with a long red ponytail, in a black cropped jacket and black skirt, stands in the driving lane holding her car key high above her head and looks around. She lowers her arm, turns and walks away down the lane between cars parked in marked bays. A car with its headlights on waits at the far end, and a tabby cat sits on the bonnet of a parked car on the right.
title: car_park_5705

asset_description: Three young friends play cards at a table on a moving train, fields passing outside the window. A young woman with long dark hair, in a mustard top and wide jeans, throws one arm up in triumph and laughs, then puts her hand back on the table. Across from her a young man in a navy shirt holds a fan of cards and rolls his eyes up. A young woman with a red ponytail, in a green T-shirt, stands at the table holding her cards. Paper coffee cups and a pile of cards sit on the table, and a brown and white spaniel lies underneath.
title: cards_5706

asset_description: Beside a calm lake with pine trees and a wooden cabin, in warm evening light, a young man with a short beard, in a loose white linen shirt and light trousers, holds a big tortoise against his chest with one arm. He feeds it a red strawberry, looks at it fondly as it chews, then offers it another strawberry. A bowl of strawberries sits on a wooden picnic table in front, and a raised flower bed full of colourful flowers and a metal watering can stand behind him.
title: care_for_5707

asset_description: In a supermarket car park at dusk in heavy rain, the wet tarmac shining under street lamps, a young woman in a grey sweatshirt and jeans crouches and holds her open black coat out wide over a small wet shaggy dog. She wraps the coat around the dog, picks it up and walks towards the camera, hugging it to her chest. A shopping trolley with a carrier bag stands behind her, and a middle-aged woman, an older man and a man in a hooded jacket stand watching in front of the brightly lit shop.
title: care_5708

asset_description: At a wildlife rescue centre in soft golden evening light, a smiling young man in a green work shirt and white trousers feeds a baby elephant from a big plastic milk bottle and strokes its back. The little elephant wears a red and green checked blanket, swings its trunk and drinks, milk dripping from its mouth. The man then bends down and rests his head against the elephant's head while it curls its trunk up over him. A fence of rough wooden poles, a tin-roofed shelter and acacia trees stand around them on the red earth.
title: caring_5711

asset_description: In an old courtroom with dark wood panelling and tall windows letting in hazy sunlight, a young lawyer in a dark three-piece suit and tie walks across the floor holding a sheaf of papers and points at a muddy old bicycle on a wooden stand with a yellow evidence tag numbered 2. He stops, turns, then flings his arm out towards the bicycle and speaks with his mouth wide open as a sheet falls from his hand. Clumps of dried mud lie on the floor, and people in suits sit watching on the benches.
title: case_5712

asset_description: In a quiet forest cemetery at sunrise, rows of plain square grey stone grave markers stand among tall straight pine trees on frosty, mossy grass, fading into pink morning mist. A red squirrel with tufted ears sits on top of one of the stones, nibbling a pine cone held in its front paws, with bits of cone on the ground below. It then leaps down, runs across the grass and settles on a stone again, eating. The light is soft and cold, and the scene is calm.
title: cemetery_5714

asset_description: In an old underground office inside an arched stone tunnel lit by green desk lamps, a young woman with her hair pinned up in an old-fashioned style, in a green blouse and navy skirt, sits at a riveted metal desk. She lays a metal ruler across a handwritten letter on a glass sheet and runs a small blade along it to cut out a line, then sits back and smiles. Stacks of envelopes sit on the desk, a wire basket below is full of cut paper strips, and another woman works at a desk behind her.
title: censorship_5715

asset_description: On a snowy shore in Antarctica on a clear, sunny day, with white icebergs floating on the dark blue sea behind, a young woman in a yellow beanie, a red padded jacket, black trousers and gloves stands beside her backpack. A line of gentoo penguins with black backs, white bellies and orange beaks waddles past her one by one, and she points at each of them, counting, then lowers her arm. Further along the shore people in red and dark jackets work beside a white box, and footprints cover the snow.
title: census_5716

asset_description: In the sandy arena of a huge ancient stone amphitheatre, with rows of golden arches and stone seats curving all around under a pale blue sky with thin clouds, a young woman with curly dark hair, in a mustard blouse, a flowing white skirt and sandals, spins round and round with her arms out, laughing, her skirt swirling. She stays right in the middle of the empty arena, inside a large circle drawn in the sand, and small birds fly high above the walls.
title: center_5717

asset_description: In a bright office with big windows, pendant lamps and potted plants, three young colleagues play a wooden block-stacking game. A young man in a blue shirt pulls a block out of the middle of the tall tower, which wobbles and leans, then settles upright again. He holds up the block and grins. A young man in a green T-shirt crouches and holds the base steady on a book, and a young woman in a maroon jumper gasps with her mouth open and her hands raised. Coffee mugs and pens lie on the table in front.
title: central_5718

asset_description: In an elegant old office with wooden cabinets, a checked black and white floor, green banker's lamps and a crystal chandelier, an official in a dark jacket and gold watch presses a heavy brass embossing seal onto a cream certificate with a gold seal and a red ribbon on a round walnut desk. A smiling young woman with long black hair, in a green cardigan, sits across the desk with her chin on her hands, watching. The official then lifts the certificate and holds it up to her, and she looks at it in delight.
title: certification_5719

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a yellow raincoat, a striped top, rolled jeans and a straw hat rides a bicycle along a wet stone causeway, holding her hat on with one hand. Her wheels splash through sea water as she rides, and waves break on both sides. Behind her a big old grey stone abbey church with a tall square bell tower, arched windows and slate roofs stands on a rocky island with a green walled garden. Gulls fly under a heavy grey sky.
title: abbey_6814

asset_description: In a sunny town square at a lemon festival, a young woman in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue rubber gloves squeezes a lemon above her head over a long paper test strip. The strip turns from blue to bright red, and she shouts with joy as the crowd in summer clothes cheers, claps and films with phones. On a table beside her a bowl of white powder foams over next to a glass of juice. Behind the crowd rise a giant lion and a ship built from lemons and oranges under yellow bunting.
title: acid_6815

asset_description: On the small stage of a basement theatre with brick walls and string lights, a young woman in a black polo neck and trousers sits on a wooden chair and leans far back with wide eyes and flying hair, as if caught in a storm. A man holds an electric fan towards her and a woman on a ladder pours water from a watering can, while a man plays an upright piano. She then sits up and shades her eyes with one hand, looking into the distance. The audience in the front rows laughs and covers their faces.
title: act_out_6816

asset_description: On a big steel bridge on a misty morning, a young woman in an orange jacket and green headscarf sits cross-legged on the wet road and shouts into a megaphone, one arm locked into a painted tube joining her to the next person. Other young protesters in warm hats sit in a line across the lanes under a flag with a burning globe. She leans forward and keeps shouting, then lowers the megaphone and stares straight ahead in silence. A police officer in a yellow vest stands behind her, and lorries wait with their lights on.
title: activist_6817

asset_description: In a busy old-fashioned office with tall windows, wooden desks, typewriters, rotary phones and an old computer, a young man in a light blue shirt, tie and grey trousers rolls along the wooden floor on red roller skates, carrying a tall stack of ring binders. He sways and kicks one skate out as he moves, and a loose sheet falls to the floor. Colleagues at every desk wave folders and documents at him, calling for his attention, and an open filing cabinet drawer stands beside him.
title: administrator_6818

asset_description: On the rainy deck of a navy ship in a harbour, an older woman in a long dark navy coat with gold buttons, thick gold stripes on the sleeves and a white-topped peaked cap stands on a wooden step, raises her hand and salutes. She holds the salute, then drops her arm and speaks. Behind her a line of young sailors in dark uniforms and white caps stands to attention, one of them saluting, and an officer in a raincoat watches. A flag flies from a mast above them and a small tugboat waits on the grey water.
title: admiral_6819

asset_description: A huge grown elephant with long curved white tusks and big ears walks across a dry golden savanna at sunset. Right beside its front legs trots a tiny baby elephant, lifting its short trunk and kicking up dust. The big elephant swings its trunk down and gently touches the baby's back as they walk on together. The grass is tall and pale, flat-topped acacia trees stand behind them and low hills fade into the warm orange haze of the evening sky.
title: adult_6820

asset_description: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, with chandeliers, candles, white tablecloths and tall arched windows over a river, a young woman in a green silk dress looks down into her open brown wallet with a nervous smile. A man in a velvet jacket points happily at the menu while a waiter pours champagne. She closes the wallet in her lap and looks up as a waiter brings a tall three-level tray of lobster, crabs and oysters to the table, and she smiles. A violinist plays behind them.
title: afford_6821

asset_description: In a narrow stone street of a seaside town after a big storm, a wooden fishing boat with a tall mast lies stranded in the road next to a parked car, hung with seaweed, while seagulls fly around it. Seaweed, white crates and rubbish cover the wet road, and water gushes out of a doorway onto the pavement and slowly stops. A young woman in a jumper and green wellies holds a broom by a shop door and stares up at the boat with her mouth open. Further down, two men stand in the street near a black dog and an armchair.
title: aftermath_6823

asset_description: On a flat city rooftop on a hot sunny day, a young man in a backwards cap, a sleeveless shirt and shorts crouches beside several big metal air conditioning units with round fans and wire grilles. He connects coloured hoses and pressure gauges to one of the units, with a white bucket beside him. He wipes the sweat from his forehead with his arm, then looks up, holds the gauges and talks with a tired face. Low brick buildings, trees and a clear blue sky surround the roof.
title: air_conditioning_6824

asset_description: At an old wooden chalet in a sunny mountain village, a smiling young woman in a white shirt leans out over an upstairs balcony rail and shakes a big white duvet out into the fresh air, flapping it up and down and laughing. Pillows hang on the wall beside her, a striped rug hangs on the rail next to red geraniums, and below, an older woman in a striped cardigan arranges pillows while a cat sits beside her. A church tower with an onion dome and snowy peaks rise in the background.
title: air_out_6825

asset_description: On a whitewashed terrace above the sea in soft evening light, a light wind blows the long white curtains of the doorway out into the air. Pink petals float past and a straw hat rolls across the stone floor. A young man in an open white shirt lies on a built-in bench with a blue cushion, a book in his hand, and smiles as the breeze moves his hair. A shell wind chime sways, a young woman leans on the white wall by a domed chapel, and a cat walks past a table with a water jug.
title: air_6826

asset_description: In a small bedroom in bright morning light, a young woman with messy blonde hair and a white T-shirt lies asleep on a white pillow. Beside the bed a round silver alarm clock with two bells stands on a wooden chair used as a bedside table, on a newspaper next to a book and a glass of water. She lifts her head, sits up half-asleep and swings her arm down towards the clock, knocking the book off, then drops back onto the pillow and sleeps again. A chest of drawers and a window with thin curtains are behind her.
title: alarm_clock_6827

asset_description: In a narrow corridor of an industrial building filled with flashing red light and a little smoke, a big round red alarm bell and red warning lamps glow on the white wall. A young woman in a white hard hat, navy overalls and a yellow high-visibility vest walks along the corridor towards them, then stops, stretches out her arms and shouts, directing a line of workers in hard hats and overalls who hurry along behind her. One worker carries a clipboard, and a fire extinguisher hangs on the wall.
title: alarm_6828

asset_description: In a crowded street market in an Asian city in late afternoon light, a young woman with long blonde hair, a loose white shirt, beige trousers and sandals stands with a wheeled suitcase and an open guidebook. She looks up and around at the signs in a foreign script, then down at her book and around again as a motor scooter passes behind her. A stallholder hands a paper bag across a food cart, and paper lanterns, cycle rickshaws and tangled overhead cables fill the busy street.
title: alien_6829

asset_description: In a large open boat workshop with a corrugated roof, the shiny, silvery metal hull of a new boat hangs from ropes above a rusty steel cradle and slowly turns as it is lowered. Workers in hard hats and yellow or orange high-visibility clothes hold the ropes and guide it from below. Coils of silver wire stand in the foreground, a forklift waits behind, and the sea and a quay are visible through the wide open doors.
title: aluminum_6830

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a yellow dress and a woven apron stands by a wooden fruit cart full of mangoes and papayas under a striped awning on a cobbled square with colourful old houses and palm trees. She holds a piece of mango high in the air while more bright green parrots with yellow and red markings fly in and land on her raised hand and her shoulder. Behind her a man at a café table ducks under a metal tray as the parrots flap past.
title: amazon_6831

asset_description: In the snowy courtyard of a grand stone palace, a young woman in a long grey coat and a black bowler-style hat, a sealed white envelope under her arm, leans in and pushes hard on the big golden wheel of a gilded carriage stuck in the snow, helped by footmen in red coats. Then she straightens up, turns and smiles, holding the envelope, while a footman opens a black umbrella. White horses stand in harness and men in dark suits wait on the palace steps as snow falls.
title: ambassador_6832

asset_description: In a bright modern office high above a city, a young man in glasses and a light blue shirt draws a curved line with a marker across a glass wall covered in printed charts, graphs and sticky notes. Then he steps back with a pile of printouts and looks at the room, while two young women behind him point their pens at the charts and stare at the curve. Laptops, coffee cups, a highlighter and scattered chart printouts cover the long white desk.
title: analyst_6833

asset_description: On a building site on a sunny day, a young woman in a white hard hat, safety glasses, a red checked shirt over a grey top and a tool belt stands on a ladder and holds a metal triangle ruler into the sharp point where two wooden roof beams meet, looking closely at it. A young man in a yellow vest holds up the beams from below and looks up. More wooden roof trusses rise behind them, and a woman stands on a balcony in the background.
title: angle_6834

asset_description: On a desert plain covered in bright orange wild poppies under dark stormy clouds, a dry seed pod on a tall stalk in the foreground bursts open and sprays a cloud of tiny black seeds into the air. Petals and dust blow in the wind and young green shoots grow from the red soil. A tortoise sits among the flowers, a herd of horses gallops past a spiky Joshua tree towards the front, and a hawk flies over snow-topped mountains.
title: annual_6835

asset_description: A modern red-brick apartment building with rows of balconies glows in low golden sun. A young woman in a white vest top and grey jeans pulls a big green velvet sofa up on a rope over the railing of her balcony until it lands inside, then cheers with a raised fist. Neighbours on the other balconies watch, two older women wave their arms and men lean over the railings. Washing and potted plants hang on the balconies and a van stands in the street below.
title: apartment_building_6836

asset_description: At a rooftop party at sunset with string lights, potted plants and a view over city roofs, a round barbecue grill bursts into flames. A young woman in a paper party hat, a yellow top and white jeans braces her legs and sprays a red fire extinguisher at the grill, covering it in a big white cloud, though small flames still flicker inside. Behind her a man holds a plate of sausages high over his head, and friends sitting nearby laugh and clap.
title: apply_6837

asset_description: Inside a huge Gothic cathedral with pointed arches, stone pillars and a round rose window, shafts of sunlight shine through incense smoke. An older man in long cream and gold robes and a tall pointed cream and gold hat raises one hand in blessing and holds a tall staff with a curled top. Beside him a young server in a white robe swings a smoking silver incense holder on chains. Rows of people sit on wooden chairs and watch.
title: archbishop_6838

asset_description: On a rainy evening on a wide, wet stone plaza by the water, a smiling young woman with a dark bob in a cream trouser suit holds out a white paper model of a building with curved, sail-shaped roofs. Behind her stands the real building it copies: a huge white opera house with the same shell-like roofs and a glowing glass front, with people with umbrellas on its steps. Fireworks burst in the sky, and she hugs the model to her chest and looks up at them, delighted.
title: architecture_6839

asset_description: At a small island harbour on a grey, windy day, a young woman with a long brown plait, a red jacket, jeans and boots stands on the wet stone quay next to a ferry's lowered ramp, a ticket in her hand. She sets down a cardboard parcel tied with string next to her backpack with a rolled mat, looks around and then calls out and points. Behind her a man pushes a trolley of sacks, and locals with a dog stand by a white cottage and orange floats.
title: arrival_6840

asset_description: In a huge open-pit mine at sunset with red dusty ground, a crane lowers a massive shiny metal wheel hub, made of discs, bolts and gears fitted together, on chains. A young worker in an orange high-visibility shirt, a white hard hat and safety glasses stands on a metal platform and guides the hub with his hands onto the axle of an enormous yellow truck, then steps back. A woman watches from the truck, a big tyre lies below and a spare gear part sits on a pallet.
title: assembly_6842

asset_description: At a packed outdoor music festival on a hot sunny day, a young man in sunglasses, a patterned shirt and white shorts sits in a deck chair balanced on top of a tall stepladder under a big red and white striped umbrella. He cools himself with a small fan and sips a drink, while the crowd in hats and bandanas behind and below him stare up in annoyance. Security staff in black T-shirts push through the crowd, and water sprays over the field.
title: asshole_6843

asset_description: In a dusty village square on a sunny afternoon with trees, colourful bunting and a cart with a wooden barrel, a young man in a grey sleeveless top and dark trousers crouches with his legs wide, grips a huge round boulder with both hands and slowly lifts it off the ground in a cloud of dust, his face tight with effort. Two old men with walking sticks sit on chairs and watch closely, other villagers stand behind them and a dog lies in the shade.
title: attempt_6845

asset_description: In a luxury flat with tall windows over the sea, left in a mess after a wild party, a serious woman in glasses, red lipstick and a dark grey trouser suit walks forward and holds out a thick contract with coloured tabs and a pen on top, speaking firmly. Behind her a man in a shirt sleeping on the sofa wakes up and sits up. Banknotes, playing cards, confetti and bottles lie on the floor and rug, and a curtain blows in the wind.
title: attorney_6846

asset_description: In a muddy scrapyard on a grey day, a huge round rusty electromagnet hangs from chains on a crane, with twisted bars and scraps of metal stuck to its underside. Two laughing workers in white hard hats and yellow high-visibility jackets, a young woman and a young man, hold on tight to flat metal sheets that the magnet pulls up towards itself, leaning back and struggling to keep them down. Piles of scrap metal lie against a concrete wall and a crane stands behind.
title: attraction_6847

asset_description: On a busy sandy beach under dark storm clouds, with rough grey waves and a wooden lifeguard tower, a young woman in a dark navy uniform jacket and white shirt walks towards the camera, raises a megaphone and shouts through it. Beside her a young lifeguard in red shorts carries a red flag on a pole, and police officers in light blue shirts and caps walk with her. Sunbathers fill the beach behind them, and a beach umbrella blows away in the wind.
title: authority_6848

asset_description: In a steep, narrow cobbled alley between old stone houses with flower pots, shutters and washing hung between the windows, a small, round, shiny red vintage car with chrome bumpers drives slowly down the stone steps towards the camera as red petals float down. A laughing young woman leans out of the passenger window, then sits back inside, and she and the driver laugh behind the windscreen. A young man with a bicycle and an old woman with a basket of bread watch from doorways.
title: automobile_6849

asset_description: At a wedding party in a wooden barn lit by strings of warm fairy lights, a young man in a grey suit and dark red tie sits alone at a round table with a white cloth, confetti and plates of cake. He happily eats cake with a fork, raises one hand in a small wave, and goes back to his cake. The chairs around him are empty, with jackets and a handbag left on them. Behind him the dance floor is full of couples dancing close together.
title: bachelor_6850

asset_description: In a small home office at night, lit by a desk lamp, a young man in a grey hoodie sits at a scratched wooden desk and writes a label with a black marker on a small orange external hard drive. A second orange drive is connected to the open laptop beside him, whose screen shows a progress bar. Then he puts the labelled drive into a metal case with foam lining and closes the lid. Coiled cables, a mug and shelves full of boxes and folders stand around him.
title: back_up_your_files_6851

asset_description: At a science show in a busy hall under a glass roof, a young man in a white lab coat and gloves holds up a clear dish under a purple lamp, showing a handprint made of glowing colonies of tiny germs in orange, pink, green and yellow. A large screen above him shows round and rod-shaped cells under a microscope. A young woman in a tracksuit top holds up her open hand beside him and stares at the dish in surprise, while teenagers behind a rope film with their phones.
title: bacteria_6852

asset_description: On a salt marsh at dawn, with muddy creeks, green grass and a line of geese flying across a pale sky, a young woman in a flat cap, a waxed olive jacket, green trousers and rubber boots stands holding several wild ducks she has caught, hanging from a strap. She lifts the strap with the ducks over her shoulder and then reaches down to stroke a wet golden retriever that stands beside her looking up. A canvas bag with a flask lies on the grass at her feet.
title: bag_6853

asset_description: On a wet wooden jetty by a wide river, a young woman in a white vest and black shorts stands still while two teammates tie a long strip of bright red cloth around her upper arm. When they let go, she looks down at the red band on her arm and smiles, its long ends hanging down. Around her rows of young rowers in white vests hold wooden oars upright, rowing boats lie on the dock and a timber boathouse with a board of gold names stands behind.
title: band_6854

asset_description: In an open farm shed, a young man in a denim shirt and white T-shirt holds a big bunch of long-stemmed sunflowers and ties the stems together with twine from a spool on the wet metal table in front of him. Then he lifts the finished bundle upright, holds it out and swings it onto his shoulder. Leaves, petals and another bundle of sunflowers lie on the table, two older men work behind him and a field of sunflowers stretches away outside.
title: band_6855

asset_description: At an outdoor dinner on a hillside at sunset, a young woman in sunglasses and a white sleeveless dress hugs a huge armful of long baguettes and pulls a red ribbon tight around them to tie them into one bundle. A scruffy grey-brown dog reaches up for the bread at the start, and one baguette flies through the air behind her while a guest throws up her arms. Guests stand by a long table with a white cloth under paper lanterns and a vine-covered pergola.
title: band_6856

asset_description: In an old-fashioned bank office with tall windows and a large leather-topped desk with a brass lamp, a serious young woman in a dark grey suit sits at the desk and slides a folded paper towards a bearded man in a cap sitting opposite her. He picks it up and unfolds it while she holds a pen. Behind her a man in a dark suit reads a big open ledger, and a heavy steel vault door stands open, showing shelves stacked with bundles of banknotes.
title: banker_6858

asset_description: On a muddy country lane between a dry stone wall and a busy motorway, in low evening sun, a young man in a checked shirt, a quilted vest, jeans and rubber boots pushes hard against a huge round hay bale in the open gap of a wooden gate, blocking it. A long line of black and brown cattle comes trotting down the lane towards him and past him, and a young woman standing on the step of a tractor waves her arms. His cap lies in the mud.
title: bar_6859

asset_description: At the tall wrought-iron gates of a grand stone castle with towers on a sunny day, a smiling young man in a green tweed jacket, checked shirt and tie swings one gate wide open and steps aside to let villagers in for a summer fair. People carry a wooden folding table, a woman in a pink dress hurries in with a cake tin and a scruffy dog runs past. An old man in a tweed waistcoat holding a ring of keys watches, and bunting and a small flag lie on the gravel.
title: baron_6860

asset_description: In a grand hall with a crystal chandelier, tall windows and gold-framed portraits, a young man in a black tailcoat, white bow tie, a wide blue sash and a gold star medal stands at the top of red-carpeted marble stairs and calmly leans forward to reach for a silver tray held out by a young maid in a black dress and white apron, who holds up a glass. Guests in evening gowns, long gloves and suits watch from below in shock.
title: baron_6861

asset_description: On a wide, flat, white salt plain at sunrise under a pale pink sky, a young man in a white sleeveless top, navy trousers and white socks pushes up into a perfectly straight handstand on a simple wooden set of two parallel bars, his arms locked and his legs pointing to the sky. Then he swings off the bars sideways, lands on the cracked salt ground in a cloud of white dust and throws both arms up in triumph.
title: bars_6862

asset_description: Inside an old wooden barn lit by sunbeams through the planks, a heavy burlap sack lies open on a wooden cart with spoked wheels, and a stream of dried beans in white, cream, red, brown and black pours out of it onto the floorboards, forming a big spreading pile. Brown hens walk up and peck at the beans, and one hen flaps up onto the cart. A tabby cat sleeps on top of the other sacks, with hay and dried herbs in the background.
title: bean_6863

asset_description: At night inside an old stone barn with arched doorways and a lit oil lantern hanging from a beam, a young woman in a knitted hat and waxed green jacket kneels in the straw with her hands pressed to her mouth, moved and amazed. In front of her a ewe licks a tiny newborn white lamb that stands up on shaky legs. The woman lowers her hands, smiles and claps softly. A metal bucket and a towel lie beside her, and other sheep look over a wooden pen.
title: bear_6864

asset_description: At a wedding party in a muddy field under a grey sky, a young woman in a white chef's jacket, a stained apron and green rubber boots carries a tall four-tier white wedding cake high above her head on a board, stepping carefully through deep mud. A herd of black and brown cows crowds around her, one stretching its nose towards her. An overturned shopping trolley lies in the mud, and guests in suits and dresses watch from a wooden platform in front of a white marquee with bunting.
title: bear_6865

asset_description: A large herd of cattle crosses a shallow river at sunrise under a cloudy golden sky. A big, dark brown, stocky bullock walks out of the water onto a pebbly bank in the foreground, splashing, with a brown calf beside it. Behind them dozens of brown, black and white-faced cattle wade through the river, white egrets stand and fly among them, and riders on horses wait on the far bank near a farmhouse and willow trees.
title: beef_6866

asset_description: Inside a long black luxury car on a rainy night in a city, a young female chauffeur in a black peaked cap, black jacket and leather gloves drives calmly, looking ahead. Behind her a clear glass wall divides the car, and in the back seat a laughing bride in a lace wedding dress and a young woman in a pink dress hit each other with pillows, filling the back with flying white feathers. City lights blur through the wet windows.
title: berlin_6868
