asset_description: On a mountain farm on a sunny day, with a stone house, a stone wall and snowy peaks behind, a big shaggy male goat with a long beard and huge curved horns stands on the roof of a small old cream-coloured car. A young woman in a red checked shirt, green dungarees and rubber boots holds up a carrot to it, and the goat takes it, rears up on its back legs and lands on the roof again while she watches with her hands on her hips. More goats stand along the wall.
title: billy_6870

asset_description: On a rainy cobbled square outside an old stone church, a young clergyman in a long gold embroidered cloak over a white robe, with a silver cross on his chest, stands with his eyes closed and one hand raised in blessing. Behind him a big dappled grey horse on a lead grabs his tall pointed gold-and-white hat in its teeth and lifts it off his head into the air. The young woman holding the horse gasps, and villagers with a goat and umbrellas watch.
title: bishop_6871

asset_description: Low down in a sandy riding arena on a cloudy day, a bay horse pushes its head towards the camera and pulls a funny face, lips pulled back to show its big teeth around the shiny metal ring and bar in its mouth, joined to the leather bridle and reins. Drool drips from its mouth. The young woman riding it in a black helmet and navy fleece laughs out loud. Behind them a man stands by white jumping poles and a rider on a grey horse waits.
title: bit_6872

asset_description: On a working boat moored in a grey harbour, a young woman in a knitted hat, work gloves and navy overalls with an orange high-visibility jacket pulls hard on a rope with a squinting face, sounding a huge brass horn fixed to the white cabin, which shoots out a loud burst of steam. Then she lets go and shouts up at the horn. Behind her crew members in orange and navy workwear stand on deck, and a big flock of seagulls flies up from the quay.
title: blast_6873

asset_description: At a cosy kitchen table at night by a window with fairy lights and a city view, a young woman with her hair in a messy bun, flour on her face and a cream jumper eats a big bite of cake from a fork while typing on a laptop with a colourful web page open. Then she lowers the fork and turns to look to the side. In front of her stand three plates of home-made cakes, each with a yellow sticky note, plus mugs and a bowl. A tabby cat watches from the windowsill.
title: blogger_6874

asset_description: Inside an orange mountain tent at night in a snowstorm, lit by a hanging lantern, a young woman in a blue puffer jacket and a headband with a head torch kneels and reads the round dial of a gauge in her hand. It is connected to a grey cuff wrapped around the upper arm of a bare-chested young man sitting wrapped in a silver emergency blanket. She looks up at him. A green gas bottle and an ice axe lie on the floor, and a climber crouches in the snowy doorway.
title: blood_pressure_6875

asset_description: A small white propeller plane stands on a tropical airstrip by a turquoise sea, with palm trees and a windsock. A laughing young woman with long wavy hair, a white shirt, a yellow flowered skirt and a denim jacket tied round her waist climbs the short metal steps to the open door, carrying a surfboard. A smiling pilot in a navy uniform leans out and helps her, and she steps up into the plane. Below, a ground worker in a yellow vest and ear protectors loads bags onto a luggage cart.
title: board_a_plane_6876

asset_description: On a seaside promenade a huge brown dust storm rolls in behind palm trees. A young man in a blue shirt, cargo shorts, work boots and a white vest presses a sheet of plywood over the window of a small pink ice-cream kiosk with one hand and hammers a nail into it. Then he turns his head and stares at the approaching storm in alarm. The kiosk's other window is already covered with two crossed planks, and stacked plywood boards and loose planks lie on the paving while people walk a dog behind.
title: board_up_6877

asset_description: In an indoor rink a young women's ice hockey player in a white and navy jersey and a navy helmet with a face cage skates hard along the white wall around the rink, her stick across her body, with a yellow strip along its bottom. She turns away from the wall and skates on past the camera. Behind her another player lies on the ice. Above the wall, fans behind tall glass panels cheer and bang on the glass, and a coach in a dark suit shouts from the bench.
title: boards_6879

asset_description: At a night festival a man with his hair in a bun, in a dark short coat and trousers, stands in a wide lunge on a wet wooden stage and strikes the skin of a giant drum on a red stand with a thick wooden stick, so that dust and spray fly off the drumhead. He swings the stick high over his head, hits the drum again and shouts. Paper lanterns glow on a string above, a wooden shrine gate stands in the smoke behind, and spectators crowd the edge of the stage.
title: boom_6882

asset_description: At an outdoor music festival at dusk under a stormy grey sky, a smiling man in a black T-shirt with headphones around his neck pushes up a fader on a large mixing desk, and its rows of level meters glow brighter. Beyond a barrier a huge crowd raises their arms towards a stage lit by spotlights and haze, where a band plays. A young woman in the crowd cheers with a raised hand. Then the man, grinning widely, cups a hand to his mouth and shouts towards the stage.
title: boost_6883

asset_description: In a retro American diner a man in a denim jacket sits in a booth with high cream and burgundy padded bench backs around a chrome-edged table with plates of pancakes. A huge brindle Great Dane stands with its front paws on the table. A young waitress in a mint-green uniform and white apron, with a scarf in her dark ponytail, pours coffee from a steel pot into a cup, then pulls the pot back and looks on as the dog lowers its head and drinks from the cup. Men in the next booth watch and grin.
title: booth_6884

asset_description: In a sunny city park a young woman with a blonde ponytail, a white T-shirt and light blue jeans holding an ice-cream cone looks back over her shoulder with her mouth wide open. The seat of her jeans is covered in green stripes of wet paint, and she puts one hand on her bottom. Beside her a young man in a denim jacket bends over laughing and points at the freshly painted green bench. A cardboard sign reading WET PAINT and a paint tin lie on the ground, with pigeons, joggers and a pond behind.
title: bottom_6885

asset_description: On tall orange sand dunes under a clear blue sky, a young woman in a white crop top, a flowing rust-coloured skirt and a mustard scarf leaps barefoot down the steep slope in one huge stride, arms flung up and laughing, with sand spraying from her foot. She lands and keeps bounding down towards the camera in big strides, sand flying, and runs past. Lower down two people with backpacks walk across the slope, and a line of camels rests at the foot of the dune.
title: bound_6886

asset_description: In a sunny narrow courtyard between old ochre houses with peeling plaster and wooden shutters, washing hangs on lines strung across: striped towels, shirts, grey socks, a white sheet and, in the middle, a coral-pink bra hanging from a wooden peg. The wind flips the bra up over the line and it swings back down while the white sheet flutters. A peg falls and lands in a puddle on the wet cobbles below, near a bicycle in a doorway, a broom, a crate of bottles and red geraniums.
title: bra_6888

asset_description: In a grand hall with chandeliers, long tables covered in white cloth hold rows of chessboards and chess clocks. A young woman in a cream blouse and dark trousers, wearing a black blindfold, stands on the table holding up two fingers, then walks slowly along it between the boards, pointing down at them. Seated older men in jackets and jumpers stare at her in amazement, one man stands clutching his head with both hands, and a crowd of spectators watches from the back of the room.
title: brain_6889

asset_description: At a floodlit race track at night a dark blue sports car stops hard at the edge of the track, its front brake disc glowing bright orange behind the black wheel spokes, with sparks spraying from under the car. Another car streaks past as a red blur. The blue car then swings round towards the camera, its tyres smoking heavily, and slides sideways along the red and white kerb with the orange brakes still glowing. A stack of old tyres lies in the foreground, and a marshal post stands by a green light.
title: brakes_6890

asset_description: Seen straight down from above, grey tidal mudflats lie at low tide. A shining channel of water runs down from the top and splits again and again into smaller and smaller forks, like the trunk and branches of a tree, and the water glitters as it flows. The small dark shadow of a plane slowly crosses the mud, a line of old wooden posts runs diagonally across the lower part, and a small white rowing boat lies stranded near the bottom. Green strands of seaweed catch along the channels.
title: branch_6891

asset_description: In a cluttered metal workshop a young woman with a black bob, yellow tinted glasses, a denim shirt and a canvas apron heaves a wheelbarrow upside down above her head and tips a shower of golden brass objects onto a huge pile on the concrete floor: door knobs, taps, keys, hinges and hooks. A scruffy terrier sits on the pile. She lowers the empty wheelbarrow, sets it down and wipes her forehead. Behind, two older men sit at a bench, and shelves are lined with polished brass pots and jugs.
title: brass_6892

asset_description: At a big indoor swimming pool a young woman in a navy swimsuit and white cap bursts up out of the water at the wall, raises both fists and shouts, her goggles in one hand. She drops down, smiles, then throws her arms up again and screams with joy. A large screen above shows NEW 55.12s with a gold star and the line PREVIOUS RECORD: 56.08s. A swimmer in the next lane stares with her mouth open, officials in white stand on the pool deck, and a packed crowd cheers in the stands.
title: break_a_record_6893

asset_description: On an outdoor tennis court in warm evening light a young woman in a navy work jumpsuit, with sunglasses on her head and a long braid, kneels beside the bare chassis of a motorcycle and lifts out its silver engine. She sets the engine down on the court beside her and wipes her hands on a rag. All around her hundreds of parts are laid out in neat rows: bolts, springs, gears, cables, pistons and washers. Behind the net a young man and a young woman in denim overalls stand with folded arms and watch.
title: break_apart_6894

asset_description: At a rural cattle show on an overcast day, a shaggy ginger Highland cow with long curved horns charges towards the camera across the grass, its lead rope flying loose in the air. A young woman with braids in a white show coat reaches after it, and more handlers in white coats stand behind. The cow swerves and gallops along a wooden fence lined with spectators, who lean back as it passes. Other Highland cattle stand in a line, and a tipped bucket and a brush lie on the grass.
title: break_away_6896

asset_description: In a crowded city park on a hot sunny day, a young man in an olive polo shirt and shorts crouches on the grass and turns a metal key in a sprinkler valve in the ground, sending a strong jet of water sideways with a small rainbow in it. Behind him the picnic crowd scatters in every direction: two young women run holding a blanket over their heads, a man leaps over a hedge and runs past, and a dog runs along. More sprinklers spray near a gazebo, and the young man looks calmly up.
title: break_up_6897

asset_description: At an outdoor farm show under a cloudy blue sky, a big pink pig wearing prize rosettes and a PRIZE WINNER sash leaps high out of a show ring covered in wood shavings, its rope trailing behind. A young woman in a white coat dives after it and lands on her knees. The pig lands, scrambles over the edge of the ring and runs off past the camera, while the woman gets up laughing. Older men in tweed jackets and flat caps holding clipboards watch, with other pigs and a striped marquee behind.
title: break_6898

asset_description: A robin perches on a snow- and ice-covered metal railing in a blizzard, seen close up. Its bright orange breast is puffed out and its belly is white. It opens its beak as if singing, turns its head and closes its beak again as the view moves closer. Long icicles hang from the rail below it, snowflakes blow sideways, and far behind, blurred orange lights glow through the white haze near a dark rock face. Snow settles on its brown back and wings.
title: breast_6899

asset_description: Inside a plain old museum room with tall windows, a young woman in a grey coat, her dark hair in a bun, carefully lowers a heavy carved stone slab into its empty dusty outline on top of a glass display case, while an older man's hands help from the side. She lets go and smooths the dust around it, and the older man in a flat cap leans in to look closely. A crowd of people in winter jackets and caps watches. Other stone fragments stand inside the case, with work gloves on top and a bucket nearby.
title: bring_back_6900

asset_description: In a sunny churchyard in front of an old stone church tower with a clock, a young woman with a long braid, a fleece vest and leather gloves braces her feet and lets a thick rope slide through her hands, lowering a large green bronze bell from a pulley on a scaffold. The bell sinks slowly and settles onto a wooden cradle with sandbags on the grass. Among the gravestones other people watch, one man in black raises his hands, and coiled rope lies on a stone slab.
title: bring_down_6901

asset_description: Inside a wooden barn on a cold winter morning, a young man in a waxed jacket and green rubber boots, with a towel hanging from his pocket, bends down and gently sets a newborn black-and-white lamb onto the straw. He straightens up and watches as a ewe stretches forward to sniff the lamb, which stands on its own. A flock of white sheep crowds behind, a sheepdog sits by the metal gate, hay bales are stacked above, an oil lantern glows and breath steams in the air.
title: bring_in_6902

asset_description: In a bright art restoration studio a young woman in a white lab coat and purple gloves, with a magnifying visor on her head and a pencil in her hair bun, dabs an old dark oil painting on an easel with a small cotton pad. As she wipes, bright blue sky and then a figure in a red robe appear under the brown dirt. She gasps, steps back and smiles with delight. A tray of cotton swabs, jars and a colour chart lie on the table, and other restorers work behind.
title: bring_out_6903

asset_description: In a village hall decorated with bunting during a baking contest, a man in a green jumper lies dazed on his back across a table of pies and cakes. A young woman in a green cardigan and jeans kneels over him, wrinkling her nose, and holds an open box with a green herb pie right under his nose. He slowly opens his eyes and lifts his head, and she breaks into a delighted smile. A cook in a white hat gasps behind them, a crowd watches, and a cherry pie and a tipped jug of cream sit in front.
title: bring_to_6904

asset_description: In a dim brick foundry with wooden roof beams, a young man in safety glasses, a leather apron and heavy gloves tilts a long-handled crucible and pours glowing molten metal into a funnel on top of a sand-covered mould, as sparks fly. He lifts the crucible back and holds it still, and another man appears at the side. Beside them stands a life-size shiny bronze horse statue on a wooden base, and a bronze horse leg rises out of the sand in front. Old bells and ingots fill the shelves.
title: bronze_6905

asset_description: In a narrow second-hand bookshop on a rainy day, a young man with wet hair, a dark wool coat speckled with raindrops and a brown scarf leans lazily against a tall bookshelf with his hands in his pockets, glancing up at the book spines. He straightens, points idly at a shelf without taking any book, then leans back against the shelf again. Shelves packed with books line both sides, boxes of books sit on the wooden floor, and a young woman writes at a desk by the rainy window.
title: browser_6906

asset_description: On a snowy mountain top at sunset, five young men in bright retro ski suits in purple, teal and blue are piled together on an old beige sofa in the snow, laughing and shouting. One lies across the others' laps, one pours a hot drink from a flask that spills onto the snow, and others raise enamel mugs. A shaggy grey dog in a bobble hat stands on the back of the sofa and shakes its head. A stone cairn is behind them, and backpacks lie beside the sofa as snow blows past.
title: buddy_6907

asset_description: On a straight country road through golden grassland with blue mountains beyond, a huge shaggy brown bison stands right beside a red vintage convertible, its dark woolly head and short curved horn next to the side mirror, snorting dust. In the driver's seat a young woman in a white shirt and a yellow headscarf freezes with a sandwich at her mouth. The bison lifts its head, steps forward and walks slowly past the car, and she stares after it. More bison cross the road behind, and a straw hat lies on the asphalt.
title: buffalo_6908

asset_description: At night in a tropical rainforest a white sheet is stretched between a rope and a wooden pole and lit by a hanging lantern. It is covered with hundreds of insects: moths with spread wings, beetles, green shield bugs, grasshoppers and flies, with a huge dark horned beetle crawling slowly across the middle. Moths flutter on and off the sheet, a swarm flies around the lamp, a green praying mantis clings to the pole, and a wooden crate with a notebook stands on the leaf-covered ground.
title: bug_6909

asset_description: In a dark laboratory a brass-coloured bullet with a copper tip passes through a red apple on a steel rod. Its far side bursts open in a spray of white flesh and juice, and a ring of air and water ripples around the bullet as it flies on and out of view. Water drops fall in straight lines from above, a block of ice smokes at the base, small metal sensors with red laser beams stand on the bench, and a sheet of crumpled gold foil hangs behind. Apple pieces lie scattered on the bench.
title: bullet_6910

asset_description: At a bus stop in heavy evening rain, about ten people in jackets and hoods squeeze tightly together under the small glass shelter roof: a woman holding a cake box, a man with a bicycle and a cyclist in a helmet. At the edge a laughing young man in a wet white T-shirt holds a paper bag over his head as water pours off the roof onto him, and the people huddle even closer. Red double-decker buses with their lights on come along the shining wet street under the streetlights.
title: bunch_6911

asset_description: In a bright bedroom with a tall window and white curtains, a young woman with curly hair, a black slip dress and a black leather jacket stands beside a tall dark-wood chest of drawers with brass handles. Its drawers are pulled open and stuffed with jeans, jumpers and scarves. She throws a bundle of colourful scarves into the air, pulls a pair of jeans out of a drawer and tosses it, then pulls out a striped sock and holds it up. An unmade bed covered in clothes and tulips in a vase complete the room.
title: bureau_6912

asset_description: In a busy old bus station under a glass and iron roof on a sunny day, a shaggy brown dog wearing a small pack leaps off a wooden bench. A young man with long wavy hair, a cap, a khaki T-shirt and shorts swings a canvas backpack onto his shoulder, walks to a white coach and climbs in through its door, and the dog trots after him. An old man sleeps with his head back on a seat by the bench. Travellers with rolling suitcases, a woman holding flowers, a closed kiosk and pigeons fill the platform.
title: bus_station_6913

asset_description: Beside a desert highway with red rock cliffs in the distance, a worn-out pale blue station wagon with two rusty orange doors and bags roped onto its roof rack stands on the gravel shoulder, with white steam pouring from its open bonnet. A wing mirror falls off onto the ground. A young man in a red T-shirt and dirty jeans throws up a hand, kicks the car door, waves his cap and laughs up at the sky. A spare tyre and a fuel can lie in front, and a lorry approaches on the road.
title: bus_6914

asset_description: On the deck of a small fishing boat on a rough grey sea, a young woman with a long braid, a grey fleece and orange waterproof bib trousers braces her feet and fights a fish with a strongly bent rod, the thick end of its handle pushed into a holder at her hip. A big wave crashes over the side and water rushes across the deck. An older man in yellow oilskins comes out of the cabin and holds out a landing net. A bucket of small silver fish, cool boxes and ropes sit on the wet deck.
title: butt_6915

asset_description: Inside the cab of a steam locomotive, a smiling young man in blue overalls, a flat cap and a red neckerchief leans out of the side opening, holding a handle, as steam streams past. He turns back in, reaches down to a brass lever, then leans out again with a grin. Around him are brass gauges, copper pipes, valves and an open firebox glowing orange, with a brass wheel in the foreground. Outside are green hills and a curved stone viaduct, with smoke drifting overhead.
title: cab_6916

asset_description: In a small harbour at sunset under dramatic clouds, a large three-masted sailing ship with grey sails comes into port past a stone lighthouse at the end of the pier, as waves splash high over the harbour wall. On the pier a man in a dark jacket swings a coiled rope towards the ship, and a crowd in yellow and orange oilskins cheers with raised arms. A bearded man in a dark jacket comes forward on the pier, smiling, and hauls in a coil of rope. Colourful houses and fishing boats line the harbour.
title: call_at_6917

asset_description: In a bright corridor used as a waiting area, a young woman in a black blazer and white top, with sunglasses on her head, leans out of an open office door holding papers and a pen, beckons with one finger and speaks. Along the wall people in mascot costumes wait on chairs: a smiling sun and a chicken. A young man in a full banana suit walks past her through the door into the office, and she steps back to let him in. A coat stand with costume heads and a water cooler stand at the end of the corridor.
title: call_in_6918

asset_description: In the machine room inside an old bell tower, a large shiny brass disc with an egg-shaped outline turns on an axle between big gears and chains, and a vertical metal rod beneath it moves up and down. Pigeons fly off through beams of sunlight and feathers drift down. On the wooden workbench below, smaller brass discs of the same kind sit on a shaft next to oil cans. Through the slatted shutters a bronze bell hangs in front of a view of city rooftops.
title: cam_6919

asset_description: A young woman with long black hair blowing in the wind, dark sunglasses and a long red satin dress sits barefoot on a white toilet in the middle of an empty, cracked white salt flat. She calmly sips from a small glass of coffee, lowers it and looks ahead, a gold cuff on her wrist, and lifts the glass again. There is nothing else around her but the flat crusted ground, low mountains on the horizon and a clear blue sky in bright sunlight.
title: can_6920

asset_description: A large white government building with a tall dome, rows of columns and a gold statue on top stands across a snowy plaza on a bright winter day. A long line of men and women in dark coats with briefcases walks carefully down wide snowy stone steps beside a colonnade, past a metal handrail. A fountain sprays by the columns, a yellow snowplough clears the road, a flock of birds swirls above the dome, and a lost glove lies in the snow on the steps.
title: capitol_6922

asset_description: At a seaside skatepark at sunset, a young man in a black T-shirt and grey shorts sits on the concrete edge of the bowl, wincing and laughing, while a young woman in a white top and jeans with a long ponytail wraps a white bandage around his scraped knee. She finishes the bandage and then bends down to pick up a spray bottle beside an open green first-aid kit. Wrappers and a skateboard lie on the ground, a small scruffy dog sniffs nearby, and skaters ride behind under a pink sky.
title: care_for_6923

asset_description: On a steep cobbled street in a seaside town, a young woman with red hair, a flowered helmet, goggles and dungarees hurtles down the hill in an old white bathtub on iron wheels, one wheel off the ground, dust flying, between rows of hay bales. A marshal in a yellow vest dives aside. The bathtub rolls towards the camera and slows, and she pushes up her goggles and throws both arms in the air, screaming with joy. Crowds behind metal barriers and on a balcony cheer below pastel houses and a church tower.
title: career_6924

asset_description: On a dusty farm track between sunflower fields on a sunny day, a young woman with a long black ponytail, a brown leather jacket, a white top and jeans sits on the bench of a wooden cart with big spoked wheels, piled high with watermelons. She catches a watermelon that she has tossed into the air and holds it on her lap while a chestnut horse pulls the cart forward. A basket of sunflowers hangs on the side, a straw hat lies on the seat, a dog trots behind, and farm workers wave near a red-roofed farmhouse.
title: cart_6925

asset_description: At a snowy expedition camp below a dark mountain, a young woman in a blue hooded snowsuit and black gloves kneels in the snow beside an open orange hard-shell case and lifts a grey folded drone out of its foam compartments. She closes the lid of the case with one hand, unfolds the drone's arms and holds it up in front of her. A second orange case sits on a sled behind her, a man crouches in the entrance of a yellow tent, and another man shovels snow near bamboo poles as snow blows across the camp.
title: case_6926

asset_description: On a snowy city street at night, a young woman with long braids, a white bobble hat, black gloves and a sparkly silver sequinned coat stands at a cash machine set into a stone wall, taking banknotes from it while the screen glows. She puts one hand in her pocket and turns towards the people in winter coats queuing behind her, one of whom holds up a card. Streetlights, falling snowflakes, a paper cup on the pavement and a shop window with fairy lights fill the background.
title: cash_machine_6927

asset_description: In a lavish gambling hall with a gold ceiling and crystal chandeliers, a roulette wheel and stacks of chips stand in the foreground. Behind it a serious young man in a black tuxedo with a bow tie and a red rose stands beside an old dirty wheelbarrow piled high with red, black and gold chips. A young croupier with a black bob, a waistcoat and a bow tie holds a long rake, a young woman in a green sequin dress laughs behind her hand, and a young man in a velvet jacket sits at a card table.
title: casino_6928

asset_description: Inside a dark foundry shed with a corrugated roof, a freshly cast metal horse statue glows orange-hot as it hangs from chains above a mould box, gripped by long tongs, while chunks of black sand fall away below it. A smiling worker in a leather apron and gloves stands beside it holding a hammer, and another worker with folded arms watches from behind. A furnace glows at the back, a pale wooden model horse stands on a bench, and the floor is covered in sand and metal moulds.
title: casting_6929

asset_description: On a city street at dusk after rain, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a camel coat and white trainers leaps through the air towards the open door of a red bus, holding a stack of white gift boxes above her head, while her silk scarf falls into a puddle. She lands inside the bus, passengers wave and clap at the windows, a pigeon flaps up, and the doors close. The bus then drives away from the glass shelter, leaving the scarf lying on the wet pavement.
title: catch_the_bus_6930

asset_description: On a mountain road in bright summer sunshine, a young woman in a teal cycling jersey with a long braid and a white helmet rides towards the camera, smiling. As the view widens, two men in helmets appear riding level with her, one in grey with mirrored glasses and one in yellow, and the three ride side by side round a bend while the woman smiles across at the others. A low stone wall runs along the edge of the road, with high rocky peaks behind them under a pale blue sky.
title: catch_up_6931

asset_description: In a bright hotel bedroom, a laughing young woman with long curly dark hair in a white bathrobe kneels on a big white bed and swings a pillow that hits a blonde young woman on the side of the head, and feathers burst into the air. The blonde woman laughs and hits back with her own pillow as the fight goes on. A breakfast tray with croissants and a spilled glass of orange juice lies on the bed, pale dresses hang on a wooden wardrobe, and a third woman laughs in an armchair.
title: catch_6933

asset_description: In a climbing centre built inside an old empty indoor swimming pool with a glass roof and big arched windows, a young woman with a long braid hangs from coloured holds on a steep overhanging wall high above the tiled pool. She swings, reaches up, kicks her legs and hooks one leg back up, while chalk dust puffs in the air and a rope hangs below her. Down in the dry pool people climb the tiled walls over thick blue and red mats, a metal pool ladder remains on the side, and a small cafe counter stands at the back.
title: center_6935

asset_description: On a wooden harbour pier at night under a full moon, a young woman in a black sleeveless bodysuit, dripping wet, walks forward holding up an open iron shackle on a long chain and shouting in triumph, her breath steaming. A heap of chains, a black box and an orange rope lie on the boards behind her. Friends cheer and hug, a man in a top hat and waistcoat points at her, and a young woman in a red jacket holds up a foil blanket, under strings of lights and an old street lamp.
title: chains_6937

asset_description: In a floodlit stadium in the rain, a referee in a yellow shirt with a whistle in her mouth and a player in a dark navy kit kneel face to face in the mud, staring at a coin on the wet ground between them. The coin spins and comes to rest standing on its edge in the mud. The player gasps with her mouth wide open and puts her hand down on the ground, and the referee stares in surprise. Behind them a line of players in maroon kits waits in front of the packed stand.
title: chance_6938

asset_description: Backstage in a theatre, a young man in black trousers and a white waistcoat stands with his arms out while a dresser behind him pulls a gold sequinned jacket off his arm and drops it on the floor, then helps him into a black tailcoat. A young woman in black kneels to fix his trouser leg, and by the red stage curtain another woman in black holds up two fingers as a signal. A mirror framed with round bulbs, a rail of costumes and a pair of black shoes on the wooden floor surround them.
title: change_clothes_6939

asset_description: On a station platform between two trains at dusk, a young woman in a camel coat and trousers with a guitar case on her back leaps across the platform from one train door to the other, sunglasses in her hair, while a glove, an apple and a spilled paper cup lie behind her. She lands on the step of the right train and holds on to its door, looking back. A conductor leans out of the left train, and travellers with a suitcase, a potted plant and a dog walk along the platform behind.
title: change_trains_6940

asset_description: From the top of wooden beach steps, two hands in a knitted cardigan hold up an old printed picture of a sunny sandy beach with a small blue hut on stilts and people on the sand. Behind it the same coast now looks completely different: the sand is gone, grey waves smash against black rocks, and a broken hut lies on the rocks. A man and a woman in a yellow raincoat lean on a hut balcony and look down. Then one hand lowers the picture and holds up a steaming mug under a stormy evening sky.
title: change_6941

asset_description: A narrow stone water channel runs straight through an olive grove in warm evening light. On the left a wooden sluice gate on a metal post stands open, and brown water gushes through the opening, foaming and swirling along the channel between the two stone walls and carrying dry leaves with it. The water spreads and rises over the channel floor. A small wooden footbridge crosses the channel further along, dust hangs in the low sun and the ground in front is dry and cracked.
title: channel_6942

asset_description: On the stone stage of an open-air theatre on a cliff by the sea at dusk, an actor dressed as a Viking warrior, in a horned metal helmet, a fur cape, a long brown cloak and leather arm straps, shouts with his mouth wide open, swings a wooden staff high over his head and then plants it on the stage. A stagehand in black stands by the ropes on the left, footlights glow along the stage edge, and rows of people watch from the stone seats, with burning torches and crashing waves behind them.
title: character_6943

asset_description: In a busy airport departure lounge, a young woman in a grey hoodie kneels on the carpet next to a charging pillar and laughs as she holds up her phone, plugged in by a white cable. The red battery symbol on the screen turns green, and she makes a happy fist. Next to her a tired man in a grey suit and tie leans against the pillar with his eyes half closed. Cables, a spilled coffee cup, a neck pillow and bags lie on the floor, and a departures board hangs behind.
title: charge_your_phone_6944

asset_description: Inside an old wood-panelled train dining car with snowy pink mountains outside the windows, a young chef in a white jacket and grey neckerchief lifts a tall shiny metal ring off a round dessert on a white tablecloth: a cake walled with upright sponge fingers, topped with cream and raspberries and tied with a pink ribbon. A woman in a velvet top covers her mouth in surprise, a man in a dinner jacket stares and then smiles, and other diners watch from lamp-lit tables.
title: charlotte_6945

asset_description: At an outdoor pepper-eating contest under a canvas awning on a sunny day, a young man in a white shirt and a red neckerchief holds a bunch of long red and green hot peppers above his head with a pepper in his mouth, then lowers his arm and keeps chewing. The wooden table in front of him is covered with boards of thin red peppers and a basket of green ones, and a string of dried peppers hangs above. Beside him another man pours water from a jug over his face while a referee and a crowd cheer.
title: chile_6946

asset_description: At a winter street-market stall at dusk under strings of warm bulbs, a smiling young woman in a cream jumper and a dark apron ladles thick, steaming chili with minced meat and beans from a huge metal pot into a paper bowl and hands it to a customer in red gloves. A bowl of chili topped with grated cheese stands on the steel counter. A basset hound in a paper chef's hat and an apron sits on a wooden crate beside the pot, and a crowd in woolly hats and scarves waits behind.
title: chili_6947

asset_description: A thick stream of hot brown chocolate pours from a big ladle into a glass cup held out by a hand. On a narrow cobbled street at night in heavy rain, lit by strings of bulbs and blue neon, a barefoot woman in a gold sequin dress and a stained apron stands on a wooden cart, dips the ladle into steaming metal pots and lifts it high to pour again. All around, a crowd of people in dark raincoats and hoods hold up cups to be filled, and a man in an apron serves at the other side.
title: chocolate_6949

asset_description: In a bright loft flat with tall factory windows and brick walls, a young woman in a sage green crop top, matching leggings, white socks and sunglasses walks in through a heavy steel door and tosses things behind and around her: a black jacket flies through the air and white trainers land on the concrete floor. She walks forward, pushes up her sunglasses and holds a water bottle. A bag sits by the door, a grey cat rests on a leather sofa and plants stand by the windows.
title: chuck_6950

asset_description: On a harbour quay at dusk under dark storm clouds, a young woman with long dark curly hair and a navy wool coat over an orange high-visibility vest sits by a rusty bollard. She cups her hands around a burning match and lights a thin white cigarette held between her lips, shakes out the match, breathes out smoke and then holds the cigarette in her fingers while she pushes her hair back. Behind her a lit ferry is being unloaded by workers in hi-vis jackets.
title: cigarette_6951

asset_description: At the open doors of an old wooden barn on a sunny day, dust hangs in the light as a young man in a grey shirt walks out carrying a large mounted moose head with antlers on his shoulder and a wooden chair in his other hand. A rolled-up old carpet lies on the ground with a beagle resting on it. The barn behind him is almost empty. Outside, people sort piles of boxes, old televisions and furniture next to a red tractor and a white farmhouse.
title: clear_out_6953

asset_description: On a rooftop terrace in an old town at sunset, a young woman with a red flower in her dark hair, a black top and a long red ruffled skirt dances flamenco with her arms raised, holding wooden castanets in her hands, then spins so that her skirt swirls out and laughs. Beside her a young man in a white shirt sits on a wooden box drum and plays a guitar, smiling. Pigeons fly up from the tiled roof behind them, pots of geraniums stand on the wall, and church domes and a bell tower rise in the distance.
title: click_6954

asset_description: On top of a huge offshore wind turbine far out at sea on a bright day, a laughing young woman with a long braid, orange work trousers, a grey top and a yellow safety harness sits on the white roof holding a metal flask and a mug of steaming coffee. A colleague in a white helmet eats a croissant beside her and points, and a seagull flies past the turbine blades. A lunch box with croissants and apples, flasks, helmets, gloves and a coiled rope lie around them, and a boat crosses the sea below.
title: coffee_break_6957

asset_description: A small empty cafe in soft daylight has round marble tables with black iron bases and curved wooden chairs in front of a grey counter with a marble top. On the counter stand a glass case full of croissants and pastries, a steaming espresso machine, stacks of cups and a coffee grinder, under copper pendant lamps. Water flows in through the open glass door and spreads over the patterned tiled floor around a single cup and saucer, and the street outside is flooded too.
title: coffee_shop_6958

asset_description: On a lake shore under a stormy sky with dark pine forest behind, a young man in a green fleece and shorts wades knee-deep through the water with a bundle of camping gear under one arm: a rolled mat, a guitar case, a kettle, a yellow rubber duck and a folding chair. He grabs a floating sun hat and puts it on his head, then a boot slips out of the bundle and splashes into the water, and he laughs. A collapsed green tent lies on a rock, a red cool box floats nearby and friends wade behind.
title: collect_6959

asset_description: A smiling young woman with a black bob and fringe, a mustard cardigan and a long olive dress stands beside a tall wooden-framed standing mirror. Next to her, white shelves are crowded from floor to ceiling with dozens of old porcelain teapots with painted flowers. She touches a teapot on a high shelf, then turns and spreads her arms proudly towards the shelves. Two friends laugh on a sofa behind her, more teapots stand on a table, and open cardboard boxes with bubble wrap sit on the floor.
title: collector_6960

asset_description: At a rooftop bar at sunset with a city skyline and strings of bulbs overhead, a young woman bartender with a high ponytail and a black T-shirt pours soda into a tall ice-filled glass topped with a lemon slice, adds a red cherry and slides the drink across the marble bar to a man in a denim jacket. He takes it, grins and drinks through a straw. A metal shaker, a jigger, halved lemons, a plate of lemon slices and a bowl of cherries stand on the bar, and a crowd drinks behind.
title: collins_6961

asset_description: At an old-style army camp in a flooded field in pouring rain, a senior officer in a peaked cap with a red band, gold badges on his shoulders and a long dark greatcoat stands on the bonnet of a muddy vintage car, pointing with both arms and shouting orders. Soldiers in round helmets pull on the ropes of a sagging tent, papers blow away, a saddled horse runs loose and a brass band plays behind. A dog splashes through the water with a second officer's cap in its mouth.
title: colonel_6962

asset_description: In a bright science laboratory, a young woman with a red braid, safety glasses, a white lab coat and blue gloves sits at a bench and collects drops from a tall vertical glass tube clamped to a metal stand. The tube is filled with white powder showing a green band and a yellow band, and a tap at its bottom lets liquid drip into small test tubes in a metal rack, which she moves along. Behind her a young man in a lab coat writes notes at the next bench under a desk lamp.
title: column_6963

asset_description: On a sandy beach at sunset under heavy clouds, a young man in a peach running jacket, black leggings and trainers runs along the sand with a phone to his ear, then stops short in surprise with his mouth open in front of the huge black wooden ribs of an old shipwreck sticking out of the sand, hung with orange seaweed and dripping with water. A shaggy grey dog barks at the wreck beside him. Far behind, a couple walk along the shore and a lighthouse stands on a headland.
title: come_across_6964

asset_description: On a calm lake at sunrise with pine forest and mountains behind, a big red, orange and cream striped hot-air balloon with a wicker basket and a pilot is sinking slowly over the water, its reflection shining in the lake. In the foreground a young woman with red hair, sunglasses on her head, a white shirt and khaki trousers leans out of another wicker basket standing on the grassy bank and dips her fingers into the water, making ripples, then straightens up and smiles.
title: come_down_6965

asset_description: At a wooden beach bar during a sudden storm, with dark clouds, bending palm trees and big waves, a young woman in a white tank top, denim shorts and a belt bag clings to a wooden post with both arms while the strong wind lifts her feet off the ground. Above her, a large piece of the corrugated metal roof tears loose, lifts away from the edge and flies off. Green plastic chairs tumble across the sand, a man works behind the bar, and another woman with a dog braces against the wind.
title: come_off_6967

asset_description: From the back of an open safari vehicle on a dusty track in golden evening light, a large elephant with wide ears and white tusks walks straight towards the vehicle, raising dust, and comes very close, with the rest of the herd and young calves following behind. The guide in a khaki shirt and green shorts stands up in the vehicle and holds up one hand. A driver and two women tourists sit in the seats, and acacia trees and hills fill the background.
title: come_on_6968

asset_description: At the finish of a mountain race in a village square with wet cobbles at night, a young woman runner covered in mud, with a race number and a running vest, stands under a wooden finish arch laughing and crying with joy while holding a black and white border collie. She kneels down and hugs the dog, and a steward in an orange vest wraps a gold foil blanket around her shoulders. People cheer around her, and a line of small headlamps zigzags down the dark misty mountain behind.
title: come_through_6969

asset_description: On the deck of a fishing boat at sea under a cloudy sunset sky, a huge green net full of silver fish rises from over the side, pouring fish onto the wet deck. A young woman in a knitted hat and orange waterproof overalls leans on a rope winch and shouts with joy. The crane lifts the bulging net high above the deck while crew members in orange gear cheer with raised arms by the white wheelhouse, and seagulls circle overhead.
title: come_up_6971

asset_description: A young woman with very long braids, a green and pink varsity jacket, loose brown cargo trousers and white trainers walks along the narrow top of a wall on a city rooftop at dusk, coming straight towards the camera. Her braids swing as she moves. Tall buildings with bright neon signs and a busy street with cars lie far below. She stops close to the camera, laughs happily and waves with one hand.
title: come_6972

asset_description: In a small basement comedy club with pipes on the ceiling, fairy lights and a single spotlight, a young man in a brown corduroy jacket and jeans stands on a low black stage next to a microphone stand with a calm, straight face. In front of him the audience roars with laughter: people bend over in their seats, one man lies on the floor, a chair tips over and falls, and spilled beer lies on the wooden boards. The view moves closer to the man, who stays serious.
title: comedian_6973

asset_description: On a sunny city canal with red-brick warehouses and an arched bridge, a young man with curly hair in striped pyjamas and a grey cardigan stands on the back of a green narrowboat, frying eggs in a pan on a small blue camping stove. Young people climb and jump from a red narrowboat onto his boat with sunflowers, a guitar and a potted lemon tree, and a small white dog comes too. A crowd cheers on the red boat while a smiling woman with sunflowers stands next to him and he stares blankly.
title: company_6975

asset_description: In a dim attic room under a sloping roof with a skylight, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper with a grey blanket around her shoulders sits at an old upright piano. One hand plays the keys while the other writes notes on a sheet of music with a pencil; her breath shows in the cold air. A desk lamp and a mug stand on the piano, crumpled sheets of paper cover the floor and a pencil falls. At the end she smiles and keeps writing.
title: composer_6976

asset_description: In an old brick metal workshop lit by a glowing furnace, a young man in a sleeveless shirt and a leather apron places a silver bar onto a pile of copper-coloured metal blocks on the pan of a large old balance scale with a brass arm. He then straightens up, rests his hands on the wooden table and looks at the scale. Brass weights, copper scraps in a tray, a small crucible and tongs lie on the table, and a woman works at the furnace behind him.
title: composition_6977

asset_description: In a school gym with a wooden floor and basketball hoops, rows of people sit on folding chairs at a town hall meeting. A young politician in a white shirt, a dark tie and navy trousers crouches and holds a microphone out to an older man in a plaid shirt and a green cap, who points his finger and speaks firmly. The politician listens closely as the view moves nearer. A paper coffee cup, a newspaper and a crumpled paper lie on the floor.
title: congressman_6978

asset_description: In a modern open-plan office with standing desks, bean bags, sticky notes on glass and an indoor slide, a young man with a moustache, round glasses, a tweed waistcoat and a tie sits at an old wooden desk with a typewriter, two rotary telephones, a green banker's lamp and stacks of files. He holds up his hands to refuse, then lowers them and starts typing on the typewriter. A young woman in colourful overalls stands behind him and puts a hand to her head.
title: conservative_6979

asset_description: In a desert with Joshua trees and round granite boulders at sunset, a young woman climber with a messy bun, a rust-coloured tank top, olive trousers and climbing shoes crouches on top of a rock under a huge overhanging boulder. She reaches up and touches the rock with a chalky finger, then brings her hand to her chin and studies it carefully. Finally she rubs her hands together and a small puff of chalk dust floats in the low sunlight.
title: consider_6980

asset_description: In a meadow with pine forest and mountains behind, a gloved hand tightens a bolt with a spanner on a metal plate that joins wooden beams. The view pulls back: a young woman in a white hard hat, denim overalls and a tool belt sits at the top of a large wooden dome structure with a small metal tool between her teeth, holds a new beam and raises the spanner. Below, a man stands on a yellow scaffold, two men hold a ladder and a dog lies on the grass.
title: construct_6981

asset_description: In a busy restaurant kitchen with steel counters and steam, a young man in a beige linen suit and suede loafers stands on top of a steel counter and draws a flowchart with boxes and arrows on a large paper flip chart with a marker. He then writes on a clipboard. Cooks in white jackets watch him, a head chef in black folds his arms and looks doubtful, and a pan bursts into tall flames behind. Plates of food, spilled sauce and a ladle sit on the counter.
title: consultant_6982

asset_description: In a wooden cabin dining hall lit by a hanging lamp, a big middle-aged man in a plaid shirt and braces hunches over a tin plate piled with beans, potatoes and a pork chop. A woman leans over and ladles more beans from a big pot onto his spoon, and he stuffs the spoonful into his mouth. Then he takes a big bite of a thick piece of bread. Other workers in caps eat at the long wooden table, beans lie scattered on the boards and a stack of empty plates waits beside him.
title: consume_6983

asset_description: In an office at night with glass towers outside the window, a young woman with long curly hair, round glasses and a cream blouse sits at a desk and checks a thick stack of printed financial accounts, circling a number with a red pen. Three young men in shirts lean over her shoulders to watch; then they straighten up, one rubs his face and one drinks from a coffee cup. She looks up, smiles and goes back to the page. Piles of papers, binders, a calculator with a paper roll and a noodle box surround her.
title: controller_6984

asset_description: At a lakeside campsite at dusk with string lights between the pines, a young man in a black vest and a beige apron throws a bunch of fresh homemade noodles into the air in a cloud of flour. He catches them, stretches the long noodles wide between his hands and lays them on a wooden board. On the folding table are flour, eggs and eggshells, tomatoes, garlic and spring onions, and a pot steams on a camping stove. Friends with takeaway boxes watch amazed, and a dog looks up.
title: cook_from_scratch_6985

asset_description: In a small shop on a hot day with bright light pouring through the open door, a young woman in a white shirt and linen trousers sits cross-legged on the cracked concrete floor in front of an open glass-door drinks fridge, cold mist rolling out around her. She holds a cold bottle of water to her cheek and reads a book. Shelves of bottled water and cans glow inside the other fridge, and behind her people wait at the counter, one man fanning himself.
title: cooler_6986

asset_description: In an old brick workshop full of wooden barrels, a young woman with her hair in a bun, a leather apron and work trousers kneels on the stone floor and swings a hammer above her head to drive a metal hoop down onto a wooden barrel, while tall flames and sparks rise from inside it. She hits the hoop, then stands up and wipes her forehead with her arm. Wood shavings cover the floor, barrels stand behind her, and an older man in a leather apron watches with folded arms.
title: cooper_6987

asset_description: Backstage at an outdoor music festival at dusk, under strings of bulbs, a young woman with long braids, a black bomber jacket, a headset microphone and a pass on a lanyard stands in the middle, pointing with one hand and signalling with the other to direct the crew. A man works on a ladder, men move black flight cases and a caterer stands nearby. She then lowers her arms and stands still. The lit stage tent glows with coloured lights behind.
title: coordinator_6988

asset_description: On a sunny city street with red double-decker buses, a young woman police officer in a peaked cap, a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in the road with her arms stretched out to stop the traffic. A mother duck leads a line of ducklings across the road in front of her, and a police car with flashing blue lights waits behind. Water sprays from a red fire hydrant, a man in a white shirt crouches by the ducklings in the spray, and people watch from the pavement.
title: cop_6989

asset_description: On the dusty African savanna at sunset, with acacia trees and white birds flying up, a young woman with long braids in dusty overalls pulls a big canvas sheet off a life-size model of a young elephant standing on a wooden trolley with wheels. A real adult elephant stands beside it and reaches its trunk towards the model. The woman looks up and laughs, the sheet lies on the trolley, and two rangers in khaki stand behind with their hands on their heads.
title: copy_6990

asset_description: In a narrow cobbled street in a sunny old village, a laughing young woman in a white blouse, olive trousers and sandals pulls hard on a long white rope that runs up to a pulley on a wall, hoisting a wicker basket towards a balcony. The basket holds a small scruffy dog, a baguette and flowers. It rises to the balcony, where a woman reaches for it, and the woman below lets go and laughs. Coils of rope lie on the stones and an old man sits on a chair nearby.
title: cord_6992

asset_description: A young woman with long black hair and a mustard cardigan sits at a wooden desk by a window over a rainy garden, laughing as she writes a letter with a fountain pen. A pressed pink flower lies on an open envelope, and next to it is a thick bundle of airmail envelopes with colourful stamps tied with a ribbon. She lifts the pen to her lips, smiles and writes on. A bottle of ink, a mug of tea and a stand with a handwritten letter are on the desk, and a cat sleeps on the window seat.
title: correspondent_6993

asset_description: On a narrow stone staircase between old walls in warm sunlight, a smiling young man in a white shirt stands on the steps and tosses a long roll of thin white fabric, which unrolls and billows down the stairs in soft waves while he holds the roll. Rolls of the same white cloth are stacked along both walls. A woman and two men stand against the wall, the woman raising her hands and cheering, and an older woman in a patterned sari watches from a doorway.
title: cotton_6994

asset_description: Wide golden wheat fields at sunset lie under a huge storm cloud with a thin tornado on the horizon. A flattened track of bent wheat and a dirt road run through the fields towards the storm. A young woman in a plaid shirt and shorts stands on the roof of a dusty white pickup with her arms raised, and a young man sits beside her pointing at the tornado. A dark car drives up the dirt road in a cloud of dust and she turns to look. A red barn and a silo stand far away.
title: course_6995

asset_description: A small lighthouse stands at the end of a pier on a freezing winter day. The whole tower is wrapped in a thick coat of ice, with long icicles hanging from its gallery and roof. A wave crashes against it, throwing up white spray, and the water runs back over the icy pier. The railings along the pier are coated in heavy ice. A snowy shore with a small wooden hut and frosted trees lies behind, gulls fly past and low sunlight breaks through dark grey clouds.
title: covering_6996

asset_description: In a narrow cobbled lane of brick houses on a wet autumn day, an old red sports car is parked by the wall, almost completely hidden under a fitted grey fabric cover that is soaked with rain. The cover has slipped off at the front corner, showing a red wing and a round chrome headlight. A gust lifts the front of the cover, showing the chrome grille and number plate, then it drops back into place. Water drips onto the cobbles and yellow leaves lie on the car and the ground.
title: covering_6997

asset_description: On a tropical beach at dusk with palm trees and a thatched beach bar with lights, a group of cows of different colours wanders along the sand and the water's edge. A pale cow and a small dark calf walk side by side through the foaming waves towards the camera. A spotted cow lies on a striped beach towel under a pink umbrella, and other cows stand by sun loungers and a surfboard on the sand. Wooden fishing boats rest further along the beach.
title: cows_6998

asset_description: At a snowy ice festival at night, a young woman with long blonde braids, a red snowsuit, a fur trapper hat with red ear protectors and gloves stands in the snow with both arms raised, shouting with joy. A chainsaw lies at her feet. Behind her rises a huge castle carved from ice and lit in purple and blue, and a crowd stands behind metal barriers. She lowers her arms, turns round and looks up at the ice castle as the crowd cheers.
title: creator_6999

asset_description: At night in an empty ancient stone arena under a full moon, a large dark brown cricket with long thin antennae sits on the rim of a shiny brass tuba lying on the wooden stage. It walks slowly along the rim and spreads its wings. Behind it the stage is set for an orchestra with empty chairs, music stands, a double bass lying on its side and copper kettle drums. A tall floor lamp glows on the right with small moths flying around it, and empty stone seats rise behind.
title: cricket_7000

asset_description: In a theatre with gilded balconies, a young woman with dark hair in a bun, black-rimmed glasses and a black suit sits in the front row with a serious, unimpressed face, writing notes in a small notebook with a pen. She adjusts her glasses, presses her lips together and keeps writing. All around her the audience roars with laughter, and a man next to her wipes tears from his eyes. A rose and a programme lie on the edge of the stage in front of her.
title: critic_7001

asset_description: A mountain stream flows over smooth grey rock. In the foreground the water has worn a deep round hollow into the rock, like a big stone bowl, filled with clear green water. A small trout swims slowly around inside, and a rounded stone rests on its bottom. Water from the waterfall behind splashes in, making rings that spread across the surface and then calm. A fallen log leans against the falls, and moss, pine needles and smaller hollows lie below.
title: cup_7002

asset_description: At an outdoor hot spring in snowy mountains, with steam rising in the low winter sun, a young man stands waist-deep in the hot water, laughing, his arms flung wide as a pair of wooden crutches flies through the air above him and falls away. He then walks out through the water towards the camera on his own legs, laughing. Behind him other bathers in the pool raise their arms and cheer. Snow covers the stone edge and the pine trees, and monkeys sit on the roof of a wooden bathhouse.
title: cure_7003

asset_description: Inside a simple village clinic with bare walls and sunlight coming through a window, a smiling young nurse in a pale blue uniform, a white headscarf, a stethoscope and blue gloves reaches into a blue cool box full of ice on the table, takes out a small glass vial of medicine and holds it up high. A young man in a motorbike helmet stands behind her, and villagers crowd at the open door, some raising their hands and cheering. Health posters hang on the wall.
title: cure_7004

asset_description: In a wheat field at golden hour, a young woman with wavy auburn hair in a long ivory satin dress runs barefoot straight through the tall ripe wheat towards the camera, laughing, pushing white sunglasses up onto her head and carrying a pair of white high heels in one hand. Pigeons fly up beside her. Far back, a group of wedding guests waits by a gate near a red tractor, and a stone church tower rises behind the trees.
title: cut_across_7005

asset_description: Inside a television broadcast truck, a young man with his hair in a bun, a black T-shirt and a headset with a microphone laughs as he points at a small screen and presses buttons on a big lit-up mixing desk. A wall of monitors shows tennis matches, and the biggest screen shows a shaggy dog in sunglasses with a tennis ball in its mouth. Beside him a red-haired woman covers her mouth, then bends over laughing. A paper coffee cup sits on the desk.
title: cut_away_7006

asset_description: In a vineyard in soft morning light, a young woman with a long dark braid, an olive T-shirt, dark jeans and brown boots guides a small metal plough pulled by a brown horse between rows of green grapevines. The blade cuts into the dark soil, turning up a deep furrow and throwing clumps of earth into the air in a cloud of dust. Seagulls land and fly behind her, a fox walks between the vines, and a stone farmhouse and tall cypress trees stand in the distance.
title: cut_into_7007

asset_description: In a dim film editing room, a young woman with dark hair in a messy bun and a black hoodie sits at a desk with her hand on a colourful editing keyboard. A side monitor shows a swimmer in a tropical lagoon, and the big dark screen on the wall switches to a snowy mountain slope. She folds her arms and looks at it, then puts her hands back on the keyboard. A young man in a beanie on a leather sofa laughs and points. Film posters, a lava lamp, headphones and a coffee cup fill the room.
title: cut_to_7008

asset_description: At a street party at sunset, a young man with dark hair in a white T-shirt and a flour-dusted apron leans over a long wooden table and runs a pizza cutter through a huge rectangular pizza, cutting it into neat square pieces. Hands reach in, and a woman in a yellow raincoat and a man in a blue cap take slices onto plates. Behind them a man clutches his head, and a brass band plays under strings of colourful bunting between market stalls.
title: cut_up_7009

asset_description: On a wide sandy beach on a bright, hazy day, a young woman with a blond braid in black cycling clothes leans a black fat-tyre bike into a sharp turn on the wet sand, the back wheel spraying sand and leaving a curved track. She passes a jellyfish lying on the sand and rides away from the camera along the curving tracks. Kitesurfers ride the waves under colourful kites, a man stands with a dog near the water, and people walk near the dunes.
title: cut_7010

asset_description: In a harvested field at golden hour, a young man in a checked flannel shirt, white T-shirt, jeans, sunglasses and brown boots balances with his arms spread wide on top of a huge round hay bale lying on its side, a long cylinder of tightly rolled straw. He steps along it, wobbling and waving his arms. More bales stand in a row behind him, sheep run past, a black-and-white sheepdog trots alongside, and a farmer stands by a tractor and a gate with his hands on his head.
title: cylinder_7012

asset_description: At a rainy outdoor rock concert at night, a young man with a tall black mohawk and a studded leather jacket, with a baby in a grey carrier strapped to his chest, kneels in the mud beside a laughing young woman who holds a black umbrella and rests a hand on her rounded belly. He holds a pair of tiny white baby shoes up to her belly, his mouth wide open with joy. Two men in denim vests watch, one with a hand on his chest. A huge crowd faces a stage with bright lights and bursts of flame.
title: daddy_7013

asset_description: A farmyard on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks away across the wet concrete carrying two metal buckets of milk, which splash onto the ground as she turns and smiles. A line of black-and-white cows walks beside her towards a metal shed, where a farmer in green overalls stands at the open door. A collie trots past milk churns, and a steel milk tank and milking stalls stand by the shed, with green fields behind.
title: dairy_7015

asset_description: A farm lane on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks towards the camera laughing, letting go of a metal gate as a long line of black-and-white cows follows her out past a barn. She pats a cow on the back as it walks by her. A black-and-white collie trots behind, milk churns stand against the barn wall, a milk tanker is parked further back and a young man in green overalls walks along the fence of a green field.
title: dairy_7016

asset_description: A flower market street on a damp morning. A young man in a white chef's jacket, a white apron and a white cap rides an old bicycle over the cobbles, balancing a big metal tray of round golden pastries filled with cherry and apricot high on one hand. A pigeon swoops down, grabs one pastry in its beak and flies off over his head while he looks up in surprise and keeps riding. Buckets of tulips and eucalyptus line the street, and a woman behind a stall laughs.
title: danish_7019

asset_description: An old railway platform at night. A young man in a camel coat lifts a young woman in a red coat and black boots off the ground as she throws her arms around him, then sets her down and they hug, smiling with their foreheads touching. A steam train with maroon carriages stands beside them in clouds of steam. At their feet lie a dropped leather suitcase with clothes spilling out and a knocked-over metal bucket of flowers. An old man in a suit and smiling travellers watch under the lamps and the platform clock.
title: darling_7020

asset_description: A wooden platform high in a rainforest tree at sunset. A young woman in a red dress, a white helmet and a climbing harness swings in on a zip line, lands on the platform and holds out a sunflower to a young man in a white shirt and beige trousers, who laughs and takes it. A table with a white cloth, a candle and glasses is set for two. A waiter holds a menu, a guide in black stands by the rope, two toucans land on the line, and paper lanterns hang above a misty waterfall.
title: date_7021

asset_description: A crowded antiques warehouse with high wooden beams. A young woman in a tweed jacket and tall boots stands on an old armchair balanced on a suitcase on top of a wooden wardrobe, holding a crystal chandelier that throws sparks at its fitting and reaching out with her other hand, then smiles down. A young man in dungarees steadies the wardrobe and a man in a camel coat looks up and spreads his hands. Grandfather clocks, rolled rugs, lamps and stuffed birds under glass domes fill the room, and pigeons fly under the roof.
title: dealer_7022

asset_description: The great hall of an old university, with tall Gothic windows, stone walls and a dark wooden roof. A young woman in a black academic gown with red trim and a gold chain of office stands barefoot on a wooden desk, shouting with one arm raised while papers fly through the air and fall to the floor. She then shades her eyes and points across the hall. Behind her a row of staff in black gowns hold cardboard boxes, two people stand on ladders at a window and a dog stands among the fallen papers.
title: dean_7023

asset_description: Inside an airport terminal at night during a snowstorm. A tearful young woman in a camel coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a snow-covered green parka and knit hat, who holds a bunch of red roses behind her back, and they hug tightly, laughing. Around them stranded travellers sit on the floor wrapped in sleeping bags and silver foil blankets, clapping and smiling. A suitcase stands nearby, and through the tall glass windows a snowplough with orange lights works in the falling snow.
title: dear_7024

asset_description: A tug of war at a rainy country fair. A heavy man in a striped rugby shirt is pulled forward by the rope through a muddy puddle until he slides along it on his front, while his teammates lie in a heap in the mud behind. At the other end, women in jeans and aprons pull hard, then fall back laughing; one sits in the mud cheering and two hug. A young referee in a rain jacket raises a flag. Spectators with umbrellas watch behind bunting, next to a white tent with tea urns.
title: defeat_7025

asset_description: An old wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. A young man with slicked-back dark hair and a beard, in a navy suit, stands in the dock gripping its brass rail, looks down and slowly bows his head, a guard in a white shirt standing beside him. Below, a lawyer in a white wig and black gown sits at a desk piled with files, and a man in a tweed jacket holds up a sheet of paper. A judge in a red robe sits at the back and the public gallery above is full of watching people.
title: defendant_7026

asset_description: A sunny cafe terrace high above the sea. A young waitress with a dark ponytail, a white shirt and a black apron stands on a wicker chair and swings a white paper parasol at a monkey leaping towards the table, then holds the open parasol out like a shield. She is protecting a cake under a glass dome and cups of coffee from several more monkeys on the table and the railing. A cat hides under the table, a tourist crouches with a camera, and big white clouds rise over the coast.
title: defender_7027

asset_description: A young woman in a pink hoodie covers her mouth with wide eyes as she holds up a phone; a message bubble beside it breaks into pixels next to a red bin icon. The view widens: she sits on a pink sofa at night between two friends who look at her, worried, and popcorn spills from a bowl onto the blanket in her lap. At the end she falls back onto the sofa. Behind them are a pizza box, wine glasses, a TV with a paused film, fairy lights and potted plants.
title: delete_7028

asset_description: Inside a grand, busy shop at Christmas. A young man in a green blazer with a name badge and a red and green striped scarf rides an escalator down towards the camera, carrying a tall stack of gift boxes, a rolled rug, a teddy bear and a lamp, with a guitar case on his back, and looks around in surprise. Behind him several floors of balconies with golden railings are crowded with shoppers, a huge decorated Christmas tree rises in the middle, and a glass dome lets in daylight.
title: department_store_7029

asset_description: A wet peat bog on a grey day. A young woman in a red rain jacket, a knit hat and green wellies kneels in the black mud and presses a clump of green moss firmly into the waterlogged ground, then lifts her hands, wipes her arm and reaches for the next spot. Long rows of moss clumps already planted stretch away beside her. Behind her other volunteers in rain jackets plant more or carry sacks, rolls of brown matting are stacked by a wooden boardwalk, a small hut stands on the horizon and a bird flies overhead.
title: deposit_7030

asset_description: Hilly countryside at sunrise. A deep, wide hollow in the green hills is filled with white mist that slowly drifts and swells, with a waterfall pouring over its rim at the far end and a line of cows standing along the top of the ridge against the orange sky. Treetops poke out of the fog and a flock of birds flies across it. Below, a stone farmhouse with a smoking chimney sits by a winding lane, a dry stone wall with fence posts runs down the slope, and two hares sit in the grass beside a gnarled tree.
title: depression_7031

asset_description: An old living room being redecorated. A young woman with a dark bob and glasses, a mustard cardigan and cream trousers stands on a wooden stepladder and reaches up as a large piece of green velvet fabric flies through the air; it falls past her and unrolls across the floor. She pushes her glasses up and then holds up a measuring tape. The walls are painted mustard. Fabric and paint samples lie on the wooden floor, a sofa is wrapped in plastic, the fireplace is covered with a dust sheet and sunlight comes through tall bay windows.
title: designer_7033

asset_description: A messy workshop at night under a skylight. A young woman in paint-stained denim overalls with goggles on her head rides a silver suitcase that has a glowing blue wheel, arms out for balance and mouth open in surprise. Behind her a long line of earlier broken suitcase models lies on the floor, sketches of the design are pinned to the wall and a 3D printer sits on a table. Her friends in the background watch from a sofa, then jump and cheer, one holding a bowl of noodles.
title: develop_7034

asset_description: A wooden jetty on a turquoise bay at golden hour, with a white sailing boat moored beside it and pine trees on the rocky shore. A laughing young woman with long sandy hair in a navy one-piece swimsuit walks barefoot towards the camera and pulls one strap down off her shoulder, showing a pale stripe where the sun has tanned the skin around it. She laughs, covers her face with her hand and swings a white linen shirt. Rope and a canvas bag lie on the boards, and a friend sits at the end.
title: develop_7036

asset_description: A building site under a blue sky with big white clouds. A young woman in a cream trouser suit, a black top, sunglasses and white trainers stands in the bucket of a yellow excavator as it slowly lowers her towards the ground, holding a small white model house on a board high in one hand and pointing into the distance with the other. Below, workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests stand by a site office cabin, a bulldozer waits, and plots of bare earth are marked out with stakes and orange tape.
title: developer_7037

asset_description: A wood-panelled auction room. A young woman with braided hair, a cream blazer and white gloves sits at a green table and holds up a sparkling cut diamond with tweezers into a beam of sunlight, turning it and sending rainbow sparkles across the room, then smiles. A black tray of rings lies in front of her. Behind a rope barrier the audience watches, a woman laughing and a man shielding his eyes from the glare, while a guard in a dark suit and white gloves stands by.
title: diamond_7039

asset_description: A busy board-game cafe. A young woman with curly black hair, a black sweater and gold necklaces has just thrown a white die with black spots; it flies through the air, lands on a board game with a winding path and wooden pawns and rolls to a stop while she gasps and puts a hand on her chest. A second die, cards, glass tokens and a phone lie on the table, and a bowl of popcorn has tipped over. Behind her two friends hold their heads, and shelves of game boxes and pendant lamps fill the room.
title: die_7040

asset_description: Inside a dim old railway depot. A green diesel locomotive stands over an inspection pit with its front panels opened wide, showing a large grey engine inside. Thick black smoke pours from its roof into shafts of light from the high windows and slowly turns grey, while pigeons fly up through the beams and clouds of white smoke burst out from under the locomotive. Brick walls and another locomotive surround it. On the floor lie a coiled hose, a rag and a row of spanners, and gas cylinders stand on a trolley.
title: diesel_7041

asset_description: A sunny clifftop. A young woman with windblown dark hair, a yellow rain jacket and black leggings leans on a wooden fence, laughing as she takes pictures with a small silver compact digital camera, its strap dangling. She lowers it, pushes her hair from her face and raises it again. A backpack with a water bottle sits at her feet in the long grass and pink sea flowers. Behind her the turquoise sea sparkles, and a white lighthouse stands on a rocky islet just off the coast.
title: digital_camera_7042

asset_description: A house party in a small kitchen. A young woman in a denim jacket and a black dress sticks out her tongue as she holds a small silver digital camera at arm's length, its flash firing, taking a selfie with friends who pull faces beside her. Then she lowers the camera and they all crowd round to look at its screen, laughing. A pizza box, a bowl of crisps, bottles and cans stand on the counter. Balloons are stuck on the fridge, fairy lights hang along the cupboards and people dance in the doorway.
title: digital_camera_7043

asset_description: A bright, elegant room for meals. A long polished wooden table is set with white plates, crystal glasses and brass candlesticks with lit candles, bowls of roast potatoes and green beans, and a dish of butter that a tabby cat sniffs. A young woman in a cream knitted dress comes through the door laughing, carrying a steaming roast chicken on a platter, and a young man in a navy jumper walks over laughing. A golden retriever with a napkin round its neck sits on a chair at the table.
title: dining_room_7044

asset_description: A formal wood-panelled meeting room with tall windows and heavy grey curtains. Around a long polished table covered with stacks of papers and paper cups, one knocked over, sit people in dark suits. A woman in a grey suit leans forward calmly and pushes a handwritten document across the table to a man opposite, who picks it up, while a man beside her argues with his hand raised and then sits back. Others look on seriously. A wall clock, a coffee jug and a brass wall lamp are behind them.
title: diplomat_7045

asset_description: A night women's football match in heavy snow, seen from inside the goal through the white net. A player in a white shirt and black shorts leaps and heads an orange ball towards the goal; it flies high towards the net. The goalkeeper in green dives across with her gloves stretched out and lands face down on the snow, while the player lands and throws both arms up, cheering. Defenders in navy stand behind. The snowy pitch is lit by rows of bright floodlights, and the stands behind are packed with fans.
title: direct_7046

asset_description: The deck of a sailing boat at sunset. A wooden record player on the cockpit table plays a black vinyl record that spins round, and a seagull stands right next to it, bending down to look at the record, then lifting its head and opening its beak. A stack of record sleeves with a pink seashell on top sits on the bench, another black record lies on the wooden deck, and two enamel mugs stand in holders. Coiled ropes, winches and a golden sail surround them, and a lighthouse is on the horizon.
title: disc_7047

asset_description: A building site at golden hour. A young woman in a khaki work shirt and trousers kneels at the bottom of a freshly dug trench, brushing earth away with a paintbrush to uncover a colourful ancient mosaic of a face made of small stones. She raises her other hand to her mouth in surprise and stares at it.
