Above her, construction workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests lean over the edge and stare down, one putting his hands on his head, while a small digger and a cement mixer stand behind them.
title: discover_7048

asset_description: A frozen lake on a sunny winter day. A large flat round disk of ice has been cut out of the lake and floats in a ring of dark water. A man in an orange puffer jacket, a beanie and mirrored ski goggles pushes it with a long wooden pole so that it turns, then stands up straight holding the pole, while four friends sit on camping chairs on the disk, waving and cheering. An ice saw and a hand drill lie on the snow in front, and pine forest and snowy hills line the shore.
title: disk_7049

asset_description: A beach volleyball game at sunrise. A young woman in a black sports top and shorts dives low across the sand with her arms stretched out together and hits a blue and yellow volleyball high into the air, sand flying up behind her. She lands on her front, gets up on her knees and cheers with her fists raised. A volleyball net stands beside her, and friends at the edge of the court cheer and clap. Seagulls fly low over the beach and a jogger runs along the water's edge in the golden light.
title: do_sport_7050

asset_description: A living room the morning after a party. A young man in sunglasses, a white T-shirt, grey joggers and yellow rubber gloves mops the wooden floor, which is covered in confetti, streamers and party hats, while holding a full black bin bag in his other hand. He stops, lifts his sunglasses and looks around at the mess. Two young people are asleep on the sofa behind him, lampshades hang from the ceiling, and a woman stands by the doorway as sunlight comes through the window.
title: do_the_cleaning_7051

asset_description: A small, steamy home kitchen. A young woman with her hair in a bun, a black T-shirt and a long apron tastes from a wooden spoon at a gas stove covered with bubbling pots, stretching her other arm out to stop her hungry family from coming in, then stirs the pots. An older woman and two men crowd the doorway holding plates, and a cat sits on top of the fridge. The oven is open with a tray of roast potatoes, and bowls of peas, chopped vegetables and a colander of potatoes fill the counter.
title: do_the_cooking_7052

asset_description: The small kitchen of a village hall. A young man in a white shirt and a loose tie laughs as he rinses dirty plates over a steel sink full of suds and hands them to a laughing bride in a white wedding dress and veil, with an apron over the dress, who dries them with a checked tea towel and puts them in the rack. A tall stack of dirty plates waits on the counter and a rack in front is full of clean plates and cutlery. Behind them chairs are stacked in the hall and guests walk past.
title: do_the_dishes_7053

asset_description: A sunny beach. A shirtless young man in navy swim shorts stands knee-deep in clear sea water behind an ironing board, lifts a steaming iron and presses a white shirt with it, then holds the shirt up by its edges. Behind him ironed shirts hang on hangers from a striped beach umbrella. People float on inflatable rings and stare, a man in the water gasps, others sunbathe on the sand, and a group plays volleyball further up the beach.
title: do_the_ironing_7054

asset_description: A launderette. A young man in a navy T-shirt and jeans, a grey sock on his shoulder, first takes a selfie in a mirror with his phone, then pulls jeans and a sweater out of an open washing machine into an overflowing basket. He takes the sock off his shoulder and looks at it. A pile of clothes, a red jumper and a tipped-over box of washing powder lie on the tiled floor. Behind him a row of machines spins clothes, two women fold a sheet together and a young person sleeps slumped on a bench.
title: do_the_laundry_7055

asset_description: A brightly lit launderette. A young man in a black velvet jacket over an open shirt, patterned turquoise swim shorts and flip-flops holds a laundry basket full of clothes against his hip. A grey sock falls out of it as he pulls out a grey piece of clothing, holds it to his face and then holds it up, looking straight ahead. Behind him a young woman in sports clothes pulls a white sheet out of a dryer, a ginger cat sits on the machines and a young man lies asleep on a bench under strip lights.
title: do_the_laundry_7056

asset_description: A hospital rooftop helipad at sunset. A young woman doctor in a white coat over navy scrubs, a stethoscope around her neck, runs towards a red and white helicopter with its rotor spinning, carrying a red medical bag. Behind her a nurse in blue scrubs runs too as papers fly away in the wind from the blades. At the helicopter, crew members wait in the open door and others bring a stretcher. A city skyline glows pink and orange in the background.
title: doc_7057

asset_description: Inside a village bakery at golden hour. A female deer with no antlers stands on the checked tiled floor and bites a croissant from a tray held by a surprised young woman baker in a white apron, a headscarf and an oven glove, then reaches for more. A paper bag of bread rolls has spilled on the floor, and floury hoof prints lead in from the open door. Glass counters of pastries and shelves of loaves fill the shop, an older woman peeks from the back and a cyclist outside takes a picture with his phone.
title: doe_7058

asset_description: A food stand at a football stadium at night. A golden retriever in a white paper cap and a striped apron stands at the grill, holding a smoked sausage with tongs and placing it in a long bun in a paper tray. A tabby cat in a matching cap sits beside a tray of long bread rolls. A hot dog topped with fried onions and a crumpled napkin lie on the steel counter in front. Behind them laughing fans in red and white scarves watch and film under bright floodlights.
title: dog_7059

asset_description: On a street of brick terraced houses in autumn, two movers in dark workwear stand by a shiny black grand piano on a metal ramp from a white van, outside a small community library with a blue door. A young man in a navy jumper hands a key to a smiling red-haired young woman, and the two talk while neighbours on the pavement clap. One mover pulls the padded blanket off the piano. Fallen leaves and lifting straps lie on the ground.
title: donor_7060

asset_description: On building scaffolding high above a street, a hand holding a thin brush paints a small red dot on a huge white wall covered with neat rows of round dots in many colours. The view pulls back: a young man in a backwards cap, a white T-shirt, paint-spattered white overalls and a yellow harness steps back from the wall, squints and looks at his work. Little paint pots, brushes, a bucket and a coil of rope lie on the planks, and cyclists and people pass below.
title: dot_7061

asset_description: Inside a roadside diner with ceiling fans and a checkered floor, a young woman in a black leather jacket and boots stands on a red bar stool and tips back a huge glass of pink milkshake, gulping it down. Then she lowers the glass, shouts with joy and raises her fist high. A crowd of bearded bikers in leather vests cheers and points at her, a waitress in a pink uniform holding a metal jug stares and then smiles, and burgers sit on the counter.
title: down_7062

asset_description: In a sunny old workroom where pillows are made, a young bearded man in a linen shirt and canvas apron blows a cloud of tiny, soft white feathers from his open palm into the air. Then he laughs, leans towards the camera and rubs his nose as feathers float around his curly hair. Big cloth sacks overflowing with fluffy white feathers stand around the room, and white pillows lie on an old treadle sewing machine table. An older woman laughs by the window while a black cat reaches up at the feathers.
title: down_7063

asset_description: On a muddy rugby pitch under dark storm clouds, a young player in a striped muddy jersey with a long braid grabs an opponent round the hips and brings her crashing down into the mud as the ball flies loose. Both players slide through the puddles, then lie in the mud laughing and push themselves up onto their hands and knees while teammates run up. Spectators under umbrellas cheer on the touchline, and a referee in green runs towards them with one arm raised.
title: down_7064

asset_description: At a fountain in an old town square in autumn, a male mallard duck with a glossy green head, a white neck ring and orange feet flies in with its wings spread wide and lands on the arm of a white stone statue of a man in a robe. It folds its wings and sits there, looking around. A brown female duck swims in the water below, another green-headed male floats on the right, water spouts from carved stone fish, pigeons walk on the paving, and a church tower and a bakery stand behind.
title: drake_7065

asset_description: Inside a train carriage at night, a young man with a beard, a denim shirt and a white T-shirt sits fast asleep in his seat with his eyes closed and a happy smile, waving both arms high in the air as if cheering. A sandwich and a paper coffee cup sit on the table in front of him. Other passengers watch, amused, and a woman covers her mouth. A small brown dog in the aisle moves up to the table and sniffs at the sandwich, and lights streak past the window.
title: dream_7066

asset_description: Inside a white seaside restaurant with blue shutters, a young man in sunglasses, a white shirt and a black apron swings a red tablecloth like a bullfighter's cape and chases a group of goats out through the open glass doors. The goats run outside one after another until only one is left by the door. An overturned chair, plates, bread rolls and lemons lie on the terracotta floor, guests laugh and point by the window, a waitress holds up a tray, and the blue sea shines outside.
title: drive_out_7068

asset_description: On a gravel lane at a country cottage in golden evening light, a young man in a navy suit and red bow tie drives an old red tractor with a big bunch of sunflowers tied to the side towards the front door. As he comes closer he raises his straw boater hat, and dust rises behind the wheels. A young woman in a flowered dress stands on the doorstep with her hands over her mouth and then laughs, while an older woman watches from an upstairs window. Roses cover the walls and hay bales lie in the fields.
title: drive_up_7069

asset_description: Inside a dim city pub in daylight, a tired, unshaven man in a dark jacket sits alone at the wooden bar, drinks from a glass of whisky and puts it down. He touches the row of empty shot glasses in front of him and then rests his head in his hand. A half-empty bottle, a bowl of peanuts, coins and notes lie on the bar. A young barmaid in a black apron dries a glass and watches him with concern, and people with coffee cups stand in the bright street outside the big window.
title: drunk_7070

asset_description: On the lawn of a grand country estate on a grey day, a smiling grey-bearded older man in a red velvet robe with a white ermine cape and a jewelled gold crown rides a muddy quad bike towards the camera, first holding his crown with one hand and then gripping the handlebars. He laughs as the quad splashes through a big muddy puddle, and mud and water spray from the wheels. Behind him stand large old trees and a pale stone mansion with tall columns.
title: duke_7071

asset_description: In front of a stone country mansion under a cloudy sky, a young blond man in a dark suit and a long red velvet robe trimmed with white fur hurries across the gravel and bends to catch a round leather hat box rolling away from him. Two shaggy grey wolfhounds run up to him and sniff at the box as he lifts it, smiling. Then he turns and walks off towards the house with the dogs beside him. A butler in black stands on the front steps, a flag flies on the roof and an old black car is parked on the right.
title: earl_7072

asset_description: On the scaffolding beside an old stone church at sunset, a young woman in white gloves, knee pads and navy dungarees kneels on padded blankets and steadies a tall stained-glass window panel in its stone arch with one hand, leaning her face very close to the glass. Behind her three men in white hard hats and work clothes stand holding straps. Warm light shines through the coloured glass. A coil of rope, a spirit level and a box of tools lie on the planks.
title: ease_7073

asset_description: At a long wooden table in a vineyard at dusk, a woman in a straw hat and black vest lifts a huge steaming pan of seafood paella over the heads of farm workers in dusty work clothes and caps and sets it down in the middle of the table. The laughing workers reach out with their plates and start serving themselves, and she smiles and touches her hat. Bread, bowls of salad, cheese and grapes cover the table, string lights hang between olive trees, and a dog lies under the table.
title: eats_7074

asset_description: At a busy street market on a wet cobbled square, a young woman with long braids and a camel coat crouches beside crates of onions and potatoes and writes on a clipboard with a small line graph drawn on it. She looks up thoughtfully, taps her pen against her chin and goes on writing. A chalkboard next to her shows the prices of potatoes and onions per kilo. Above her an older trader in a flat cap and apron holds out an onion, and a hanging scale and customers fill the back under striped awnings.
title: economist_7075

asset_description: On a bright salt flat, a young woman's boots step exactly along the sharp line where the white salt crust meets dark gravel, and dust rises by her feet. The view pulls back: she wears a wide-brimmed hat, mirrored sunglasses, a khaki shirt and trousers, and walks towards the camera with her arms stretched out for balance, wobbling a little. Behind her two men stand by canvas tents, a folding table and an off-road car, and pink flamingos wade far away on the left.
title: edge_7076

asset_description: Seen from the back seat of a small car in an empty car park at sunset, an older woman with long dark hair and a brown jumper sits behind the wheel, looks back over her shoulder with a calm little smile and points firmly at the front. In the front passenger seat a younger woman in a beige hoodie throws up her hand and protests, then bends forward with her hand still raised. Four iced coffees sit in the cup holders and a tree-shaped air freshener hangs from the mirror.
title: elder_7077

asset_description: In a bright brick workshop with tall arched windows, a young man in a linen shirt and leather apron holds up one piece of amber glass with a number on it against the light and checks it. Then he lowers it and lays it carefully on its outline on a numbered paper pattern, next to a half-finished stained-glass panel of blue, green and orange pieces. A soldering iron, a coil of lead strip and a tin of nails lie on the bench, and a young woman behind him looks up and smiles.
title: element_7079

asset_description: In the hallway of an old apartment building, a young woman in a yellow jacket and jeans pushes open the folding brass gate of an ornate old lift with black ironwork and squeezes out of the small wooden cabin, hugging a huge potted palm. Leaves and soil fall onto the tiled floor. Crushed behind her inside are a man in a suit holding his briefcase over his head, an older woman with a small dog, and a man in a cap. A spiral stone staircase rises around the lift.
title: elevator_7080

asset_description: Inside a hospital emergency department at night, paramedics in dark uniforms and blue gloves push a patient on a wheeled stretcher through the glass entrance doors, one squeezing a breathing bag. A young nurse in navy scrubs runs beside them, and a doctor in a white coat pulls on gloves in a side doorway. Behind the glass blue and red lights flash in the dark, and worried relatives stand in the waiting area. An empty wheelchair stands on the right and a pair of gloves lies on the floor.
title: emergency_room_7081

asset_description: At a farm gate by a vineyard on a sunny day, a smiling young woman in a straw hat, denim shirt and work trousers leans on an open wooden gate while a flock of sheep walks past her through the gate in a small cloud of dust. She laughs, stands up and pats one of the sheep. A small ride-on mower stands unused under a black cover behind her at the end of the vines. A brown and white dog lies calmly on the grass in front, and dry golden hills rise under the clear sky.
title: employ_7082

asset_description: On a wet street corner of an old town, a young man and a young woman meet by chance, both wearing identical mustard rain jackets and navy striped scarves. She covers her mouth in surprise and he laughs; then they both laugh, and he taps his forehead. Each holds a leash, and their two corgis sniff noses between them. Buckets of red and yellow tulips stand against the stone wall with ivy, a bicycle leans nearby, and a baker smiles from a doorway behind.
title: encounter_7083

asset_description: In a small new cafe in a brick-walled garage on a rainy morning, a young woman in a denim shirt, patterned scarf and grey apron pushes the metal roller shutter all the way up with one hand, holding a spatula in the other, and stares out in surprise at a long queue of people with umbrellas on the wet pavement. She turns towards the steaming pan on the gas stove, looks back with an excited smile, then turns to the stove again and raises a hand. Wooden stools, a counter, paint tins and a ladder fill the room.
title: entrepreneur_7085

asset_description: Inside a small cheese dairy with stone floors, a young woman in a white cap, white jacket and blue apron holds a fresh block of white curd over a large copper vat while whey drips back into the yellowish liquid below. In her other hand she holds a tiny measuring spoon. She looks at the curd, smiles and lowers it back into the liquid. Wooden cheese moulds are stacked on the left, shelves of round cheeses stand on the right, and a glass of whey and a cheesecloth lie in front.
title: enzyme_7086

asset_description: In a sunny farmyard, a smiling young woman in a navy postal polo shirt, shorts, boots and sporty sunglasses holds out a bundle of letters by a wooden gate and then walks down the track towards the camera with the letters in her hand. A group of grey geese walks closely all around her, some flapping their wings, and a black and white collie trots behind. Two farm workers in overalls by a quad bike laugh and wipe their eyes, and a cat sits on the stone wall.
title: escort_7087

asset_description: On a high rooftop building site at sunrise, a young woman in a white hard hat, an orange safety vest and a harness bends over wet concrete and drags a long aluminium straightedge back and forth across it, pushing the rough grey mix into a flat, shiny surface. Behind her two workers spread more concrete and a laser level stands on a tripod. A crane holds a load in the air, and tall towers rise out of a sea of clouds under a pink sky.
title: even_out_7088

asset_description: At a market in an old stone town on a sunny day, a laughing young woman in a mustard jacket and wide jeans pushes against a heap of colourful wet sponges bursting out of a big wooden barrel. A blue elephant-shaped sponge on top grows bigger and bigger and pushes a wooden crate off, and huge yellow sponges swell up around the barrel. Small sponges lie on the wet cobbles. Shoppers and a dog stand among fruit stalls behind, and one man films the scene with his phone.
title: expand_7089

asset_description: On a wet mossy rock in front of a tall waterfall in a green mountain valley, a young woman in a black swimsuit stands barefoot with her arms spread wide, head tilted back and mouth open in a shout of joy as the spray soaks her hair and skin. For a moment she puts a hand over her face and laughs, then spreads her arms again. The white column of water pours down behind her, and steep forested slopes lie on both sides under a pale sky.
title: experience_7090

asset_description: On a dusty country lane in warm evening light, two women in black cycling kit and helmets ride road bikes towards the camera past hay bales. The leader on the right rides close to the bales with a focused face, and the second rider follows a little behind her and to the left. A crowd of spectators stands behind metal barriers, a man on the right reaches out his hand towards the leader, and a team car with bikes on the roof follows through the dust under tall poplar trees.
title: exploit_7091

asset_description: On a sunny stone square in an old town, a black cloth comes off a life-size statue of clear ice standing on a stone plinth, and a broken ice hand lies in a puddle on the ground. A young man in a flat cap, white shirt and black waistcoat holds the black cloth and grins beside the shiny, dripping ice figure. The ice melts in the hot sun and water runs down onto the plinth. Tourists in summer clothes watch, and cafe tables stand under tall shuttered buildings.
title: expose_7092

asset_description: On a film set on a rainy cobbled street, a young woman in a brown old-fashioned coat and hat with a paper tag pinned to it stands silently in a line of people in similar period coats and hats behind a rope. A brown hat falls through the air and lands on the wet stones. The view moves closer to her face as she looks down and closes her eyes. Further back, under a big tarpaulin and bright film lights, two actors in suits stand with a crew member holding an umbrella next to a rail of costumes.
title: extra_7093

asset_description: At a muddy music festival at sunset, a laughing young woman with long braids, a yellow rain jacket and denim shorts pulls hard on a green rubber boot stuck deep in the mud. The boot comes loose with a spray of brown mud, and she falls back and lands sitting in a puddle. Laughing, she holds the boot up high above her head. Behind her friends in clear rain ponchos laugh, and a steward in an orange vest covers his face. Flags fly over a big tent, and a bucket hat, a cup and another boot lie in the mud.
title: extract_7094

asset_description: At night on a frozen lake, a referee's arm in a black and white striped sleeve drops a black puck between two young women in helmets, one in a red jersey and one in blue, who crouch face to face with their sticks on the clear ice. They fight for the puck, and the player in blue skates away with it. The view moves to the spectators in fur hats behind a snow bank lit by torches, with a dog, a raised lantern and a drum, under green northern lights and snowy mountains.
title: face_off_7095

asset_description: On a wet cobbled market square under dark storm clouds, a small white car stands on the edge of a stone fountain, with water spraying over its roof and the driver's door open. Inside, a young woman at the wheel hides her face in her hands, while a serious examiner in a blue shirt and tie in the passenger seat holds up a sheet with a big red cross. She lowers her hands and stares ahead in defeat. Market stalls with striped umbrellas and shoppers stand around the square.
title: fail_an_exam_7096

asset_description: In a bright restoration studio full of white plaster busts on shelves, a young woman in a white lab coat and gloves rubs a long cotton swab on the cheek of a bust of a man that looks like old brown marble. Where she cleans, the brown colour comes off and plain white plaster shows underneath. She leans in, frowns with doubt and touches the white patch with her finger. A tray of used cotton swabs, white powder and a jar of liquid lie around it, and two colleagues work behind her.
title: fake_7097

asset_description: At the edge of a huge waterfall in a rocky canyon, wide curtains of white water pour over a cliff into a deep gorge, throwing up clouds of spray with a rainbow in it. On the wet rock in front, a young man in a black tailcoat plays a shiny black grand piano with his coat tails flapping and spray blowing over him. Tourists in colourful rain ponchos stand behind a railing, and two people shelter under an umbrella.
title: falls_7099

asset_description: On an icy fjord at sunset, a young woman in a black beanie and a yellow drysuit sits in a red sea kayak and pulls a cord tight with her teeth and hands, tying together a home-made sail: a paddle and a pole lashed upright with a torn orange tent sheet and a silver emergency blanket stretched between them. Then she sits back, looks at a seal poking its head out of the water nearby and raises her fist. Chunks of floating ice surround the kayak.
title: fashion_7100

asset_description: At night at a street takeaway window under a glowing neon sign, a golden retriever in a paper cook's hat and headset leans out of the steamy window and hands a paper bag with a burger and chips to a laughing young woman in a mint helmet on a mint-green scooter. She takes the bag and lifts it high over her head with joy. Another dog in a cook's hat works in the kitchen behind, and a line of cars and scooters with headlights waits on the wet road.
title: fast_food_7101

asset_description: On an old gas cooker by a sunny kitchen window, a thick slab of pork belly with a wide white layer of fat sizzles in a black cast-iron pan full of bubbling melted fat. Drops spit into the air, and melted fat runs over the rim of the pan and drips down past the blue flame. A bowl of solid white lard sits beside the stove, and another raw slab of pork belly lies on a wooden board with salt and a cleaver. Wooden spoons stand in a jar against the tiles.
title: fat_7102

asset_description: In a busy family kitchen on a warm evening, seen through an open doorway, a laughing young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper is greeted by a big golden retriever standing up on its back legs with its paws on her, while another young woman hugs her from the side. A young man rushes over and hugs her too, and they all laugh together. An older man holds up a cake, a second dog stands in front, and bunting hangs over the stove and dresser.
title: favorite_7103

asset_description: A jockey in a green silk shirt with white stars and a white helmet rides a grey horse along the white rail of the parade ring at a crowded racecourse on a grey day, led by a man in a dark jacket. Jockeys in bright silks on brown horses follow behind. As the grey horse walks closer, a huge crowd pressed against the rail, many in green and white scarves and rosettes, holds up phones and cameras towards it. A packed grandstand and bare trees stand behind.
title: favourite_7104

asset_description: In a busy backstage dressing room, a young woman with her hair in a low bun and a black satin robe sits with her eyes closed and her chin raised. A make-up artist's hand paints gold leaf onto her lips and chin with a fine brush, then a second brush comes in. Gold covers her eyelids, the ridge of her nose and her lips. A hairdryer blows flakes of gold into the air. Clothes rails, lit mirrors, a white gown on the wall and other models getting ready fill the room.
title: feature_7105

asset_description: On the wet wooden deck of a fishing boat in a rough grey sea, a man with very short hair in a yellow oilskin jacket and trousers grips the metal rail with one hand and presses his fist to his chest, bent forward with a pale, screwed-up face. He straightens up, opens his mouth wide and heaves as if about to throw up, then leans on the rail again, cheeks puffed. White-capped waves crash around the boat under heavy clouds. Coiled ropes, a life ring and green nets lie on the deck.
title: feel_sick_7106

asset_description: A young woman in a black swimsuit stands waist-deep in milky blue water in a steaming outdoor hot spring while snow falls. With her eyes closed and her head tilted up, she holds out her open hands to catch the snowflakes, lowers her hands to the water, breathes out and lifts them again. Flakes land on her eyelashes, wet hair and bare shoulders, and steam rises around her. Snow-covered black lava rocks and a white hillside fade into the mist behind her.
title: feel_7107

asset_description: On a wide city street full of marchers, a young woman with braids, a denim jacket and a purple bandana sits on a friend's shoulders and punches the air with a purple scarf tied to her fist. She shouts at first, then keeps her fist raised with a calm, proud face while the friend below her starts to smile. Her white T-shirt shows a big purple female symbol. Around her a crowd of women in purple T-shirts raise their fists and hold cardboard signs with the same symbol, and purple smoke drifts.
title: feminist_7108

asset_description: Seen from above, in a cosy bedroom at night, a young man in a white T-shirt and striped pyjama bottoms kneels in the middle of a bed and swings pillows left and right to push back laughing young women in pyjamas who reach for him from all sides. He hits out again and again as feathers burst into the air. Fairy lights lie on the bedspread, trays of croissants sit on the bed and the bedside table, an open suitcase spills clothes, and a dog sits at the foot of the bed.
title: fight_off_7110

asset_description: In a boxing ring in an old brick gym, a young woman with braids, a black sports top, red shorts and red gloves throws a straight punch that meets the blue glove her opponent raises, sending sweat into the light. She then pulls her gloves back up to guard her face and steps back while her opponent moves out of sight. A referee in a white shirt and bow tie walks around the ring. Spectators crowd around the red ropes, and punching bags and old posters hang on the walls.
title: fighter_7111

asset_description: At a hobby desk in a warm lamp-lit room, a young man with curly hair, round glasses pushed up on his forehead and a green cardigan paints a tiny model of a man in a green jacket with a fine brush. He lifts the little painted man up close to his face, studies it, then sets it down on the desk. Rows of unpainted grey miniature people stand on the table, a small glass dome covers another model, paint pots crowd the desk, sketches hang on a cork board and a tabby cat sleeps on a stool.
title: figure_7112

asset_description: Inside a busy post office, a young woman in a mustard rain jacket bends over the counter and writes in the little boxes of a long paper form with a pen, concentrating hard as she moves down the page. The view moves closer to her. Behind her a queue of people in winter coats waits with parcels, and clerks serve customers at numbered counter windows. A self-service machine, racks of greeting cards, posters and a wall clock fill the room.
title: fill_in_a_form_7113

asset_description: On a wet city rooftop under dark clouds at sunset, a young woman in a yellow rain jacket lifts a large metal rectangle out of a long trough of soapy water. A thin, shiny soap film stretches across it, shimmering with rainbow colours and billowing in the wind as she raises it higher. A young man crouches behind it and reaches up to touch the soap film with his fingers, while another person holds up a small wind meter. Skyscrapers and a water tower rise in the background.
title: film_7114

asset_description: At night in heavy snow, an old red-brick fire station with three arched garage doors stands open and brightly lit, showing red fire engines inside. Through a tall lit window upstairs a firefighter slides down a brass pole. A fire engine with flashing red lights drives out of the middle door, crosses the snowy forecourt and turns onto the road. Firefighters in yellow gear stand by the doors, and a bell hangs in the tower above. Tyre tracks cross the snow in front.
title: fire_station_7116

asset_description: Brown floodwater covers a street of tall stone tenement buildings and fills the ground-level flats. A young woman in a yellow jacket sits in a wooden rowing boat right outside an open front door and paddles away from the building, the water swirling behind the boat. Tables and chairs are piled up inside the flooded room beside her, and a sofa and sandbags stand in the water outside. Above, a neighbour leans out of a dry upper window. A bicycle stands in the water.
title: first_floor_7117

asset_description: On the stage of a grand concert hall, a young woman in a long emerald green dress holds her cello high above her head with one hand and laughs with joy, her other arm wide open, while flowers fly through the air. She lowers the cello, hugs it to her chest and then bows deeply over it. Behind her the orchestra in black stands and applauds, and the conductor claps on his podium. Petals, her bow and an empty cello case lie on the wooden floor, and a packed audience fills the hall.
title: first_lady_7118

asset_description: On the deck of a small fishing boat in a stormy sea, a young woman with braids, a navy jumper and orange waterproof bib trousers shouts with effort as she hauls a huge green net full of silver fish over the rusty rail. The fish pour out of the net and spill across the wet wooden deck around her boots. Seagulls fly overhead, a big wave breaks white behind the boat, and a man in yellow oilskins laughs by the winch. Plastic crates of fish stand nearby, and an island lies in the distance.
title: fisher_7119

asset_description: On a misty country road in the rain, dogs in hard hats and high-visibility vests work on an old cream bus with its bonnet open. One dog in a yellow hat lies on a mechanic's creeper and reaches a spanner towards an engine block on a tarp. One in a white hat stands on a metal lifting rig whose chain holds up the engine, and another in a yellow hat shines a small lamp. More dogs sit on the roof and in the driver's seat. Tools lie on the tarp, and a young woman with an umbrella watches.
title: fix_something_7120

asset_description: At night in a storm, a white lighthouse with dark bands stands at the end of a stone harbour pier. Its lamp shines a bright starburst of light, goes dark while a huge wave crashes against the rocks and throws white spray high into the air, and then shines brightly again. A small light on a marker in the water blinks once. Water pours off the pier as the wave falls back. Dark water churns around the harbour, the masts of small boats poke up below, and a coiled rope lies on a bollard.
title: flash_7121

asset_description: Under a dark storm sky, a wide, completely level grassland stretches to a straight horizon. A herd of horses in brown, white and black gallops from left to right through a shallow pool of rainwater, splashing, and their reflections move across the water. Black and white birds fly up in front of them. A wooden fence post stands by a dirt track, and grey curtains of rain fall from the clouds in the distance.
title: flat_7122

asset_description: Inside a fish market hall, a young woman with a long blonde braid, a black beanie, a navy jumper and an orange apron stands at a marble counter covered in ice with a whole salmon. In a blue-gloved hand she lifts back the top half of the fish and lays it open, showing thick, bright orange flesh, then smooths it flat. An older man in a green jacket leans on the counter, watching closely, and his eyes widen. Mackerel, prawns and lemons lie on ice in front, and other fishmongers work behind.
title: flesh_7123

asset_description: On a sunny day, a young man in a tuxedo and bow tie walks carefully down a long outdoor stone staircase between old houses, holding a tall three-tier white wedding cake on a silver tray high above his head while rose petals fall around him. Step by step he comes closer. Wedding guests cheer from a balcony at the top, a woman leans on a side balcony with a cloth hanging over the railing, and older neighbours sit on chairs by the steps next to pots of red geraniums.
title: flight_7124

asset_description: In a narrow old town street with balconies, a young woman in a white T-shirt, work trousers and fingerless gloves catches a coin she has tossed into the air, then holds it up between her fingers and looks at it with a small smile. Beside her a bearded man in navy overalls leans with his arms folded against an upright piano on a hand trolley, wrapped in a moving blanket, and then bends to the trolley. Neighbours watch from balconies and a doorway, and a man on a scooter waits behind.
title: flip_7125

asset_description: In a street of red-brick houses flooded with brown water, a laughing young woman with a long braid and a green jacket in a wooden canoe reaches up and passes a paper bag of bread to a woman leaning out of an upper-floor window. She then sits down, picks up a paddle and paddles the canoe along the street. A shaggy grey dog stands in the canoe with her. A football and a blue crate of apples float nearby, two neighbours lean out of another upper window, and sandbags lie by a door.
title: flood_7127

asset_description: In the evening rain, the glass front of a tall apartment building shows many lit flats stacked one above another. On each level people do different things: a family eats at a table, people do yoga, a man irons, others sit on sofas. A crane holds a black grand piano on a strap outside one of the upper levels, and a woman on the balcony beside it stretches out her arms, then lowers them and watches. The view slowly moves back to show more of the building.
title: floor_7129

asset_description: On a sunny day, the view moves from a stone courtyard, where a wedding party gathers by long white tables and string lights, up to a small balcony. There a young man in sunglasses stands shirtless in an overfilled inflatable paddling pool with a pink flamingo ring around his waist, grinning and giving a thumbs up, while water pours over the railing onto the guests below. A bride in a white dress and men in suits look up, some holding white chairs over their heads.
title: fool_7131

asset_description: On a wet country road under a dark green storm sky, a huge tornado touches down over flat fields as lightning flashes. A young red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat and cap holds a camera whose flip-out screen shows the tornado she has just recorded. She shouts at first, then grins in excitement as two young men crowd in to stare at the screen, one clutching his head, and another young man with a large camera joins them. A muddy pickup truck and broken boards are behind them.
title: footage_7132

asset_description: On a rainy night under bright stadium floodlights, a player in a mud-smeared white uniform and a dark red helmet leaps along the white sideline and catches the brown football with both gloved hands while an opponent in gold reaches around him from behind. He tucks the ball in and runs on out of view, and an opponent rushes past. The view then shows coaches in dark jackets and teammates in white uniforms on the sideline, with a blue water cooler and the stands behind.
title: footballer_7134

asset_description: At a sunny outdoor science show, a heavy iron wrecking ball hanging from a yellow crane smashes into a tall pyramid of stacked watermelons, and pink juice and pieces burst into the air. The pyramid collapses and watermelons roll across the ground as the ball swings back. In front, a young man with curly hair, safety glasses and a juice-spattered white lab coat holds a red lever and cheers with one arm up. A young woman in a lab coat records it on a tablet, and a crowd behind a barrier watches.
title: force_7135

asset_description: In a bare mountain valley at sunset, an orange off-road truck drives slowly through a wide, shallow glacial river with water splashing around its wheels, and the driver leans out of the window. Beside it a line of young hikers with backpacks hold hands and wade across, the water up to their knees. Behind them a gravel track leads to a yellow tent, with a glacier, dark mountains and steam rising in the golden evening light. Coloured marker poles stand on the near bank.
title: ford_7136

asset_description: In green hill country on a sunny day, a pale green off-road vehicle drives straight through a shallow stony river towards the viewer, throwing up big splashes, while a smiling young man leans out of a side window. Beside it a line of flat stepping stones runs across the river, where sheep stand waiting, and an older walker stands on the dirt track on the far bank. A wooden marker post stands in the water and a green rubber boot lies on the stones.
title: ford_7137

asset_description: Seen from above, an old stone fort stands on a rocky point in a stormy sea. A huge white wave crashes over the thick walls and floods across the wet parade ground, where rows of soldiers in dark uniforms stand in formation, then water pours back off the walls. A sunbeam breaks through grey clouds behind, smoke rises from the chimneys of a long stone barracks next to a small round watchtower, a few soldiers move along the wall, and a small boat rocks in the white water below.
title: fort_7138

asset_description: On the wet deck of a rusty fishing boat at sea under a cloudy sky, a young woman with a long braid in an orange waterproof jacket and overalls throws her arms wide in amazement as a huge net above her releases a flood of silver fish. The fish pour down and pile up around her legs while she shouts. Seagulls circle above. On the next boat, men in orange overalls and dark caps lean on the rail and stare, one holding up a single small fish in his hand.
title: fortune_7139

asset_description: On an evening in a stone square lit by old street lamps under a pink sky, a public meeting fills curved stone steps with dozens of people of all ages, some raising their hands. In the middle a young woman in a mustard shirt talks into a microphone and points towards the crowd, then turns and keeps speaking. A white architectural model of buildings and trees stands on a table beside her. A man in a suit and another in a grey shirt sit on chairs listening, and the man in the suit gestures.
title: forum_7140

asset_description: Inside a bright optician's shop, a young man in a white coat over a navy shirt stands behind a glass display counter, trying on a pair of glasses with thick red-brown rims and grinning. He takes them off, leans over the counter to talk to a woman in a beige trench coat who laughs with her hand at her mouth, and then puts the glasses back on. The wall behind him is covered in rows of empty glasses on wooden rails, more lie in the counter, and another man works at a desk behind.
title: frame_7141

asset_description: In a picture-framing workshop with a canal outside the window, a young woman with a long braid in a linen shirt and blue apron presses a painting of lemons on a branch into an ornate gold wooden border on a workbench, then steps back smiling. An old man in a cardigan holds his face in both hands, delighted, and then claps. Sample corner pieces in many colours cover the walls, a mitre saw stands behind, and a jar of nails and wooden strips lie on the bench.
title: frame_7142

asset_description: On moving-in day in a sunny student dormitory, a young woman in a grey hoodie and white trainers walks in from a busy corridor carrying a cardboard box full of bedding, a desk lamp and a small cactus, with a paper campus map held in her teeth. She hurries into the room, grinning. A bare metal bed with a blue mattress, an empty wooden desk and a cork board wait in the room. In the corridor behind her, other students carry boxes and a woman wheels in a small fridge.
title: freshman_7143

asset_description: At night at a busy street food stall full of steam and hanging light bulbs, a smiling young man in a grey bandana, white T-shirt and white apron pours golden potato fries from a wire frying basket into a white paper cone. He then turns and hands the full cone to a laughing man in the small crowd, who reaches out for it while the others cheer. Steel deep fryers stand on the counter, with more fries in a tray and spilled from a metal cup.
title: fries_7144

asset_description: On a narrow cobbled street of grey stone houses in the morning, a young man in a navy bathrobe and slippers stands in the open doorway of his house holding a steaming mug, looking shocked. A shaggy brown long-horned cow stands right beside him and snorts out a cloud of breath, and he steps back inside behind the glossy red front door with its brass knocker and fan-shaped window. A cat walks past two milk bottles on the step, a herd of cows fills the street behind, and a neighbour laughs at a window.
title: front_door_7145

asset_description: In a small harbour town on a cloudy day, the huge, rusty black and red front of a cargo ship towers over the quay, its pointed bow pushing up white water, with a large anchor hanging on a chain. A small blue fishing boat bobs beside it in the waves. A worker in a yellow high-visibility jacket holds a thick rope tied to the ship, a German shepherd walks down the wet stone steps, seagulls fly, and colourful houses and a white lighthouse line the harbour behind.
title: front_7146

asset_description: At a desert campsite at dusk with pink clouds and red rock buttes behind, a bearded young man in a cream jacket crouches by a campfire and reaches up as a black cast-iron frying pan and a pancake fly high above him. A young woman in a knitted cardigan walks up holding another pan; the pancake drops towards her, and she then lifts her pan high and cheers while he holds his own pan again. Friends sit near white bell tents, beside a table with a bowl of batter and a stack of pancakes, and a dog watches.
title: frying_pan_7147

asset_description: On a rainy summer day, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a knotted white shirt and denim shorts roller-skates along the wet floorboards of a long covered wooden porch beside a white house, coming towards the viewer and spreading her arms wide. A ceiling fan turns overhead, ferns hang in baskets, and a white rocking chair, tall shuttered doors and a jug of iced tea on the white railing line the porch. A dog lies on the boards behind her.
title: gallery_7148

asset_description: At a desert gas station at sunset, a huge red dust storm rolls in behind the lit canopy. A young attendant in an orange shirt and dark apron stands at a fuel pump beside a mud-covered rally car and points at the queue of cars with headlights on waiting on the dirt road. Two drivers in racing suits climb out of the car, carry their white helmets and walk towards the viewer. A dry tumbleweed lies on the concrete forecourt.
title: gas_station_7149

asset_description: A young man in a plaid shirt with a headlamp on his forehead crouches on a wooden porch at dusk after a storm, with a fallen tree in the yard behind. He pours gasoline from a red metal jerry can through a white funnel into a small portable generator. A lit oil lantern stands beside the generator, and a wrench and a coiled cable lie on the damp boards. A woman holding a torch watches from a window. He then stops pouring, lifts the can upright and turns to smile at her.
title: gasoline_7150

asset_description: A young woman with a long ponytail and a black T-shirt crouches on the black stage of an empty concert arena under purple and blue spotlights hanging from a metal lighting rig. She presses a button on a small black fog machine, and a huge white cloud of fog pours out and rolls over the stage past a drum kit and microphone stands. She sits back, laughs and waves while the fog spreads over the edge of the stage. A plastic canister of fluid stands beside her and crew members laugh and clap behind.
title: generator_7153

asset_description: A bearded man in a dark three-piece suit and red tie rides a tall unicycle down the traffic lane of a busy city bridge on a sunny morning, beside the metal barrier. He holds a paper coffee cup in one gloved hand and a brown leather briefcase in the other, and his tie flies over his shoulder in the wind. A red double-decker bus, a black car and a yellow taxi move in the traffic behind him, with tall towers beyond. He sips his coffee as he rides, and a smiling cyclist follows him.
title: get_about_7154

asset_description: A smiling young woman in a long silver satin dress climbs barefoot over a high old stone wall covered in ivy at an evening garden party, holding the top with one hand, her silver high-heeled sandals in her teeth. She swings her leg over, takes the sandals in her hand and sits on top of the wall, laughing and touching her hair. Below, on the lawn in front of a large country house, guests in black suits and dark dresses stand by a white tent and watch her as the sun sets behind the trees.
title: get_away_7155

asset_description: A young man in a backwards red cap and a white tank top stands at a long table at a hot dog eating contest on a sunny seaside boardwalk under strings of colourful flags. He throws his head back and pumps his fist in the air as he swallows a hot dog. A young woman beside him holds a cup and a jug of water, a referee in a striped shirt stands nearby, and another contestant in a blue tank top sits at the table. Trays of hot dogs, bowls of water and sauce bottles cover the table, and a big crowd cheers with raised arms behind.
title: get_down_7156

asset_description: A young woman with messy dark hair, a grey T-shirt and heavy fireproof trousers with red braces stands inside a fire station at night. She swings her padded fire jacket over her shoulders, pushes her arms into the sleeves and pulls it on, then turns away while fixing her hair. Behind her, a red fire engine flashes its lights by the open door with rain falling outside, a firefighter slides down a brass pole, others in full gear stand by the truck, and a spotted Dalmatian dog walks across the floor.
title: get_dressed_7157

asset_description: A young woman with long messy black hair, a sparkly black top and a paper party hat stands on a leather sofa in a small karaoke room with coloured disco lights on the walls. With her eyes shut she sings loudly into a microphone and throws out one arm, then drops down onto the sofa, still singing and laughing. Two young women beside her laugh and cover their ears, one holding her leg. On the low table lie a half-empty beer bottle, several glasses, one knocked over, spilled crisps and a tambourine, and a TV screen glows on the wall.
title: get_drunk_7158

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a long navy coat walks up to her front door on a terraced street on a rainy evening, holding a black umbrella over her head and carrying brown paper shopping bags. A big fluffy brown and white dog in a yellow raincoat walks beside her and looks up at her. She reaches the step, takes out her house keys and unlocks the warm, glowing yellow door while the dog waits next to her. Lit windows, street lamps and wet paving stones fill the street behind them.
title: get_home_7159

asset_description: A young woman in a straw hat, white shirt and denim shorts stands with a rolling suitcase in a narrow cobbled lane of whitewashed houses with blue doors, seen from under a white arch on a sunny day. She looks around, confused, while an older man in a doorway points down the lane with both hands and a woman leans on a balcony railing above. She then unfolds a paper map and studies it with a smile. Potted plants line the walls, washing hangs from a window, and a ginger cat sits on the cobbles near pink flowers.
title: get_lost_on_the_way_7160

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a plum satin dress stands barefoot on a long white table at an outdoor evening wedding dinner in an orchard under string lights. She lifts a golden retriever puppy out of a big open wicker hamper, hugs it and holds it up high. A second puppy walks along the table past a half-eaten cake, leaving muddy paw prints on the tablecloth among tipped-over glasses. A young man in a suit at the table reaches out, and guests behind cheer with raised arms.
title: get_out_7161

asset_description: A young woman in a navy vest and work trousers throws her arms up and shouts with joy inside a sheep-shearing shed with a corrugated metal roof and wooden pens, as clumps of wool fly into the air. A freshly shorn white sheep trots away. She grabs a big armful of wool, drops to her knees and hugs it, laughing. Tired young men in vests sit slumped against the wall, an older man in a navy shirt sweeps with a broom, and a huge pile of fleeces lies at the back of the shed.
title: get_over_7162

asset_description: A young woman in a cream puffer jacket, a mustard scarf and a dark red beanie stands in the middle of a crowded tram on a winter evening. With her eyes shut she holds a tissue to her nose with gloved hands, sneezing and wiping her nose. A thermos flask and a bag with a baguette hang from her arms. Around her, a young man pulls his scarf over his nose, a young woman holds out a packet of tissues, and another passenger frowns, while a young man in front reads a book. Snow is visible through the windows.
title: get_sick_7163

asset_description: A red-haired young woman in a red puffer jacket, a knitted bobble hat and black snow trousers pulls a wooden sled up a snowy mountain slope in a snowstorm, with pine trees and a wooden cabin far behind. Three husky dogs wearing goggles sit on a tartan blanket in the sled, and another husky walks beside her on a lead. She stops, bends forward with her hands on her knees, breathing hard with clouds of breath, and then turns to look back at the dogs. A dropped mitten and a flask lie in the snow.
title: get_tired_7164

asset_description: A young woman climber in a red down jacket with the hood up, ski goggles, black trousers, a harness with an ice axe and yellow boots with crampons steps onto the narrow snowy summit of a mountain on a clear day, her arms spread for balance. Far below lies a sea of white clouds with rocky peaks poking through. She stands still on the top, lifts her goggles onto her head, laughs and waves. A rope runs down behind her and her shadow falls across the snow.
title: get_7166

asset_description: A wet golden retriever trots out of the shallow waves on a grey sandy beach on an overcast day, dragging a big pink inflatable flamingo by its head in its mouth. A laughing young woman with wet hair, a cream knitted jumper and a black swimsuit waits at the water's edge with her arms spread wide. The dog brings the flamingo up to her, she crouches down, and she hugs the dog while the flamingo lies on the sand beside them. Small waves roll in behind.
title: get_7167

asset_description: A dark green vintage sports car with round headlights on stands at the grassy side of a narrow country lane on a grey rainy day, with tall green hedges and a church spire in the distance. A smiling young man in a navy jumper holds the passenger door open while a laughing young woman with long dark hair climbs into the passenger seat. He then leans in towards her and she smiles out at him from the car. Pink flower petals and a green ribbon lie on the wet grass and road.
title: give_a_lift_7168

asset_description: A young woman in a dark sports top kneels in warm water in a blue inflatable birth pool in a softly lit living room at night, with candles on the mantelpiece and fairy lights along the curtains. Her eyes are shut and her face is tense as she holds hands tightly with a man in a grey T-shirt kneeling outside the pool, their foreheads together. He then lifts his head and speaks to her. A midwife in navy scrubs holds a torch beside them, and a birthing ball, blankets on the sofa and an open medical kit are behind.
title: give_birth_7169

asset_description: A narrow green valley lies deep between steep, misty mountains with waterfalls running down their sides. A double rainbow arches across the valley under grey clouds while a bird of prey flies above. A line of shaggy brown long-horned cattle walks along a dirt path beside a clear rocky stream, and some of them splash through the water. Purple heather and ferns grow along the stream, and a roofless stone cottage, a lone tree, a stone wall and a stag on a hill stand nearby.
title: glen_7170

asset_description: A young woman with long braids tied up in a bun and a mustard jumper bends close over a detailed model village on a table. With a thin needle and steady fingers she fixes a tiny part onto a thatched stone cottage, while a tube of glue lies on a green cutting mat beside a small matchbox. Three young women sit by a tall window with a view of a church and watch quietly. Then she jumps up and cheers with both fists, and a laughing young man in a denim jacket leans in beside the table.
title: glue_7172

asset_description: A young woman with curly dark hair, sunglasses, a white shirt and denim shorts stands on a stone quay in a small sunny fishing harbour with blue and white boats. Holding a hot glue gun, she presses a scallop shell onto the upturned wooden hull of an old rowing boat, which is already half covered in rows of seashells, and then lifts the glue gun again. Crates and buckets full of shells stand around her, a cable lies across the ground, a seagull stands by a crate, and two young men watch from behind.
title: glue_7173

asset_description: A smiling young woman in khaki travel clothes with a large backpack walks through a bright ferry terminal with big glass windows and a white ferry docked outside. She holds her passport up to her mouth, then looks down at the phone in her hand as she walks on. Behind her a queue of travellers with suitcases and backpacks files through the boarding gate, a couple hugs by the window, a young man sits on the floor beside a guitar case, and a porter pushes a luggage trolley.
title: go_abroad_7174

asset_description: A smiling young woman with a long braid and a green wax jacket stands in a shallow stream in a misty wood at dusk, lit by an old oil lantern hanging from a twisted, mossy tree root. Holding the root with one hand, she searches in the water with the other, then pulls out a small dark lump and shows it, laughing, to a big shaggy grey dog beside her. Two scruffy terrier dogs watch from the bank, a canvas bag and a small trowel rest on a mossy stump, and autumn leaves float on the water.
title: go_after_7175

asset_description: A laughing young woman with long dark hair sits by the open window of an old, colourful bus driving along a mountain road above green rice terraces. She holds a straw hat on her head and laughs, then takes it off and holds it in her lap, while a white goat pokes its head in through the window beside her. Tassels and flowers decorate the luggage rack above, which is piled with sacks. Other passengers sit behind her, and a basket of mangoes sits on the seat in front.
title: go_by_bus_7176

asset_description: A young woman with a long braid, a red helmet, a red vest top, black shorts and hiking boots abseils down the wet cliff face of a deep, narrow rock canyon, with ferns on the walls and a waterfall pouring down in a misty beam of light behind. She sits back in her harness with her feet against the rock and holds the rope with gloved hands as she moves lower step by step. As she goes down, a pool of water with round stones comes into view at the bottom of the canyon.
title: go_down_7177

asset_description: A young woman with braided hair in a cream blazer, black trousers and heels sits on a grey bench in a bright modern office waiting area with glass walls and a view over city rooftops. Holding a paper coffee cup, she bends to pick up papers that have slipped out of her folder onto the floor. She stands up smiling with the papers and coffee and walks towards a woman with a clipboard waiting by the door, leaving the folder on the floor. Two young men in suits sit on the bench, and a receptionist sits behind a white desk.
title: go_for_an_interview_7178

asset_description: A smiling young man in sunglasses and a navy suit leaps into the air towards the infinity pool of a sunny luxury beach resort with palm trees and a turquoise sea, his tie flying up. He splashes into the water, his rolling suitcase falls over on the stone edge, and he ends up floating on his back with his arms spread wide, still in his suit and brown leather shoes. A laughing waiter in white holds a tray with a coconut drink and a flower garland, and guests lie on sun loungers behind.
title: go_on_holiday_7180

asset_description: A smiling young man in a navy suit stands at a candlelit table at a canal-side restaurant at night, on a wooden deck under glowing string lights, with tall brick houses and a bridge behind. He takes a plate covered with a silver dome from a cook in a white jacket in a rowing boat on the water, carries it to the table and sits down holding it, while a cloud of steam rises from under the dome. His companion, a young woman, laughs at the table, and other couples dine at white-clothed tables along the deck.
title: go_out_for_dinner_7182

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a pale yellow raincoat and jeans walks along the wet pavement of a rainy shopping street with shop fronts and white awnings. She holds a black umbrella and points at a shop window. She leads a small brown pony that carries paper shopping bags on both sides, one with a long baguette sticking out. A shop assistant in an apron stands in a doorway, and behind them a cyclist rides by and people hurry through the rain, one holding a box over his head.
title: go_shopping_7183

asset_description: A laughing young couple ride one red bicycle across a large cobbled square in the evening, in front of a grand baroque church with two bell towers lit by string lights. A young man in a green T-shirt pedals and looks up at the church, while a young woman sits behind him and looks up too. They ride towards the camera as a pigeon flies off, past a dropped ice cream cone lying on the cobbles. A street painter with an easel, a horse and carriage, tourists and cafe tables with umbrellas fill the square.
title: go_sightseeing_7184

asset_description: A laughing young woman in a white T-shirt, black trousers and striped socks leaps high through the metal detector arch at an airport security checkpoint with big windows onto parked planes. She lands, bows, and walks to the conveyor belt, where grey plastic trays hold her ankle boots, a brown belt, a denim jacket, a clear bag of toiletries and a whole pineapple, and she picks up her boots. A laughing security officer in a navy uniform holds a clipboard, and travellers in the queue laugh behind.
title: go_through_security_7185

asset_description: A young woman with long dark hair, a grey long-sleeved nightshirt and thick knitted socks climbs from a rope ladder onto a bed built on a wooden platform high above a dark pine forest at dusk, hung from ropes under the branches of a tree. She crawls onto the bed, sits down, pulls a patchwork quilt over herself, lies back on the white pillows and closes her eyes. A small lantern glows warmly on the wooden headboard, and misty forested hills stretch away under a deep blue evening sky.
title: go_to_bed_7186

asset_description: A young man with curly dark hair, a green T-shirt and rolled-up khaki trousers lies barefoot in a hammock slung between two huge redwood trees, with golden sunlight shining between the trunks. His eyes are closed and his head falls back as he drifts off. An open book slips out of his hanging hand and falls to the ground, and his empty arm keeps hanging over the side while he sleeps. A coiled rope lies on the forest floor among ferns.
title: go_to_sleep_7187

asset_description: A young woman with long dark hair in a black wetsuit and long black fins swims in deep blue sea beneath a huge floating block of ice. She kicks her fins and glides along under the ice, then turns upwards and stretches one arm towards the ice above, with a trail of silver bubbles rising behind her. Beams of sunlight shine down through the water from around the edge of the ice, and the water below her fades into dark blue.
title: go_under_7188

asset_description: A smiling young woman in an orange helmet and orange jacket glides past a small wooden coffee hut with a striped awning on a mountain ridge at sunrise, hanging in her paraglider harness under a wide wing. She takes a paper coffee cup from a bearded man leaning out of the hut, where a coffee machine steams, and flies on holding the cup. She passes cheering hikers and a jumping dog on the rocky path and glides away over a sea of pink clouds, with other paragliders drifting in the distance.
title: grab_a_coffee_7191

asset_description: A young man in a black gown with a gold stole lands from a jump in a crouch on the lawn in front of an old stone university building, then springs up and stands with both arms raised high, holding a rolled diploma with a red ribbon and shouting with joy. His black square cap lies on the grass in front of him. Behind him a big crowd of graduates in gowns and families holding flowers and balloons cheer beside a wooden podium.
title: graduate_7192

asset_description: A laughing grandmother in a flowery dress, a cardigan and a sun hat drives an old red tractor with bunting along a dusty farm track beside a golden wheat field in the evening, raising one fist in the air. Next to her, a young bride in a white lace dress and long veil holds on and laughs. Behind them a trailer full of cheering wedding guests in suits and dresses waves hats and jackets in the air, and a small dog runs along in the dust as the tractor comes closer.
title: grandma_7193

asset_description: A young woman with her hair in a bun, a grey shirt and a black top holds up a printed page showing a blue moth and pins it onto a wall covered in neatly pinned book pages, where pictures of flowers, fruit and insects sit between columns of text. She smooths the page flat with her hand and looks at it with a smile. On the table in front lie stacks of prints, brushes in jars and a tin of pins, while another woman works on a ladder and a third sits at a desk behind, in a bright studio with tall windows.
title: graphics_7194

asset_description: A young woman chef with short black hair and hoop earrings, in a white chef's jacket, stands in a busy restaurant kitchen holding a big steel bowl and looking up at fresh leafy greens, kale and spinach leaves flying through the air above her. The leaves fall down into her bowl, and she lowers her eyes and smiles with the bowl full of greens. Behind her two male cooks work at the stoves, steam rises from a pot on the left, copper pans hang overhead and piles of green leaves lie on the steel counter.
title: greens_7195

asset_description: A dark green bronze statue of a griffin stands on a stone pillar at the end of an old bridge wall at dusk. The creature has an eagle's head and huge spread feathered wings on a lion's body with a long tail, and one clawed foot is raised. A crow flies in and lands on the tip of its wing. A glowing street lamp stands beside it, wet cobblestones shine with puddles, and behind it a stone arch bridge crosses a misty river towards gothic towers under a stormy sky.
title: griffin_7196

asset_description: A big clump of dark brown earth breaks off a steep bank of soil at the edge of a freshly ploughed field and falls in a cloud of dust, showing roots and pale chalky layers. The earth crashes down and the dust slowly settles, while a badger peeks out of a burrow in the bank. A red fox stands on the loose ground at the top and looks down, crows walk on the furrows behind it in the morning mist, and at the bottom a rusty plough blade lies in a muddy brown puddle among broken branches and stones.
title: ground_7198

asset_description: On a stormy night at an animal rescue camp on the savanna, a young man in an olive ranger uniform stands behind a baby elephant lying on straw under a checked blanket. He lifts a large green tarpaulin higher with both arms to shield the calf, then looks down at it and smiles. Behind him, under a tin roof, other rangers with a lantern look after more young elephants. Lightning flashes near a lone acacia tree under dark clouds and the muddy ground is wet.
title: guardian_7199

asset_description: On a rocky hilltop high above the sea, a man in a red jacket, black helmet and sunglasses runs off the rock as an orange paraglider wing fills above him. He lifts into the air and floats away over a turquoise gulf of calm water, almost closed in by green hilly headlands with white houses, while the open sea shines in the sun beyond. Two people stand near a striped windsock on the slope below and watch him as he flies further out and gets smaller.
title: gulf_7200

asset_description: Under a huge banyan tree with long hanging roots, an old man with a long white beard, a red mark on his forehead and orange robes holds up a dry, see-through leaf and turns it in his fingers as he talks. Young people sit behind him and listen. Then the view widens: he sits cross-legged on a mat and teaches a circle of young men and women in jumpers and hoodies sitting barefoot on mats, a notebook beside one of them. A brass water pot stands on the dusty ground and a bell hangs from a branch in soft misty light.
title: guru_7201

asset_description: In a farmyard at misty sunrise, a young man in a cowboy hat, a sleeveless denim shirt, jeans, gloves and muddy boots holds a bale of straw high above his head and throws it down beside a wooden fence. He then wipes his face with his arm and grins. Brown, black and white cows crowd behind the fence next to him. An older man in a hat and sheepskin coat stands by a metal gate holding a mug, with stacked bales and a barn behind him.
title: hand_7202

asset_description: An opened computer hard drive stands upright on a block of black cooled lava at night. Its metal case shows the shiny round disk, the spindle and the read arm, and the cover plate leans beside it. A small drop of glowing orange lava bubbles at its base and thin smoke curls up around it, while bright lava trickles down cracks in the rock. Behind it a river of molten lava flows across the dark ground and a volcano throws up fire and smoke under a starry sky.
title: hard_drive_7203

asset_description: On a grey beach covered in black oil, a young woman in a white protective suit, face mask and yellow rubber gloves kneels in the oily water and holds a seabird soaked in thick dripping oil, looking at it sadly. She then gets up with the bird in her hands and turns away to carry it off. Oil coats the sand, the rocks, the seaweed and crabs beside her. Behind her, workers in suits and boots carry crates, a yellow floating barrier lies along the waterline and a tanker ship sits on the grey sea.
title: harm_7205

asset_description: Inside a wet fish market hall, a young woman with pinned-up red hair, in a long dark green velvet dress and green heels, sits on a stool and plays a tall golden harp, swaying as she plucks the strings, with a pair of yellow rubber boots beside her. Behind her, men in orange waterproof overalls stand at steel tables piled with fish and shellfish on ice and sing along, one holding up a big fish. Hanging lamps light the hall, steam drifts in the air and a seagull sits on a beam.
title: harper_7206

asset_description: On a quiet village street at misty sunrise, a large adult male red deer with wide branching antlers stands on a zebra crossing, raises his head and calls out, his breath steaming in the cold air. He then lowers his head, looks around and steps forward across the crossing. Several female deer wait further down the street behind him. A black bird flies past a bakery with a striped awning, a van waits with its headlights on beside a striped post with an orange globe lamp, and a church spire rises behind.
title: hart_7207

asset_description: On a steep mountain slope, a young woman hiker in a red t-shirt, shorts and a backpack, with two braids and dirt on her face, crouches on wet rocks beside a thin stream of clear water running from the mossy cliff. She sips water from her cupped hands, lowers them and smiles, catches more water from the stream and drinks again, drops splashing around her. The low sun shines over the ridge behind her and a wide valley lies far below.
title: have_a_drink_7208

asset_description: Inside a huge antiques warehouse with skylights, a young woman with a long braid, in a camel coat, white top and jeans, walks slowly down the middle aisle, looking up at a large crystal chandelier and then around her with a smile. On both sides stand stacks of old furniture: a wooden rocking horse high on a shelf, shutters, glass cases with stuffed birds, an old barber chair and rolled carpets. An old man reads a newspaper in an armchair and another man crouches by a crate.
title: have_a_look_around_7210

asset_description: On a hanging tent platform fixed to a sheer granite cliff, high above a sea of clouds at sunrise, a young woman climber in an orange down jacket, a bobble hat with a head torch and a harness eats breakfast. She takes a bite from her fork, then lifts a steaming mug and laughs. On her lap is a plate of toast, fried egg and baked beans. A black raven sits on the platform edge next to her, birds fly past, and ropes and a second platform hang nearby.
title: have_breakfast_7212

asset_description: Inside a small stone mountain hut during a snowstorm, a young woman with red braided hair, wrapped in a thick grey blanket, sits near a glowing fire. A man in a green jacket hands her a hot mug, and she holds it in both hands, closes her eyes and smiles. Hikers in snowy hoods come in through the open wooden door out of the blowing snow, and then the door is shut. A black and white sheepdog lies at her feet, jackets hang drying overhead and boots and a kettle stand by the fireplace.
title: haven_7213

asset_description: On a city street on a very hot evening, a young woman in a white blouse and dark pencil skirt stands barefoot on wet cobblestones holding her black shoes, while cool spray from a burst water pipe showers over the crowd and makes a rainbow. She opens her mouth, throws her arms wide and laughs up into the water. Office workers in suits with briefcases stand around her in the mist, a dog lies on the wet pavement and rolls onto its back, and a red double-decker bus waits behind in the golden low sun.
title: heat_wave_7214

asset_description: In an old wood-panelled lawyer's office on a rainy day, a young woman with messy red hair held up by pencils, in a paint-splashed denim jacket, sits at a leather-topped desk with her hands at her open mouth in shock. An old man slides a big ring of old iron keys and a worn leather folder towards her. She grabs the keys, lifts them up and stares at them with a huge excited smile. Behind her, relatives in black suits and dresses stare in disbelief, one man getting up, beside a grandfather clock and shelves of law books.
title: heir_7215

asset_description: On a snowy city street at night, under falling snow and green traffic lights, a smiling young man in a camel coat leans his whole weight against the back of a small white car stuck in the snow and pushes it. The car moves forward, he straightens up laughing and steps up to the driver's window. The young woman driving leans out, laughing and waving a white mitten. A paper grocery bag lies in the snow beside them, with oranges and a baguette spilling out, and people with umbrellas watch from the pavement.
title: help_7216

asset_description: At a dinner in a white-walled courtyard at dusk, under strings of lights, pink bougainvillea and lemon trees in pots, a laughing young woman in a linen apron leans over a long wooden table and lifts a big spoonful of yellow seafood rice with prawns from a wide pan onto a man's plate. He raises his hands happily, she serves more and then stands back laughing. Friends around the table laugh, and there are plates of rice, a salad bowl, a water jug, lemon wedges and candles in jars.
title: help_7217

asset_description: In a ruined stone castle, a bearded man with round glasses, in a tweed jacket and white cotton gloves, holds an old yellowed plan of the building up against the wall beside a brick archway and compares it with the stones. He turns his head from the plan to the wall and breaks into a happy smile. In front of him a folding table holds a laptop, old leather books, a magnifying glass and an open sketchbook with floor plans. Ivy grows over the walls, a crow flies off the top and visitors walk along the path behind.
title: historian_7218

asset_description: On a flooded town street in the rain, a young woman in a yellow rain jacket and dark waders strains to push a heavy sandbag onto a long wall of sandbags, while brown floodwater gushes through a gap and splashes over the cobbles at her feet. She then steps back, wipes her face with her arm and smiles, mud on her cheeks. Beyond the wall the river has risen over the road and a car is sunk up to its windows. Workers in yellow and orange safety vests pass more sandbags along the line behind her.
title: hold_back_7219

asset_description: In an ice hockey game on a frozen lake in winter, a young goalkeeper in a cream wool jumper, knitted hat and old leather pads throws himself across the ice in front of a small wooden goal and blocks the puck with his stick and pads. Young players in woolly hats and padded jackets jab at the puck, spraying ice, then tumble over him. He lies on the ice laughing as the crowd behind raises their arms and cheers beside a fire burning in a metal barrel, with snowy pine forest beyond.
title: hold_off_7220

asset_description: On a stormy seaside promenade, a young man with wet curly hair, in a yellow raincoat, grey jumper, jeans and white trainers, leans far sideways against a metal railing in the strong wind, laughing with his fists up, as a paper coffee cup and leaves fly past. Behind him a woman in a dark coat holds on tightly to a lamp post, a couple sits on a bench, an umbrella blows away inside out and a dog stands by them. Big waves crash over the sea wall near beach huts and a pier, and the man comes closer as he laughs.
title: hold_on_7221

asset_description: At a wildlife park on a sunny day, a young woman with long braids, in a yellow sundress, leans forward on a wooden viewing deck and stretches her arm out, holding out a leafy branch to a tall giraffe, which sticks out its long dark tongue to reach it. She then pulls back laughing, and a guide in a khaki uniform and cap holds out another branch as the giraffe lifts its head. Smiling friends watch behind her, a potted plant stands on the deck and another giraffe walks on the dry sandy ground beyond the fence.
title: hold_out_7222

asset_description: On a cobbled lane at a street festival at sunset, a young woman in a teal and bronze superhero costume, a visor and tall boots holds up a long metal beam above her head with both hands. She rises from a wide squat until she stands straight with her legs apart, keeping the beam up under a lit metal arch. Behind her a crowd of young people with drinks and food watch and cheer, one man raising his fist, under strings of bulbs over the stalls. A paper lantern and torn red and white bunting lie on the cobbles in front of her.
title: hold_up_7223

asset_description: On the bottom of a swimming pool, a young man with spiky black hair, in a black tuxedo and bow tie, sits at a table laid with a white cloth and pinches his nose shut, keeping his mouth closed, with his eyes wide. Around the table other young people in evening dresses and suits sit underwater, laughing, chatting and raising glasses as bubbles rise from them. Tall white candles stand on the table, a bowl of apples floats upwards and lane ropes stretch across the surface above.
