title: hold_your_breath_7224

asset_description: Inside a rally car racing through desert dunes, a young woman driver in a white helmet and blue racing overalls grips the steering wheel while her co-driver's gloved arm reaches up. The car jolts and a water bottle, sunglasses, a clipboard and a paper cup fly through the air and land on the floor, but a phone stays firmly clamped in a black spring-mounted holder in the middle of the dashboard. The driver laughs as the car speeds on past bright sand dunes behind a cracked, dusty windscreen.
title: holder_7225

asset_description: On a city pavement on a cold, frosty morning, a young bearded man in a black beanie, an olive army jacket and gloves sits on a sleeping bag on flattened cardboard in a shop doorway, with plastic bags of belongings and a book beside him. A young woman in black with a ponytail crouches in front of him and hands him a steaming paper cup of coffee and a paper bag. He sips the coffee and smiles while she holds out the bag, and his small shaggy dog sits between them. Men in dark coats walk past behind.
title: homeless_7226

asset_description: On a flooded country lane in the rain, a young bride in a muddy cream wedding dress crouches barefoot in the water at the front of an old white car and fastens a heavy steel hook on a tow cable onto the car's bumper. She then stands up and walks away, and the cable pulls tight through the brown floodwater towards a tractor further down the lane. Guests in suits and a bridesmaid with a bouquet sit barefoot on the car roof and clap, and white swans swim in the water behind.
title: hook_7228

asset_description: In a laboratory, a young woman scientist with long braids, safety glasses pushed up on her head, a white lab coat and purple gloves drops liquid from a pipette into a small glass of yellow fluid. She then puts the pipette aside, looks down at a printed graph with one sharp peak and smiles. On the steel bench are a rack of blood sample tubes with coloured caps, a sample tray and a model of the thyroid gland. An open centrifuge stands behind her, and a young man at the back holds up a tube.
title: hormone_7229

asset_description: At a sunny outdoor flea market, a young woman with long braids, in a brown t-shirt and jeans, holds up an ugly shiny green-gold china poodle holding a bunch of plastic grapes and pulls a disgusted face. She turns to look at it, grimaces again and then bursts out laughing. Beside her a young woman with red hair holds a lamp with a pink fringed shade, and an older man in a flat cap smiles behind the stall. The table is covered in teacups, brass ornaments and records under striped awnings and bunting.
title: horror_7230

asset_description: In a reed nest above a calm pond at sunset, a big grey fluffy cuckoo chick fills the whole nest and opens its wide orange beak. A much smaller brown reed warbler perched on a reed stem pushes a green caterpillar into its beak, then sits back and watches as the chick stretches up, flaps its wings and begs for more. A second small warbler waits nearby. Dragonflies hover over the water, a water bird swims behind and willow trees glow in the warm evening light.
title: host_7231

asset_description: At night on a wet airport runway in the rain, a thin young woman in a grey tracksuit, wrapped in a grey blanket, walks away from a small private jet, held around the shoulders by a man. They stop, and she throws her arms around him and cries on his shoulder while he holds her head. By the plane's steps a man in a dark coat stands still and a woman in a dark uniform wipes her eyes. Behind a barrier a small crowd waits under tall floodlights, and a bunch of flowers lies on the wet tarmac.
title: hostage_7232

asset_description: On a hillside neighbourhood in warm afternoon sun, hundreds of small brick and concrete houses, some painted green, yellow, blue and pink, are packed closely together up the steep slope, with flat roofs, water tanks, satellite dishes and tangled wires between them. In the foreground a young woman in a pink vest top, a patterned skirt and a headscarf walks up worn concrete steps between the houses, away from the viewer, carrying a basket of laundry on her hip, and gets smaller as she climbs.
title: housing_7234

asset_description: On a windy heather moor under a cloudy sky, a young woman with a long braid, in a red jacket and dark trousers, runs with one shoe off, reaching after a red round flying device with a small box hanging under it, while a black and white sheepdog races beside her. A startled grouse flaps away from her feet. The device rises out of reach, and she jumps and stretches her arms up after it as the dog leaps too. A lost boot, a hat and a map lie in the heather, and a man on a quad bike watches from a dirt track.
title: hunt_7235

asset_description: On a seaside promenade during a tropical storm at dusk, palm trees bend hard in the wind and huge waves crash over the sea wall, throwing spray across the path. Muddy sea water then floods over the paving around a striped blue and white deckchair that has been blown across it, among scattered coconuts, torn palm leaves, flip-flops and a red toy bucket and spade. A pastel cafe with boarded-up windows and an empty lifeguard hut stand by the rough grey sea.
title: hurricane_7236

asset_description: In an empty lecture hall, a balloon tied to a metal stand on a long wooden bench bursts into a huge rolling ball of orange flame, next to a long metal rod with a small flame at its tip. The fireball rises, darkens and turns into thick grey smoke that drifts up to the ceiling, leaving only the small flame burning. A small gas cylinder, safety goggles, a glass beaker and a red fire blanket lie on the bench. A blackboard with formulas, a fire extinguisher, rows of empty seats and another balloon are behind.
title: hydrogen_7237

asset_description: Inside a car wash, a young man in a white linen shirt sits calmly in an open-top black convertible while a huge spinning blue brush presses against his head and pink soap foam covers his shirt, his shorts and the seats. The brush moves away, he closes his eyes and sips from a foamy takeaway cup, and then a jet of water sprays straight into his face. A small dog in a yellow raincoat sits in the back seat. Behind a window two women stare at him in disbelief, holding their heads.
title: idiot_7239

asset_description: At a small roadside shrine under a big old tree on a misty morning, a woman in a pale blue sari stands barefoot on a stone step and gently touches a dark carved stone statue of a god, dressed in red cloth and hung with thick orange marigold garlands. She then steps back, presses her palms together, bows her head and prays, and looks up at the statue. Brass oil lamps, incense and a plate of fruit stand on the ledge in front of it, a brass bell hangs from a branch and two men with a bicycle stand on the road behind.
title: idol_7240

asset_description: In a sunny city park, a big red, yellow and blue hot air balloon crash-lands behind a wooden bench, its wicker basket tearing up the grass while the pilot clings on, and people run and a dog dashes away. On the bench a young woman with long black hair, headphones and sunglasses on her head, in a white shirt and beige trousers, calmly reads a book and sips an iced drink through a straw, a paper bag of pastries beside her. She never looks up while the basket tips over and families picnic further back.
title: ignore_7241

asset_description: At night outside an airport arrivals building in falling snow, a young man in a denim jacket and patterned shirt, with a backpack, looks up in wonder at the snowflakes, a big brown suitcase and a cardboard box tied with string at his feet. A young woman in a bobble hat and dark parka wraps a thick hooded winter coat with a fur collar around his shoulders. He pulls it closed, laughs and keeps staring up at the snow. Other travellers pull suitcases past waiting taxis, and city towers glow behind.
title: immigrant_7242

asset_description: At the rim of a huge fresh crater in a flat desert under a grey sky, a young woman with curly hair tied back, in a rust-coloured jacket and beige trousers, stands on a cracked slab and looks down into it. She crouches, picks up a small grey rock fragment and turns it in her fingers, smiling. Below her the ground is torn open in layers of red, grey and white rock, broken boulders lie across the slopes and smoke still rises from the centre of the crater.
title: impact_7243

asset_description: In a deep trench dug under a city street at dusk, a young woman engineer in a white hard hat, an orange high-visibility jacket and work trousers climbs a ladder, holding on to a huge old riveted iron water main beside her, and looks up as she climbs. Around her the trench is crossed by more large pipes, a yellow gas pipe and bundles of black and orange cables, and an old brick sewer tunnel opens behind. Water trickles down the muddy walls, and above, cars pass on the road between lit brick buildings.
title: infrastructure_7244

asset_description: An old stone inn with a snowy roof stands in a mountain village at dusk. A young woman with long red hair, in a cream winter coat, bobble hat and scarf, pulls a suitcase through deep snow towards the arched wooden door, where a man in a dark jacket waits in the warm light. A big brown and white St Bernard dog carries a lit lantern in its mouth and walks ahead of her up to the door. The man reaches up beside the door and smiles. Skis lean against the wall under a blank hanging wooden sign, and logs are stacked by the house.
title: inn_7245

asset_description: A dry desert village at sunset. A young woman with long braids and a yellow headscarf, in dusty overalls, kneels in the sand and catches clean water in her hands as it pours from a tap on a tall new machine covered in solar panels into a clay pot. She laughs, presses her wet hands to her face, then throws her head back and raises her hands in joy while the water keeps running into the pot. Behind her a workbench with tools and notes stands by rusty metal cabinets, and a crowd of children cheer and hold up cups, bowls and pots.
title: innovation_7246

asset_description: An old library with tall dark wooden bookshelves. A young woman with long red-brown hair, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and a black skirt, stands on a wooden ladder and pushes a thick brown book into a gap on a high shelf until it slides in. She then steps down a rung, smiles and looks up at the shelf. A grey cat sits on the shelf above beside a pile of books and watches her. Behind her a couple covers their mouths nervously and then claps, and soft light falls into the room.
title: insert_7247

asset_description: A snowy frozen river under an iron city bridge. A young man with dark hair, in a long grey wool coat, a suit and leather gloves, stands on the ice and points ahead, giving orders. A young police officer in a dark uniform and cap walks up to him with a plastic evidence bag and hands it over, and the man takes it. Other officers and a police dog stand nearby. Behind yellow tape a red car stands nose-down in the ice, workers in white suits examine it, and people look down from the bridge.
title: inspector_7248

asset_description: A cobbled city square at sunset under pink clouds. A young woman with a braid, in khaki cargo trousers and a short jacket, pulls a canvas sheet off a huge sculpture of a whale's head made of welded bicycle chains, gears and scrap metal, and it falls to the ground. She raises both arms in triumph, shouts with joy and then puts her hands to her face, while a fountain jet rises higher behind the whale. A crowd holding coffee cups cheers and claps, ladders and a toolbox stand beside her, and pigeons fly up from the wet cobbles.
title: inspiration_7249

asset_description: A young woman sits at a kitchen table by a window in morning light. She has long brown hair and a grey sweatshirt and holds up an insulin pen, checking the dose. She then lifts her sweatshirt, injects into her belly and looks at the pen again. On the table are a plate of rice and beans, an open blue cool bag holding two small glass vials, a blood sugar meter, a small plastic cap and a notebook with handwritten numbers. A young man sits behind her eating from a bowl and smiles at her.
title: insulin_7250

asset_description: A cosy old café with bookshelves and framed portraits on the walls. A young man with curly black hair, glasses and a beard, in a brown corduroy jacket and black polo neck, argues passionately with his mouth wide open, pointing at a tall stack of books full of sticky notes, and draws a diagram with a fountain pen. He then laughs and touches his glasses. At the marble table with espresso cups and sugar cubes, a young woman sits with her arms crossed and frowns, while a man beside him laughs. Brass lamps glow.
title: intellectual_7251

asset_description: A research camp on a sunny snowfield. A young woman scientist in a red down jacket and gloves holds up a long clear cylinder of ice from a drill and studies it, her breath steaming. A bearded man in a red jacket and dark hat steps in beside her and points at the ice, and she smiles. Beside them stands a metal drill rig, and other men in red jackets and orange snow trousers look on. Boxes of ice samples sit on a wooden sledge with coiled rope, and red tents, flags and jagged mountains are behind them.
title: investigator_7252

asset_description: A golf course by the sea at golden hour. A young woman in a cream cap with sunglasses on the peak, a cream polo shirt and beige trousers swings her golf iron through and follows through high over her shoulder. She then laughs and lowers the club. A golden retriever stands beside her with another iron in its mouth next to a white golf bag. Two men in caps watch from behind, one holding up a sheet of paper, with dune grass, seagulls and the sea in soft evening light.
title: iron_7255

asset_description: An old lost property office. A young woman with a blond bun, a dark blue shirt and waistcoat stands behind a worn wooden counter and hands one small single item, a tiny white object wrapped in tissue, into the open palm of a customer reaching in from the left. She places it in the hand, the customer pulls back, and she folds her hands and smiles. Tall shelves behind her hold umbrellas, bicycles, crutches and stuffed birds. A man carries a tuba in the background, and a ticket book and a brass bell lie on the counter.
title: item_7256

asset_description: An inspection room with grey lockers and a barred window. A young woman in a white lab coat and gloves lifts a carved pale ivory bangle out of a wooden crate labelled as wooden ornaments, with straw packing spilling out. She holds it up, looks at it closely under a lamp and then lays it on the steel table, where a whole elephant tusk, rows of ivory bangles, chess pieces, small carved figures and a magnifying visor lie. Two colleagues in lab coats write notes and open another crate behind her.
title: ivory_7257

asset_description: The African savanna in warm evening light. A woman in an olive ranger shirt and bucket hat kneels in dry golden grass and holds a long curved elephant tusk of cream-white ivory across her arms. She looks at it closely and runs her hand along its finely cracked surface; its wide end is hollow. Behind her a man in the same uniform loads a metal box into an open safari truck, and in the dusty distance a herd of elephants walks past flat-topped acacia trees.
title: ivory_7258

asset_description: An autumn picnic in strong wind. A blue jay with a pointed blue crest, blue-and-white barred wings and a black collar stands on a glazed doughnut on a paper plate on a wooden picnic table, beak wide open as if it is screeching. Paper plates and a red checked blanket blow off the table, orange leaves swirl and another jay flies past in the sky. A cut cake with blue icing sits at the end of the table. A row of grey squirrels sits on the bench, seen from behind, staring up at the bird, and one climbs onto the table.
title: jay_7259

asset_description: A small jazz club in a brick-vaulted cellar. A woman with her locs tied up in a knot, wearing a grey satin shirt and black trousers, plays a brass trumpet under a spotlight, a music stand in front of her. She lowers the trumpet, smiles at the man beside her who plays a tall wooden double bass, and then lifts it to her lips again. In the foreground a young man plays a snare drum with brushes. The audience sits at small round tables lit by candles in jars.
title: jazz_7260

asset_description: A bright old workshop with tall windows and a wooden floor. A young man in a blue denim shirt, brown leather apron and jeans raises his arms and unrolls a long heavy bolt of dark blue denim fabric, which flies up in a wide wave while white fluff drifts down. The fabric falls across a long wooden cutting table, and he smooths it flat with his hands. Scissors and a tape measure lie on the table. A young woman at an old sewing machine watches, shelves of folded denim fill the back and a cat sits on a bench.
title: jean_7261

asset_description: A steep whitewashed lane in a Greek island village at sunset. A grey female donkey wearing a woven straw hat and a folded blanket over her back stands on the stone steps, and her small fuzzy brown foal drinks milk from under her belly. The foal then steps forward and nuzzles its mother's side. Blue doors and shutters line the white houses, a tabby cat lies on a windowsill, pots of basil and a basket of lemons sit by a doorstep and a bucket of water stands on the ground. Pink bougainvillea hangs over a wall and the blue sea shines below.
title: jenny_7262

asset_description: A flooded narrow street of old tall houses. A young woman with curly hair in a yellow raincoat, a sparkly silver dress and black boots stands in knee-deep water and forces a long iron crowbar into the gap of a blue wooden bakery door. The door bursts open with a splash and splinters, and she lowers the crowbar and laughs. A ginger cat sits on the brass door knocker above her, a loaf and a croissant float in the water, the shop window is full of bread, and two men carry a ladder behind.
title: jimmy_7264

asset_description: An old attic with bare wooden beams under a sloping ceiling. A woman in a plaid shirt, khaki work trousers, boots and grey work gloves crouches on the dusty wooden floor and levers up a loose floorboard with a metal bar, a puff of dust rising from the gap below. She lifts the board out with both hands, stands up and holds it upright beside the open hole in the floor, then looks down into it. A tin of old rusty nails stands beside her, planks are stacked against the wall and warm sunlight comes through a tall window.
title: jimmy_7265

asset_description: A muddy building site at sunrise. A laughing young woman with a braid, in a white hard hat, orange high-visibility vest, grey hoodie and dirty work trousers walks under a wooden roof truss hanging from a crane strap, carrying a tray of four paper coffee cups, a hammer in her tool belt. Three workers in hard hats lean over the scaffolding above her and wave. She stops, looks up and lifts the tray of coffee towards them. A timber house skeleton, a wheelbarrow and planks lie around in the dust and low golden light.
title: job_7266

asset_description: A new steel footbridge over a deep river gorge at sunrise. The two halves of the bridge meet in the middle, and a young woman in a white hard hat, orange high-visibility jacket and safety harness kneels on the steel grating, tightening the bolts on the plate that joins them with a big wrench. Across the gap a worker welds the seam in a shower of sparks. She then sits up and raises her fist with a shout, and workers in hard hats cheer on both sides. Two tall cranes stand on the cliffs and a safety net hangs below.
title: join_7267

asset_description: A museum hall with a glass roof, marble floor and white arches during a thunderstorm, lightning flashing above. A young woman in an orange climbing helmet with a head torch, a grey T-shirt and a harness stands on metal scaffolding and guides the huge ball-shaped end of a giant fossil bone into its round socket, forming the joint of a dinosaur leg hanging from a crane hook. Below, workers in hard hats raise their arms and cheer between wooden crates of bones, and a man drives a small yellow crane.
title: joint_7268

asset_description: At night a young man in a brown beanie, olive puffer jacket and hoodie with a lanyard sits on a low wall beside a lit takeaway van. He holds a handful of chips over a greasy paper wrapper of chips, ketchup and a battered sausage on his lap and eats them. He turns to look at a seagull that stands on the wall beside him, drinks from a can and smiles. A cheeseburger in paper sits next to him on the wall, steam rises from the van's fryer and orange street lights shine on the wet pavement behind.
title: junk_food_7269

asset_description: A barbecue on a sandy beach at sunset. A young woman in a red bandana, an open blue shirt and a denim apron turns sausages and corn on a round black grill with tongs and glares sideways at a big seagull. The seagull stands on a small wooden table beside her next to a plate of burger buns. She turns to it and points her finger at it in warning. A laughing man in a bucket hat and sunglasses stands behind her. Paper lanterns hang on a string above, and a woman in a yellow swimsuit plays volleyball by the sea.
title: keep_an_eye_on_7270

asset_description: An old farmhouse kitchen with a dresser full of blue and white plates and a back door open to a stone yard. An older woman in a wool hat, a knitted jumper and yellow waterproof dungarees rests her hand on a big sack of potatoes on the wooden table, while a hand from the right takes a brown envelope from the table. A young man reads a newspaper behind the table, then lowers it and laughs. A young woman in a beanie steps in from the right and smiles, and the older woman clasps her hands. A fish in paper lies on the table.
title: keep_7273

asset_description: A dim clinic room lit by a desk lamp. A young woman with long red hair lies on an examination couch in a navy T-shirt, while a smiling young woman in navy scrubs holds an ultrasound probe against her side and points at the screen of the ultrasound machine, which shows a grey bean-shaped kidney. The patient looks at the screen, and the woman in scrubs then turns to her and smiles. A poster with two red kidneys stands behind them, and a bottle of gel and a paper towel roll sit on a metal trolley in front.
title: kidney_7275

asset_description: A shallow coral reef in clear blue water. A young diver in a black and blue wetsuit, mask and air tank swims low over the reef and reaches towards the coral, with bubbles rising above her. Most of the coral around her has died and turned bone white: large branching white corals and pale round corals, with only a few patches of brown coral left. A yellow measuring tape and a white slate lie across the reef, and one small orange fish swims among the white branches. The diver turns her head and looks straight ahead with wide eyes.
title: kill_off_7276

asset_description: An empty railway platform at night under a street lamp and a large clock. A young man in an olive parka, grey hoodie, jeans and a knitted beanie reaches up and places one more paper cup on top of a very tall, wobbly tower of cups stacked on his silver suitcase. He steps back, spreads his arms wide and then clenches his fists in triumph. Around him lie a long paper chain on a bench, a pile of folded paper boats and a few sandwiches. People doze on a bench behind him and a cat sits by the tracks.
title: kill_time_7277

asset_description: The African savanna in hazy golden light. A spotted leopard lies stretched along the thick branch of a lone acacia tree, its long tail hanging down and curling at the tip. Draped over the same branch next to its head hangs the limp body of a small brown antelope it has caught, its thin legs dangling in the air. The leopard opens its mouth in a wide yawn, then lays its head down beside the antelope and rests. Below the tree, tall dry golden grass stretches away to low hills on the horizon.
title: killer_7278

asset_description: An old stone harbour wall on a grey, windy day. A grinning young lad in navy swim shorts leaps off the edge of the wall into the air, arms out and legs bent, falls straight down and lands in the choppy green water with a big splash. He comes up, laughs and raises one arm. On the wall above, three other young lads in swim shorts watch and cheer, one holding his head in his hands, one holding up a bag of crisps. A football and trainers lie on the mossy stone steps, a rusty ladder runs down the wall and small fishing boats float in the harbour.
title: lad_7280

asset_description: A dark foundry lit by glowing metal. A young man in a shiny silver heat-proof suit, thick gloves and a raised face shield holds a long straight metal lance pushed into the tap hole at the bottom of a huge riveted furnace, and bright orange molten metal pours out into a channel at his feet. At first a fountain of white-hot sparks bursts from the top of the furnace, then it dies down to smoke while the metal keeps flowing and fills the channel. Another worker in a silver suit stands in the background.
title: lance_7281

asset_description: A tall old stairwell with a curving wooden handrail and a big arched window. On the wooden landing halfway up the stairs stands a black grand piano, and a young removal man in a grey T-shirt sits on a cardboard box and plays it while an orange cat walks along the piano. At the end he throws both arms up. His workmates rest on the steps below among moving blankets, one wakes up and claps, and another sits against the wall. Above, neighbours with coffee cups lean over the banisters of the upper floors and smile.
title: landing_7282

asset_description: A shabby small kitchen in a rented flat. Water drips into a saucepan on the tiled floor between two pairs of feet. The view rises to a bearded young man in a navy quilted jacket, checked shirt and chinos, holding a clipboard and a bunch of keys, who scratches his neck and winces up at a large brown water stain on the ceiling. Beside him a young woman in a black hoodie with long braids stands with her arms folded. Mould grows in the corners, mugs stand by the cooker and a calendar hangs on the wall.
title: landlord_7283

asset_description: A lakeside campsite at dusk, with dark pine forest and blue mountains behind the still water. A young woman in a cream knitted jumper, olive trousers and a head torch crouches by a ring of stones and carefully lays thin sticks upright in a cone over birch bark to build a campfire. She then sits back, takes a match from between her lips and holds it up with a smile. A chopping block with an axe and a pile of split logs stand beside her, a kettle and a frying pan sit on the stones, and a lantern glows by a canvas tent.
title: lay_7284

asset_description: A village fair on a grey day, under a marquee with bunting. A young man in a white chef's jacket and striped apron stands on a stepladder and pours a thick stream of cream from a big metal pot into a giant glass bowl, adding the top layer to a huge trifle. Through the glass the layers of sponge, fruit, jelly, custard and berries are stacked one above another. He then lifts the empty pot away and smiles. A crowd behind a rope watches and claps, a woman covers her face and a man steadies the ladder.
title: layer_7285

asset_description: An old university lecture hall seen from the back rows, lit by a tall window. A young woman lecturer with her hair in a bun, in a green dress and dark cardigan, stands at a long wooden demonstration bench with a sink and a wooden pointer and looks at a student who raises her hand. She then walks to the tall sliding blackboards covered in chalk and points at them. Rows of students with long hair sit at curved wooden desks taking notes in open notebooks, and a clock hangs above the door.
title: lecturer_7286

asset_description: A sparring match in a dim boxing gym strung with fairy lights. A young woman with two long braids, in a black sports top and black shorts, throws a straight punch with her left hand in a gold boxing glove at a young man in black wearing headgear, while her right hand stays up by her chin as a guard. She pulls back, throws another left and then smiles behind her gloves. A crowd of people stands behind the ropes watching, and heavy punch bags hang under the lamps in the background.
title: left_7287

asset_description: A narrow old-town street on a sunny festival day, with yellow houses, washing lines and coloured bunting. A smiling young man in a white shirt leans over a balcony railing and slowly lets down a wicker basket on a rope, with a fluffy ginger cat sitting inside it. On the cobbles below, a baker in a white apron reaches up with a long loaf of bread towards the basket. A brass band in white shirts plays in a big crowd under falling confetti, and neighbours look out of other windows.
title: let_down_7288

asset_description: A huge old library at night during a thunderstorm. Tall dark wooden bookshelves full of books rise up both walls to galleries with iron railings, and a rolling brass ladder stands by the shelves. A long reading table with green desk lamps runs down the left side. Through a tall Gothic window with a round rose window, bright lightning flashes outside. A white barn owl flies towards the viewer with spread wings as loose sheets of paper flutter down, and lands on top of the ladder, where it folds its wings and sits.
title: library_7290

asset_description: A tug of war at a muddy country show on a grey day. A stocky young man in a dirty grey work shirt and khaki trousers leans far back and pulls hard on a thick rope wound around his body, his face tight with effort, as dust and churned mud fly around his boots. His opponents slip and fall onto their knees and into the dirt. He stands up straight, raises both fists in the air and roars. A crowd of people behind a rope barrier claps and cheers, and a big canvas tent and cattle pens stand in the background.
title: lick_7291

asset_description: A close view of a young woman standing outside in falling snow at dusk. She has dark hair, a pink knitted scarf and a cream parka with a fur-trimmed hood, and she tilts her face up with both eyes closed. A single large white snowflake rests on her closed eyelid among the lashes, and smaller flakes sit in her hair. The snowflake melts away, she smiles, opens her eyes and laughs up at the sky. Behind her, snowy fir trees and an old street lamp glow softly out of focus in the blue evening light.
title: lid_7292

asset_description: An old black wood-burning stove stands with its door open in a dim cottage room. Inside, a small white firelighter cube burns under a pile of kindling sticks and split logs, and its flame grows taller and brighter as the sticks catch fire, with sparks and thin smoke rising. On the stone hearth in front lie an opened box of white firelighter cubes with crumbs around it, worn leather gloves and a small brush and dustpan. A basket of birch logs stands beside the stove under a window.
title: lighter_7293

asset_description: In a back garden in low golden evening light, a young woman with her hair in a bun, in a white top and denim shorts, crouches barefoot in a freshly dug pond hole covered with a big sheet of shiny black plastic lining. Water from a green hose spreads over the bottom while she smooths the lining with her hands, then moves forward on her knees towards the edge, where bricks lie on the lining. Four friends crouch around the rim watching, a dog peeks over the edge and a spade stands in the soil next to cut turf.
title: lining_7294

asset_description: On the icy deck of a red ship at night, with green northern lights in the sky and a big wave breaking behind, three workers in orange flotation suits, harnesses and black hats join two parts of a heavy rusty anchor chain. A bearded man raises a hammer and swings it down again and again onto a big shiny steel connecting link fitted between the rusty links, while the others hold the chain with metal bars and one heats it with a glowing torch. Frost and sea spray cover the deck and the winch.
title: link_7295

asset_description: Under a thatched palm roof at an outdoor distillery in warm late sun, a young woman with her dark hair tied back, in an olive shirt and a stained canvas apron, holds a round gourd high above her head and pours a thin stream of clear spirit into a small cup-shaped gourd in her other hand. Then she lowers the full cup, lifts it to her face and smells the foamy liquor with a serious look. Behind her stand a copper still with a coiled copper pipe, a glass jug, a wooden vat of mash and a man working.
title: liquor_7296

asset_description: In a small bedroom of a house at a zoo on a foggy morning, a young woman with curly hair pinned up, in blue striped pyjamas, brushes her teeth at the open window while a giraffe pokes its head in and licks her toothbrush with its long dark tongue. Then she steps back with the toothbrush in her hand and the giraffe lifts its head away, and she looks out of the window. Her zoo uniform shirt hangs on the wardrobe with a cat on top, boots stand by the bed, a hen walks on the floor and more giraffes stand outside.
title: live_in_7297

asset_description: In a bright lecture room during an anatomy class, a young woman medical student with long braids, in a white coat over blue scrubs, sits on a chair and holds a large reddish-brown model of a liver against the upper right side of her body. An older man in a jacket leans in and points at it with a pen, and her smile turns into a pained grimace. Behind them stand a white skeleton model and a half-open torso model showing the organs, next to a blackboard, and other students in white coats sit at desks taking notes.
title: liver_7298

asset_description: On a narrow village street at sunrise, a young woman with a long red braid, in a waxed jacket, jeans and green wellington boots, walks towards the viewer swinging a metal bucket and leading a crowd of farm animals down the wet road: black and white cows, pink pigs, sheep, goats, white geese and brown hens, with breath steaming in the cold. Parked cars and a milk van stand behind them, and people watch from the doorways of grey stone houses, one of them waving.
title: livestock_7299

asset_description: On a narrow mountain road on a sunny summer day, a rusty old flatbed truck carries a huge, top-heavy stack of hay bales tied with rope, piled far higher and wider than the truck itself. The truck stands at the edge of a low stone wall above a steep drop, and as the view moves around it, the load leans out over the drop and the front wheel hangs over the edge. A small stone roadside shrine with a wooden cross stands in the wildflowers in front, and green valleys and blue mountains stretch away behind.
title: loading_7300

asset_description: Inside an old country bus on a warm, hazy day, a sign above the windscreen lists the stops. The aisle is crowded with passengers and their things: a white goat on a rope, a tall wooden wardrobe, a shaggy dog lying on the floor, a bicycle leaning on a seat, baskets of vegetables and a net of lemons. A man in overalls pats the goat, then walks up the aisle and stands by the wardrobe, wiping his face. Young people in shorts and T-shirts sit in the seats on both sides, and a young woman sits at the front.
title: local_7301

asset_description: In a zoo yard at dusk, wet with rain and scattered with straw, a young man in a navy fleece, work trousers and green wellington boots stands at a heavy green wooden door in a stone wall and turns a big key in the lock under a glowing lamp. Then he steps back from the door and turns, surprised, towards a crowd of king penguins standing behind him. One king penguin stands right next to the door looking up, a few lie on their bellies, and a keeper with a wheelbarrow waits in the mist.
title: lock_the_door_7302

asset_description: In a farmhouse kitchen, a shaggy ginger Highland cow pushes its big head in over the lower half of a stable door and sticks out its pink tongue towards a young woman with a messy bun, in a cream cable-knit jumper, sitting at a wooden table. She turns her head sharply away with her eyes screwed shut, laughing, and holds up one hand to block the cow, while the cow keeps reaching for her with its tongue. Spilled oats lie on the table next to an enamel jug, and pots hang on the wall behind.
title: look_away_7304

asset_description: On a rainy city street at dusk, in front of a bakery window full of bread, a laughing young man in a white T-shirt, soaked with rain, holds his black jacket up over his head and over a smiling young woman in a camel coat to keep her dry. She holds a paper bakery bag and touches her wet hair, and the two walk along the shop front together under the striped awning, laughing. Behind them a red telephone box, people with umbrellas, a parked bicycle and street lamps line the wet pavement.
title: love_7308

asset_description: An old stone lighthouse stands on black rocks in a storm, under grey clouds with a gap of golden light on the horizon. On the railed balcony at the top, a young couple in matching yellow raincoats hold each other close and kiss, while a huge white wave crashes up against the tower below them and then falls back, leaving water pouring off the rocks. Inside the glass lantern room behind them, a man watches beside the glowing lamp. Seagulls fly around the tower over the rough sea.
title: lover_7310

asset_description: In a classic Parisian café with marble tables, bentwood chairs and a chalkboard menu, a young waiter in a white shirt, black waistcoat and bow tie politely helps a woman with long auburn hair take off her camel coat at the door. She wears a dark outfit and a patterned silk scarf and carries a straw basket with a leek sticking out. The waiter walks away holding the coat while she walks into the café and reaches for a chair at a table. Other waiters move past the bar.
title: madame_7311

asset_description: At a street newsstand on a wet city pavement in early morning light, a young man with dark hair, in a navy zip-up jacket, fingerless gloves and jeans, flips through a thick fanned-out stack of glossy magazines, then turns and holds the stack out to a customer whose hand reaches in from the right to take one. The kiosk behind him is packed with rows of colourful magazines, comics and sweets, a brass bell hangs from the roof and bundles of newspapers lie on the ground. A city bus passes behind.
title: magazine_7312

asset_description: At a summer village fête in a meadow near an old stone church tower, with bunting strung overhead, an older woman places a crown of white daisies and blue cornflowers on the long fair hair of a young woman in a navy dress standing at a wooden table covered in wildflowers and folded floral cloths. Then the young woman turns and walks away towards three other young women in flowery summer dresses, who sit holding their own flower crowns, while the older woman picks up more flowers. Villagers stand in the warm sun.
title: maiden_7313

asset_description: At night, at a long banquet table set in a red sandstone canyon under a starry sky, a smiling young chef in a white jacket and black apron and another chef carry a whole large fish baked in a crust of salt on a long wooden board. The chef holds a cleaver over the salt crust while flames flicker along the board among sprigs of herbs; then the flames die down and smoke rises. Behind him the table glows with rows of candles and lanterns, and the seated guests watch.
title: main_course_7314

asset_description: From a high rocky headland with pink sea flowers, the view looks over a northern bay at golden hour. A long line of brown horses splashes through the calm shallow water towards a sandy beach on the wide green mainland, the first horse reaching the sand at the end. Across the bay lie a pine forest and a small village at the foot of distant mountains, and small boats dot the glowing water under a low sun. A seal rests on the rocks below.
title: mainland_7315

asset_description: At an aid delivery in a valley under grey clouds, a large twin-rotor military helicopter stands on muddy grass with its rear ramp open and its rotors turning. In front, a young officer in camouflage uniform and cap directs the work with sweeping arm movements and finally a raised hand, while soldiers carry sacks of rice and cases of bottled water off the helicopter to a pickup truck. A split rice sack lies in the grass, villagers wait by the truck and houses stand on the hillside.
title: major_7316

asset_description: On a sunny street of terraced houses, a young woman in paint-splattered white overalls stands on scaffolding with a roller, covering her mouth in shock. The view pulls back to show that the whole house has been painted bright pink, even its chimney, while the grey house next door is untouched. Another painter in overalls stands by the gate below, a woman looks out of the door, and on the pavement a young man in a straw hat and neck pillow, with two suitcases, stares up at the pink house.
title: make_a_mistake_7319

asset_description: At night on a rooftop between tall apartment blocks, a young woman in a red slip dress, a black leather jacket, gold chains and chunky white trainers bangs a copper pot again and again with a big wooden spoon, shouting with her mouth wide open. Neighbours in bathrobes and pyjamas stand around her, some covering their ears, some laughing, one holding up pot lids. Pigeons fly up, string lights and a washing line hang overhead, and pans lie scattered on the ground.
title: make_noise_7321

asset_description: In a bright bedroom in the morning, a young woman in a long light-blue shirt and socks laughs as she flings a white sheet high into the air over a wooden bed, and a ginger cat leaps through the air under the billowing sheet. The sheet settles over the bed with the cat sitting on top, and she leans over the bed and smooths the sheet around the cat. A bearded man in a bathrobe stands in the doorway holding mugs and drinking, and a pillow lies on the floor by tall windows and potted plants.
title: make_the_bed_7323

asset_description: On a snowy office rooftop between tall glass towers, a young man in a white shirt, tie and sunglasses, trousers rolled up, leans back in a striped deckchair in the one narrow beam of sunshine, his bare feet in a small inflatable paddling pool, holding an ice cream cone and enjoying the sun. Colleagues in winter coats and scarves stand behind him laughing, some filming with their phones. A pigeon sits on the snowy ledge beside an air-conditioning unit.
title: make_the_most_of_7324

asset_description: At night on a beach under a full moon, a young woman with long curly hair, in a cream cable-knit sweater and denim shorts, stands behind a crackling campfire holding up a piece of driftwood, flinging her arms wide and leaning forward with her mouth open as she tells a dramatic story. Sparks fly into the dark. Friends listen around the fire: a young woman wrapped in a blanket stares wide-eyed, someone holds a marshmallow on a stick and a scruffy dog barks up at her. A guitar and an enamel mug lie in the sand.
title: make_up_7325

asset_description: In a snowy old market street, a large male red deer with huge branching antlers stands on top of a wooden fruit cart full of red apples, bellowing, while apples tumble over the icy cobblestones. A smaller female deer without antlers stands on the left. The male jumps down from the cart and walks straight towards the viewer among the scattered apples, bellowing again. Market stalls with torn striped awnings line the stone houses, and men in winter coats run behind with a barking dog.
title: male_7327

asset_description: On a wide gravel promenade in a park, lined on both sides by tall autumn plane trees and old lamp posts and leading to an ornate iron gate, a huge flock of sheep walks down the middle of the path towards the viewer, herded by a black-and-white collie and a man with a wooden staff. Joggers and walkers with coffee cups line the edges of the path, golden leaves drift down onto the sheep and the low sun shines through the trees.
title: mall_7328

asset_description: At night at a rainy football stadium under floodlights, a young player in a red shirt, red socks and white shorts stands at the edge of the pitch by the advertising boards while a woman in a clear rain poncho and red scarf leans over the barrier, hugs him tightly and kisses his cheek, and he laughs. His teammates in red jog towards them, a photographer kneels on the grass, a steward in a yellow jacket stands by the boards, and golden streamers fly over packed stands of cheering fans.
title: mama_7329

asset_description: In a bright bicycle factory with tall windows, a young woman in a navy cap, grey T-shirt, work apron and gloves steadies the wheel of a bicycle hanging from an overhead assembly line, then works on it with a cordless drill and finally turns to the steel workbench in front of her. On the bench lie trays of bolts, a bike chain, a stack of black tyres and a brown saddle. Other workers work at benches behind her and rows of finished bicycles stand in a rack on the right.
title: manufacture_7332

asset_description: In a sunlit woodworking workshop, a young woman with long wavy hair, in a dark hoodie and leather apron, crouches on the sawdust-covered floor and smiles up as a blank skateboard deck of pale, smooth maple wood falls from the air. She catches it, holds it across her knee and runs her hand along its smooth surface. Stacks of thin light wooden sheets lean against the wall, blank decks hang on a wall rack and a press, a band saw and a workbench stand around her. A dog sleeps under the bench.
title: maple_7334

asset_description: In a marina at sunrise, with rows of white motor yachts and sailing boats with tall masts moored along wooden jetties, a muscular man in sunglasses and a white bathrobe kneels on a big pink inflatable flamingo, paddling with a wooden oar and balancing a tray of coffee cups and pastries. A small dog watches from the jetty, a couple in bathrobes stand on the jetty and an older man leans from the bow of a boat. Ripples spread on the calm golden water.
title: marina_7336

asset_description: On a misty green clifftop by the sea, a young woman in an orange rain jacket and a knitted orange headband kneels in the long grass and uses small pliers to fix a little tag onto the leg of a puffin she holds, while another puffin stands on top of her head. Then she stands up and throws the tagged puffin into the air, and it flies away over the cliff as the puffin on her head flaps its wings. An open tin of orange tags lies in the grass and a colleague in an orange jacket with a clipboard laughs.
title: mark_7337

asset_description: In a flat, wet marsh at sunset, a young woman in a black long-sleeved wetsuit kneels on a paddle board and paddles along a narrow channel of still water between tall green and golden grasses, right through a flock of pink flamingos that wade and take off around her. More flamingos fly across the pink sky. A white horse grazes in the grassland, a wooden bird-watching tower stands on the horizon and the board is reflected in the water.
title: marsh_7338

asset_description: Close up under the white wooden eave of an old building, small birds with glossy dark blue backs, white bellies, long pointed wings and forked tails fly around a cup-shaped mud nest. One bird hovers in front of the nest with an insect in its beak, lands at the nest and pushes its head inside, then flies off again, while other birds swoop past. A few loose white feathers drift in the air, the light is soft and golden, and a blurred field lies in the background.
title: martin_7339

asset_description: On the high outer bridge of a cargo ship in a container port at dusk, a young woman officer with a blonde braid, in a navy uniform, leans over the rail pointing down and speaking into a walkie-talkie as she guides a red tugboat below. Behind her an older bearded captain in a white peaked cap watches calmly. Crew members in overalls handle ropes on the deck, a thermos flask and binoculars sit on the ledge, and cranes and stacked containers line the quay.
title: mate_7340

asset_description: In a dim art gallery, a tall wooden stand holds a thin, stretched, milky plastic sheet, lit from behind by a spotlight. A young woman with long platinum hair, in a long black dress, presses against the sheet from behind with her palms raised and her eyes closed, and pushes her face further into it, so that the thin sheet stretches and wrinkles around her hands and face. At the left a young man in the shadows covers his mouth in surprise. A floor light and coiled cables lie nearby.
title: membrane_7342

asset_description: On a busy city street between glass skyscrapers, a young woman bike courier in a sticker-covered helmet, a dark T-shirt, jeans and a messenger bag stops on her bicycle and hands a yellow envelope to a young man in a grey suit by a revolving door. He takes it and walks into the building, while she rides off along the pavement towards the viewer. A yellow taxi passes, steam rises from a street grate, pigeons peck on the pavement and office workers walk by.
title: messenger_7344

asset_description: On a snowy race track in the mountains, a young man in a red jacket over a white top, black ski trousers and sunglasses is pulled along on short skis by a rope tied around the middle of his body, at his waist, fastened to the harness of a brown horse galloping beside him. He laughs and shouts with his arms spread wide, wobbles and spreads them again. Spectators stand behind a rope line, another rider follows on a horse, and snowy pine trees and a wooden cabin with a smoking chimney fill the background.
title: middle_7345

asset_description: A tall old stone mill building stands beside a river in evening light, with a big wooden waterwheel turning under rushing white water at its base. A young red-haired woman swings out from an upper doorway on a rope, sitting on a sack and laughing, and swings down over the waterwheel, while a cloud of white flour bursts from the loft door above her. Two men lean out of the doorway reaching towards her, a horse and cart stand on the left and birds fly over the roof.
title: mill_7347

asset_description: Inside an old windmill lit by oil lanterns, a young woman covered in white flour dust, in work clothes and boots, hangs from a thick rope above a wooden case holding two large round millstones and slides down it to the stone floor. A huge wooden cogwheel sits under the roof beams. A young man climbs a ladder and a woman at a shutter looks on, flour pours from a wooden chute into a sack, and full sacks stand on the floor.
title: miller_7348

asset_description: In the gravel courtyard of a large stone villa among vineyard hills, a man with slicked-back hair, an open cream silk shirt, gold chains, black trousers and loafers strides across a white towel laid over a puddle and keeps walking towards the viewer. Four young women in white blouses and black trousers follow him in a line, carrying expensive leather handbags, one holding a small dachshund in a bag. Classic silver sports cars are parked by a stone fountain, and tall cypress trees stand by the courtyard.
title: millionaire_7349

asset_description: A rainy outdoor fashion show on an airport apron at dusk. A young woman with short natural hair walks towards the camera down the wet runway in a black turtleneck, a very short flared orange skirt, black tights, knee-high black boots and a long black coat that swings as she moves. Guests sit on both sides, some under umbrellas, a large passenger plane stands behind them, floodlights and a lighting rig glow, confetti blows in the wind and a worker in a high-visibility jacket runs across under stormy orange clouds.
title: mini_7352

asset_description: A small mountain railway station in falling snow at dusk. A young woman in a blue ski suit, a padded vest, a knitted hat and ski boots runs through the snow along the platform with skis and a pole in her arms, reaching out towards a red and cream train that keeps moving beside her. A conductor in a cap leans out of the open door and stretches out his hand, friends in ski gear wave from a window, and a porter with a luggage trolley stands by the lit wooden station hut.
title: miss_7359

asset_description: A sunny country kitchen. A big silver stand mixer whips chocolate batter and cream in its large steel mixing bowl so fast that batter splashes out and flour hangs in the air. A beagle at the counter edge jumps up, catches a flying splash of cream in its mouth and then licks its lips. Broken eggshells and a raw yolk lie on the floury wooden counter with a wooden spoon, a pile of sugar, a kitchen timer and muffins on a cooling rack, an open recipe book stands behind the mixer and copper pans hang on the wall.
title: mixing_bowl_7362

asset_description: A rocky mountain summit under a deep blue sky. A young woman in a yellow jacket, black trousers and hiking boots climbs onto a boulder, stretches up and holds a mobile phone high in the air, first with one hand and then with both, her ponytail blowing sideways. A young man sits on the rocks below, laughing and eating a sandwich. A stone cairn, a backpack, trekking poles and a paper map lie on the rocks, two black birds fly past and hazy ridges stretch to the horizon.
title: mobile_phone_7363

asset_description: A bright white gallery with a glass roof. A young man with curly hair in a paint-stained T-shirt and grey trousers stands on a stepladder and blows at a large red disc of a big hanging sculpture of thin black wires with red, yellow, black and white discs. The sculpture starts to turn slowly in the air while he raises his hands and watches it with a smile. A young woman in black holds the ladder and looks up, and two visitors watch from a balcony above.
title: mobile_7364

asset_description: A bright car design studio. A young woman in a grey clay-stained work coat, with a smudge on her cheek, pulls a toothed tool along the side of a full-size clay car, and a long curl of brown clay peels off and falls. In the foreground a small clay model of the same car stands on a round metal turntable, and clay shavings cover the floor. A young man shapes clay at a trolley on the left, a photographer takes pictures in the background and long ceiling lights shine overhead.
title: model_7365

asset_description: A cosy living room in the evening. A young woman with dark curly hair in a cream knit sweater leans close to a lit aquarium and purses her lips like a fish. A black fish with a large sail-like fin and tail swims up to the glass until it is face to face with her. Smaller silver-white fish swim among green plants and driftwood, and food flakes float at the surface. A fish net and a tub of fish food lie on the cabinet, and a cat sleeps on the sofa behind her.
title: molly_7367

asset_description: A warm hallway on a snowy night. A middle-aged woman in a burgundy cardigan and slippers holds a young man's face and kisses his cheek as he comes in through the open front door in a green parka, laughing. He drops his big canvas bag, they hug tightly and he lifts her a little off the floor, then she kisses his cheek again. A golden retriever jumps up at them, snow falls outside, a wooden sledge and scarves hang on the wall and a kitchen glows at the back.
title: mommy_7368

asset_description: A calm, glassy fjord at dawn seen from above. A young woman in a black wetsuit stands on a paddle board and paddles in a wide curve around a large humpback whale lying at the surface right next to her, while its misty spout rises into the air. Further out another whale lifts its tail above the water, and a small boat with people in orange jackets watches. Pieces of floating ice drift on the water and snowy mountains are reflected in the still surface.
title: move_around_7369

asset_description: Sea kayaking in front of a glacier under a grey sky. A young man in a red helmet, a yellow jacket and a life vest faces the camera and paddles hard away from the glacier in a white sea kayak, his face strained, as a huge wall of blue ice breaks off behind him and crashes into the sea in a cloud of spray. Other kayakers in bright jackets sit in their kayaks further back, chunks of ice float on the choppy grey sea around him and seabirds circle overhead.
title: move_back_7370

asset_description: A wooden treehouse in a rainforest during a rain shower. A young woman in a tank top, shorts and hiking boots stands on the small porch by the open door and pulls up a net bundle on a rope holding a cardboard box, a rolled sleeping mat, a potted plant and a bag, then lifts it onto the porch and turns towards the door. A monkey sits on the corrugated metal roof next to a lantern. A man on a platform below holds the other end of the rope, and huge tropical leaves surround the cabin.
title: move_in_7372

asset_description: Dusk at a narrow stone canal lock. A huge white cruise ship eases slowly forward into the lock, its bow only just fitting between the walls and pressing big black fenders against the sides while water churns at the hull. Crowds on the quay wave and take photos, workers in high-visibility jackets walk along the edge, passengers line the lit decks and strings of lights run up to the mast. A small stone lock-keeper's house with a lit window stands by the dark water.
title: move_into_7373

asset_description: Bright blue sea under water. A young woman in a black wetsuit, mask and long black fins swims forward through a clear tunnel that opens in the middle of a huge swirling school of small silver fish. Dolphins and sea lions glide along the edges of the shoal and cross the tunnel near her, trails of bubbles rise towards the surface, and the hull of a small boat floats on the sunlit surface high above. Rays of light shine down through the water.
title: move_through_7376

asset_description: A busy restaurant kitchen with white tiled walls and copper pans. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey trousers climbs a black iron spiral staircase and reaches up for a white chef's jacket that an older chef holds out to him from the gallery above. Cooks in white jackets and aprons cheer and push him upwards from below, and more cooks on the balcony throw tea towels into the air and clap. Steam rises from large steel pots on the stove.
title: move_up_7377

asset_description: A wood-panelled courtroom in grey daylight. A middle-aged man in a navy suit and white shirt stands in the wooden dock behind a brass rail with a cold, blank face, his wrists in handcuffs, while a uniformed officer holds his arm. The view moves slowly closer to him. Behind him a woman in black bends over and cries into a dark coat. A woman lawyer in front lays her hand on a thick file next to a water jug, and rows of serious people watch under tall windows.
title: murderer_7378

asset_description: Inside a wooden barn at night, lit by old oil lanterns. A young man in a checked shirt, grey vest, braces and rolled trousers stands barefoot in front of the open barn door with his arms spread wide, telling a story. He leans forward with a wild face and then jumps up with both hands high in the air. A group of young friends sit on hay bales around him with mugs and plates, staring at him with open mouths, and a shaggy grey dog sits at his feet.
title: narrator_7379

asset_description: A snowy reindeer corral at pink winter dawn. A young woman with long fair braids, a dark blue knitted hat with a red patterned band, a black snowsuit and fur-trimmed boots strides through the snow and pulls a large reindeer along by a rope lasso. Many more reindeer with big antlers crowd behind her inside a wooden fence. Behind them stand a cone-shaped canvas tent with a fire glowing inside, a snowmobile, a person in orange and a line of bare birch trees.
title: native_7381

asset_description: A frozen lake at dusk in winter. A young woman in a red parka and red snow trousers kneels on the dark clear ice and screams with laughter as a flame from a small hole in the ice grows into a tall orange column of fire. White frozen gas bubbles are trapped in stacks inside the ice all around. Behind her two people in dark winter coats take photos, and a metal gas cylinder, a snowmobile and small wooden cabins stand along the snowy shore by the trees.
title: natural_gas_7382

asset_description: A messy hotel room the morning after a party, with sunlight coming through white curtains. A young woman with red hair, a gold sequin dress and smudged make-up lies on the carpet and stretches her arm out towards a glass of water on a low table, grabs it and rolls onto her side holding it. A paper party hat lies next to her. Confetti, playing cards, banknotes, silver trays and bottles cover the floor, and a man in a white shirt and tie sleeps on the sofa behind her.
title: need_7383

asset_description: A wet street outside an old red-brick prison with towers and a huge arched wooden gate. A young man in a black bomber jacket, grey hoodie and black trousers walks out of the small open door carrying a plastic bag of belongings, shading his eyes against the daylight, then smiles. A uniformed guard stands in the doorway behind him. A friend in a dark jacket runs up the street from a parked car, and the two men hug tightly on the pavement.
title: nick_7386

asset_description: A long family lunch outdoors under a vine-covered pergola by an old stone house on a sunny day. A bald older man in a light blue shirt leans over and pulls a coin from behind the ear of a young woman in a green sundress, who covers her eyes and laughs, holding a fork with a peach slice. He holds up the coin and she points at it, laughing. A grey-haired woman next to her laughs too. The linen table is full of grilled vegetables, peaches, bread and water carafes.
title: niece_7387

asset_description: A roof being built high above an old town at sunset. A bearded carpenter in a white helmet, white shirt, black waistcoat and safety harness stands on a huge square beam of pale solid oak that hangs from a crane hook, and swings an axe into it so wood chips fly. The cut end shows its tree rings clearly. The beam then comes to rest on a wooden post. Below him young apprentices in black hold wooden mallets on the scaffolding next to rows of new rafters, and a church spire rises behind.
title: oak_7389

asset_description: A bright carpentry workshop seen from above. A young man in a grey long-sleeved top and a canvas apron rubs oil into a long pale wooden table with a cloth. One strip of the table is already dark, glossy and golden with oil. A ginger cat walks across the dry part of the table, lies down near its edge and then gets off the table, and the man looks up and grins. An open tin stands in a small puddle of oil next to a pair of cotton gloves, and another man works on a chair behind.
title: oil_7392

asset_description: A sunny olive grove. A young woman with long dark hair, a rust-coloured sleeveless top and a long cream skirt stands barefoot on a wooden crate and pours a thin golden-green stream of olive oil from a clay jug held high above her head. The oil lands on a round crusty loaf held up by a young man in a white linen shirt. She lowers the jug and he lifts the oily loaf to his face and smells it. Olives lie on a net on the ground, a donkey stands behind and pickers work among the trees.
title: olive_oil_7393

asset_description: A harbour on a foggy blue morning. A young woman in navy work overalls, gloves, boots and a knitted hat throws her whole weight against a long iron lever on the cobbled quay and pulls it down from upright to flat, smiling. The two halves of an old wooden drawbridge stand raised in the air, and a tall sailing ship slides through the gap. Behind a red and white barrier, cyclists, a bus, cars and people in hi-vis vests wait under lit street lamps.
title: open_up_7394

asset_description: The sea between two towering dark cliffs. A young woman in a white helmet and navy jacket paddles a bright red kayak through the narrow gap between the rock walls and comes out towards the camera, smiling with excitement as white water foams around her. Grey seals lie on the rocks on both sides and watch her. Behind her another kayaker in yellow waits in the open water, and a lighthouse stands on a far headland in the hazy backlight.
title: opening_7395

asset_description: An abandoned funfair at dusk. An old merry-go-round lit up with hundreds of warm bulbs turns in a haze of mist, its painted wooden horses going round, although weeds and long grass grow all around it. A fox stands in the grass and watches, and the lights reflect in a rippled puddle on the cracked concrete. Behind it stand a broken ticket booth covered in ivy and a big Ferris wheel under a cloudy blue evening sky.
title: operate_7396

asset_description: A record pressing factory. A young woman in a navy work coat and white cotton gloves lifts a large metal tape reel high above her head and looks up at it, then lowers it and holds it in front of her, looking at it and speaking, while a big crowd of workers watches from the back of the hall. Beside her a young man in ear defenders works a pressing machine. Black vinyl records run along a conveyor, tall stacks of white sleeves stand nearby, and an open tape case lies on a trolley.
title: original_7398

asset_description: A snowy mountain summit ridge at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds. A male climber in a red and black down suit, his beard covered in frost, kneels in the snow and breathes through a mask that a young woman in a yellow hooded down suit holds to his face, connected to an orange gas cylinder. Steam comes from the mask, then he stands up with the cylinder while she stays kneeling. A second orange cylinder lies in the snow, and other climbers walk up the slope below.
title: oxygen_7401

asset_description: Inside a camper van parked in the desert. A young woman with her hair in a bun, a beige T-shirt and a head torch holds a small torch in her mouth and quickly stuffs a grey towel into a big backpack with a water bottle in its side pocket, then closes it, swings it onto her shoulder and stands up. A rolled sleeping mat lies next to her. A black and white dog comes in through the side door carrying a hiking boot, while outside a huge wall of sand blows closer.
title: pack_a_bag_7402

asset_description: A sunny beach road. A young man in sunglasses, a linen shirt and shorts leans with one leg stretched out and pushes hard with both hands to slide shut the door of a pale blue vintage van crammed full with things and a pink inflatable flamingo. Surfboards, bags and folding chairs are piled high on the roof rack. The door closes and he stands up. On the sand three friends cheer with their arms up, one sitting on a cooler, and a beach ball, frisbee and towel lie on the road.
title: pack_7403

asset_description: Looking up a narrow old street between tall ochre and pink houses with green wooden shutters and small iron balconies. A washing line stretched across the street holds a long row of women's underpants in soft pastel colours, lilac, pink, blue, mint, white and yellow, each pinned with pegs and swaying in the wind as they dry in the sun. The sky is pale and clear, and more houses continue down the lane.
title: pants_7406

asset_description: A railway platform at night in the rain. A young woman with long dark hair in a camel coat and brown boots jumps into the arms of a man with glasses, a flat cap and a quilted navy jacket, and he lifts her and swings her round, both laughing. He sets her down, they hug and she touches his face. His suitcase stands next to them and a cloth bag lies on the ground with oranges and books. A smiling conductor leans out of the train door, and travellers with bags walk past.
title: papa_7407

asset_description: Inside a warm, old-fashioned bar. A man with short brown hair and a cream linen shirt lifts a bulldog in a striped knitted jumper from the bar edge and sets it down carefully on a round wooden bar stool, where it stands calmly. He lets go, steps back and gestures towards the dog. A newspaper and a set of keys lie on the marble counter beside a brass rail. Shelves of bottles glow behind the bar, a bartender works in the background, and other customers talk further along.
title: park_7408

asset_description: In front of a huge blue-white glacier wall. A woman with a knitted headband, a red jacket, leather work gloves and a climbing harness lifts a large chunk of clear blue ice broken off from the glacier up in front of her face, turns it, then lowers it to her chest and looks at the camera. The block is full of tiny air bubbles and drips water. Her breath steams in the cold air, and small floating pieces of ice and a black gravel shore lie behind her in bright sunlight.
title: part_7409

asset_description: A cold outdoor swimming race on a grassy riverbank. A young man in a black sleeveless swim top and shorts stands barefoot, pulls on a printed swim cap and goggles, then walks past a rope and steps into the brown river. A young woman beside him adjusts her goggles. A marshal in a yellow hi-vis vest holds up a clipboard next to a chalkboard of numbers, a crowd in winter coats stands behind a rope near piles of clothes and shoes, and a line of orange buoys floats on the water.
title: participant_7410

asset_description: A wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. An older judge in a black robe reads a paper at the high bench under a green lamp. At the tables in front, a young woman in a navy suit covers her mouth in shock while the woman beside her puts a hand on her back, then she stands up and turns to lean over the table towards that woman. On the other side a man in a grey suit holds his head in both hands. A clerk types on a laptop, files lie on the tables, and people watch from the benches.
title: party_7411

asset_description: A snowy mountain road under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a red puffer jacket and snow boots throws her fist in the air, shouts with joy and jumps next to a small white car with a red L sign on its roof, then leans in at the driver's window. Inside, a young man with glasses smiles from the driver's seat and holds up a clipboard with a big green tick. A man in an orange vest watches from a truck window, an orange snowplough waits behind, and a line of cars comes down the road.
title: pass_an_exam_7412

asset_description: A small, simple dockside cafe on a grey morning. A woman behind the counter pours tea from one white enamel mug into another next to a steel water urn, while bacon sizzles and steams on a griddle behind her. A bearded man in a brown work jacket and a yellow hi-vis vest steps up to the counter, picks up a pen and leans over a newspaper crossword. Mugs hang on hooks under a price board, another worker in a beanie waits behind, and cranes stand outside the window.
title: patron_7415

asset_description: A misty sea cliff covered in pink sea thrift flowers. A young woman with a long black braid, an olive waxed jacket and rubber boots stands on the narrow path holding a wicker basket and reaches up to touch the nose of a huge grey-green dragon. The dragon's horned, scaly head leans out of a cave in the cliff face, lowers and rubs gently against her cheek while she laughs with her eyes closed. A wooden walking stick lies on the path, and rocky islands sit in the grey sea below.
title: pay_a_visit_7416

asset_description: Inside a busy old-style Italian restaurant with copper pans hanging from the ceiling, a young woman in a cream silk blouse grips a huge wooden pepper mill with both hands and grinds black pepper onto a plate of pasta on a red checked tablecloth. She straightens up and lifts the mill higher and higher above her head while she keeps grinding. The young man next to her laughs and then hides his face in his hand. A waiter behind them holds another wooden pepper mill and raises his eyebrows. A water carafe and a bread basket stand on the table.
title: pepper_7419

asset_description: On a windy green hilltop under dark storm clouds, a young woman with red hair in a long dark green dress stands barefoot and points firmly across the field while her dress blows in the wind. A black and white sheepdog drives a small group of white sheep through an open wooden gate towards the front. The sheep run past and out of sight, and the dog crouches low on the muddy grass by the gate. A quad bike, a white canvas tent and fallen metal hurdles stand on the grass behind her.
title: perform_7420

asset_description: In a small tavern with white walls, old posters and hams hanging from a beam, a male flamenco dancer with long dark hair, a short black jacket, black trousers and heeled boots dances on a wooden stage under a spotlight. He stamps his boot so that dust flies up from the boards, then turns, swings his arms and spins with one arm raised high. A guitarist plays behind him, and the audience at small round tables with candles and wine glasses claps and cheers with open mouths.
title: performer_7421

asset_description: In an old stone barn at dusk, lit by lanterns, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper, a leather apron and green rubber boots laughs as she pulls open the wooden tap of a big barrel. A pale golden, fizzy drink gushes out in a thick stream into a wooden tub, which fills with froth and overflows onto the floor. Crates of green pears stand nearby and bunches of pears hang from the beams. Friends at the open door to the orchard cheer, and a dog lies on the floor.
title: perry_7422

asset_description: At an oil field in a dry, sunny desert, thick, shiny black crude oil pours from the valve of an old rusty red wellhead into a metal bucket. The bucket is full and overflows, and the oil runs down its sides. The black puddle with a rainbow sheen around the bucket spreads wider and wider across the cracked pale ground. A coiled hose and a pair of oily black gloves lie nearby, and in the background a pump jack, storage tanks and a whirl of dust stand in the haze.
title: petroleum_7425

asset_description: In an empty old factory hall with tall arched windows, warm sunbeams shine through the dusty air. A young woman with long dark hair, a denim shirt, cream trousers and white trainers smiles with her eyes closed and her arms spread out, then turns slowly in a full circle on the dusty floor and faces the front again, still smiling. A young man in a jacket leans in the doorway and watches her. Rubble, wooden pallets and a rusty wheelbarrow lie around the hall.
title: picture_7427

asset_description: In a dusty desert canyon with striped red and cream cliffs, a young woman with a long braid, a bandana on her head and another around her neck, a khaki vest and work gloves leans over a huge fallen log of petrified wood and presses her hands on a broken piece of it. The stone shines inside in deep red, yellow and purple. The wind blows dust, and a hat flies through the air. Her colleagues shield their eyes and watch, and a tripod and a pickup truck stand behind.
title: piece_7428

asset_description: On a windy sandy beach under a blue sky with white clouds, a young woman in a white linen shirt kneels on all fours on a red and white striped beach shelter and holds it down with her hands and knees, laughing. The wind lifts the shelter higher and higher, and she ends up lying flat on it. Loose metal tent pegs lie in the sand in front of her. Behind her a young man and woman in swimwear run and chase a flying yellow towel and a straw hat near the turquoise sea.
title: pin_7429

asset_description: In a busy indoor fish market under a high iron roof, a young woman with a ponytail, a white T-shirt, a black waterproof apron and yellow rubber boots tosses a whole silver salmon high into the air with one hand. The salmon flies up and across the market, and a man further back catches it. Behind her another fishmonger raises both hands. White boxes of fish and mussels on ice fill the front, a tabby cat sits on a stack of crates, and older shoppers in winter coats watch.
title: pitch_7430

asset_description: At a baseball game in a thunderstorm at night, a young woman in a muddy pinstriped uniform slides head first through a brown puddle and reaches for home plate, a white five-sided slab lying in the mud. Mud splashes around her as she lands on the plate, and she lifts her head and screams with joy. A catcher in a helmet reaches out with a glove, and an umpire in navy spreads his arms wide behind them. Floodlights shine through the rain, lightning flashes, and a crowd fills the stand.
title: plate_7434

asset_description: In an elegant sitting room at night with a big stone fireplace, a young man in a black dinner suit crouches on the stone floor and pushes a long metal poker into the fire. A huge burst of flame and orange sparks shoots up. He stands up and walks away from the fireplace, holding the poker with its tip still burning. Behind him guests in evening dresses and dinner jackets sit on sofas and watch. Logs, a hearth brush, tongs and a coal bucket lie on the floor.
title: poker_7439

asset_description: On a snowy Arctic plain at golden hour, a big white polar bear stands up on its hind legs beside a large white tundra bus with huge tyres and rests its front paws on the side under a window. Inside, a young woman in a cream knitted hat presses her hands to the glass and gasps. The bear drops down onto all four paws and walks along the bus through the snow. Other passengers look out of the windows, one covering her mouth, and a second polar bear stands in the snow in the distance.
title: polar_bear_7440

asset_description: A herd of horses runs through a shallow river in a red desert canyon. At the front a laughing young woman with a long black braid, in a denim shirt and jeans, rides barefoot and bareback on a buckskin horse straight towards the front, water splashing up around its legs. Dozens of brown, grey and white horses gallop behind her, kicking up dust and water in the golden evening light. People stand at a wooden corral fence in the background under a huge sandstone rock.
title: pony_7442

asset_description: Inside a home garage in the evening, with the roller door open, a young woman with her hair in a messy bun, a white vest and oil-stained overalls lies on a low wheeled board under an old motorbike. She rolls out from under it, sits up under a work lamp and holds up a small part, smiling. An older man with grey hair and a moustache in a checked shirt leans down into view beside her and looks at the part. Tools hang on a wall board and a black tool chest stands behind.
title: pop_7444

asset_description: At a muddy music festival at sunset, a young woman with red braids, in a denim jacket, a floral dress and rubber boots, steps away from a makeshift toilet with her arms flung up in triumph and a pained face. Then she turns, bends her knees and pulls a pained face again. The white toilet stands behind her between hay bales and a shower curtain, with a roll of paper on a stick. A line of laughing young people in boots waits and watches, and tents and flags fill the field behind.
title: pot_7449
