asset_description: In a pottery workshop in an old wooden barn, a woman with her hair tied back, in an apron over a denim dress, sits at a spinning wheel and shapes a tall grey clay vase with wet, clay-covered hands. The view starts very close on her hands inside the vase and moves back until the whole workshop is visible. Beside the wheel are a bucket, a sponge and small tools. Behind her another person works at a second wheel, shelves hold rows of pots and an orange kiln glows by the sunlit barn door.
title: potter_7450

asset_description: At a busy street food market at night, a young woman in a black vest top, a patterned bandana and a brown apron stands at a steel counter and tosses noodles, prawns and spring onions in a black wok over a gas burner. A tall burst of orange flame and steam shoots up into the dark blue sky, then new flames flare up from the wok as she keeps tossing. Bowls of chopped green onion and red chilli stand in front of her, and a crowd under strings of light bulbs watches behind her.
title: prepare_7453

asset_description: On a high mountain pass in a snowstorm, a man in a black cycling helmet and black kit rides a racing bike up a snow-covered road towards the front, his face set and his breath steaming, snowflakes stuck to his clothes. He keeps pedalling hard and comes closer. Behind him a group of cyclists wrapped in silver foil blankets stand outside a small stone hut and watch, and a marmot sits on a rock by the road. Dark clouds and rays of light cover the snowy peaks behind.
title: press_on_7454

asset_description: On a canal towpath on a misty morning, with an old brick bridge arching over the water, a laughing young man in a checked flannel shirt, a grey hoodie, work trousers and boots leans forward and hauls a green narrowboat along the bank with a thick rope over his shoulder. The boat moves slowly forward. Three young men in winter jackets sit on the boat roof, one raising a mug and cheering. A grey heron stands on the far bank, and a coil of rope and an iron winch lie on the path.
title: pull_7472

asset_description: On a frosty village street on a cold winter morning, with stone cottages behind, a young woman in a knitted hat and a navy quilted jacket pushes down the long curved iron handle of an old cast-iron hand pump. A strong stream of water gushes from its spout into a metal bucket, fills it and splashes over the cobbles. A queue of villagers with buckets, metal milk churns and a wheelbarrow waits behind her, and a golden-brown dog drinks from the stone trough.
title: pump_7473

asset_description: By a stone fountain in a sunny town square, a smiling young man with black hair, in a cream knitted jumper and a chain necklace, holds a wooden cross of strings and makes a painted wooden puppet boy in a striped suit dance on the fountain's rim. The puppet kicks up a leg, bows towards a grey pigeon standing next to crumbs, and reaches a hand out to it while the pigeon stares at the puppet. Water sprays from the fountain, and friends and an old man watch and laugh.
title: puppet_7476

asset_description: In a sunny old country kitchen, a plump tabby cat with a white chest and a brown leather collar with a small bell lies stretched out on a peeling white windowsill with one front paw hanging over the edge. The cat gets up, walks along the sill past a green potted plant and sits upright, looking out of the window. Tea towels and a jar of wooden spoons hang behind it, and a basket of onions, a ball of grey wool and a saucer of milk sit on the stone floor by a wooden table.
title: pussy_7478

asset_description: In a bank vault in a basement corridor lit by harsh white and red light, a man in a black uniform shirt and trousers braces his legs and pushes a huge round steel vault door shut, gripping its spoked wheel handle with both hands. At first metal shelves inside hold a sparkling diamond and small boxes, then the heavy door swings closed over them. Security guards in dark uniforms stand at the end of the corridor at first, next to a steel trolley at the foot of a staircase.
title: put_away_7480

asset_description: In a flooded museum hall with a leaking glass roof, where rain pours down in a stream, two monkeys in small aprons and white gloves stand on a stone pedestal and guide an ancient clay jar, hanging in a rope sling from a beam, back down onto its place until it stands on the pedestal. Another monkey climbs the rope above, one on a wooden crate holds a board and a lit torch, and one sits in the water on the marble floor. Glass cases, a stepladder, a fallen bust and coils of rope fill the hall.
title: put_back_7481

asset_description: At a town square festival at sunset with bunting and balloons, a young woman in a safety harness leans out from a raised metal lift platform and gently lowers one long wooden block onto the very top of a giant stacking-block tower much taller than a person, with sawdust puffing out. She lets go, pulls back her hands and holds on to the railing, staring at the tower. A bald man in the platform watches, and below a large crowd stands tense, many with their hands at their faces.
title: put_down_7482

asset_description: On a grass airstrip in a mountain valley in bright afternoon light, with snowy peaks and a glacier behind, a small cream and dark red single-engine plane with its propeller spinning comes in low and touches down on the grass. Its big fat wheels hit the ground and throw up bits of grass as it rolls past a windsock on a pole standing in an old tyre. The pilot sits in the cockpit, and a flock of sheep grazes in the field behind the plane.
title: put_down_7483

asset_description: On a honeycomb in sunlight, a larger bee with a long, shiny orange-and-brown striped body stands over the wax cells, clearly bigger than all the others. A small white egg sits at the tip of her body over an empty cell. She moves slowly across the comb while a crowd of smaller worker bees with hairy brown bodies and clear wings walks around her, many facing her and touching her with their antennae. Further down, the cells glisten with golden honey.
title: queen_7488

asset_description: From under a tin roof during a heavy tropical downpour, thick streams of rain pour off the roof edge and pound onto a muddy street full of brown puddles. Water gushes from a pipe and splashes onto the muddy ground right beside an old rusty oil drum. The rain keeps falling across the street, where bicycles lean against a wall under a sagging cloth awning, stacked plastic crates are covered with plastic sheeting, and banana trees stand in the grey mist.
title: rainfall_7492

asset_description: Inside a small boxing hall packed with spectators on wooden benches, two young boxers in white vests, one with brown gloves and one with black gloves, stand face to face. A referee in a white shirt, black bow tie and black trousers stands between them, pushes them apart with both hands, and they move out of sight. He stands alone in the middle of the ring with both arms stretched straight out to the sides and looks around sternly. White ropes run across the ring, and lamps hang over the crowd.
title: referee_7502

asset_description: At a sailing race on a rough grey sea with white-capped waves, a racing yacht heels hard as it turns tightly around a huge orange inflatable buoy, passing right beside it. A young woman in a red sailing jacket and black waterproof trousers leans out over the edge of the deck holding a rope, with more crew in red behind her. The yacht sweeps past the buoy, and spray bursts up along its side. Other yachts with white sails race in the distance.
title: round_7529

asset_description: In warm morning light, a man in a round helmet with goggles, sunglasses and a brown leather jacket rides a motorbike with a sidecar away from a stone cottage down a gravel lane. He looks back and smiles, then waves a gloved hand as dust sprays from the back wheel. A rolled green sleeping bag with a map is strapped behind him, and a shaggy grey-and-white dog sits in the sidecar. At the garden gate an older woman, young women and a man wave goodbye and cheer.
title: set_off_7563

asset_description: A scene from the Ice Age, seen from inside a rocky cave mouth. A young woman and a young man in thick fur clothes and fur boots walk through deep snow towards the front, pulling a wooden sledge loaded with sticks, and the man smiles. A woolly mammoth with long curved tusks stomps along the frozen river behind them. A fire burns in the cave, an animal hide is stretched on a wooden rack, a hide tent stands on the shore, and huge blue glaciers rise under a cloudy golden sky.
title: age_7738

asset_description: In an animated vaulted brick cheese cellar lit by a hanging lantern, three mice in aprons look after rows of big round cheese wheels stored on long wooden shelves. One mouse in a flat cap pushes a heavy old wheel with a rough crust along a shelf, another in a green waistcoat stands on the shelf above, and a third climbs up a ladder holding a brush and steps onto the shelf. A wooden bucket stands on the stone floor and snow lies against the small barred window.
title: aging_7739

asset_description: On a farm field at sunset, a big green tractor pulls a plough through the stubble, raising a cloud of dust and turning the soil into dark furrows. A young woman in a blue jacket sits in the cab. In front, a young man in a white T-shirt and orange trousers walks over the ploughed earth, looking at a handful of soil, and walks out of sight. A hawk on a wooden fence post spreads its wings and flies off over the field. Tall trees stand against an orange evening sky.
title: agricultural_7740

asset_description: In an entrance hall with dark green walls and a patterned tiled floor, a young woman in a lilac bathrobe, a towel wrapped around her head and black high heels stands in front of the closed front door. The door swings open, and three smartly dressed young people stand on the step holding sunflowers, a cake and a wrapped present. A black and white dog runs in ahead of them. The woman jumps back in surprise, laughing, with a hand on her head, and autumn leaves blow in.
title: ahead_of_time_7741

asset_description: Inside an indoor climbing hall, a young woman in a green top and black shorts leaps off the wall with one arm stretched up and grabs the big yellow hold at the very top of the steep grey climbing wall, chalk dust puffing from her hand. She hangs from it with her legs swinging. On the blue padded floor below, three friends in sports clothes watch, then throw their arms up and cheer. More climbers stand near a counter, and colourful holds cover the walls under a high roof.
title: aim_7742

asset_description: On a seaside promenade on a stormy day, four very different young people walk along the wet paving in a row, and the strong wind blows all of them in the same way: a man in a cream suit, a young man in a black wetsuit carrying a white surfboard, a cook in a white hat and blue apron who holds her hat, and a woman in a lilac top. Their hair flies sideways and yellow leaves swirl around them. Waves crash behind the blue railing and a gull hangs in the grey sky.
title: alike_7743

asset_description: On a calm fjord, a young woman in a red jacket, a yellow life vest and a dark woolly hat sits in a white kayak holding a paddle and smiling. Right behind her, without warning, a huge humpback whale bursts up out of the water and crashes back down in a big white splash. She turns her head, her mouth falls open in shock, and then she laughs with wide eyes. Steep mountains covered in orange and yellow autumn trees rise behind, with a small red boathouse on the shore.
title: all_of_a_sudden_7744

asset_description: In a dark wood-panelled bistro in the evening, a young woman in a white satin dress and a young man in a cream suit sit at a small marble table, lean their heads together and laugh. Together they cut a small white cake decorated with sugar roses with one knife and then lift the knife up, smiling at each other. Glasses of sparkling wine, a candle, a vase of pink roses, a wrapped gift and a bunch of dried flowers stand on the table, and a rainy street glows through the window.
title: anniversary_7746

asset_description: A small wooden drawbridge over a city canal is raised and split in the middle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket stands on one half and a young man in a navy jacket stands on the other half. Holding the white railings, they lean out over the gap of dark water and stretch their hands towards each other, laughing, but their fingers do not meet. Chains hang from the white beams above, a houseboat with plants is moored below, a bird flies past, and brick houses and autumn trees line the canal under grey clouds.
title: apart_7747

asset_description: A big workshop with brick walls and roof windows, where a team builds a giant red and gold dragon sculpture on a wooden platform. A young woman in dungarees paints its head from a ladder, climbs down, then climbs back up and paints again. A man sands its side and a young woman in a green jumper yawns and drinks from a coffee cup. Two more workers sleep on the concrete floor among paint tins, coffee cups and a pizza box, and pale pink dawn light shows through the windows.
title: around_the_clock_7748

asset_description: A bright art studio with white brick walls and paint-splashed windows. A young woman in paint-covered white trousers and a rust-coloured top throws a huge wave of blue paint from a tin onto a big canvas full of orange and pink swirls, and the paint runs down onto the floor. She laughs and throws her head back. A young man in a paint-spotted T-shirt paints the top of the canvas from a stepladder, and other young people stand at easels in the back with a plaster bust and tables of paint.
title: artistic_7749

asset_description: A pit stop on a race track at dusk. A blue single-seat race car stands on a jack in the pit lane while a crew in blue overalls works on it at top speed. A young woman in a white top throws an old tyre through the air, picks up a new wheel and pushes it onto the front of the car as the view moves in close. A young man crouches at another wheel, and a crew member behind the car holds up a round sign. Air hoses hang from a metal boom, and an empty grandstand stands in the distance.
title: as_soon_as_possible_7750

asset_description: An airport arrivals hall at night. A young man in a navy jacket walks in pulling a black suitcase. A young woman in a cream jumper and jeans runs to him, leaps into his arms and hugs him tightly, holding a bunch of pink and yellow tulips, while his suitcase falls over. On the stone floor lie the signs of a long wait: a stack of empty paper coffee cups, a half-eaten sandwich, a crumpled coat and a neck pillow. A porter pushes luggage trolleys past the sliding doors behind.
title: at_last_7752

asset_description: A restaurant kitchen seen from the doorway, through a pair of wooden swing doors with a cloth hanging over one. A young woman chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, places food on plates next to a pan of vegetables over a blue gas flame. Behind her a young man in a black apron chops greens. The viewer's hands push on the swing doors, and the chef turns towards the door and holds up her palm. Copper pans hang from a rail, lamps glow over the pass and white tiles cover the walls.
title: at_the_moment_7753

asset_description: A one-man band on a cobbled old-town square on a sunny day. A young man in a cap and maroon shirt plays an acoustic guitar and blows a harmonica held in a holder at his mouth, with a cymbal and a drum strapped to his back and a tambourine tied to one foot. A young woman with a bicycle bends down to his open guitar case, then stands up and sings along, smiling. A small scruffy dog sits by the case, and pastel houses and a stone fountain stand behind.
title: at_the_same_time_7754

asset_description: A work meeting in a bright office with brick walls and tall windows. A young woman in a bright blue blazer and cream trousers stands at the head of a long wooden table, raises a pen and smiles, then sits down and draws on large building plans unrolled on the table. A young man in a denim shirt and a young woman in a lilac cardigan lean over the plans with her. Open notebooks, paper cups and a glass water jug stand around them under black wire pendant lamps.
title: attend_7755

asset_description: A 3D-animated car repair garage. A big brown bear in blue overalls stands on his hind legs and fits the front wheel onto a shiny red sports car raised on a lift, then lets go and stands back. A raccoon in an orange overall and red cap lies on a wheeled creeper on the floor holding a spanner, then gets up and stands on the creeper. Red tool chests, spare tyres on a wall rack and an air hose fill the workshop, and autumn leaves blow in through the open roller door.
title: automotive_7756

asset_description: A young man in a white T-shirt, blue shorts and sandals waters a small vegetable garden with a hose on a sunny day, holding up a bunch of ripe red tomatoes from a plant. Behind the wooden garden fence, filling the whole background, a gigantic white cruise ship with a name on its hull glides past on the water, smoke rising from its funnel. The man looks up and speaks, then keeps watering. A deckchair, a metal watering can and pots of herbs stand on the brick path.
title: background_7757

asset_description: A jammed baggage belt in an airport arrivals hall. The view starts close on a big black suitcase and pulls back: suitcases and bags are piled high and stuck on the carousel, with a yellow suitcase on top of the pile. A young man in a cream jacket pulls hard at the black suitcase, a young woman in a camel coat holding a red suitcase watches beside him, and a worker in an orange high-visibility vest sorts the pile. Other travellers wait with trolleys by the big windows.
title: backup_7758

asset_description: A narrow town street on a hot summer day during a water fight. On a balcony a young man and a young woman tip wooden barrels over the railing, and a huge flood of water pours from them onto a young woman in a white top and turquoise shorts standing below with her arms spread wide, laughing. She turns around under the water and then faces forward again as it splashes all over the cobbles. Colourful paper lanterns hang across the street and young people with water pistols watch.
title: barrels_7759

asset_description: A mirror selfie in an elegant hotel corridor with a black and white marble floor. The view moves from a gold-framed mirror into the corridor. A young woman in a long emerald green satin gown holds up her phone, turns so the flowing train spreads across the floor, and smiles widely. A white cat walks onto the train. Behind her a young woman in a short black dress kicks up a leg and laughs, a brass luggage trolley stands by the wall, and glass lamps hang from the ceiling.
title: beautifully_7760

asset_description: A science lab with long white benches. In front, a live orange-brown octopus sits on a glass jar of water, pulls off its metal lid with its arms, slides into the jar and lifts the lid up above it. Behind it stand two silver humanoid robots with open wiring, not moving. At the back a young woman scientist in a white coat clutches her head and laughs, and a man in a lab coat holding a clipboard stares. An open fish tank, screws, notes and a coffee cup lie on the bench.
title: being_7761

asset_description: A baking contest under a white tent in a park. A golden retriever in a green jacket with a blue rosette pinned on it acts as the judge and puts a second blue rosette next to a plate of sausages, then bends down and sniffs the sausages before standing up again, clearly happy. A cat in a white chef's jacket raises its paws beside a tall strawberry cake, and a rabbit in a striped apron stands next to a tart. A chocolate cake and jugs of lemonade complete the long white table.
title: bias_7762

asset_description: A biology lab with pale green tiles and many plants by the windows. Young students in white lab coats work at black benches with a microscope, petri dishes of moss, a tray of flowers, a pile of seed pods and small glass tanks with plants. In the middle a young woman in white gloves holds a green frog in her cupped hands, holds it out towards the viewer and smiles widely. Other students hold plant pots, and a teacher in a lab coat stands in the doorway with a tray of seedlings.
title: biology_7763

asset_description: A rooftop party at dusk with city towers, strings of lights and a brown balloon floating by. A young woman in a black slip dress holds up a fork with one tiny piece of chocolate cake on it, eats it and then looks unimpressed, holding a plate with the empty fork. Next to her on the long white table stands a huge four-tier chocolate cake with burning sparklers. Her friends at the table laugh, one covering his face and one filming with a phone. Stacks of plates and a big knife lie in front.
title: bit_7764

asset_description: A cosy farmhouse kitchen with a black range cooker, copper pots and a dresser full of blue and white plates. A young man in a winter jacket and yellow scarf, his suitcase beside him, sits at a long pine table with a young woman in a lilac hoodie. A young woman with a red braid serves him a tall stack of pancakes and he starts to cut them, while a young man pours tea from a brown teapot. A cat jumps down from the dresser, a jug of orange juice stands on the table and snow lies outside.
title: board_7765

asset_description: A paraglider flies high over a bay, the viewer's hands holding the steering handles and brown boots hanging below. The flight passes right over a tall red tower of a suspension bridge and continues along the bridge, with cars driving on its deck far below. The long red bridge spans the water to green hills on the far shore above a thick layer of white fog. Other colourful paragliders in yellow, turquoise and red float nearby in the pale golden light.
title: bridge_7767

asset_description: Steep whitewashed steps in a sunny island village with blue doors, pink flowers and blue domes. A young man in a white shirt and beige shorts staggers under a huge pile of backpacks, duffel bags and a guitar case, an olive bag hanging at his side and a blue cool box in his hand. The pile wobbles and nearly slips as he struggles to hold it, his face strained. Up the steps his friends walk away from him, one carrying a crate of lemons, a woman sweeps by a door and a cat lies on a step.
title: burden_7768

asset_description: A hallway with blue walls and a patterned tiled floor. A young woman in a blue shirt and wide black trousers stands by the open front door with a travel bag and points casually through a doorway. In the bathroom behind it a large white swan stands in the roll-top bath. A young man in a green T-shirt sits on the arm of a sofa tying his shoe. The woman then lifts her bag, turns and walks out of the front door. Coats hang on hooks and botanical prints hang on the wall.
title: by_the_way_7769

asset_description: A sunny roof terrace. The view rises from open paint cans, a pink lid and a stirring stick on a dust sheet to a young woman in paint-splashed white dungarees on a stepladder. She tips a whole can of bright pink paint against a tall white wall, the paint pouring down in a thick stream and dripping onto the floor, then holds the empty can in front of her. On a wicker sofa behind her a young woman in jeans holds a drink and laughs. Potted palms and a line of small flags stand under a blue sky.
title: can_7770

asset_description: A sunny alpine valley. A marmot stands upright on a big lichen-covered rock in a meadow full of small purple, yellow and white wildflowers, then jumps down and runs off. A clear stream runs past a wooden fence and a small stone hut, dark pine woods cover the slopes, and a waterfall appears on the mountainside. Behind them rises a sharp, pointed mountain peak whose top is covered in white snow, with a plume of cloud blowing off the summit into the deep blue sky.
title: cap_7771

asset_description: A sandy beach on a bright day. A young woman lifeguard in a yellow jacket and red swimsuit kneels in the sand and presses down again and again with both hands on the chest of a grey training dummy, practising heart massage, sand flying up. A young man lifeguard in red shorts kneels beside her and counts with his hands raised. Another lifeguard in a red swimsuit jogs out of the waves towards them, past a lifeguard tower, rescue boards and colourful umbrellas.
title: cardiac_7772

asset_description: A grand pale green dining room with a crystal chandelier and a parquet floor. A big brown bear dressed as a waiter in a white jacket and black bow tie walks slowly on its hind legs, balancing a tall, wobbly tower of stacked teacups and saucers on a tray, and brings it to a round table. A young woman in a pink suit sits at the table, holds up a hand in alarm and stares with her mouth open as the tower arrives. Other tables, potted palms and tall windows fill the room.
title: carefully_7773

asset_description: A small café with pale wooden walls. A young woman with long red curly hair in a blue top tips a big glass jar full of copper coins onto the wooden counter, and the small coins pour out into a pile. Behind the counter a white goat in a green apron stands on its hind legs holding a wooden spatula, looks at the pile and then turns to her, and she smiles at it. A paper coffee cup, cinnamon buns under a glass dome, a coffee machine, mugs on a shelf and a plant are around them.
title: cent_7774

asset_description: An old-fashioned chemistry lab with tall windows and a brass chandelier. A black and white border collie in a white lab coat stands up at a wooden bench and pours a clear liquid from a glass jug into a flask held in a metal stand, and the liquid turns bright purple and starts to bubble. A young woman in a lab coat and dark red jumper laughs beside it and then holds the glowing flask while the dog watches. A stoneware bottle, a rack of test tubes and a small brown bottle stand around them.
title: chemical_7775

asset_description: A family hallway with framed paintings and a wooden floor. A young woman in a yellow jacket, far too big for it, sits squeezed into a small red toy pedal car and rolls towards the viewer, laughing, with a teddy bear on her shoulder. A beagle trots beside her. Behind her a young man takes a toy drum out of an old wooden toy chest and lifts it up over his head, and a wooden rocking horse stands by the wall. Warm light comes through the glass front door.
title: childhood_7776

asset_description: A small doughnut shop with mint green tiles and a checked floor. A young woman in a pink cardigan points at the rows of doughnuts in the glass display case: pink, chocolate, sugared and sprinkled ones on metal trays. Behind the counter a young man in a white T-shirt and navy apron picks one up with a pair of tongs and holds it up to her, smiling: a pink glazed doughnut with sprinkles. She gives him a thumbs up. A hot water urn, paper bags and cactus plants stand behind him.
title: choice_7777

asset_description: A ski resort in winter with almost no snow. The view starts close on white ski boots on skis in a muddy puddle and rises to show a young woman in a blue puffer jacket, red scarf and black trousers standing on skis on green grass. The mountain slopes behind her are brown and bare, and only a small glacier is left near the rocky peak. A snow cannon sprays a cloud of white mist, and an empty chairlift and a wooden hut stand nearby. She pulls on her gloves and looks around.
title: climate_change_7778

asset_description: A small kitchen with orange tiles and wooden cupboards. A burst pipe shoots a jet of water up to the ceiling. A young woman in a wet blue T-shirt lies on the wet floor and reaches deep into the open cupboard under the sink to turn the water valve, her face tense. The jet stops, a plastic bowl falls to the floor, and she sits up laughing. A young man in a white T-shirt stands over her laughing, holding a saucepan of water. Dishes sit in a rack by the window.
title: close_off_7779

asset_description: A wooden giraffe-feeding platform in the African countryside. The viewer's hands, in a linen shirt and a silver watch, hold out a green leafy twig, and a giraffe's head is only a few centimetres away, its long dark tongue stretching out to the leaves, every hair and spot clearly visible. The giraffe pulls the twig into its mouth and chews, looking straight ahead. A young woman in a rust top leans on the railing beside it, laughing and pointing. Flat-topped trees stand under a cloudy sky.
title: close_up_7780

asset_description: The view from inside an orange tent at dawn. The viewer's hands in mustard sleeves pull the tent door open. Just outside, only a step away, a red fox stands on the grass, sniffs at the tent and the hand holding the door, then lifts its head and looks around. Behind it lie hiking boots, a black kettle and a metal mug on a flat rock, and a canoe on the grass. Tall pine trees stand beside a misty lake, with mountains under a pale pink sky.
title: close_7781

asset_description: A breakfast table in an old dining room with a black and white checked floor and a brass chandelier. An elephant pushes its head through the tall open window and stretches its long trunk further and further across the table, past a plate of croissants held by a laughing young woman in a lilac top, towards the banana in the viewer's hand. The viewer's other hand holds a cup of coffee on the white tablecloth, and potted palms stand by the walls.
title: closer_7782

asset_description: An outdoor swimming pool on a hot day. In front, a young woman in sunglasses and a coral bikini lies relaxed on a big pink doughnut-shaped float with a drink in her hand, waves and then settles back without moving from her spot. Behind her, a young man jumps from the top of a tall white diving tower with his arms and legs spread, another person dives head first and splashes into the water, and a man climbs the ladder. Striped beach huts and people sunbathing line the pool.
title: comfort_zone_7783

asset_description: An old stairwell with a curving iron banister, tiled walls and a stained glass window. Two young men carry a heavy teal velvet sofa on the stone stairs, one at the bottom and one at the top. A young woman lies stretched out on the sofa in a cream jumper and jeans, calmly reading a book, and puts her arm behind her head, completely relaxed. Moving boxes, a palm plant and a cushion on the stairs are around them.
title: comfortably_7784

asset_description: A comedy club with a bare brick wall and dark red curtains. A young woman with long red hair in a black blazer stands on a small stage in a spotlight, holding a microphone and acting out a joke with a straight face. In the audience at small candlelit tables people laugh loudly: a young woman in blue spills her drink and bends over to pick up the glass, and a young man in a cream jumper laughs so hard that he leans forward out of his chair. Glasses and candles stand on the tables.
title: comic_7785

asset_description: A narrow hallway with dark green walls and a speckled stone floor, with moving boxes stacked around. A long orange sofa lies stuck in front of the doorway while two young men push it from behind. A young woman in a mustard cardigan grabs it and tips it up on its end, so it stands upright and can fit through the doorway. Behind her the two young men watch, and one raises both hands in surprise. A bicycle hangs on the wall and a potted plant stands by the boxes.
title: common_sense_7786

asset_description: An autumn harvest fair with hay bales, a white tent and a carousel. A long wooden plank lies across the tops of two huge orange pumpkins that are exactly the same height, so the plank is perfectly level. A young woman in a flat cap and green jacket crouches behind it checking, then stands up between the pumpkins. A young man in a checked shirt and dungarees clenches his fists, a young woman covers her mouth, and two more people watch from the hay bales. Crates of apples stand to the side.
title: compare_7787

asset_description: A wooden workbench in a rock shop. The viewer's hands in a red checked shirt hold a plain grey round stone that cracks into two halves, with grit falling down, and open it to show that it is full of sparkling purple crystals inside. A young woman in a turquoise jumper with long braids leans on the bench, smiles widely and points at the crystals. A chain cutter, a green lamp, a sack of uncut round stones and shelves of crystals are around, and red desert rocks show through the window.
title: contain_7788

asset_description: A concrete gym. A young woman in a coral sports top sits in a round metal tub full of icy water, screaming and laughing as a blonde woman in black gym clothes pours a whole bucket of ice cubes over her head. Ice splashes out onto the black rubber floor. The blonde woman lowers the empty bucket and leans over the tub laughing, while the young woman in the tub grips its edge and shivers. On the right a young man sits laughing with ice packs strapped to his knees, and people train behind.
title: cooling_7789

asset_description: A sunny street market with coloured bunting overhead. A young man walks towards the camera down the cobbled lane as a one-man band made from things at hand: he plays an acoustic guitar and a harmonica with a small horn at his mouth, a frying pan on a pole above his head, and a saucepan, spoons, a cheese grater and a tambourine swing from his body, with an old suitcase on his back. Behind him young people clap and cheer, and a young woman waves a bunch of tulips beside the fruit and flower stalls.
title: creativity_7790

asset_description: A fairground wall-of-death show at night. A rider in a helmet, goggles and a grey vest races a motorbike sideways round and round the inside of a huge round wooden drum, its headlight shining, smoke and dark tyre marks circling the boards. Above the rim young spectators cheer with raised fists while a man in a flat cap waves a red flag. The view then moves behind the spectators, who clap with raised hands as the rider keeps circling below. Strings of light bulbs and a big wheel glow in the dark.
title: cycle_7792

asset_description: A modern city square on a sunny day, with glass office towers and a tram behind. In the middle stands a tall, cracked ancient marble column with a pigeon on top. Around its base the pavement is a glass floor, and under the glass lie old stone paving and a patterned mosaic. A young woman in a dark red outfit kneels and looks down through the glass, and a man stands with a hand on the column. A young man in a blue shirt jumps a skateboard onto the glass and rolls past her as the pigeon flies away.
title: date_back_7793

asset_description: Four stacked scenes show one young woman on the same concrete rooftop beside a metal water tank, with a town and the sea behind. At the top she sits in a green armchair sipping from a morning cup; next she lies stretched out in the chair in the bright midday light and lifts her sun hat; then she drinks from her cup in the golden afternoon light; and at the bottom she sleeps under a blanket at dusk with empty cups at her feet. A tabby cat sits on the wall in every scene and turns its head.
title: day_7795

asset_description: An office with bare concrete walls. A large round wall clock shows both hands straight up at twelve. A young woman in black dives through a service hatch under a half-raised metal shutter, stretched flat in the air, and slaps a thick blue bound report down on the desk as loose pages fly off. She lands with her hands on the desk and smiles. A young man in a light blue shirt at the desk was drinking from a glass and now throws up his hands in surprise, while two colleagues behind the hatch stare in amazement.
title: deadline_7796

asset_description: A red and yellow inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass at a summer festival under a blue sky. Three young people in shorts jump on it at first, but the castle goes soft and sinks: its pointed red towers lean in and droop together, and the walls sag lower and lower until the three stand on a sunken floor. A young man in an orange T-shirt kneels in front of it beside the black air blower, its hose lying on the grass. Food trucks, white tents and people are in the background.
title: decline_7797

asset_description: A small back garden in autumn in warm evening light. A bearded young man in a rust cardigan and jeans lies back in a hammock, reading a book and sipping from a mug, then looks up and smiles. Beside him a huge heap of raked brown and yellow leaves lies unfinished with a rake in it, and a wheelbarrow full of leaves stands by a green wooden shed. Leaves cover the lawn and keep falling from the tree above. String lights hang by the open glass door of the brick house.
title: delay_7798

asset_description: A meeting in an old hall with tall arched windows, a wooden parquet floor and colourful bunting. Young people sit on rows of wooden chairs and many raise their hands high in the air. A young woman in a dark red jumper and white skirt walks in front holding a clipboard, pointing at the raised hands as she counts them, then stops and writes on the clipboard. A young man in a white shirt stands behind with his arms folded, watching. Daylight comes in through the windows.
title: democracy_7799

asset_description: A bright dental clinic. A young woman in a lilac top lies back in a blue dentist's chair, laughing with her mouth wide open. A student in a white coat and blue gloves holds a small dental mirror at her teeth. All around them, young students in teal and grey scrubs lean in to watch; some laugh and cover their mouths, and one holds up a model of a set of teeth. Cabinets, a big round lamp and a window with a tree are behind them.
title: dental_7800

asset_description: A rock-climbing spot under a big overhanging cliff at sunset, with fields and a river in the valley below. A young woman in a maroon top, black shorts and a climbing harness hangs in mid-air from a single rope, her feet off the rock, laughing as she swings. On the ground a bearded young man in a blue T-shirt holds the other end of the rope tight at his harness, leaning back to take all her weight and looking up at her. Dust rises from the gravel path, and a rope bag stands beside him.
title: depend_on_7801

asset_description: The finish of a muddy obstacle race in a pine forest. A young man covered from head to toe in mud, his T-shirt, shorts and shoes soaked brown, bows his head as a young blonde woman in a yellow T-shirt hangs a medal on a red ribbon around his neck. He lifts his head and grins proudly, and she smiles and pats his shoulder. Behind them are a tall wooden climbing wall with a net, a pool of brown water, hay bales and a table, and sunlight breaks through the clouds.
title: deserve_7802

asset_description: A narrow old cobbled street at night, lit by a wall lantern. A young man in a white shirt stands below a balcony, singing with his head tilted up as he plays an acoustic guitar with everything he has, then drops to his knees on the cobbles and keeps playing. Red roses lie scattered around his open guitar case. Up on the iron balcony a young woman stands in the arms of another young man, both looking down at him. Flower pots sit by the pastel house doors.
title: desperately_7803

asset_description: Dusk outside a stone and wooden mountain hut high among snowy peaks. A young woman in a yellow jacket and snowshoes kneels in the deep snow, then jumps up with her arms thrown in the air, laughing as snow flies around her. A young man in a green jacket and knit hat, also on snowshoes, pushes open the hut's heavy wooden door, and warm light shines out from inside. A husky dog stands by the door, and prayer flags hang across the blue evening sky.
title: destination_7804

asset_description: A wet riverside path on a cloudy spring day with blossom trees and an old lamp post. A young woman in a blue tweed jacket, white skirt and white trainers stands stuck in the middle, holding her head with both hands. On her left a brick tunnel under the path is flooded with brown water that covers the way. On her right a large grey goose spreads its wings and hisses at her, blocking the path ahead. At the end she throws her arms out wide in despair. A railway bridge crosses in the background.
title: dilemma_7805

asset_description: An open grassy airfield under dark stormy clouds. An orange and white striped windsock on a tall pole stands straight out to the right, blown stiff by a strong wind. A small tree beside it is bent over the same way, the long grass is flattened to the right, and loose leaves fly through the air at first. The view slowly rises from a muddy track with puddles towards the windsock and the moving clouds, with a low barn and trees on the horizon in the evening light.
title: direction_7806

asset_description: A cramped student room at night. A young man in a dark red tracksuit sits at a desk with his books, gripping his hair with both hands and grimacing, and at the end slams his hands down on the books. Right behind him a young woman plays a drum kit, a young woman in a yellow hoodie runs a vacuum cleaner across the rug next to his chair, and a beagle barks up at her. A tall pile of books stands on the floor, and posters and fairy lights hang on the walls.
title: distraction_7807

asset_description: A big empty flat with pale green walls, tall windows and a wooden parquet floor on moving day. A young man lies flat on his back on a bare mattress in the middle of the room, hands folded on his stomach, not moving at all. Around him his friends are busy: a young woman carrying a potted plant steps right over him, a young woman in a lilac hoodie drops a cushion onto his face, and a young man in maroon bends to lift a sofa. Moving boxes, a rolled carpet, a lamp and a bicycle stand around.
title: do_nothing_7808

asset_description: An old-style diner with a long white counter, red stools and pink and blue neon signs on the wall. A milkshake and a covered cake stand are on the counter.
title: dollar_7809

asset_description: An outdoor tennis court under dark grey clouds. More players stand at the far fence by a bench with bags.
title: dozens_7811

asset_description: An old lecture hall with wooden benches, round hanging lamps and a tall arched window with autumn leaves outside. A young man in a green jumper sits with his chin in his hand and a faint smile, staring off into space with a pencil loose in his fingers, and knocks over his paper coffee cup so coffee runs down the desk. title: dreaming_7812

asset_description: A wet old-town square with a stone fountain in spring. asset_description: A steep cobbled street in an old city at dawn, the sky pink and the sun just coming up. The street lamps are still lit and the street is almost empty. title: early_7814

asset_description: A busy Asian market street lined with red paper lanterns and food stalls. The sun is rising low at the far end of the street, its bright light shining straight down the lane. A smiling vendor in a red apron hands food to a young woman at a stall with steaming pots, and scooters are parked along the side.
title: east_7815

asset_description: A sunny street of brick terraced houses on moving day. Behind her two young men bend and struggle to carry a mattress towards a moving van with its ramp down; one heaves it onto his shoulder. Cardboard boxes stand on the pavement and a tree grows by the road.
title: easy_7816

asset_description: A young woman in a green jumper sits at a small table in a room with wooden cabinets and warm wall lamps. asset_description: A busy railway station platform under a high arched glass roof. A train stands at the platform, and a conductor and passengers walk past and smile.

asset_description: An elegant 1920s-style ballroom with a chandelier, a herringbone wooden floor, palms and tall French doors. Through the open doors an old-fashioned cream car with spoked wheels is parked.

asset_description: An apple orchard at dusk under a purple evening sky. A long table is already laid with a white cloth, a glass jug and glasses, with benches on both sides, but no guests have arrived yet. Crates of plants stand ready in the grass.
title: eve_7820

asset_description: Under a concrete motorway bridge at night, with graffiti on the pillars and coloured string lights. Behind her a big crowd of young people in bright tracksuits cheer with raised arms, a young man in blue bows down to the ground in front of her, and she points at the camera with a big smile. A speaker stands beside the mat.
title: excel_7821

asset_description: A huge field of sunflowers on rolling hills at sunrise. A small goldfinch flutters in front of one big sunflower, then flies off over the field towards the sun. Far behind, a lone tree, a row of tall cypress trees and a dirt road lie on the hills under a pale orange sky with a few pink clouds. Large green leaves fill the foreground.
title: face_7823

asset_description: Two young people sandboarding down a huge orange sand dune under a clear blue sky. A young woman in a yellow top and black shorts crouches low on her board and speeds down in front, her braids flying and sand spraying up behind her, and she laughs. Further up the slope a young man in a white open shirt and navy shorts rides his board more slowly behind her, his arms spread out for balance. A four-wheel-drive car and a lone tree stand far below at the foot of the dune.
title: faster_7824

asset_description: A cosy living room with wood-panelled walls, a glowing orange lamp and a thick rust-coloured rug. A black Labrador walks over a big pile of colourful soft toys in front of an open cardboard box, carrying only one of them in its mouth, a yellow rubber duck, and lies down with it. A young woman in a green top kneels on the rug laughing, holding up a toy fox that the dog ignores. Plants, records and a brown sofa fill the room.
title: favorite_7826

asset_description: A frozen lake in winter at sunrise, with snowy pine trees and a small red wooden sauna cabin. A young man kneeling on the snow pulls his dark red hoodie off over his head and drops it, raises his hands with a resigned grin, his bare chest in the cold air, and starts to get up to join her. A husky stands by the cabin, and a pair of boots stands in the snow.
title: fine_7827

asset_description: A wooden boardwalk crossing the dunes towards a beach on a sunny evening. The boardwalk simply stops, its end dropping into the soft white sand. Behind him a young blonde woman rides a skateboard along the boardwalk, and friends walk up with a surfboard and a cool box.
title: finish_7828

asset_description: A tug of war on a sunny tropical beach with palm trees and a volleyball net. A young woman in a coral bikini top and black shorts holds her end of the thick rope alone, feet dug deep into the sand, calm and smiling. Friends watch from behind, one holding her head in disbelief.

asset_description: An opening night in an art gallery with white brick walls, spotlights and a big blue and orange painting. Behind them a young woman in a red top covers her eyes in embarrassment, and other guests stand around.
title: first_impression_7831

asset_description: A bright kitchen with blue patterned tiles, open shelves and a wicker lamp. A young woman in a mustard T-shirt kneels up on a wooden chair and raises one finger high in the air as she starts to list her points, then lowers her hand and points across the table. Across the breakfast table a young man in a white T-shirt holds his face in his hand, laughs and then hides his face. Mugs, bowls and a frying pan with eggs cover the table, and a ginger cat sits on the counter behind him.
title: first_of_all_7832

asset_description: The open door of a bright whitewashed hotel room with a sea view and a balcony. In the doorway a young man in a blue shirt stands with the suitcases, smiling and laughing. Pink flowers stand by the bed and patterned tiles cover the floor.
title: firstly_7833

asset_description: A street-food market at night lit by paper lanterns under brick arches. A young woman in a black leather jacket takes a big bite of a folded taco, eyes shut and head tilted back with pleasure, and keeps chewing happily. Two friends beside her bite into their own tacos. Small bowls of red and green salsa and lime wedges stand on the long wooden table, and behind them a cook in a red cap turns tortillas on a hot griddle at a stall, then folds his arms.
title: flavor_7834

asset_description: A snowy volcano at dusk with no people. Bare birch trees and a small pool stand in the snow beside the flow, and black lava rocks fill the foreground.
title: flow_7835

asset_description: A cosy pub with dark green tiles, a roaring fireplace and paintings of horses. A young woman in a dark red top leans over a wooden table, eyes fixed on a tall wooden block tower, and carefully pushes out one block with a single finger. Behind her two friends shout, wave and gasp to distract her, one holding a paper bag, but she never looks up and then points at the tower. Drinks and a bowl of crisps sit on the table, and a spaniel under it wakes and lifts its head.
title: focus_7836

asset_description: A pebble beach below tall layered cliffs on a windy sunny day. A young woman in a mustard jumper and navy trousers holds up a round stone with a spiral fossil in it and points along the beach, then points at the fossil while showing it to a young woman in a light blue jacket who leans in to look. A young man in a dark red jumper crouches and picks up other stones. A canvas bag with a notebook and a small hammer lies on a flat rock, and waves break behind them.
title: for_example_7837

asset_description: A young couple on a stone riverside bridge in Rome at sunset, with a great domed church on the skyline. The railing is covered in dozens of colourful padlocks. He lowers his arm, and the two turn to each other and smile. A seagull stands on the wall and street lamps line the bridge.
title: forever_7839

asset_description: A seaside promenade in a violent storm, with a tornado twisting down from black clouds over the rough sea. Around him two men wrestle a pink inflatable flamingo, a woman clings to a lamp post, an umbrella and a hat fly through the air, a striped deckchair stands by the railing and waves crash over the railing.
title: forward_7840

asset_description: The front seat of a red roller coaster car as it goes over the top of a steep drop, with the track plunging down ahead. The rider in the seat behind her, seen only by his arms and green T-shirt, grips the metal lap bar. Far below lie an amusement park with a Ferris wheel, colourful rides, a lake and trees under a bright blue sky.
title: forwards_7841

asset_description: A wooden canoe on a calm lake at sunset, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer's hands in white sleeves hold a bitten red apple and a fishing rod, with a leather bag at their feet. A loon dives under the water, leaving ripples, and a small cabin with a lit window stands among tall pine trees on the shore under a pink sky.
title: free_time_7842

asset_description: A frozen lake in winter at sunrise. A young man in a navy bathrobe stands barefoot on the snow and shakes out a wet towel; water sprays off it and the towel stiffens and turns white with frost. A young woman in a maroon puffer jacket laughs and reaches out to touch it. Behind them a woman in a blue swimsuit climbs a ladder out of a square hole cut in the ice and stands on the edge, hugging herself in the cold. Frosted birch trees, fairy lights and a red wooden cabin stand behind.
title: freezing_7843

asset_description: A sunny rustic kitchen with wooden beams and copper pans on the wall. Two women who look alike, one young and one about thirty years older, stand side by side in white tops and rust-coloured trousers. On the wooden island are a bowl of batter, a jar of honey, a stack of pancakes and a dish of oranges, and light comes through a window with an olive tree outside.

asset_description: A big striped hot-air balloon in orange, cream and blue on a grassy field at sunrise. A young woman in a blue jacket stands smiling in the wicker basket as it lifts slowly and smoothly off the ground and rises a little higher. More people and a pickup truck are in the background under a soft pink sky.
title: gently_7845

asset_description: Three young people doing fieldwork in a wide glacial river valley under a stormy grey sky. A clipboard and backpacks lie on the stones, and snowy mountains and a glacier rise behind.

asset_description: A rocky beach below a tall cliff of striped red, cream and brown rock layers. Two more students measure the cliff layers with a tall pole, and a notebook and backpacks lie nearby, with the sea and a blue sky behind.

asset_description: A rooftop dinner at dusk. asset_description: The doorway of an old university lecture hall, seen from the viewer's place. asset_description: The driver's seat of a go-kart on a sunny outdoor track, with the viewer's hands in black and red racing gloves on the steering wheel. Stacks of tyres, red and white kerbs and blossoming trees line the track.

asset_description: A cosy wooden pottery studio in winter. asset_description: A bright, warm glass greenhouse full of sunlight. asset_description: An old wooden greenhouse. An enormous pumpkin has grown so big that it has pushed out a glass pane and hangs against the broken window. A young woman with long dreadlocks, a green headscarf and work dungarees stands on a stepladder and wraps a measuring tape around it. A loose glass pane falls and breaks on the floor near the door. Thick green vines spread across the soil, a knocked-over watering can lies on the ground, and two young people stare in amazement through the glass door.

asset_description: A cosy wooden cabin living room on a snowy night. A wood stove burns, with board games and mugs on the table.

asset_description: A mirror selfie in a bright barber shop with a brick wall and colourful posters. A man in a black barber cape sits in the chair and holds up his phone, looking surprised: one side of his face is shaved clean with a little foam left, while the other side still has a full dark beard. Hanging bulbs, red chairs and a plant fill the shop.

asset_description: A slackline stretched high across a deep gorge full of autumn trees in red, orange and yellow, with a river far below. A young man in a green fleece sits by the anchor on the near rock, watches her, smiles and shades his eyes, and a young woman in a mustard jacket crouches on the far side.

asset_description: A selfie at an outdoor music festival at sunset. Two young women press their cheeks together and laugh with wide open mouths: one with long braids in a blue crop top, the other with curly hair in a yellow halter top. Colourful confetti swirls in the sky, the stage behind glows with coloured lights, and the crowd dances around them, one young man sitting on a friend's shoulders with his fist up, and a straw hat flies into the air. The sky is streaked pink and orange.
title: happily_7859

asset_description: A rooftop gym on a sunny day.
