A red towel hangs from his waistband. A young woman in a lilac sports top stands behind him and watches. A brick wall, a water tower and string lights stand against a blue sky.
title: hard_7860

asset_description: A mirror selfie in a pink shop fitting room with a dark green velvet curtain on a gold rail. A young woman with long braids and gold hoop earrings wears a short silver sequin dress and holds up her phone, grimacing with clenched teeth as she twists one arm behind her back, unable to reach the zip; she gives up for a moment, touches her hair, then tries again. Other dresses hang on hooks on the wall, a round gold stool holds folded jeans and a tote bag, and sandals sit on the wooden floor.
title: have_a_problem_7862

asset_description: An outdoor concert at dusk. A young woman in a blue satin top, jeans and white trainers climbs over the metal crowd barrier onto the stage with a huge smile, helped by a young man in a white T-shirt. A young female guitarist in a mustard shirt holds out a microphone to her, and a young singer in a black shirt reaches out to welcome her. She takes the microphone and starts to sing at the front of the stage, while the young man below cheers with his fist up. Coloured spotlights shine from the stage.
title: have_an_opportunity_7863

asset_description: A snowy city rooftop at dusk, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer holds out two hands in thick cream knitted mittens towards a round metal fire pit where logs burn with bright orange flames and sparks rise into the falling snow. A smiling young man in a sheepskin jacket leans in, puts another log on the fire and sits back. Friends in puffer jackets and woolly hats sit on benches around the fire with warm mugs, and others stand and chat behind. Fairy lights, small potted pine trees and city buildings stand behind them.
title: heating_7865

asset_description: An old-fashioned hardware shop with a wall of small wooden drawers, coils of rope and brooms on hooks. A German shepherd dog in a green apron stands on its hind legs with its front paws on the wooden counter and hands a small screwdriver to a young man with curly hair in a terracotta T-shirt. He takes it, looks at it and laughs, holding a wooden stool under his other arm, while the dog pants happily. A few screws lie on the counter, a cardboard box leans against it, and a brass lamp hangs above.
title: help_7867

asset_description: An outdoor dinner in a stone courtyard at dusk, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer twirls a big forkful of spaghetti in tomato sauce and lifts it high above a bowl on a blue checked tablecloth. A black, white and brown dog with its chin on the table edge raises its head, follows the food with wide eyes, licks its lips and keeps staring, waiting for a bite. Behind it stand an olive tree hung with warm string lights, lavender bushes, terracotta pots, a wooden chair and an old stone wall under a peach sky.
title: hopefully_7870

asset_description: A warehouse loading bay at dawn. A German shepherd dog in a yellow hard hat and orange safety vest stands on its hind legs, pushes a time card into a clock machine on the wall, then drops down and walks off with a card in its mouth. A line of other dogs in yellow hard hats waits behind, and a border collie with a card in its mouth steps up next. A round wall clock and a board of shift times hang on the wall, and a woman in a safety vest, a forklift and pallets are behind.
title: hours_7871

asset_description: A grand hotel lobby with a marble floor, gold chandeliers and a revolving door. A young man with curly hair walks forward in a dark suit and tie that does not fit him well: the trousers stop short above his black shoes and the jacket pulls at the shoulders. Beside him a young woman in a burgundy satin slip dress holds two glasses of water and laughs with her head thrown back, then falls behind as he walks on towards the camera. Other guests in evening clothes stand by a curved wooden reception desk.
title: ill_7872

asset_description: A sunny city street lined with cafes and trees. A bright yellow sports car is parked up on the pavement, its front wheels blocking the walkway beside a pedestrian crossing. A police officer in a navy uniform and cap stands at the windscreen and puts a parking ticket under the wiper. People at the cafe tables turn to watch, a young woman in an orange top walks past, and a young man in a white linen shirt and trousers rushes out of the cafe with his arms raised in protest.
title: illegally_7873

asset_description: A sunny old-town street. On a yellow plastered wall a door and a garden view are painted so realistically that they look like a real open archway. A young woman in a denim jacket, lilac top and white pleated skirt presses her hand flat against the painted door and stares at it with her mouth wide open, surprised that it is only a flat wall. Friends at a small cafe table laugh at her, one covering her mouth, and a waiter stands behind. A pink blossom tree, green shutters, red flowers and petals on the cobbles fill the scene.
title: illusion_7874

asset_description: An empty park field on a misty autumn morning at sunrise. A young man with curly hair in a brown jacket gets up from a folding camping chair, spreads a tartan blanket on the grass, then sits down on it alone and leans back, his breath steaming in the cold air. Behind him a big outdoor concert stage is still being built: a yellow crane lifts a metal lighting rig into the air, and metal fences stand around the stage. City towers are visible in the haze and fallen leaves cover the grass.
title: in_advance_7875

asset_description: A mirror selfie in a vintage clothes shop with brick walls and mustard fitting-room curtains. A smiling young man in a very loud tropical shirt with bright parrots and flowers over a white T-shirt holds up his phone with a hand on his hip. Beside him a young woman in a green cardigan and black skirt puts a hand on her chest, holds out her other palm and pulls a doubtful face. He looks down at his shirt and his smile turns into a frown. A clothes rail, a straw hat, a pink armchair and a palm plant stand behind.
title: in_my_opinion_7876

asset_description: A selfie at a lakeside campsite on a sunny autumn day. A smiling young woman in a mustard beanie, a red puffer vest and a cream fleece holds the camera. Behind her an orange pop-up tent flies through the air, lands and stands fully open in a second. A young man in a green sweater cheers with both fists up, a young man in a navy sweater holding a pile of tangled green tent poles stares with his mouth open, and a spotted dog runs around the tent. Leaves fall, and a misty lake and a wooden jetty lie behind them.
title: in_no_time_7877

asset_description: A small car repair garage with a brick wall. An old cream car is raised on a lift with one wheel removed. A young woman mechanic in a navy top and rust-coloured overalls tied at the waist holds up a worn car part next to her phone and patiently explains it to a young man in a cream knitted sweater and black trousers. He scratches his head with a wide-eyed, confused look, then his face opens into a smile as she lowers the phone. A red tool chest, oil cans and a stack of tyres fill the garage.
title: in_other_words_7878

asset_description: A narrow cobbled lane between old honey-coloured stone cottages with climbing roses. A small vintage green car is so close to the stone wall that a young man in a white T-shirt and navy trousers is squeezed into the tiny gap between the car and the wall, pressing his hand against the stones and shouting to the driver. Inside, a young woman covers her mouth with her hand in shock. A tabby cat walks along the top of the wall towards him, and flower boxes and a street lantern hang on the houses.
title: inch_7879

asset_description: A tropical beach at sunrise with no people. A tiny baby sea turtle crawls across the smooth wet sand straight towards the sea on its own, flicking up little sprays of sand with its flippers and leaving a trail behind it, until a gentle wave washes over it at the water's edge. Behind it are the sandy hole of its nest with broken eggshells and a coconut husk, and a small pale crab scuttles nearby. Palm trees lean along the shore and the low golden sun casts long shadows.
title: instinct_7881

asset_description: A low view in a sunny park looking up at a clear blue sky. Two white vapour trails left by two high planes cross each other and form a large X in the middle of the sky. The viewer's arm in a blue sleeve points up at the exact crossing point, then a laughing young woman in a lilac top and a young man in an open white shirt join in and point at it too, and a frisbee flies past. Green grass, a picnic blanket, pink blossom trees and a church spire are at the bottom.
title: intersection_7882

asset_description: A park path in spring with pink cherry blossom trees. A young woman with long wavy hair in a denim jacket, pink sweater and white skirt kneels on the petal-covered path with her arms wide open as a fluffy cream puppy leaps through the air towards her. She catches it, hugs it close and laughs while the puppy licks her face. A young woman in an olive jacket and cream trousers holding the lead smiles behind her, and a cyclist in a red jacket rides past. A green bench, a lamp post and daffodils are nearby.
title: joy_7883

asset_description: A sunny balcony with a tiled floor, green shutters and an iron railing. A terracotta pot of red geraniums falls, and a young woman in a mustard sweater and black shorts throws herself into the splits and catches it with both hands a moment before it hits the floor, while soil sprays out onto the tiles. She bends over the pot in relief and then laughs. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt watering flowers puts down his metal watering can, laughs and puts a hand to his head. Pots of red flowers sit on the windowsill.
title: just_in_time_7884

asset_description: A cosy bedroom with wooden walls, a paper lamp and a mustard bedspread. A brown hen sits on a pile of folded white towels in a wicker laundry basket on the bed. A young woman in a blue T-shirt lies on the bed with her cupped hands under the hen, catches a fresh brown egg and lifts it up, laughing in delight. In the doorway a young man in a navy sweater drops a laundry bag and stares with his mouth open, then grins. A clothes rail and framed plant prints are behind.
title: laying_7887

asset_description: An attic with wooden beams, a skylight and a work lamp. A large model railway fills a big table: tiny fields, hedges, houses, a tunnel and a station are carefully arranged, and a red steam train puffs smoke as it crosses a stone viaduct and disappears. In the foreground two hands with mint nail polish and lilac sleeves set a small fir tree onto a green hill. A young man in navy dungarees leans across the table, places a tiny piece on the far side and looks up with a smile.
title: layout_7888

asset_description: A relaxed summer afternoon under a big tree in a park by a lake. A young woman in a white blouse and yellow shorts lies back on cushions, laughs and stretches her arms. A young man in a blue vest top lies beside her and raises an arm, and a young man in an open white shirt swings gently in a striped hammock. A golden spaniel rests on the blanket and then lies down, next to a picnic basket, a jug of lemonade, grapes, books and a frisbee. A red and yellow kite flies overhead.
title: leisure_7889

asset_description: An elegant restaurant with dark panelled walls, a crystal chandelier and green velvet chairs. A man with his hair tied back, a brown suit and an open white shirt sits at a round table with a knife and fork. On his huge white plate lies only one tiny piece of fish with a sprig of herbs. A waitress in black adds a garnish with long silver tweezers and steps away. The man looks up with a raised eyebrow, then cuts the piece and lifts the whole thing on his fork, leaving the plate empty.
title: little_7891

asset_description: A narrow snowy mountain ridge high above a sea of clouds in cold morning light. A young woman in a blue down jacket, black trousers, frosted goggles and a woolly hat climbs steadily up the slope towards the viewer, holding a fixed rope with her gloved hand, her crampons biting into the snow and her face tired but determined. Behind her a man in a yellow beanie and a dark jacket follows on the same rope with his head down. The sun glows low behind the clouds.
title: live_on_7892

asset_description: A mirror selfie in the dark green hallway of a small flat. A young woman with long dark hair in a mustard sweater and grey trousers holds up her phone while a young man in a white T-shirt hugs her from behind; both laugh and he leans his head against hers. Around them are stacked cardboard moving boxes, coats on the hooks, a bicycle against the wall and mugs on a shelf. A tabby cat walks across the herringbone wooden floor and stops beside them under a hanging lamp.
title: live_together_7893

asset_description: An old, moss-stained aeroplane body turned into a home in a sunny pine forest. A young woman in a striped shirt and shorts stands barefoot on the wide wing, pegs a white sheet on a washing line and then sips from her mug. Tomato plants grow in pots beside the open doorway, rubber boots and a doormat sit by the entrance, and smoke rises from a chimney on the roof. A dog climbs up the wooden steps onto the wing past a parked bicycle, and a cyclist rides along a path behind.
title: live_7894

asset_description: A quiet old library with tall arched windows, dark bookshelves and an upper gallery with an iron railing. At a long wooden table a young man in a cream cable-knit jumper sneezes hard into his hand and his papers fly up into the air and land on the table. The young woman next to him leans back with her mouth wide open, a young man behind her rubs his face, and a woman in a dark blazer stares. Up on the gallery an older woman in a lilac cardigan leans over the railing and watches.
title: loudly_7896

asset_description: A farm in green hills at sunset. A chestnut horse with a light mane stands in long grass while a man in a blue shirt and a leather wristband holds its face gently with both hands and strokes it. The view moves closer and the horse lowers its head and half closes its eyes as he strokes its forehead. Behind them are an old stone barn with a slate roof, a gravel track, a wooden gate and white wildflowers, all glowing in warm golden evening light.
title: love_7897

asset_description: A limbo game on a sandy beach at dusk. A young man in an open light blue shirt, white T-shirt and navy shorts bends his knees deeply and leans far back to get under a thin bamboo pole between two tall wooden posts, his arms stretched out. A young woman in a green top kneels by one post and watches. Friends in swimwear behind him cheer with their arms in the air, and a young woman in a purple top jumps up and shouts. A thatched beach bar with string lights stands behind under a pink and blue sky.
title: lowest_7898

asset_description: A mirror selfie in a hotel corridor. A young woman with long dark curly hair spins in a burgundy top and skirt, and her outfit turns into a top and short skirt with a pink flamingo and green palm-leaf print exactly like the flamingo wallpaper behind her, so she almost blends into the wall. She smiles, takes photos with her phone and poses in pink heeled sandals. Behind her a porter in a burgundy uniform peeks out from beside a brass luggage trolley and stares. There is a green carpet, a gold wall lamp and a potted palm.
title: match_7900

asset_description: An attic bedroom with a leaking skylight. Water drips steadily from the wet, stained ceiling onto the old wooden floor, where a bucket and pans catch it. A young woman in a burgundy jumper with damp hair hugs a black guitar case tightly to her chest with her eyes closed. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers crouches beside her, smiles and holds out a checked cloth, then moves the pans and slips out of view as the view moves closer to her. A chest of drawers with an oil lamp is behind.
title: matter_to_7901

asset_description: A bright country kitchen with pale green cupboards, wooden shelves and an open door to the garden. A young man in a white apron and navy T-shirt stands at the stove and laughs as he flips a pancake high into the air from a frying pan, catches it and flips it again; a plate of pancakes sits beside him. At the same time, out in the garden behind him, a golden retriever digs in a raised vegetable bed, throwing out carrots and lettuces, looks up for a moment and keeps digging.
title: meanwhile_7902

asset_description: A view from a small stone platform with a railing and an old green lamp post, looking down a wide river in a town on a sunny autumn day. Two rivers come together here and flow side by side: on the left the water is clear turquoise, on the right it is cloudy grey-brown, with a sharp line where the two touch. A white swan swims into view on the turquoise side and a small boat drifts in on the right. Stone embankments, yellow trees, old houses, a footbridge and snowy mountains are behind.
title: meet_7903

asset_description: A wide selfie at a summer music festival at sunset. A laughing young woman in a straw hat, yellow halter top and denim shorts and a young man in an open orange shirt pose close to the camera, then step back and jump, both doing the same dance move with arms stretched out to the side and one knee lifted. Behind them hundreds of young people on the grass all copy the same move, and a man in a green cap dances into the front. A big white festival tent, bunting and a hot-air balloon fill the background.
title: meme_7904

asset_description: Inside an old car with tan leather seats, looking at the back seat from the front. Three young friends squeeze together on the back seat. In the centre a laughing young woman in a mustard jumper and denim shorts leans forward, then sits back with her arms crossed and her knees pressed together, with one person on each side of her: on the left a young man in a white T-shirt and blue shorts, on the right a young woman in a burgundy jumper and cream skirt. Green hedges are visible through the windows.
title: middle_7905

asset_description: A snowy city street at night with orange streetlights, falling snow and a red double-decker bus in the distance. A young woman in a red puffer jacket, white top and black trousers sits in the deep snow on the pavement, laughing, then lies back and makes a snow angel with her arms and legs. Another young woman in a navy hooded parka and black boots sits on the bench inside a glass bus shelter with her arms crossed and a cold, annoyed frown. Bicycles stand locked behind them.
title: mindset_7906

asset_description: A grand railway station with a green iron and glass roof and hanging globe lamps. A young woman in a long rust-coloured coat, dark jumper and skirt runs along the platform dragging a suitcase and reaches out towards a train that is pulling away beside her. The train leaves and the track is empty; she stops, turns towards the viewer and stares in shock with her mouth open. Behind her clothes lie spilled on the floor and a station worker in a navy uniform lowers his hand and stands watching.
title: miss_7908

asset_description: An elegant evening event in a modern art gallery with a glass roof and large colourful abstract paintings, seen from above. Guests in black suits and long evening gowns in green, red, silver and blue stand in a group, and a string quartet plays in the corner. A man in a big inflatable green dinosaur costume walks in through the open door, waddles across the floor and crouches down while the guests turn to stare. A waiter stands by the door, and white flowers decorate the tables.
title: mistake_7909

asset_description: A cosy old bar with green tiled walls and brass lamps. In the foreground a woman in a royal blue jumper and gold bracelets plays an old upright wooden piano; only her arms and hands on the keys are visible. Beside her a young man in a brown satin shirt plays a golden saxophone with his eyes half closed. Behind them a young woman in a pink satin blouse sits on a bar stool, smiling and swaying her raised hand to the tune, and a grey cat sleeps on top of the piano next to a candle.
title: music_7910

asset_description: A small, crowded kitchen at night, lit by fairy lights. On the counter stands a row of glass bottles filled with water to different levels, and a laughing young woman in a rust jumper taps them with a spoon to play notes. Next to her a young man in a white shirt drums on cooking pots with wooden spoons. Behind them a young woman blows across the top of a bottle, and friends crowd round clapping and smiling. A man in a blue shirt watches from the doorway with his arms crossed and then covers his face.
title: musical_7911

asset_description: A row of red-brick terraced houses on a sunny autumn day, with a blue and a green front door side by side. In the front garden on the left, a young woman with a long red braid, a blue jumper and yellow wellies sprays water from a garden hose over the low white fence. In the garden right beside hers, a young man in a grey T-shirt gets soaked, then points his leaf blower down and blows a storm of orange leaves back at her. A tabby cat sits on the fence and a woman waves from an upstairs window.
title: next_door_7914

asset_description: A busy old-town square on a hot, sunny day. In front a young man in a white shirt and dark tie holds a box of noodles at a street food stall, where a cook tosses noodles in a steaming wok and flames flare up. Crowds of office workers in white shirts and dark suits queue and eat noodles around the stall. The view rises to show a stone clock tower whose clock shows exactly twelve o'clock, both hands pointing straight up, above the crowded square. The light is bright and the shadows are short.
title: noon_7915

asset_description: A small rusty metal bus shelter with a single seat stands alone on a huge flat white salt plain that stretches away in every direction. There is no road, no bus, no building and no person anywhere, only cracked white ground, a shallow puddle reflecting the sky and a thin metal pole. Wind swirls dust across the plain and lifts a loose metal sheet on the shelter's roof, which flaps up and bangs down again. Dark mountains lie far off under heavy grey-blue clouds. The mood is lonely.
title: nowhere_7917

asset_description: A beach at dusk under a purple and pink sky. A huge, perfectly round, shiny silver ball lies at the water's edge, reflecting the people and the sky like a mirror. A young woman in a green sweatshirt and white trousers touches it with both hands and smiles, a young man in a checked shirt pokes it with a long stick, a young woman in a cap crouches beside it, and two young men behind them look shocked, one holding his head. A wave washes in around the ball over seaweed and driftwood.
title: object_7919

asset_description: A house party in a small flat at night, with fairy lights and a window full of city lights. In front, a young man in a dark red satin shirt holds a yellow spirit level on top of one of the small framed pictures on the wall and keeps adjusting it with a serious face, even though it already hangs straight. Behind him his friends dance, a young woman in a silver sequinned top swings her hair, and a young woman in a mustard cardigan with a drink reaches out and taps his shoulder.
title: obsession_7920

asset_description: A sunny cottage garden with a thatched cottage, a white picket fence and flowers behind. In the foreground a person in a blue top holds out a big cream towel with both hands, ready to dry a dog; beside them stand a metal tub of soapy water and a green garden hose. On the lawn a freshly washed white poodle splashes into a muddy puddle, rolls in it until it is brown, shakes itself and stands up in the mud looking pleased with itself. A brick path leads to the cottage.
title: of_course_7921

asset_description: A retro kitchen with wooden cupboards and patterned wallpaper. A young woman in a blue jumper and cream skirt stands calmly and pours orange juice from a glass jug straight down, watching it with a small smile. A young man in a burgundy shirt crouches in front of her holding out a tea towel to catch it, but the juice soaks through and splashes onto the speckled floor. She stops pouring and smiles at him while he looks up at her in disbelief. A kettle and a hob are behind them.
title: on_purpose_7922

asset_description: An industrial gym with brick walls, hanging lamps and punching bags. A young man in a navy vest and black shorts stands facing the viewer, lifting a heavy dumbbell in one hand while he holds a chocolate doughnut in the other. He keeps curling the dumbbell but stares at the doughnut with a doubtful, unsure face, as if weighing up the two. Behind him a young woman in a sports top and a young man in a white T-shirt train and move around.
title: on_the_other_hand_7923

asset_description: A sunny cobbled street with striped café awnings and white bunting overhead. A young woman in a blue blazer, white blouse and black trousers, holding a brown handbag, stops in the middle of the street and dances right there, spinning and stepping, laughing. Beside her two young street dancers in bright shell suits with a portable speaker on the ground cheer her on, and behind her a young woman in a lilac suit and other people watch and clap, some with raised hands.
title: on_the_spot_7924

asset_description: A forest trail in autumn, with golden leaves on the trees and brown ferns and fallen leaves on the ground. A young woman in a bike helmet, green top and orange vest rides a blue mountain bike down the dirt path. A large red deer stag with big antlers suddenly leaps out of the ferns right in front of her and across the path, and she brakes hard, skidding to a stop as the deer disappears. She stands over her bike, staring with her mouth open in shock, then smiles in relief.
title: out_of_nowhere_7926

asset_description: The front door of a house on a grey autumn day. The letterbox is stuffed with newspapers, and a pile of newspapers and bottles of milk sit unopened on the doorstep, showing that nobody is at home. A golden retriever in an orange high-visibility vest sits on the doormat with a cardboard parcel hanging from its neck, scratches at the door with one paw, looks up at the letterbox and then lies down to wait. From the window next door a smiling young woman leans out and sips from a mug.
title: out_7927

asset_description: A large, empty open-plan office in an old brick building late at night, dark outside the tall windows. Every desk is empty except one, where a young woman in a cream blouse sits alone, writing on papers, surrounded by piles of documents, sticky notes, a mug and a takeaway box; her jacket hangs on the chair. She keeps working, then rests her head on her hand and rubs her temple, tired. Far in the background a cleaner with a trolley and a security guard stand by the lit exit.
title: overtime_7928

asset_description: A huge car park full of cars on a sunny day. A giant blue monster truck with flame decals stands right on top of two small cars in their marked spaces, its enormous tyres crushing a red car and a white car and cracking their windscreens. As the view pulls back, a young man in a white T-shirt stands on the truck's bonnet with both arms raised in triumph. Below, a young woman in a burgundy top stands with her arms crossed looking annoyed, and a man holds his head in shock. Broken glass lies on the ground.
title: parking_7929

asset_description: A cream camper van parked in a sunny farmyard beside an old stone barn. A young woman in a blue sports top and black shorts scrubs the side of the van with a big yellow sponge, smiling. Only the patch she has already washed is clean and wet; the rest of the van is still covered in grey dust and dirt. A young man in a white T-shirt crouches beside her pouring water from one metal bucket into another, then lifts a bucket up to her. Water runs down onto the wet concrete.
title: partially_7930

asset_description: A narrow road through an alpine village on a sunny summer day, with wooden chalets, green meadows and snow-capped mountains under a blue sky. A young woman in a blue cycling jersey and helmet rides a road bike along the road towards the viewer, going by an old red tractor pulling a trailer piled high with hay, and moves ahead of it with a smile. A young man drives the tractor. A brown cow grazes in a field beside a stone wall on the left.
title: past_7931

asset_description: An outdoor basketball court at dusk with blue and orange paint, a wire fence and tall flats behind. A tall young man in a white vest and black shorts rises in an enormous jump, one arm fully stretched up with the ball above the rim, reaches the highest point, slams the ball through the hoop and hangs on the rim. He drops back down and lands in a deep crouch. A shorter young man in a navy kit stands nearby, and a row of friends in bright jackets by the fence cheer with raised arms.
title: peak_7932

asset_description: A bright modern hall with concrete walls, big windows, stairs and round hanging lamps. A tall clear box stands on the floor, almost full of white plastic balls. A young man in a blue T-shirt and cream trousers pours a stream of red balls into it from a metal bowl, so the red balls form only a thin layer on top of all the white ones. A laughing young woman in a burgundy top and dark skirt closes the lid, and he steps back with the empty bowl. A few red balls and cloth sacks lie on the floor.
title: percentage_7935

asset_description: An old-fashioned pharmacy with dark wooden shelves full of glass apothecary jars and brown medicine bottles, green hanging lamps and brass scales on a marble counter. Behind the counter a grey tabby cat in a white coat counts small white pills on a blue counting tray with a spatula, next to a small brown pill bottle, and then picks up the bottle. On the other side a hare in a red and white striped scarf, dusted with snow, waits with its paws on the counter. Snow falls outside the window.
title: pharmaceutical_7936

asset_description: A science laboratory with white brick walls, steel beams, hanging bulbs and glass cabinets. A young woman in a mustard jumper and black shorts stands on a mat on a lab bench with her hands on the large silver metal dome of a static electricity generator. Her long dark hair stands straight out from her head in every direction; she laughs, touches her hair in surprise, and then it falls back down. A young man in a light blue shirt beside the bench turns the generator's handle and looks up at her, smiling.
title: physics_7937

asset_description: A street outside a small café at sunset. A young woman in a light blue shirt and white skirt kneels on the pavement with her hands pressed together under her chin, looking up with big hopeful eyes. A young man in a white T-shirt and navy apron leans out of the café doorway, smiles and holds out a croissant on a plate, then hands it down to her and she takes it happily. A dropped paper bag and oranges lie behind her, and a woman sweeps outside the café.
title: please_7938

asset_description: A grassy hilltop at sunset with a view over a town and fields. A young woman in a light blue dress swings high and fast on a rope swing hanging from a big old oak tree, laughing with her head thrown back and her hair flying. Below on a blanket a young man in a white shirt sits cross-legged and eats chocolate cake with his eyes closed, enjoying every bite, while a brown and white spaniel jumps and runs around beside him. The light is warm, soft and golden.
title: pleasure_7939

asset_description: A cosy living room at night with fairy lights and a snowy window. A delivery man in a red jacket and bike helmet comes through the front door carrying an enormous stack of pizza boxes taller than himself and looks up at it nervously. The view widens: a young woman in a mustard jumper laughs with her hand on her head, friends on the sofa and by the window eat slices of pizza, open pizzas cover the coffee table, more boxes are piled up, and a golden retriever eats a whole pizza from a box on the floor.
title: plenty_7940

asset_description: A narrow hallway in an old flat with dark red walls, a wooden floor and a bicycle. A young woman in a burgundy hoodie and shorts stands on a wooden chair and balances a metal bucket full of water and ice on top of a half-open door. A young man crouches beside the chair, holding it steady with his finger on his lips. A young woman in a mustard top comes down the hall laughing and hurries out of view. The first woman jumps down, and both crouch by the chair, grinning and watching the door.
title: plot_7941

asset_description: A retro living room with orange patterned wallpaper, a brown corduroy sofa and a fluffy rug. A young man in an open light blue shirt and cream trousers stands smiling happily with a long orange and red snake around his neck and resting on his hand. Right beside him a young woman in a lilac hoodie screams in horror, jumps up onto the arm of the sofa with her knees raised and finally covers her eyes. A cushion and a spilled bowl of popcorn lie on the rug.
title: point_of_view_7942

asset_description: A university lecture room with a big green chalkboard and wooden desks. A young woman in a beige blazer and black trousers lunges forward and presses a piece of chalk hard into one tiny spot in the middle of the board, with chalk dust bursting out and straight chalk lines running outwards from that single spot like a star. She then steps back, stands up straight and brushes the chalk off her hands. Chalk crumbs lie on the floor, and two students stand back behind her, one holding a long wooden pointer.
title: point_7943

asset_description: A sunny old-town square with stone buildings, iron balconies, café chairs and a stone fountain. Two tall clear tubes stand on the paving: one is filling with green tennis balls, the other with orange balls. A young woman in a blue denim jacket stands between them, and a young woman in a lilac top holds a green ball, bends down and drops it into the green tube. A young man with a skateboard stands nearby, a cyclist rides past behind, people watch and chat, and a pigeon flies up from the ground.
title: poll_7944

asset_description: A bright café with round paper lamps, big windows and a wooden counter. A young female barista in a black apron, laughing and waving one hand, pours milk from a steel jug but misses the cup, so the milk floods across the counter and runs down its front. A grey cat leaps off the wet counter in fright, and a young man in a brown apron leans over and wipes up the mess with a cloth. A customer in a lilac jumper watches in the foreground, and people sit and stand behind.
title: poorly_7945

asset_description: A wet street of tall stone terraced houses on a sunny autumn day with yellow leaves blowing about. A black dog in a red postman's cap and red uniform stands on its back legs at a round red pillar postbox and empties the letters from its open door into a big canvas mail sack. It then drops onto all fours and trots off with the sack on its back towards a small red mail van at the kerb, where a black and white collie leans out of the window and watches.
title: postal_7946

asset_description: An old-fashioned grocery shop with wooden shelves of glass jars, hanging hams and glowing wall lamps. On a white marble counter stands a brass balance scale: a small block of butter on paper sits on one pan and a single brass weight on the other, the two in balance. A raccoon in a white apron stands on the counter beside the scale, then leans across it and pulls the butter off the pan. A young woman in a burgundy top with a wicker basket watches, laughs and covers her mouth with her hand.
title: pound_7947

asset_description: A small city park in spring, with pink blossom trees and blocks of flats behind. A young woman in a lilac jacket hurries past, clutching her tiny dog to her chest and staring back with a worried face, and leaves the view. Behind her a large black and tan rottweiler lies calmly on the grass with a small grey kitten standing on its head, while a smiling young woman in a yellow hoodie crouches beside it and strokes it. A man in a navy T-shirt holds a small terrier on a lead.
title: prejudice_7949

asset_description: A sandy beach at sunset. A detailed sandcastle with towers and a little flag stands at the edge of the sea, covered by a big clear glass dome. A wave crashes against the dome and sprays white foam, then washes around it, but the sandcastle inside stays dry and whole. A laughing young woman in a white shirt kneels in the surf holding the dome, a young man in blue shorts kneels on the other side holding it too, and a woman in a yellow top and denim shorts throws her arms up and cheers behind them.
title: preserve_7950

asset_description: An industrial gym with brick walls, steel beams and big windows. A young man in a white vest and black shorts stands in front of a tall mirror, raises his arms and flexes both biceps, and his reflection shows him smiling broadly at himself with his chest out. A barbell with black plates lies on the floor behind him. A young woman in a black top and blue shorts smiles and claps beside him, and another man exercises in the background.
title: proudly_7951

asset_description: A calm, old-fashioned consulting room. A young man in a rust T-shirt and beige trousers lies on a green velvet sofa, talking and gesturing with his hands, and at the end rests his hands on his chest. Behind him a young woman in a green jumper sits on a wooden chair with a notebook, listening closely with a slight smile. The room has a tall floor lamp, a deep red curtain, a green tiled stove, a glass of water on a side table, a patterned rug and a herringbone wooden floor.
title: psychology_7952

asset_description: A sunny city street. A young man in a navy suit, with his blue tie flying and a black briefcase under his arm, pulls hard on the handle of a glass office door and then pushes against the glass with his flat hand, but the building stays locked. Behind him the street is closed to traffic and full of people with the day off: a woman in a yellow top and red skirt dances, a man jumps to catch a frisbee, a cyclist rides past and friends sit on blankets under colourful bunting.
title: public_holiday_7953

asset_description: A warm kitchen with brass wall lamps and a black and white tiled floor. A golden retriever in a chef's hat and apron stands up at a marble counter beside a round almond tart cut into four equal pieces. With a gold server it lifts one of the four pieces out and lays it on the white plate that a laughing young man with curly black hair, in a light blue shirt, holds out. Three pieces remain in the tin, and a frosted cake stands on a stand behind them.
title: quarter_7954

asset_description: A five-a-side football pitch in a netted cage on a city rooftop at night, lit by floodlights. A young woman goalkeeper in a blue shirt, black shorts and gloves dives sideways high in the air and stretches one arm up to tip the ball away from the goal. She lands on the artificial grass and smiles. A young man in a white shirt and maroon shorts, who has just kicked the ball, holds his head, then laughs and walks towards her. Water bottles stand by the post and lit towers fill the background.
title: quick_7955

asset_description: A pit stop at a motor race under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a black and teal team suit and helmet kneels by the front wheel of a racing car, pressing a wheel gun onto it as sparks and smoke fly. Next to her another crew member holds an old tyre, a mechanic holds up a round stop sign, and wheel nuts lie scattered on the asphalt. When she is done she raises one arm high. Team members lean over the pit wall above, shouting and pointing.
title: quickly_7956

asset_description: A grand wood-panelled library with tall windows and green desk lamps. A young woman in a cream cardigan, navy skirt and black loafers kneels on the herringbone floor and very carefully gathers a tall, wobbly stack of heavy books into her arms, then slowly lifts it against her chest, her face tense as she tries not to make a sound. Around her students read and write at long tables without looking up, a man climbs a tall wooden ladder at the shelves, and a book trolley stands nearby.
title: quietly_7957

asset_description: A bright modern office lobby with a marble floor and a wall of green plants. A smiling young woman in a royal blue blazer and black trousers drops her work ID badge on its lanyard into a steel bin, then walks towards the glass exit doors carrying a cardboard box with a plant, a framed picture and a desk lamp in it. She pushes the glass door open with her free hand and steps out. Behind a wooden reception desk a young man in a navy jumper watches her go.
title: quit_7958

asset_description: A rooftop party at dusk under strings of light bulbs. A grinning young man in a patterned shirt pours water from a big clear bottle held high into a glass jug of orange juice, while a friend beside him pours in juice from a carton, so the jug ends up about half juice and half water. He then lowers the bottle and laughs. Other friends laugh, gasp and grab each other's arms. On the folding table are lemons, a bowl of ice, plastic cups, a cool box and a glass of juice.
title: ratio_7960

asset_description: A bright bedroom with a carved arch and patterned tiles, seen as a selfie. A smiling young woman with curly hair in a cream cardigan sits up in bed under a knitted blanket, holding up a mug and looking well again. A beagle walks across the bed, sniffs and licks her face, and she sips from her mug. Behind her a blonde woman in a blue jumper opens the curtains to let the sunshine in, and a man in a mustard T-shirt clears a bedside table and then stands smiling.
title: recovery_7961

asset_description: Friends sitting on a rug on a city rooftop at sunset. Five young people each pull a slice of pepperoni pizza away from a large open pizza box, with melted cheese stretching, and start eating and laughing. Most of the box is empty and greasy, and only a small part of the pizza is left in it. Hands in lilac sleeves hold the box in the foreground and then take one of the last slices too. Drinks stand on a wooden crate, and chimneys, roofs and string lights fill the background.
title: remainder_7962

asset_description: A park path on a sunny autumn day, with a lake, ducks and a black lamp post. A young woman with a huge mass of curly light-brown hair, in a rust jumper and black leggings, jogs along the path. Right beside her an apricot poodle with exactly the same fluffy curly hair walks along a green bench on its back legs, its mouth open like hers. Behind them a young woman in a green jacket and a young man in a tan jacket laugh and point at the pair.
title: resemble_7963

asset_description: A bakery with dark green walls and brass lamps in the evening. A golden retriever in a baker's hat and apron stands behind the glass counter holding a wooden peel with a paper bag and croissants on it. It tips the peel up too far, the croissants tumble out onto the counter and one lands on a baking tray, then it raises the peel with the bag and grins with its mouth open. Apart from that, the metal trays hold only crumbs and pale marks. Street lamps and old buildings are seen through the window, and a wicker basket hangs on the wall.
title: rest_7964

asset_description: A living room at night with rain on the window. A young woman with soaking wet hair, in a wet rust coat, dark skirt and black high heels, lies collapsed face down over a green velvet sofa, her arms hanging onto the rug and her legs up on the cushions. Her tote bag lies dropped on the floor. A black cat leaps off the sofa and walks away. A young man in a navy hoodie sits on a chair holding a mug, stares at her, then gets up, leans over and pats her on the back with a smile.
title: rough_day_7965

asset_description: Deep inside a dark cave with wet striped rock walls. A young man in a black jacket kneels against the rock holding a small torch with only a weak orange glow. Beside him a young woman with red braids, in a blue jacket, holds a white torch that shines brightly at first, then goes completely dark; she shakes it, looks at it and then looks at him with a worried face. The passage behind them is black. A coil of rope and a canvas backpack lie on the ground.
title: run_out_of_battery_7967

asset_description: An exam in a large hall with tall windows and a big clock on the wall. A tall young man in a navy jumper, the supervisor, stands at a desk and pulls away an exam paper while looking up at the ceiling. The young woman in a green cardigan sitting there holds on to the paper and keeps writing on it, desperate to finish, until he takes it from her. He stands holding the paper with his eyes closed, and she sits back with her pen in her hand. Rows of students sit at small desks behind them.
title: run_out_of_time_7968

asset_description: Inside a packed underground train, seen as a selfie. A grinning young woman in a red puffer jacket and a white beanie is squeezed against a young man in a blue coat. All around them people in winter coats stand pressed together, holding the poles and hand straps. A businessman in a suit holds his briefcase above his head to make space, and a woman holds her coffee cup high in the crowd. As the crowd pushes, the young woman's smile turns into a shocked face. Bright ceiling lights run along the carriage.
title: rush_hour_7969

asset_description: A seaside promenade with colourful beach huts and a metal railing in soft morning light. A young woman with a long ponytail, in a blue jumper and white shorts, kneels on the pavement holding an empty cone and looking down with a sad face at her pink scoop of ice cream, which has fallen onto the ground. A seagull walks up and pecks at it. A young man in a rust T-shirt kneels beside her with his own cone, puts a hand on her shoulder and then hugs her.
title: sadly_7970

asset_description: A weigh-in at a boxing gym with brick walls, punching bags and a ring. A young woman boxer with braided hair, in a black top, red satin shorts and hand wraps, stands barefoot on a tall metal weighing scale on a raised platform, flexing both arms. A man in a white shirt and black trousers slides the small weight along the scale's beam to measure her, then turns and bumps fists with her. A crowd of young people in winter jackets cheers behind them.
title: scale_7971

asset_description: The top of an old stone tower at sunset. A smiling young man in a white linen shirt leans on the lichen-covered wall, looks out, points at the view and laughs, and a second person's arms rest on the wall in the foreground. Below them spreads a wide view: red-tiled rooftops, a green river crossed by old stone arched bridges, rows of vineyards and olive trees, tall cypresses, and blue hills under pink and golden clouds.
title: scene_7972

asset_description: An old stone university building on a bright autumn morning. A man in a navy suit pulls open the big wooden doors at the top of the steps. A smiling young woman in a mustard cardigan and jeans, with a green backpack and books in her arms, runs up the stone steps, followed by a young man in a blue jumper with a backpack. At the top all three stand by the open doors, smiling and laughing. Orange and red leaves lie on the steps, and bicycles stand by the wall.
title: school_year_7973

asset_description: A sandy beach on a clear sunny morning. Two workers in olive shirts unstack white sun loungers from a tall pile, and closed umbrellas stand in a row by a lifeguard tower. A young woman in a white shirt and orange swimsuit dives through the air onto a lounger, kicking up sand, lands on it and throws one arm up in triumph. A shirtless young man runs up and puts a blue cool box on the lounger next to her, and behind them a group of young people runs across the beach with towels.
title: season_7974

asset_description: An elegant dinner in a room with gold mirrors, candelabras and a chandelier. A young woman with long braids in a blue satin dress sits at the long white table and smiles towards the others, while low beside the tablecloth, where nobody can see, she holds out a fork with a piece of roast meat to a big grey dog, which licks it. Then she lifts the fork back and sits up straight. The other guests clap, a woman in a green dress waves, and a waiter in a white jacket stands behind.
title: secretly_7975

asset_description: An old-fashioned optician's room with wooden panelling and a green and white checked floor. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, in a lilac jumper, sits in a leather examination chair wearing round metal test glasses. Her mouth is open in delight as she points at a small blue and yellow bird on a branch of red berries outside the window; the bird flies away and she keeps pointing and smiling. A man in a white shirt stands beside her holding a small lens and smiles.

asset_description: Inside a dim aquarium with concrete walls. A huge curved glass tank of blue water rises on the left, and a large sea turtle swims slowly past, right up close to the glass, moving its flippers. A young woman in a blue jumper and white trousers presses her hand flat against the thick glass wall, and a young man in a rust T-shirt stands beside her with his hand on the glass too, both smiling and laughing. The glass stands between them and the turtle, and a metal rail runs along the tank.
title: separate_7978

asset_description: A village cricket ground under a huge black storm cloud. Ground staff in navy rain jackets pull a large white cover across the wet pitch, leaning hard into it. Puddles lie on the field, a boundary rope runs across the grass, and spectators with umbrellas stand by a white pavilion.
title: set_back_7979

asset_description: A rooftop bar at dusk with string lights and tall towers behind. A young man behind a copper bar pours a drink, and olive trees in pots and rattan seats stand on the wooden deck.

asset_description: A sunny rooftop terrace above a city in warm evening light. Three young friends lean together over a blue tiled table and dip long spoons into one tall glass of ice cream sundae with fruit and cream: a young woman with locs in a cream knit top, a young man in a beige shirt and a young woman in a mustard jacket. They eat, laugh and feed each other from their spoons. Glasses of water, a jug with lemon slices and potted plants stand around them.

asset_description: A small kitchen at night with orange patterned tiles, a glowing pendant lamp and snow outside the window. A young woman with her hair in a bun, in a lilac jumper, sits at a wooden table with an open pizza box. The young man opposite, seen only by his green sleeves and hand, reaches towards the last slice. She pulls the box away, closes it, hugs it to her chest and glares hard at him, then points at him. A grey cat sits on the counter behind her, and glasses of water and napkins lie on the table.

asset_description: A bedroom on a rainy day. A young man with messy dark hair, in a white T-shirt, sits up in bed and blows his nose into a tissue, with used tissues on the bed and bedside table. A golden retriever in a light blue nurse's tunic stands on its hind legs beside the bed holding a tray with orange juice and a bowl of soup. The young man takes the tray and smiles at the dog. A white coat and a black apron hang on the door, a plant stands at the window and black shoes lie on the floor.
title: sick_leave_7983

asset_description: A rooftop swimming pool on a sunny day. A young woman in a blue bikini and a young man in navy swim shorts jump off the edge at exactly the same moment, knees tucked up, facing each other and smiling. They hit the water together with a big splash, then come up side by side in the pool, laughing. A lifeguard in red sits on a tall white chair by a pale blue wall with round windows, other swimmers stand nearby, and loungers, awnings and palm trees line the terrace above.

asset_description: A cosy wood-panelled living room. Three young friends slump lazily on a brown leather sofa doing nothing, their feet in white socks up on the coffee table: a young woman in a burgundy top, a young woman with braids in a lilac top, and a young man in a light blue shirt who yawns and leans back with his eyes closed. Behind them a young woman in green rushes past pulling a cable, and a grey cat moves along a shelf. Mugs and a crisp packet lie on the table.

asset_description: A riverside path on an autumn day, with yellow trees, a stone bridge and boats on the water. A young woman in a lilac top crouches and pulls hard on a lead, but her chubby bulldog sits almost still on the path. Behind them a young woman in a coral top and two young men run towards the camera and race past close by, and a cyclist rides away along the path. The young woman laughs while the bulldog stays where it is. Dry leaves lie on the path.
title: slower_7986

asset_description: A narrow city street at night in the rain, lit by glowing paper lanterns and shop signs. A giant tortoise plods across a wet zebra crossing, lifting one heavy foot after the other and slowly moving forward over the puddles. Right behind it a dark green classic sports car waits with its headlights on. Power lines hang overhead, a small tree stands in a lit shop window, and a fallen maple leaf lies on the wet road in front.

asset_description: A deep red rock canyon at sunset under dark clouds. A young man without a shirt, in orange shorts and a climbing harness, walks barefoot along a thin slackline high above the canyon, seen from behind. A river winds far below between the cliffs, and a small green tree grows on the rocks at the side.
title: so_far_7988

asset_description: A dim hallway at night with snow falling outside the window. She glances towards an open doorway, then stops and covers her mouth with her hand. Through the doorway a man sleeps on a sofa under a blanket and a brown spaniel lies on the floor. A small wall lamp gives a warm light.

asset_description: A huge sunflower field on a hot sunny day. A young woman with a ponytail, in a white shirt and rust shorts, stands on a wooden crate with her hands cupped around her mouth, calling out across the tall flowers. In the distance stand a stone farmhouse, dark cypress trees and an old cart under a clear blue sky.

asset_description: A concrete skatepark bowl at sunset, with palm trees, a pink sky and a colourful mural wall. A laughing young woman in a blue crop top and cream shorts rides her skateboard down into the bowl and swoops across it, her hair flying. On the edge lie the signs of a long day there: several empty water bottles, a paper bag, a jacket, a backpack and a row of worn wheels. A boxer dog rests by a boombox, and a young man sits on the edge with his board.
title: spend_7993

asset_description: A snowy shopping street in winter, with fairy lights on the shop fronts, a small Christmas tree and a tram. A grinning young man walks proudly towards the camera down the icy pavement in a huge white fluffy coat, a bright pink feather boa and a yellow knitted beanie, swinging the coat open to show it off. Behind him a young woman waves her scarf, and a group of young women in dark coats watch him, cover their mouths and laugh.
title: sport_7994

asset_description: A sunny cobbled street in an old town with pastel houses and a striped awning. A young woman in a white helmet, black leather jacket and red top rides a classic motorbike up the street and lifts it onto its back wheel as she passes the café. The café guests get out of the way: a young woman in a yellow top leans far back in her chair with her arm up, others press against the wall, and a waiter in a black apron flattens himself in the doorway. A worker in an orange vest stands at the far end.

asset_description: A tulip field in the country in soft morning light. Beside the field runs a narrow canal with a small bridge and a bicycle against a railing, and in the distance the sails of a windmill turn slowly next to farmhouses and a line of tall poplar trees.

asset_description: An old theatre stage with a gold arch and red velvet curtains. A young woman in a long gold sequinned gown stands in the centre in a bright spotlight, arms raised high, laughing. Behind her two dancers in black move in the blue shadows, one kneeling at the end, in front of a painted night city backdrop. Footlights line the front of the stage and the heads of the audience show in the foreground.

asset_description: A rooftop deck at sunset above a busy city. A young woman with long dark hair, in a sage green top and leggings, stands barefoot on one leg in a yoga pose on a mint mat, arms raised high, smiling peacefully with her eyes half closed. Behind and below her a motorway is completely jammed with cars and lorries, their red brake lights glowing, under tall tower blocks and an orange sky.

asset_description: A luxury hotel room at night, with wooden walls, a marble floor and a snowy city outside the window. In the doorway a cat dressed as a bellhop, in a burgundy uniform and cap, stands behind a brass luggage trolley stacked with old suitcases. A green armchair and a rust rug are in the room.

asset_description: A grand hotel lobby with a black and white chequered marble floor, gold columns and a starburst chandelier. Then the whole lobby shows: the dog stands on its hind legs at the desk, a laughing young woman in a cream suit points at it, and a young man in a navy shirt lifts a suitcase near a brass luggage trolley. Guests sit behind them.

asset_description: A gravel path across a university lawn at sunset, with red brick buildings covered in ivy behind. A large goose stands on the path with its wings spread wide and its neck stretched out. A young woman in a maroon sports top and shorts leaps sideways off the path onto the grass, laughing, to keep clear of it, and runs off. A young man on a bicycle rides past the goose, and a young man and woman holding coffee cups stand still and watch from a distance. The goose then folds its wings.

asset_description: A mirror selfie of a young woman with curly dark hair in a long striped shirt and cream shorts, laughing as she holds up her phone in a friend's bedroom. Behind her a young woman in a white vest and shorts, her hair in a messy bun, jumps off the double bed with a blue duvet and bends down by the bed, laughing. On the patterned rug a dachshund sniffs an open overnight bag, with socks and a toothbrush lying on the floor. The room has yellow walls, a bookshelf and an orange ceiling lamp.

asset_description: A young woman with long red hair in a cream jumper, navy trousers and yellow shoes stands on the metal balcony of a stone lighthouse with a red lamp room. She takes a striped towel off a washing line where jumpers and jeans flap in the wind, folds it, lays it over the railing and leans on it, laughing, above a grey, foaming sea. Pots of herbs stand on the grated floor, rubber boots wait by the open red door, and a cat sits in the doorway.

asset_description: Seen through the eyes of a person standing on gravel, both hands raised, a navy duffel bag flies through the air and is caught. A laughing young man with curly hair and an open white shirt kneels on the roof of a white camper van and has just tossed it down. On the left a young woman carries a rolled sleeping bag into a pale green roadside motel room, and another young woman crouches by a cool box at the van. A pink neon star glows on a pole against an orange desert sunset.
title: stop_over_8005

asset_description: An amateur football match under floodlights at dusk. On the muddy touchline a fresh player in a clean blue kit slaps hands with a tired teammate whose blue kit is covered in mud, then jogs past him onto the pitch. The muddy player walks slowly off the pitch, breathing hard. Beside the dugout players in orange training bibs and a young woman in a black jacket clap. White lines cross the worn grass, and autumn trees and a red brick building stand behind under a deep blue sky.

asset_description: A picnic in a formal park garden with clipped hedges and a green bench. A jet of water from a hidden lawn sprinkler shoots straight up through a red checked picnic blanket. A young woman in a white shirt and blue skirt jumps back in surprise, and a young man in a rust shirt holding a baguette falls back and rolls over, while a black spaniel leaps beside them. Then both crouch by the blanket and laugh as the water keeps spraying up. Straw hats and strawberries lie on the ground.
title: suddenly_8008

asset_description: A bright operating theatre with white tiled walls and a large metal operating lamp overhead. A young woman in green scrubs, a green cap and white gloves leans over an operating table covered with a green sheet and carefully works on a teddy bear with fine tweezers, a little white stuffing beside it. A young man in scrubs and a face mask stands next to her holding a metal dish. At the end she smiles. A tray of instruments lies on the table.
title: surgery_8009

asset_description: A training room with a steel table. A young man in maroon scrubs, a maroon cap and magnifying glasses practises stitching with forceps and thread on a banana laid on a green cloth. A laughing young woman in light blue scrubs, a navy cap and blue gloves sits beside him and claps her gloved hands, sending up a small puff of powder. In front of them lie a steel tray of shiny instruments and a tissue box, and behind them a man in teal scrubs adjusts a large round operating lamp.
