asset_description: A young woman climbs a steep snowy mountain slope under grey and white clouds with patches of blue sky. She wears a red down jacket, black trousers, a woollen hat, goggles, a climbing harness and crampons. With an ice axe in each hand she drives one axe into the snow, swings the other high above her head and pulls herself up step by step, close to the camera. A rope runs down the slope behind her, dark rocks stick out of the snow, and small orange tents stand further down the ridge.
title: survive_8011

asset_description: A café terrace on a cobbled square on a sunny day. A young woman in a yellow cardigan and black skirt sits at a table with a long white tablecloth, holding up a round white lid in one hand and looking down with narrowed eyes towards the ground. The young man opposite her in a white polo shirt sips from a coffee cup with wide, nervous eyes. Under the table a puddle of water spreads on the cobbles, right beside a white French bulldog sitting on the ground. A waiter walks past behind them.
title: suspicion_8012

asset_description: A selfie in a park in spring after rain. A smiling young woman with long dark hair in a lilac top and white pleated skirt holds the phone at arm's length. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt holds his denim jacket over her head like a roof and kisses her gently on the cheek, then smiles at her as she laughs. Pink cherry blossom petals drift through the air from a flowering tree, puddles shine on the path, and other people sit and play on the grass behind them.
title: sweet_8013

asset_description: A stone castle hall with tapestries, an iron candle chandelier and a fire in a carved fireplace. A young man with wavy red hair in a navy jumper and trousers stands with his hands on his hips in front of a gold-framed oil portrait of an old-fashioned red-haired man in a blue coat, who has the same face and the same pose. A young woman in a maroon jumper and black skirt points from him to the painting and laughs behind her hand, and then they both burst out laughing. A grey wolfhound lies on the floor.
title: take_after_8014

asset_description: A young woman in a long green satin dress calmly takes a mirror selfie in a bedroom, turning her head and checking her look. Behind her, her friends in sparkly party tops have given up waiting: one lies asleep face down across the yellow bedspread, another lies stretched out on the carpet among piles of clothes and stirs, and a third sits slumped against the wall. Shoes and discarded outfits are scattered everywhere, a lamp glows on the bedside table and lights shine outside the window.
title: take_ages_8015

asset_description: An open front door at night on a wet street with rain falling. A soaked young woman with wet black hair, a navy raincoat and bare feet stands on the chequered tiled doorstep, smiling, holding a small ginger kitten against her chest. From inside the hallway someone in a white jumper throws a big yellow towel over her head and shoulders, and she steps inside wrapped in it, still holding the kitten and smiling. A yellow raincoat hangs on a hook and a lantern glows above the door.
title: take_in_8016

asset_description: A sunny rooftop hotel pool under a clear blue sky. In front a young woman in a blue swimsuit lies back on a pastel inflatable ring with her eyes closed and a drink in her hand, smiling and completely relaxed. A man swims underwater beneath her, splashing, and then comes up behind her ring, while she gives a thumbs up without opening her eyes. Around the pool a young woman and man toss a beach ball, people lounge on sunbeds and striped cabanas stand under strings of lights.
title: take_it_easy_8017

asset_description: A wedding ceremony inside a tall Victorian glasshouse full of palms. A bride in a long satin dress and a groom in a cream suit walk hand in hand down a grass aisle away from an arch of white roses, raising their free arms in joy. Bridesmaids in champagne dresses dance beside them at first, and rows of guests in suits and dresses cheer, clap and hug on both sides and watch from a white spiral staircase and balcony. Soft evening light falls through the glass roof.
title: take_place_8018

asset_description: A corridor in a sports centre with dark green tiled walls and bright strip lights. A young woman in a maroon sports top and black shorts stands calmly in front of a mirror, smiling as she slowly takes a selfie on her phone and touches her hair. Behind her a young man in a blue T-shirt with a bag on his shoulder leans against the wall with his arms folded, waiting. Two young men move a stack of black mats, and a bench holds a climbing rope and a chalk bag.
title: take_your_time_8019

asset_description: A bakery doorway on an autumn street. A young woman in a lilac sports jacket and black leggings leans hard towards a tall chocolate layer cake on a marble stand of pastries and fruit tarts, her eyes fixed on it. A young man in a navy T-shirt holds her arm and pulls her back towards the street while she keeps straining forward. A baker in a white jacket behind the counter holds out a slice, and a woman in a yellow coat laughs outside next to a café awning.
title: temptation_8020

asset_description: An empty hallway with bare wooden floorboards, looking out through a wide open blue front door. A smiling young man in a white T-shirt carries a laughing young woman in a red top and denim dungarees in his arms and steps over the doorway into the house, while she raises one hand high in the air and a pigeon flies past. Inside, they stop and smile at each other. Cardboard moving boxes stand outside, a lemon tree in a pot stands by the door and a pink magnolia blooms.
title: threshold_8021

asset_description: A sunny bedroom where a young woman in a white vest and denim shorts kneels on top of an overfull silver suitcase, pressing the lid down with her weight. A young man in an orange T-shirt and yellow socks crouches in front of it and pulls hard at the zip, then falls backwards onto the floor, and both of them burst out laughing. A striped shirt and a yellow sock hang out of the gap. Clothes are piled on the bed, a white cat watches and a white curtain blows in at the window.
title: tightly_8023

asset_description: A mirror view in a clothes shop with red velvet changing room curtains and hanging rails. A smiling young woman with long braids twirls in a bright lime green tiered tulle dress and chunky white trainers, the skirt swinging out around her. Next to her a young blonde woman in a camel coat, black top and leather skirt stands with her arms folded and watches with a doubtful, frank expression. Other shoppers look through the rails behind them, and autumn trees show through the window.
title: to_be_honest_8024

asset_description: A bedroom at night with patterned green wallpaper and a crescent moon in the dark window. A smiling young woman in pink pyjamas sits on the edge of her bed winding a small brass alarm clock, puts it on the bedside table, then turns back and clenches her fists happily. A wetsuit hangs on the wardrobe, a surfboard leans against the wall, and a packed beach bag and a pair of flip-flops wait by the bed. A ginger cat sleeps on the mattress and a bedside lamp gives warm light.
title: tomorrow_8025

asset_description: A warmly lit flat as the evening begins, the sky outside the window deep purple with city lights coming on. A smiling young man with a short beard in a shiny royal blue shirt over a white T-shirt and cream trousers takes a mirror selfie, straightens his collar and poses, dressed to go out. Behind him by the open door another young man crouches to tie his shoes, then stands up and waits. A glass pendant lamp glows over a wooden cabinet with a plant and a bottle of scent.
title: tonight_8026

asset_description: A modern office corridor runs beside a glass-walled meeting room whose lower part is packed with thousands of red, yellow, blue and green plastic balls. Balls cover the concrete floor. A laughing man in a straw hat, rust shirt and cream trousers rolls forward on a kick scooter through the balls, then throws his arms up and shouts with joy. At the end of the corridor a young woman in a lilac top laughs, covers her mouth and leans out from behind the glass to watch him.
title: tons_8027

asset_description: A sushi bar with paper lanterns and a light wooden counter. In front of a laughing young woman in a pink cardigan stand two very tall stacks of empty coloured sushi plates. Behind the counter a young chef in a navy jacket and white headband leans over and points along the taller stack, counting the plates with an amazed face. The young woman waves her hands, then hides her face in her hand, laughing. Small plates of sushi, a cup of tea, chopsticks and a dish of ginger sit on the counter.
title: total_8028

asset_description: Friends sit at a long wooden counter in a noodle bar, seen through the eyes of one of them, whose hands in blue sleeves push banknotes onto a big pile of money in the middle. A young woman in a rust jumper lays down another note, a smiling man in a white T-shirt drops in coins, and a young woman in a pink top throws her arm up and cheers. The hands in blue sleeves pull back and then gather the pile together. Empty noodle bowls and glasses of water stand around it, and cooks work behind the counter.
title: total_8029

asset_description: A sunny stone square with a church clock tower, a fountain and pigeons. A man painted all over in bronze, posing as a street statue on a wooden box, suddenly bends forward, takes off his bronze hat and holds it out to a young woman in a white shirt and blue skirt. She jumps back with her mouth wide open in shock, then laughs with her hands at her chest. Her friend in a pink T-shirt grabs her arm, and an older man in a sun hat stands beside the box with his hand near his pocket.
title: unexpectedly_8032

asset_description: A seaside promenade on a sunny day. A young woman in a blue T-shirt and white shorts kneels on the paving holding an ice cream cone, while a pink scoop drops off it through the air. A beagle sitting in front of her catches it and licks its lips. She stares at the almost empty cone, covers her cheek and starts to cry. A young man in a striped apron grins from the window of a pink and white striped kiosk. Bunting, white railings, a pier, a blue bench and a lamppost line the beach.
title: unfortunately_8033

asset_description: Seen from a racing bike speeding down a mountain road, the rider's hands in blue gloves grip the drop handlebars. The road and the dry stone wall on the left blur with speed. Ahead a cyclist in a green jersey, black shorts and a helmet races downhill and leans into the bends, her shadow beside her. The road curves on past green meadows with cows, a wooden hut, a waterfall and snowy peaks under a blue sky.
title: velocity_8034

asset_description: A crowded university lecture hall in winter with wooden benches and globe lamps. In the front row a young woman in a cream beanie and a green scarf coughs with her eyes screwed shut, then blows her nose into a tissue, crumpled tissues piled on the desk in front of her. A young man behind her pulls his jumper over his nose, a young woman on the right squirts hand sanitiser onto her hands, and a young woman behind leans so far away that she ends up lying across the bench.
title: viral_8035

asset_description: A tiny attic bedroom with a round skylight, white beams and wooden floorboards, seen through the doorway. A giant inflatable pink flamingo fills almost the whole room from the bed up to the ceiling, its long neck bent under the roof beside a wicker lampshade. A laughing young woman in a mint top and white shorts is squashed against the wall beside it, one foot on the bed, pushing against the flamingo. An electric pump stands on the floor, and stacks of books and shelves are pushed to the edges.
title: volume_8036

asset_description: A university library late at night, with snowy rooftops and a dark blue sky outside the tall windows. At a long wooden table under green reading lamps, several students sleep with their heads on open books and paper coffee cups. Behind them a young woman with long braids in a lilac top and black trousers jumps high into the air with her arms and legs spread wide, lands and bounces again, full of energy. A cleaner with a mop stands at the far end of the room.
title: waking_8037

asset_description: An old blue wooden rowing boat on a lake at sunset, with pine forests and hills behind. Water lies in the bottom of the boat around a coil of rope. A woman in a mustard jumper and jeans, seen only by her arms and knees, dips a tiny teaspoon into the water in the boat and tips it over the side, one spoonful at a time. Facing her, a young man in a white shirt holds the oars, laughs so hard he wipes his eyes, and a brown and white spaniel sits behind him.
title: waste_of_time_8038

asset_description: A dark wooden house stands in deep snow on a clear winter day, with icicles hanging from the roof. A young woman in a red knitted hat, navy jacket and black trousers digs with a snow shovel, cutting a narrow path through snow as high as her waist along the house. A husky runs along the cleared path behind her and past her. She throws a shovel of snow high over the wall. Inside, an older man and woman watch through the big glass window.
title: way_8039

asset_description: A sunny back garden with a white picket fence, a blossoming tree and a small blue kennel. A young woman with long black hair in a yellow cardigan and jeans kneels on the grass, holding a golden puppy in one hand and a black puppy in the other, looking from side to side with a thoughtful, undecided face. She lifts both puppies up and smiles. A tennis ball and rope toys lie on the lawn. Behind her a young woman in a green T-shirt pours a bucket of water into a blue paddling pool.
title: weighing_8041

asset_description: A sitting room in a converted church with a stained glass window, a green sofa and pastel balloons. A man in a blue shirt and cream trousers sits on a floor cushion holding a beagle puppy that licks his chin. Tears fill his eyes and his lips tremble, then he pulls the puppy close and cries openly. Beside him a smiling young woman in a red jumper kneels next to an open wicker basket and watches, and confetti drifts through the air.
title: well_up_8042

asset_description: A football game on a park pitch on a sunny autumn day, seen from beside the goal. A goalkeeper's orange gloves are raised in the foreground while the white ball flies far to the side of the goalpost, well away from the goal. The young man in a red shirt who kicked it holds his head, throws out his arms, then covers his face. A teammate in white falls back onto the grass, a spaniel runs along the white line, and fallen leaves, tall trees and brick flats surround the pitch.
title: wide_8043

asset_description: A wedding party in a wooden barn strung with fairy lights. A young man in a light grey suit leaps high above the dance floor again and again, legs split out straight to each side, arms flung up, mouth wide open and tie flying, then lands and lunges forward with a shout. A pair of shoes lies on the floor. Beside him a couple embraces, a young woman in a lilac dress covers her mouth, the bride in white claps above her head and a man in green bends over laughing. A band plays behind.
title: wildly_8044

asset_description: A snowy clearing on a bright, frozen day. A smiling young woman in a red woolly hat, a blue down jacket, a red patterned jumper and snow boots flings snow off a shovel, then digs into the deep snow and clears more of the path. Behind her stands a small log cabin under a thick roof of snow, with icicles, a large stack of firewood, skis leaning on the wall and a red sled. A frozen lake and a line of dark pine trees lie beyond under a clear blue sky.
title: winter_8045

asset_description: An old-fashioned fabric shop with dark wooden shelves full of rolled cloth, glass jars and a brass chandelier. A smiling young woman in a maroon jumper holds the end of a long blue ribbon of fabric to the tip of her nose and stretches her other arm out straight to measure it to her fingertips. A young man at the counter, beside a navy bolt of cloth and a long wooden measuring stick, looks up and smiles, then cuts the fabric with scissors while she holds it.
title: yard_8046

asset_description: A sunny living room the morning after a party. A young woman with messy hair and pink pyjamas sits on a yellow sofa, laughing as she holds up a gold paper crown and a balloon, then looks at the crown and throws her arms up with a shout. Balloons, streamers and confetti are scattered over the parquet floor, and a round cake sits on the coffee table. A ginger cat curls up on a cushion, and behind the sofa a young man in a cream T-shirt pulls down a long streamer to tidy up.
title: yesterday_8047

asset_description: A young woman in a lilac puffer jacket and a red harness stands at the edge of a metal platform on a snowy stone bridge high above a rocky gorge, a bungee rope hanging below her. She leans forward with her arms stretched out as if to jump, then pulls back, straightens up and stops. A man in an orange jacket and a black beanie stands right next to her. She stares down into the deep drop and does not move, while behind the railing one friend cheers with raised fists and another holds her hands over her mouth.
title: hesitate_8048

asset_description: A smiling young man in an olive fleece stands inside a snowy zoo enclosure with three snow leopards. He holds a metal bucket high while one leopard stands on its hind legs and leans against his chest, another rolls on its back on the gravel and a third walks along a rocky ledge above. The standing leopard drops onto all fours, the man lowers the bucket and the leopard pushes its nose into it. Pieces of meat lie on the ground, and a large crowd of visitors watches from behind a glass wall.
title: keeper_8049

asset_description: A young man in a dark jacket and a navy beanie skates slowly along the edge of an outdoor ice rink at dusk, one hand on the rail. A young woman in a dark red jacket stands in front of him with open hands. He lets go of the rail, spreads both arms wide and glides towards her, laughing, while she laughs with him. A lit Christmas tree, a carousel and strings of lights glow behind them. He holds the rail at first, but a moment later he skates with no hands.
title: at_first_8050

asset_description: A young woman in a blue top and blue trousers stands on a stepladder in a bright server room, colourful cables hanging around her neck. She plugs a yellow cable into a tall black server rack and smiles. Below her, a young man in a grey beanie holds a big bundle of cables and looks up at her, laughing. More cables run along the ceiling and lie under an open floor panel. The two look like students of computer science who are learning how computers and networks really work.
title: computer_science_8051

asset_description: A shirtless young man sits on wet rocks in front of a tall jungle waterfall, with a rainbow in the mist behind him. He rubs shampoo into his hair with both hands, and white foam runs down his chest as the water washes it away. He closes his eyes and smiles. Three monkeys sit on the rocks in front of him; one holds his shampoo bottle and another puts its hands on its head like him. With no bathroom nearby, he uses the waterfall to have a shower.
title: have_a_shower_8052

asset_description: A young woman in a dark beanie, a muddy jacket and rubber boots stands on a grassy riverbank at dusk and lifts a heavy sandbag onto a wall of sandbags, where water is spilling through. Behind her, a long line of people passes more sandbags along; a man in a dark jacket brings the next one. She presses her bag into place. The river beside them has flooded the fields. Each of these volunteers is a patriot who protects the town in a flood out of love for the country.
title: patriot_8053

asset_description: A knife cuts into a round chocolate cake with a single burning gold candle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket is cutting it at a wooden counter, and a young man in a navy jacket stands close beside her. Two full champagne glasses stand next to the cake, and city lights shine through a rainy window at night. They laugh and look at each other, then he puts his arm around her and they kiss. The one candle shows that it is their first anniversary: one year together.
title: anniversary_8054

asset_description: A black-and-white ink illustration in the style of an old engraving. A large striped hot-air balloon floats among a few sketched clouds. A small man in a suit and tie hangs below it, holding the ropes with one raised hand while his legs dangle in the air. The balloon drifts gently up and to the side, and the man sways on the ropes. This is a balloon that is filled with hot air and can carry a person high into the sky.
title: balloon_8055

asset_description: A black line drawing on white with orange details. A bearded man in a hat and an orange shirt sits with his legs crossed on a long seat in a park and reads a book. A black-and-white dog with an orange collar sits on the ground beside him and looks up at him. Leaves fall slowly from two round trees, and the dog moves its head and tail a little. The long seat he is sitting on is a bench, and there is still room on it for more than one person.
title: bench_8056

asset_description: A flat illustration in dark blue, magenta and yellow. A woman with magenta hair in a bun and a big magenta coat holds a yellow cat under one arm and a steaming takeaway cup in her other hand. Her scarf blows in the wind, steam rises from the cup, and the cat moves its head and curls its long tail. Yellow and pink shapes drift across the dark background like falling leaves. The small yellow animal with the long tail under her arm is a cat.
title: cat_8057

asset_description: A watercolour-style illustration on white with yellow shapes behind. A young man with orange hair, a blue T-shirt and black slippers sits on the floor, leaning against a light blue cushion, and plays a small orange guitar. A shelf with books hangs above him and a big blue plant stands beside him. Small music notes appear and float near the instrument while his hand moves over it. The instrument he is holding and playing is a guitar.
title: guitar_8058

asset_description: A coloured illustration in the style of an old engraving: the head and shoulders of a man seen from the side, on a light grey background. He has a dark beard and moustache, small round glasses on a cord, a high stiff collar and a dark coat. On his head he wears a round grey hat with a dark band. The hat tips and bobs a little, and his head and glasses move slightly with it. The thing he wears on top of his head is a hat.
title: hat_8059

asset_description: A watercolour-style illustration of a living room, on white with yellow squares behind. A man with dark hair and a moustache stands with his mouth wide open in joy and wears black goggles that cover his eyes. He holds a controller in each hand, with cables running to his belt, and moves his arms up and down as he plays. Behind him a television with a blue screen stands on a brown cabinet, next to a blue vase and a plant. The black device over his eyes is a headset: it shows him a virtual world that nobody else in the room can see.
title: headset_8060

asset_description: A flat illustration built from simple shapes, on a cream background with pale sun rays and white clouds along the bottom. An orange-brown horse with a dark mane and a dark tail stands side-on, facing left. It lifts one front leg high, raises its head and swings its tail, as if it were dancing. Nothing else is in the picture. The big animal with four long legs, a mane and a tail is a horse.
title: horse_8061

asset_description: A flat cartoon illustration on a cream background with beige cloud shapes and small dots. A very broad man with a brown beard, a blue knitted cap, a red-orange shirt, braces and black boots strides to the left. He carries a big axe over one shoulder and a cut log under his other arm. His legs and boots move in a walking loop, his body bobs up and down, and the dots around him move. With his axe and the cut log he is carrying, he is a lumberjack: a man whose job is to cut down trees.
title: lumberjack_8062

asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing on white. Several rocky peaks with dark shadows stand side by side, and the tallest one stands in the middle with a pointed top. Dark fir trees grow at the bottom left, and a grey circle, the sun or the moon, sits behind the highest peak. The circle glows softly, a few birds fly across the sky and a small cloud drifts. The very high, rocky piece of land in the middle is a mountain.
title: mountain_8063

asset_description: A cartoon illustration on a beige background. A fat brown-green toad with big round eyes and red cheeks sits on top of a large red mushroom with white spots. It wears a pointed straw hat and smokes a pipe, and pale puffs of smoke rise into the air while its eyes and head move. Smaller mushrooms, grass, leaves and small white flowers grow around the white stem. The animal on top is a toad: it looks like a frog, but it is brown and heavy, with dry, bumpy skin instead of smooth green skin.
title: toad_8064
